The 2D Kitty is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was originally released on April 1, 2021 as an event rarity pet for the April Fools Day 2021 Update. It was re-released on December 16, 2025 with the legendary rarity for the 2D Tuesday event, which runs during specific hours every Tuesday. A temporary 2D Kitty is granted to every player during this event, but a permanent one can be obtained by opening 2D Boxes or trading.
wiki.notes: On April 1, 2021, the 2D Kitty could be obtained through talking to the NPC, Burt, near the Nursery, with a limit of one per player. The 2D Kitty had the event rarity, and it came fully grown, and was flyable and rideable. There was no way for a player to simultaneously possess two 2D Kitties, as only one could be obtained from talking to Burt, and it could not be traded or given away. The April Fools 2D Kitty disappeared from the players' inventories after leaving the game on April 2, 2021 and becoming unavailable. The tricks available on the old 2D Kitty were as follows: Sit, Joyful, Jump, Trick 1, and Trick 2. The 2D Tuesday event was introduced on December 16, 2025, and it occurs every Tuesday, between 12-1 AM, 8-9 AM, and 4-5 PM Pacific Standard Time. During this event, a 2D Kitty is temporarily added to every player's inventory, fully grown with friendship level 1. 2x Bucks and XP is active for 2D Kitty only for the duration of the event, though the 2D Kitty stays in the player's inventory until the player leaves the server. Players can earn a 2D Box from the Task Board by completing 20 needs on the temporary 2D Kitty. This task only shows up once for the entire day without repeating, so players can only complete it and claim the 2D Box once per week. The 2D Box has a 1.5% chance to give the player a permanent 2D Kitty of their own, or a 98.5% chance to grant a different reward. The 2D Kitty features a 2D black and white sketched-out cat, the outlines being black and the entire body being filled in white, resembling a cartoon or low-quality drawing. It has two pointy ears on top of its head as well as a small tuft of fur, two whiskers on each side of its head, two circular drawn-out eyes, 4 legs, a mouth, a waving tail, and a circle as its body. It has 2-frame animations to match its sketch-like appearance. Here are the tricks the 2D Kitty learns in order: The Neon 2D Kitty glows red on the lines that make up its body and details. The Mega Neon 2D Kitty glows in the same areas as the Neon 2D Kitty, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Expandable Friendly Home is a house in Adopt Me! that was released on August 31, 2023, along with the Expandable Hillside Mansion and the Expandable Luxury Mansion.
wiki.notes: Players can purchase the Expandable Friendly Home for 675. This house has four available expansions, which include the second floor for 500, basement for 125, rear extension for 250, and side extension for 325. These extensions can be added/removed at any time. The Expandable Friendly Home can also be obtained through trading. The Expandable Friendly Home features a regular-shaped house with a chimney and a black roof. There are two huge trees behind it, as well as smaller trees next to the house, and a pavement for a vehicle. The Second Floor adds a small block with a window above the main roof, the Rear Extension extends the rear, and the Side Extension adds a large block with a window on the left side. The default interior of the Expandable Friendly Home consists of a gray floor and beige walls. The main area has four rooms, with the front room having two large plants and pet bowls, the main room being a lounge that features a television and a fireplace, a bedroom on the left, and a smaller lounge on the right. The second floor adds six rooms, with one room having an upstairs staircase. The basement adds four rooms with one room having a downstairs staircase. The rear extension adds three rooms, and the side extension adds four rooms, with one room having raised block with a ladder. The extensions' rooms are empty by default.

wiki.availability: The African Wild Dog is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was added on July 13, 2023. It could have been obtained through buying 5 UGC items in the Accessory Shop. The least expensive UGC items cost 59 and the most expensive UGC items cost 100. For all 5 UGC items necessary to unlock the African Wild Dog, the price ranged from 295 to 500. It was replaced by the Jellyfish on January 4, 2024, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The African Wild Dog replaced the Glacier Moth at its release in the Accessory Shop. The African Wild Dog features a dark brown body, brown ears, black eyes, and a small darker brown nose. It has off-white fluff inside its ears, a tan back with brown and off-white spots, and a small brown tail with a white tip. Listed below are the tricks the African Wild Dog learns in order: The Neon African Wild Dog glows neon green on the inside of its ears, spots, tail, and front feet. The Mega Neon African Wild Dog glows in the same areas as the Neon African Wild Dog, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Agender Flag is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 9, 2022, as part of the Pride Event (2022).
wiki.notes: It was obtainable by purchasing it at the Pride Stand near the Playground for 50. Since the stand left the game on June 16, 2022, the Agender Flag is now only obtainable through trading. The Agender Flag features an agender flag with a white handle; this handle has a small yellow knob on its tip. The colors of the flag include black, gray, white, and green. On the flag, there are two strips of black, of gray, and of white. However, there is only one strip of white. It has a pet accessory counterpart, the Agender Pride Pin. To wave the flag, the player can click anywhere on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Agender Flag 2023 is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 1, 2023. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand near the Playground for 50. It can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Agender Flag 2023 features an Agender Flag, the only difference being the rainbow string that is intertwined along the flagpole and a Pride Paw Flying Disc at the top of the pole. To wave the flag, a player can click anywhere on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Agender Pride Pin is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 31, 2020. It could have been found in the Accessory Shop and taken for free. One pride pin could be taken by a player every hour. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Agender Pride Pin features a heart-shaped pin with a gold border and colors that represent the agender flag. The colors include black, gray, white, and green. This pet accessory goes on the pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Agender Rat Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on June 14, 2024, along with the Summer State Fair (2024).
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Pride Sticker Pack for 50. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Agender Rat Sticker features a cartoon Rat holding an Agender Flag in its paw.

wiki.availability: The Airboat is a common two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 7, 2024. Players are able to purchase it for 2,500 at the Beach Shop. It is otherwise obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Airboat features a boat with a blue floor and one red seat. On each side of the seat, there are two black controllers with red buttons. On the back of the boat, there is a red propeller and a light. The hull and front half of the frame around the propeller are color-customizable upon purchase. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.egg: Small Gift, Big Gift, or Massive Gift
wiki.availability: The Airplane Propeller is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released around early 2020. It could have been obtained by opening a Small Gift, Big Gift, or Massive Gift, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. As the Airplane Propeller is no longer part of the current Gifts rotation, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Airplane Propeller features a long-handled brown propeller which is connected to a small circular gray plate. By interacting with the Airplane Propeller, it will propel the player up until the player jumps or unequips the propeller.

wiki.availability: The Airplane Stroller is a limited rare stroller that was previously available through opening gifts. It is no longer obtainable through the present Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Airplane Stroller features a round, blue airplane with flat white wings on either side of its body. The front propellers and wheels of this stroller are a grayish-black color. This item can carry one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Airplane Wings are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They are obtainable through purchasing and opening the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. They are otherwise obtainable through opening Admin Abuse Boxes, purchasing them for 500 when they are on rotation in the Accessory Shop, or trading.
The Albatross is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on May 12, 2022. It can be obtained through purchasing and using a Golden Clam for 169, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Golden Clam can only be purchased and used in the Snowy Igloo Shop to tame an Albatross when the Snow Weather is active. Players have a 60% chance of obtaining an Albatross from the Golden Clam. The Albatross features two large wings on either side of its white body. It has a gray, wing-shaped liner around the edge of its beady black eyes, along with an orange beak. It also has gray feathers on its wings and tail. Listed below are the tricks the Albatross learns in order: The Neon Albatross glows cream yellow on the white part of its wings, the ends of the tail feathers, and on the eyeliner. The Mega Neon Albatross glows in the same areas as the Neon Albatross, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Albino Bat is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 28, 2020, along with the Halloween Event (2020). It can be obtained through opening a Bat Box, which was purchasable for 1,000. Since the event ended on November 11, 2020, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players or by opening any remaining Bat Boxes.
wiki.notes: There is a 20% chance of obtaining an Albino Bat from the Bat Box. The Albino Bat is a small, white bat with black circular eyes, a small pink nose, pink chest fur, two white feet, wings, a gray belly, and a small white tail. On the top of its head, it sports big, pointy ears with pink insides. Its model is the same as the Bat. Listed below are the tricks the Albino Bat learns in order: The Neon Albino Bat glows light blue on its nose, chest fur, and inside the ears, while the belly glows white. The Mega Neon Albino Bat glows in the same areas as the Neon Albino Bat, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Albino Gorilla is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was that was added to the game on March 16, 2023, as part of the Gorilla Fairground. It is only obtainable through the Premium Gorilla Box at a 10% chance for 195. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through opening any remaining Premium Gorilla Boxes, or through trading.
wiki.notes: When a player unboxes an Albino Gorilla, they will also receive the Bow Tie, the Top Hat, and the Walking Cane. The Albino Gorilla shares the same model as the Gorilla, except it has creamy, slightly tinted white fur. Listed below are the tricks the Albino Gorilla learns in order: The Neon Albino Gorilla glows yellow on its face, feet, ears, and underbelly. The Mega Neon Albino Gorilla glows in the same areas as the Neon Albino Gorilla, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Albino Monkey is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! and was released as part of the Monkey Fairground Event. As the event has ended, it is now currently only obtainable through trading or by opening any remaining Premium Monkey Boxes.
wiki.notes: Players had a 10% chance of obtaining the Albino Monkey from a Premium Monkey Box, which cost 195. The Albino Monkey uses the same model as the normal Monkey, except it is a creamy, slightly tinted white. It also has a small tuft of fur on its head. Listed below are the tricks the Albino Monkey learns in order: The Neon Albino Monkey glows bright white on its body fur. The Mega Neon Albino Monkey glows in the same areas as the Neon Albino Monkey, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Alicorn is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 21, 2022. Players are able to hatch it from the Pet Egg, Cracked Egg, Royal Egg, Basic Egg, Crystal Egg, or Admin Abuse Egg. It can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Alicorn has a light-blue and light-pink mane and tail. Its body and feet are a lighter shade of blue; it has a darkish blue horn and pastel teal wings with light-pink outer feathers. During daytime, the outer feathers and parts of the mane will appear to be white. Here are the tricks the Alicorn learns in order: The Neon Alicorn glows light blue on its mane, horn, hooves, and the edges of its wings. The Mega Neon Alicorn glows in the same areas as the Neon Alicorn, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Alien Eyes Hat is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 2, 2025. It could have been purchased in the Moon Temple for 750. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on May 16, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Alien Eyes Hat features two green stalks with eyes attached to the ends. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Alley Cat is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 24, 2023. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Urban Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Alley Cat features a gray Cat with a white underbelly, white feet, and extra layers of fur. Its head features two dark gray ears with pink insides, two beady black eyes, a pink nose with black whiskers, a white chin, and a white patch around its right eye. It has dark gray stripes on its body and tail, and part of its tail is covered in tape. Here are the tricks the Alley Cat learns in order: The Neon Alley Cat glows orange on the tuft of fur on its head, fur on its face, inner ears, nose, whiskers, chest fur, stripes, and feet. The Mega Neon Alley Cat glows in the same areas as the Neon Alley Cat, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Alpaca is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on November 16, 2023, and went off-sale on November 29, 2023. Players were able to purchase this pet in the Farm Zone next to the Accessory Shop or the Shop menu for 150. It can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Alpaca learns in order: The Neon Alpaca glows orange on the fur around its ears, head, and neck, as well as its tail. The Mega Neon Alpaca glows in the same areas as the Neon Alpaca, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Amami Rabbit is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 19, 2023, as a part of the Lunar New Year (2023) event. It could have been purchased for 250 at the Lunar New Year stand near the Playground. As its event as passed, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Amami Rabbit features a black body with dark gray ear insides, small tufts of fur on its head, a small tail, and four feet. It has black eyes and whiskers on its face. Listed below are the tricks the Amami Rabbit learns in order: The Neon Amami Rabbit glows purple on its outer ears, tuft of hair, whiskers, nose, feet, and tail. The Mega Neon Amami Rabbit glows in the same areas as the Neon Amami Rabbit, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Amber Bone is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that could previously be found when digging for fossils during the Fossil Isle Excavation (2020) event. As its respective event has ended, this item can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Amber Bone, as true to its name, features an amber-colored bone surrounded by brown rock. To interact with this item, a player can click or press their screen to throw. When thrown, the player's equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Amber Bone Sticker is an uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Fossil Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Amber Bone Sticker features a cartoon Amber Bone.

wiki.availability: The Amber Butterfly is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released as a part of the return of the Butterfly Sanctuary on June 6, 2025. As the Butterfly Sanctuary left on June 20, 2025, the Amber Butterfly can now only be obtained through trading or throwing any remaining Bluebell Flowers or Snapdragon Flowers.
wiki.notes: There is a 37.5% chance of obtaining an Amber Butterfly from the Bluebell Flower and Snapdragon Flower. Here are the tricks the Amber Butterfly learns in order: The Neon Amber Butterfly glows yellow on the edges of its wings. The Mega Neon Amber Butterfly cycles through the colors of the rainbow on its antennae and the edges of its wings.

wiki.availability: The Amber Earrings are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on October 5, 2020, along with the Fossil Isle Excavation (2020) event. Players could obtain them by talking to the NPC Henry after discovering the fossils of all the rare Fossil Egg pets. As the event has ended, the Amber Earrings can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Amber Earrings are a pair of earrings that feature an orange amber stone. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's ears or the sides of its head.

wiki.availability: The Amethyst Penguin is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 11, 2026, as a part of the Star Rewards Revamp Update. It is obtainable through hatching the Gemstone Egg, which is purchasable from the Star Rewards for 28, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 0.05% chance of hatching the Amethyst Penguin from the Gemstone Egg. Here are the tricks the Amethyst Penguin learns in order: The Neon Amethyst Penguin glows light purple on its wings, feet, and parts of its cape and crown. The Mega Neon Amethyst Penguin glows in the same areas as the Neon Amethyst Penguin, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Amethyst Skies Mega Neon Paint is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on September 19, 2025. It is purchasable in the Salon for 49 when on rotation, or obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Amethyst Skies Mega Neon Paint can be used in the Salon to temporarily change the Mega Neon color cycle of a pet, applying a cycle consisting of light purple, pink, magenta, and a darker purple. It can be used an unlimited number of times.

name: Amethyst Skies Mega Neon Pet Paint

wiki.availability: The Amethyst Skies Mega Neon Paint is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on September 19, 2025. It is purchasable in the Salon for 49 when on rotation, or obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Amethyst Skies Mega Neon Paint can be used in the Salon to temporarily change the Mega Neon color cycle of a pet, applying a cycle consisting of light purple, pink, magenta, and a darker purple. It can be used an unlimited number of times.

wiki.availability: The Ammonite Flying Disc (formerly known as the Ammonite Frisbee) is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 2, 2020, along with the Fossil Isle Excavation (2020) event. Players could obtain it by digging at the Fossil Isle. As the event has ended, the Ammonite Flying Disc can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Ammonite Flying Disc features a pinkish-orange and light blue striped shell. When interacted with, the Ammonite Flying Disc is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.egg: Small, Big Gift, or Massive Gift
wiki.availability: The Anchor Balloon is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on March 31, 2022, as a part of the first 2022 gift refresh update.
wiki.notes: There was a 7.5% chance of obtaining this item from a Small Gift ( 70), a 12.5% chance from a Big Gift ( 199), and a 2.5% chance from a Massive Gift ( 499). On November 3, 2022, the Gifts were updated with new items, and the Anchor Balloon was removed from the game. It can no longer be obtained from Gifts (even if the player bought the gift before the gift refresh), and can now only be obtained by trading with other players. The Anchor Balloon features a beige rope looped through a pale blue anchor. Just like any other balloon, its only function is allowing a player to jump higher.

wiki.availability: The Anchor Propeller is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on July 11, 2025, alongside week two of the Summer Festival (2025). Players could have purchased it for 5,200. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with the Anchor Propeller equipped, they will be propelled upwards. To stop ascending, the player can unequip the item or jump.

wiki.availability: The Ancient Dragon is a legendary pet that was released in Adopt Me! on July 21, 2022. Players are able to hatch it from the Pet Egg, Cracked Egg, Royal Egg, Basic Egg, Crystal Egg, or Admin Abuse Egg. It can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Ancient Dragon has a yellow body and wings with light-yellow webs. Its underbelly is light yellow. It has four legs, bushy white eyebrows, white chest hair, and a white beard. It also has a pair of white horns on top of its head and two small white fangs protruding from its mouth. Here are the tricks the Ancient Dragon learns in order: The Neon Ancient Dragon glows a mellow pink on its inner wings, horns, and tail. The Mega Neon Ancient Dragon glows in the same areas as the Neon Ancient Dragon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ancient Unicycle is a limited ultra-rare single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on November 3, 2022, as part of the 2022 Gift Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts. As it is no longer part of the gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Ancient Unicycle features a brown seat and middle frame. It has a slightly chipped gray wheel with a beige axis. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Angel Wings are limited legendary pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on April 28, 2022. They could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 0.19% and 0.06% chance of getting them from these gifts, respectively. As they were removed from the game on September 29, 2022, they can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Angel Wings feature a pair of white wings; each wing has a white top ridge and multiple feathers. These pet accessories go on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Angelfish is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on August 17, 2023. Players were able to purchase this pet in the Jungle Zone for 250. As the Jungle Zone has now left the game, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Angelfish features an orange fish with black and white stripes along its body and drifting orange fins. Here are the tricks the Angelfish will learn in order: The Neon Angelfish glows pale pink on its stripes, part of a fin, and part of its tail fin. The Mega Neon Angelfish glows in the same areas as the Neon Angelfish, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.egg: Small, Big Gift, or Massive Gift
wiki.availability: The Angelic Grappling Hook is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on March 31, 2022, as part of the 2022 Gift Refresh Update. It could be purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Angelic Grappling Hook features a white grappling hook with multiple side details. It has golden decorations around its sides and on its top. When used, it has a white string. By tapping or clicking anywhere on their screen, the player is pulled in the direction that they tap or click on.

wiki.availability: The Angelic Pogostick is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70 or 199 from Small or Big Gifts. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on August 22, 2025 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: It serves no other purpose aside from being a fun pogo stick to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Angelic Propeller is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! was released on March 20, 2020. It was obtainable from the first page of the Star Rewards, requiring 300 Stars to unlock. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on September 11, 2026 when the Star Rewards were revamped.
wiki.notes: The Angelic Propeller features a pair of white wings attached to a yellow pole. These wings are the same ones seen on pets that grow wings when flown by a player. This propeller also leaves behind the same trail as the default wings grown on some flyable pets. When a player clicks their screen with the Angelic Propeller equipped, they will be propelled upwards. To stop, they can unequip this item or jump.

wiki.availability: The Angler Fish is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 8, 2023. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Danger Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 25% chance of hatching an uncommon pet from the Danger Egg, but only a 12.5% chance of hatching an Angler Fish. The Angler Fish features a round blue body, white large white teeth sticking out its bottom lip, two black eyes, blue spikes, two purple fins, and a tail with a blue edge. It has a blue appendage with a glowing light on its head. Here are the tricks the Angler Fish learns in order: The Neon Angler Fish glows blue on its fins, rod/stalk, and teeth. The Mega Neon Angler Fish glows in the same areas as the Neon Angler Fish, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Angler Fish Light is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 5.5% and 3.3% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on September 29, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Angler Fish Light features a curved light-blue rod with a small white sphere attached to its tip. As true to its name, its design is meant to represent an anglerfish's esca. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Angry Eyebrows are limited ultra-rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on May 10, 2024. They could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As they were removed from the game on November 22, 2024, they can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Angry Eyebrows feature two thick, black eyebrows that face downwards. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Angus Bull is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 19, 2025, alongside week three of the Winter Event (2025). It was obtainable through hatching Crystal Eggs. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Aberdeen Angus Boxes or trading, as it left the game on January 9, 2026.
wiki.notes: There is a 4% chance of obtaining an Angus Bull from the Aberdeen Angus Box. Here are the tricks the Angus Bull learns in order: The Neon Angus Bull glows orange on its head and chest fur, horns, inner ears, tail tip. The Mega Neon Angus Bull glows in the same areas as the Neon Angus Bull, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Angus Calf is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 19, 2025, alongside week three of the Winter Event (2025). It was obtainable through hatching a Basic Egg or Crystal Egg. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Aberdeen Angus Boxes or trading, as it left the game on January 9, 2026.
wiki.notes: There is a 20% chance of obtaining an Angus Calf from the Aberdeen Angus Box. Here are the tricks the Angus Calf learns in order: The Neon Angus Calf glows light blue on its head and chest fur, inner ears, horns, and tail tip. The Mega Neon Angus Calf glows in the same areas as the Neon Angus Calf, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Angus Calf Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on December 12, 2025, alongside the second week of the Winter Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Winter 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Angus Calf Sticker features a cartoon Angus Calf.

wiki.availability: The Angus Cow is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 19, 2025, alongside week three of the Winter Event (2025). It was obtainable through hatching a Basic Egg or Crystal Egg. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Aberdeen Angus Boxes or trading, as it left the game on January 9, 2026.
wiki.notes: There is a 76% chance of obtaining an Angus Cow from the Aberdeen Angus Box. Here are the tricks the Angus Cow learns in order: The Neon Angus Cow glows pink on its head and chest fluff, inner ears, and tail tip. The Mega Neon Angus Cow glows in the same areas as the Neon Angus Cow, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Anhk Pogostick is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 20, 2022, during the Desert Weather Map Update. It can be found and purchased in the Desert Shop for 995 when the Desert Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Anhk Pogostick features a yellow pogostick with a large pyramid base. It has two yellow wings attached to its sides, each of which have blue streaks as part of their design. Between the wings, there is a red gem. There is a curved loop on the pogostick's tip. The curved loop and handles of the pogostick represent the design of the Ankh, an Egyptian hieroglyphic symbol. It serves no use other than being a fun pogostick to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Ankylosaurus is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, alongside the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024) event. Players were able to obtain it by placing 20 Ankylosaurus Fossils in the Fossil Sequencer 7000 and spending 400 to turn the fossils into an Ankylosaurus. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Ankylosaurus has a bluish-grey body with a beige underbelly. It has 4 feet with 2 toes on each. It has bumps protruding from its head and along its back. It has a white muzzle and tail club. Here are the tricks the Ankylosaurus learns in order: The Neon Ankylosaurus glows yellow on its spikes, muzzle, tail-tip, and claws. The Mega Neon Ankylosaurus glows in the same areas as the Neon Ankylosaurus, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ankylosaurus Fossil is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024) event. Players could obtain it by mining in the Fossil Isle Mine or purchasing a set of five for 360. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: During the event, once the player had at least twenty Ankylosaurus Fossils, they could put them in the Fossil Sequencer 7000 and spend 400 to turn the fossils into an Ankylosaurus.

wiki.availability: The Ankylosaurus Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Fossil Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Ankylosaurus Sticker features a cartoon Ankylosaurus.

wiki.egg: Small, Big Gift, or Massive Gift
wiki.availability: The Anna Rattle is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that could be obtained from a 2018 gifts rotation, but is no longer available and can only be obtained through trading. This toy is named after Anna, an NPC found on the left side of the Nursery.
wiki.notes: The Anna Rattle features Anna, the baby in the Nursery, wearing a pink onesie, held up on a white stick. The Anna Rattle serves no real purpose other than being a fun cosmetic toy item to interact with. To interact with this item, a player must click or press their screen to shake the rattle.

wiki.availability: The Ant is a common pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on July 21, 2022, as a part of the Basic Egg refresh. It can be obtained through purchasing and hatching Cracked Eggs for 350, Pet Eggs for 600, and Basic Eggs for 400, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 22.5% chance of hatching the Ant from the Cracked Egg, and a 10% chance of hatching it from the Pet Egg. The Ant has a red body with three joints. It has six legs, a pair of antennae, and beady black eyes. Listed below are the tricks the Ant learns in order: The Neon Ant glows yellow on its antennae and chest. It also has stripes of glowing yellow on its back. The Mega Neon Ant glows in the same areas as the Neon Ant, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Antenna is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 6, 2021. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 150 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Antenna features a pair of black swirly antennae that resemble those of an insect. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Anti-gravity Potion is an uncommon potion in Adopt Me! that can be found and purchased at the Sky Castle for 99, received as a reward for aging up pets, or brewed using the Anti-Gravity Cauldron furniture item in a player's house. The Anti-Gravity Cauldron costs 3,000 and can produce an Anti-gravity Potion every minute and fifteen seconds. It is otherwise obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Anti-gravity potion is stored in a clear, triangular shaped bottle with a slight curve in the middle. It has a dark gray cap and players can visibly see the black liquid inside. The Anti-gravity Potion allows the player to jump higher than usual from the ground. This potion can be stacked; players can drink more potions to significantly increase the height of their jumps. The effect of this potion also applies to some vehicles, causing them to fall and move slower, as well as drift when turning.

wiki.availability: The Meaty Chew Toy is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on November 3, 2022, as part of the 2022 Gift Refresh Update. It could be purchased for 70 or 199 from Small or Big Gifts. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Meaty Chew Toy features an outer layer of brown with red insides. It has a white bone sticking out of one end, which acts as a handle. It bears a similar appearance to the Ham (Topping) found in the Pizza Shop. When interacted with, the player throws the Meaty Chew Toy and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. The pet holds it in its mouth until the player picks up the item. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Anvil Balloon is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on November 3, 2022, as part of the second 2022 gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: It could have been obtained by opening a Small or Big Gift, which cost 70 and 199 respectively. The Anvil Balloon left the game as of the first 2023 Gift Refresh on April 20, 2023, and is now only obtainable through trading. The Anvil Balloon features a curved black block with corners near the top and bottom and a flattened top surface. It is presumably meant to reference an anvil, a metalworking tool. As it's a balloon, its only function is to allow a player to jump higher.

wiki.availability: The Apple is a common food item in Adopt Me! that can be purchased for 1 in the Green Groceries, received as a reward for aging up pets, or obtained through trading. The Apple was also purchasable in the Farm Shop before its removal.
wiki.notes: The Apple is a ripe red apple with a small black stem protruding from the top. This item can be used to fulfill the 'hungry' ailment on pets and babies. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. It takes three uses to fully consume.
