wiki.availability: The Apple Barrel Stroller is a limited rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on November 3, 2022, as part of the 2022 Gift Refresh Update. It could be purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Apple Barrel Stroller features a brown barrel held together by two black pieces; it has two black handlebars with blue frames and several red apples inside the barrel. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Apple Owl is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released into the Green Groceries on January 9, 2026, replacing the Ladybugs. Players can obtain it with a Golden Seed Ball, which costs 195, or through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 10% chance of obtaining an Apple Owl from the Golden Seed Ball. Here are the tricks the Apple Owl learns in order: The Neon Apple Owl glows golden yellow on its feet, eye spots, wing tips, and on the leaf attached to the stem on its head. The Mega Neon Apple Owl glows in the same areas as the Neon Apple Owl, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Arctic Dusk Dragon is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 5, 2025, alongside the Winter Event (2025). Players could have purchased it for 1,000. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 9, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Arctic Dusk Dragon learns in order: The Neon Arctic Dusk Dragon glows light blue on its wing membranes, horns, underbelly, tail, cheek spots, and on the spikes along its backside. The Mega Neon Arctic Dusk Dragon glows in the same areas as the Neon Arctic Dusk Dragon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Arctic Dusk Dragon Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on December 12, 2025, alongside the second week of the Winter Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Winter 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Arctic Dusk Dragon Sticker features a cartoon Arctic Dusk Dragon.

wiki.availability: The Arctic Fox is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 14, 2019, as a part of the Christmas Event (2019). As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by trading or by hatching any remaining Christmas Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 6% chance of hatching an Arctic Fox from a Christmas Egg. The Arctic Fox has pure white fur, a pair of beady black eyes, a black nose, and small white paws. Its inner ears are a light mauve. The Arctic Fox also has a long, quirky tail and a somewhat diamond-shaped face. Listed below are the tricks the Arctic Fox learns in order: The Neon Arctic Fox glows bright pink on its nose, feet, inner ears, and tail. The Mega Neon Arctic Fox glows in the same areas as the Neon Arctic Fox, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Arctic Hare is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 14, 2023, as part of the third week of the Winter Festival (2023). It could have been obtained for 20,000 from a Hare Box. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading or by opening any remaining Hare Boxes.
wiki.notes: Players have a 60% chance of getting an Arctic Hare from a Hare Box. The Arctic Hare features a white body and head, a circle of fur around its neck, black-tipped ears, black eyes, a black nose and whiskers, and white feet. Here are the tricks the Arctic Hare learns in order: The Neon Arctic Hare glows purple on its nose, whiskers, ear tips, neck fur, tail, feet, and the fur on its head. The Mega Neon Arctic Hare glows in the same areas as the Neon Arctic Hare, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Arctic Reindeer is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 14, 2019, along with the Christmas Event (2019). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading or by hatching any remaining Christmas Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 1.5% chance of hatching an Arctic Reindeer from a Christmas Egg. The Arctic Reindeer features a white body and feet, as well as a white head with a long snout which has two beady black eyes, two white ears with light brown insides, two light brown antlers, and a brown nose. It also has a short and gray tail. It is a white reskin of the Reindeer. Listed below are the tricks the Arctic Reindeer learns in order: The Neon Arctic Reindeer glows bright white on its feet, antlers, tail, and nose. The Mega Neon Arctic Reindeer glows in the same areas as the Neon Arctic Reindeer, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Arctic Tern is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 6, 2023, as part of the Summer Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it for 9,000. As its event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Arctic Tern features a white body with an orange beak, gray wings with black tips, with a long white forked tail. It has a black cap over its face. Here are the tricks the Arctic Tern learns in order: The Neon Arctic Tern glows bright green on its cap, its wings as well as its tail. The Mega Neon Arctic Tern glows in the same areas as the Neon Arctic Tern, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Arctic Tern Sticker is a common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on July 5, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Summer State Fair (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained by opening any remaining State Fair Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Arctic Tern Sticker features a cartoon Arctic Tern.

wiki.availability: The Armadillo is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 25, 2024, along with the Desert Egg. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Desert Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 40% chance of hatching a common from the Desert Egg but only a 13.33% chance of hatching the Armadillo. The Armadillo features a round, dark brown shell on the top of its head and back, with a beige underbelly, face, and ears. It has a light pink nose, inner ears, two beady black eyes, and four legs. Here are the tricks the Armadillo learns in order: The Neon Armadillo glows red on its nose, inner ears, feet, tail, and the darker part of its shell. The Mega Neon glows in the same areas as the Neon Armadillo, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Armchair Float is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 18, 2021, as part of the first 2021 Gift refresh. It could have been obtained by opening a Small, Big, or Massive Gift, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. It left the game as of the second 2021 Gift Refresh on September 2, 2021, and is now only obtainable through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Armchair Float features a plastic sofa with blue armrests, a white seat, and a blue backrest. It is similar to the floats that were found in the Pool Shop, and can be used on both land and water. A player can interact with this item to throw it onto a surface. When thrown by a baby, it is downsized.

wiki.availability: The Aromantic Flag is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 9, 2022. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand for 50; the Pride Stand could be found near the Playground and left the game on June 16, 2022. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Aromantic Flag features an aromantic flag with a white handle; this handle has a small yellow knob on its tip. The colors of the flag include black, gray, white, light green, and dark green. It has a pet accessory counterpart, the Aromantic Pride Pin. To wave the flag, the player can click anywhere on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Aromantic Flag 2023 is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 1, 2023. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand near the Playground for 50. It can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Aromantic Flag 2023 features an Aromantic Flag, the only difference being the rainbow string that is intertwined along the flagpole and a Pride Paw Flying Disc at the top of the pole. To wave the flag, the player can click anywhere on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Aromantic Pride Pin is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 31, 2020. It could have been found in the Accessory Shop and taken for free. One pride pin could be taken by a player every hour. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Aromantic Pride Pin features a heart-shaped pin with a gold border and colors that represent the aromantic flag. The colors include black, gray, white, light green and dark green. This pet accessory goes on the pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Aromantic T-Rex Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on June 14, 2024, along with the Summer State Fair (2024).
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Pride Sticker Pack for 50. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Aromantic T-Rex Sticker features a cartoon T-Rex holding an Aromantic Flag in its paw.

wiki.availability: The Arrow Head is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 9, 2024, as part of the Jokes Update. Since the Jokes Update left on August 16, 2024, the Arrow Head can now only be obtained through trading, or through opening any remaining Box of Jokes.
wiki.notes: The Arrow Head features a gold headband with a gold shaft, a red heart-shaped head, and a gold fletching. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Ash Zebra is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 14, 2023, as part of the Fire Dimension Event (2023). As the event has ended, players can only obtain it by placing any remaining Ash Zebra Baits into a Box Lure or Cozy Home Lure, where there is a 100% chance of catching one, or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Ash Zebra features a black body with gray stripes on its back. It has a dark and light gray mane, a gray tail, and black eyes. Here are the tricks the Ash Zebra learns in order: The Neon Ash Zebra glows red and orange on its tail tip. The Mega Neon Ash Zebra glows in the same areas as the Neon Ash Zebra, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ash Zebra Bait is a limited common food item in Adopt Me! that was released on September 9, 2023, along with the Fire Dimension Event (2023). Players could obtain it by throwing a Campfire Cookie during the event for the fifth time. As the event has ended, the Ash Zebra Bait can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Players can place the Ash Zebra Bait in a Box Lure or Cozy Home Lure to obtain a common Ash Zebra after a 30-minute cooldown. The Ash Zebra Bait features a blackened crust with a yellow to black gradient in the center.

wiki.availability: The Ash Zebra Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on March 28, 2025, alongside the second week of the Ice Dimension Event (2025). It can only be obtained through unwrapping any remaining Fire Dimension Sticker Packs, which cost 400, or trading, as it left the game on April 4, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Ash Zebra Sticker features a cartoon Ash Zebra.

wiki.availability: The Astro Ball is an ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on February 22, 2020, along with the Pet Shop refresh. Players can obtain it by purchasing it in the Pet Shop for 1,200 or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Astro Ball features a glass ball with a variety of gold rings inside, which surround a bright, shining star. When interacted with, the Astro Ball is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. As the Astro Ball bounces, it will make a squeaky sound. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Aurora Fox Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on January 3, 2025, alongside the fifth week of the Winter Festival (2024). It can now only be obtained through trading or unboxing any remaining Winter 2024 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000 until January 17, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Aurora Fox Sticker features a cartoon Aurora Fox.

wiki.availability: The Aurora Fox is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 3, 2025, alongside the fifth week of the Winter Festival (2024). Players could have purchased it for 600 until January 17, 2025. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Aurora Fox learns in order: The Neon Aurora Fox glows dark blue on its inner ears, and cyan on its face, underbelly, and around its eyes. The Mega Neon Aurora Fox glows in the same areas as the Neon Aurora Fox, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Aurora Fox Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on January 3, 2025, alongside the fifth week of the Winter Festival (2024). It can now only be obtained through trading or unboxing any remaining Winter 2024 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000 until January 17, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Aurora Fox Sticker features a cartoon Aurora Fox.

wiki.availability: The Aussie Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on February 29, 2020, and replaced the Farm Egg. It left on October 10, 2020, and was replaced by the Fossil Egg. It cost 750 and could be found in the Gumball Machine in the Nursery. The Aussie Egg is no longer obtainable through the Gumball Machine, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Aussie Egg features perked-up, dark brown ears, with a light—but dull—brown center. At the front of the egg, there is a small light-brown pouch which contains a smaller brown egg. The Aussie Egg is meant to resemble a Kangaroo that could be hatched from the egg itself.

wiki.availability: The Australian Kelpie is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 29, 2020, along with the Aussie Egg. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through trading or by hatching any remaining Aussie Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 27% chance of hatching a rare pet from the Aussie Egg, but only a 13.5% chance of hatching an Australian Kelpie. The Australian Kelpie has the bottom part of its body, its feet, and inner ears colored in a light wheat-like brown, whilst the upper part of its body fur is colored in black. It shares a similar model with the Wolf and Dingo. Listed below are the tricks the Australian Kelpie learns in order: The Neon Australian Kelpie glows periwinkle on its ears, feet, and underbelly. The Mega Neon Australian Kelpie glows in the same areas as the Neon Australian Kelpie, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Aviator Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.2% and 0.3% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On September 29, 2022, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Aviator Hat was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Aviator Hat features a brown hat with two flaps; there is a gray circle on each flap. On the top of the hat there is a set of gray goggles, held in place by a dark brown band. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Aviators are uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that can be found and bought in the Accessory Shop for 250, or obtained through trading. New players were also able to obtain them from a special task on the Task Board on the first day of joining the game until the Task Board Revamp Update on November 14, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Aviators feature large, round sunglasses with two metal pieces connecting the black tinted lenses. These pet accessories can be worn on a pet's face and over its eyes. They appear to be similar to the free Aviators on the Roblox Catalog.

wiki.availability: The Avocado Robinado Plush is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It can be opened from Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. It can otherwise be obtained through opening Admin Abuse Boxes or trading.
wiki.notes: The Avocado Robinado Plush serves no purpose other than just being a cosmetic and interactable item. To hug this toy, the player can click on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Axe Rattle is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 18, 2019, along with the Halloween Event (2019). Players could purchase it in the Candy Trading Shop for 2,500. As the event has ended, the Axe Rattle can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Axe Rattle features a curved brown handle, a dark gray axe head and a light gray edge. To interact with the Axe Rattle, the player can click on their screen to shake it.

wiki.availability: The Axel is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was previously obtainable in the Supercars Pack, which cost 1,000. As the Supercars Pack has left the game, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Axel is a blue supercar with normal glass windows, yellow headlights, and black tires with plain white rims. The Axel is based on the Lamborghini Veneno; however, it is more squished, and lifted slightly higher off the ground compared to the real-life Veneno. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Axolotl is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 26, 2021. Players could purchase it in the Pet Shop or on the Shop menu for 600. As the Axolotl ended up in the Final Stop Shop at a price of 400 and left the game on May 18, 2023, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: For the first two weeks of the Axolotl's release, the 2021 Summer Sale began, where the Axolotl came with a 50% discount. The Axolotl has a pink body with darker pink spots on its back, a rounded snout, pink round feet, and a pink tail. It has brown nostrils, two black beady eyes, and six dark pink gills with dark reddish-pink insides. Here are the tricks the Axolotl learns in order: The Neon Axolotl glows a bright yellow color inside its gills, and on the spots that run down from the top of its head to the end of the tail. The Mega Neon Axolotl glows in the same areas as the Neon Axolotl, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Axolotl Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on August 1, 2024. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Pets Plus Sticker Packs, which were received when purchasing the Pets Plus subscription for 299, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Axolotl Sticker features a cartoon Axolotl.

wiki.availability: The Aye Aye is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 17, 2025, alongside the third week of the Halloween Event (2025). Players could have purchased it for 3,900 or hatched it from the Basic Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on November 7, 2025.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Aye Aye learns in order: The Neon Aye Aye glows golden yellow on its nose, tail, feet, and inner ears. The Mega Neon Aye Aye glows in the same areas as the Neon Aye Aye, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Aye Aye Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2025, alongside the second week of the Halloween Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Halloween 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Aye Aye Sticker features a cartoon Aye Aye head.

wiki.availability: The Aztec Crown is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 15, 2025, alongside week two of the Aztec Temple Trek Event. Players could purchase it for 2. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on August 22, 2025.

The Aztec Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on August 15, 2025, replacing the Moon Egg. It could have been purchased from the Gumball Machine in the Nursery for 750. The Aztec Egg was replaced by the Endangered Egg on February 28, 2026, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Aztec Egg takes 5 tasks to hatch. On November 28, 2025, a bundle of four Aztec Eggs for 37 was put on sale for Black Friday weekend. The Aztec Egg was available as a free reward for completing three daily tasks from the Task Board from November 14, 2025 to February 27, 2026, with the Yarn Beanie temporarily replacing it from December 12, 2025 to January 5, 2026.

wiki.availability: The Aztec Mask is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 8, 2025, alongside the Aztec Temple Trek Event. Players could purchase it for 2. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on August 22, 2025.

The Baby Basket Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released in December 2018. It was obtainable by opening a Small, Big, or Massive Gift, which cost 70, 199, and 499, respectively. As the Baby Basket Stroller is no longer part of the gifts, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Baby Basket Stroller features a beige-colored basket attached to a handle. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Baby Bottle is a common food in Adopt Me! that can be purchased in the Baby Shop for 4, received as a reward for aging up pets, or obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Baby Bottle, as true to its name, features an off-white baby bottle topped with a blue lid. This item can be used to fulfill the 'thirsty' ailment on pets and babies. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. It takes eight uses to fully consume.

wiki.availability: The Baby Formula is a common food item in Adopt Me!. It can be found in the center of the Baby Shop for 20. It is used to boost the hunger and thirst ailments of a baby and can be fed to them when they are riding a player or when they are within a close enough range of the player.
wiki.notes: Baby Formula is a very resourceful item since it can fulfill all the surrounding babies’ hunger and thirst ailments with just one use. When the baby eats it, it cures the baby and their pet's hunger and thirst ailments. It cannot be fed to a pet.

wiki.availability: The Back Paddle is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 10, 2026, alongside week four of the Summer Camp Event (2026). From July 10, 2026 to July 20, 2026, players could exchange 10 Bronze Karp for it in the Fishing Shop. From July 20, 2026 to July 24, 2026, it was purchasable in the Summer Wagon for 975. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 24, 2026.

The Back Pencil is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It is obtainable through purchasing and opening the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. It is otherwise obtainable through opening Admin Abuse Boxes, purchasing it for 1,500 when it is on rotation in the Accessory Shop, or trading.

The Back Taco is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 2.2% and 0.83% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on September 29, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Back Taco features a taco with a yellow taco wrap which appears to contain meat, lettuce, and cheese. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Bacon and Eggs Throw Toy is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It can be opened from Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. It can otherwise be obtained through opening Admin Abuse Boxes or trading.
wiki.notes: When interacted with, the Bacon and Eggs Throw Toy is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Bacon and Eggs Throw Toy is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It can be opened from Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. It can otherwise be obtained through opening Admin Abuse Boxes or trading.
wiki.notes: When interacted with, the Bacon and Eggs Throw Toy is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Badger is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 11, 2022, along with the Fall Weather Update. It is available for purchase in the Fall Shop when it is on rotation for 700 or obtainable through trading. The Badger can also be hatched from the Basic Egg, Crystal Egg, or Admin Abuse Egg while its respective weather rotation is active.
wiki.notes: The Badger features a black body, nose, and tail. It has a fluffy white face with black spots over the eyes. Its ears are white with dark insides, and it has two beady black eyes. Here are the tricks the Badger learns in order: The Neon Badger glows white on its face and underbelly. The Mega Neon Badger glows in the same areas as the Neon Badger, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Badly Wrapped Toy Sword is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 19, 2025, alongside the third week of the Winter Event (2025). Players could have purchased it for 400. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 9, 2026.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with the Badly Wrapped Toy Sword equipped, it is swung down towards the ground.

wiki.availability: The Baked Alaska Bait is a limited ultra-rare food item in Adopt Me! that was released on February 22, 2024, along with the Fire Dimension Event (2024). Players could purchase it in the Fire Dimension or on the Shop menu for 80. As the event has ended, the Baked Alaska Bait can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Players can place the Baked Alaska Bait in a Box Lure or Cozy Home Lure to obtain an ultra-rare Burning Bunny, Flaming Fox, or Wildfire Hawk, or a legendary Volcanic Rhino after a 10-minute cooldown. The Baked Alaska Bait features a black plate and several small pastries piled on top. Each pastry has a round black outside and an orange-yellow inside.

wiki.availability: The Bakeneko is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 4, 2025, alongside the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). It could have been purchased for 3,650 during the event or from the item rotation in the Cherry Blossom Wagon. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bakeneko features a brown body, head, and tail with off-white spots and cheek fur. It has dark brown inner ears, four brown feet, and two black eyes. Covering its face is a white mask with red markings and red straps, while its chest is decorated with a gray kanji symbol. Here are the tricks the Bakeneko learns in order: The Neon Bakeneko glows light yellow on its cheek fur, body spots, feet, and the tip of its tail, while the top half of its mask glows white. The Mega Neon Bakeneko cycles through the colors of the rainbow on its mask details and straps, body spots, cheek fur, feet, chest symbol, and the tip of its tail.

wiki.availability: The Bakeneko Sticker is a limited uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 25, 2025, alongside week 4 of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Cherry Blossom 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Bakeneko Sticker features a cartoon Bakeneko.

wiki.availability: The Baku is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 8, 2022. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Japan Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 5% chance of hatching a legendary pet from the Japan Egg, but only a 2.5% chance of hatching a Baku. The Baku features a turquoise upper body with a dark orange underbelly. It has tufts of wavy range fur that sticks up on the top of its head. It has a trunk, turquoise ears with pink insides, and an orange mane, feet, and tail. Here are the tricks the Baku learns in order: The Neon Baku glows orange on its mane, eyebrows, feet, and tail. The Mega Neon Baku glows in the same places as the Neon Baku, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Bald Eagle is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 5, 2024, as part of the fourth week of the Summer State Fair (2024). Players could purchase it for 490. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bald Eagle features a dark brown body and wings with lighter brown feathers on the ends. It has a white tail and head with gray spots around its eyes, as well as a yellow beak and two yellow feet. Listed below are the tricks the Bald Eagle learns in order: The Neon Bald Eagle glows light blue on its head, wing tips, and the tips of its tail feathers. The Mega Neon Bald Eagle glows in the same areas as the Neon Bald Eagle, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Bali Starling is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 2, 2023, along with the Southeast Asia Egg. As it has left the game, it is now only obtainable by hatching any remaining Southeast Asia Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 35% chance of hatching a common pet from a Southeast Asia Egg, but only an 11.67% chance of hatching a Bali Starling. The Bali Starling is a white-feathered bird. It has blue markings around its two black eyes, and a yellow beak. It has black markings on its wings and tail, a white crest, and two blue feet. Listed below are the tricks that the Bali Starling learns in order: The Neon Bali Starling glows bright yellow on its crest, tail, chest, wing tips, beak, and feet. The Mega Neon Bali Starling glows in the same areas as the Neon Bali Starling, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ball and Chain Earrings are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on October 5, 2023, as a part of the Halloween Event (2023). Players could obtain the Ball and Chain Earrings by purchasing them for 550 in the Asylum shop. As the event has ended, they can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Ball and Chain Earrings are two gray chains with a morning star hanging from them. These pet accessories go on a pet's ears.

wiki.availability: The Ballet Swan is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 4, 2026. Players could have purchased it for 600. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on September 11, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Ballet Swan learns in order: The Neon Ballet Swan glows pink on its beak, feet, pearls, on parts of its other necklace, and on parts of its wings and skirt. The Mega Neon Ballet Swan glows in the same areas as the Neon Ballet Swan, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Balloon is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me!. It could be obtained from an old Gifts rotation, but as the Gifts have been refreshed to contain new items, it is now only obtainable through trading. The toy is used to let players jump higher than usual.
wiki.notes: The Balloon features a classic red balloon with a white string attached to the bottom. Like other balloons, it will allow the player to jump higher.

wiki.availability: The Balloon Dog is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.8% and 0.7% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Balloon Dog was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Balloon Dog features a blue balloon tied into the shape of a dog. This pet accessory goes on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Balloon Flower Hat is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It was obtainable through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on August 22, 2025, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Balloon Flower Hat features a pink flower with six rounded petals and a green center, as well as a green stem that is connected to a circular base. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Balloon Pogostick is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 28, 2024, as part of the third week of the Summer State Fair (2024). Players could purchase the Balloon Pogostick for 1,250. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Balloon Pogostick features turquoise and blue balloons intertwined to create a pogostick. The handles are shaped like a blue bow, and the footrests are turquoise. The Balloon Pogostick serves no use other than being a fun pogostick to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Balloon Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me!. It could be found in the Sky Castle, but was later moved to the Baby Shop. Players could have purchased it for 1,500. It was removed from the game on June 24, 2021, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Balloon Stroller features a large striped balloon, tethered with six strings to a brown and beige cart which hovers above the ground. It has a brown and yellow seat where babies or pets can sit. It resembles the Hot Air Balloon. Players can customize the color of the stripes of the balloon upon purchase; however, this color cannot be changed after the player purchases the item or when the stroller is traded. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Balloon Unicorn is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 28, 2024, as part of the third week of the Summer State Fair (2024). Players could purchase it for 1,000. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Balloon Unicorn learns in order: The Neon Balloon Unicorn glows pink on its mane, horn, tail, and inner ears. The Mega Neon Balloon Unicorn glows in the same areas as the Neon Balloon Unicorn, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Balloon Unicorn Sticker is a legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on July 5, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Summer State Fair (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained by opening any remaining State Fair Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Balloon Unicorn Sticker features a cartoon Balloon Unicorn.

wiki.availability: The Balloon Wings are limited uncommon wing pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on May 11, 2023. They can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Wing Chest for 600; players have a 16.5% chance of unboxing them. The Balloon Wings can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Balloon Wings feature two interlocked blue balloon circles and two yellow balloon circles. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back when it is flown.

wiki.availability: The Balloons are limited uncommon toys in Adopt Me! that were added to the game as part of a Gifts rotation. They were available in the Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. As the Gifts were updated to contain new items, the Balloons are now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Balloons feature a group of red, blue, green, and yellow balloons with white strings attached to the bottom. The Balloons allow a player to jump higher when equipped.

wiki.availability: The Bamboo Bindle is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.7% and 0.6% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On April 20, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Bamboo Bindle was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Bamboo Bindle features a long green bamboo stick with a small gray cloth tied to it. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Bamboo Earrings are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They are obtainable through purchasing and opening the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. They can otherwise be purchased for 200 when on rotation in the Accessory Shop, or obtained through trading.

The Banana Car is a limited legendary four-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released in 2019. It could have been obtained by opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, or 499, respectively. As the Banana Car is no longer part of the gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Banana Car is a giant banana-shaped vehicle with four brown and yellow seats, a black steering wheel, and four black and white wheels, all of which have a black dot in the center. It also has a minuscule windshield on the front. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Banana Chew Toy is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game as part of the Gorilla Fairground event on March 16, 2023. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through opening any remaining Standard Gorilla Boxes, or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Banana Chew Toy features a light yellow banana with a darker yellow peel. When a player interacts with the Figgy Pudding Chew Toy, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and sit with it in its mouth. The player can then click their pet to retrieve this toy. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Banana Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.2% and 0.3% chance of getting it from these gifts respectively.
wiki.notes: On September 29, 2022, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Banana Hat was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Banana Hat features a yellow banana peel with light yellow insides. It has a light green tip. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Banana Plush is a limited common toy in Adopt Me!. It could be previously obtained from an old gifts rotation. However, as the gifts has been updated with new items, this item is no longer available and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Banana Plush has the appearance of a yellow banana. It has big googly eyes, a red mouth with a black outline, arms, and legs. The Banana Plush serves no purpose other than just being a cosmetic and a hugging item. To interact with this toy, the player can click their screen to hug it, just like most plushies.

wiki.availability: The Banana Pogo is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me!. It was previously available in an old Gifts rotation, but can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Banana Pogo, true to its name, is a yellow banana with a black pole through it. It has brown tips and black handholds and footholds. It provides transportation by bouncing instead of walking.

wiki.availability: The Banana Rattle is a common toy in Adopt Me!, which can be found and bought in the Baby Shop for 100. It is otherwise obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Banana Rattle is a rattle topped with a surprised-looking peeled banana with beady brown eyes. It is complete with a yellow stick. To interact with this item, a player can click their screen to shake it back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Banana Stroller is a limited rare stroller in Adopt Me! that could previously be obtained for 70, 199, or 499 in the Small, Big, or Massive Gifts during a previous rotation. As the Gifts were refreshed with new items, the Banana Stroller is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Banana Stroller features a yellow banana-shaped stroller with a black and yellow handle, wheels, and a small light yellow seat. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Banana Tree Pogo Stick is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 16, 2023, as part of the Gorilla Fairground event. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through opening any remaining Standard Gorilla Boxes and Premium Gorilla Boxes, or through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 10% chance of unboxing this item from the Standard Gorilla Box and a 20% chance from the Premium Gorilla Box. The Banana Tree Pogo Stick features a dark brown trunk for a spring, green banana leaves for handle bars and foot rests, and yellow bananas for decoration. As it is a pogo, the Banana Tree Pogo Stick serves no purpose other than being a fun cosmetic item to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Bandage Propeller is a limited toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on October 5, 2023, as a part of the Halloween Event (2023).
wiki.notes: During the event, the Bandage Propeller was found in the Asylum shop for 850. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading. The Bandage Propeller features an orange and blue handle connected to two light brown bandages overlapping, and blue square with a white animal paw in the center. To interact with this toy, a player can click or press their screen to be propelled upward; they can press the spacebar or the jump button to stop.

wiki.availability: The Banded Palm Civet is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 2, 2023, along with the Southeast Asia Egg. As its respective egg is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Southeast Asia Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 25% chance of hatching an uncommon pet from a Southeast Asia Egg, but only a 12.5% chance of hatching a Banded Palm Civet. The Banded Palm Civet has a long brown body, head, and tail with black stripes. It has two ears with beige inner parts and black outer rims, along with two black eyes and a tuft of fur on its head. Here are the tricks the Banded Palm Civet learns in order: The Neon Banded Palm Civet glows blue on its stripes, tuft of hair, feet, and around its eyes. The Mega Neon Banded Palm Civet glows in the same areas as the Neon Banded Palm Civet, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Bandicoot is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 29, 2020, along with the Aussie Egg. As it left the game on October 10, 2021, the Bandicoot is now only obtainable through trading or by hatching any remaining Aussie Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 30% chance of hatching a Bandicoot from the Aussie Egg. The Bandicoot has a light, tan-brown upper body and a slightly dark-beige underbelly and legs. Its head features two beady black eyes, two large ears with light pink insides, and a nose in a slightly darker shade of pink. It also has a small tail with a dark brown tip. Here are the tricks the Bandicoot learns in order: The Neon Bandicoot glows bright pink on its nose, inner ears, feet, and the tip of its tail. The Mega Neon Bandicoot glows in the same areas as the Neon Bandicoot, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Banjo is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was purchasable during the Halloween Event (2019) for 6,000. As the event has ended, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Banjo features a white base with a black rim connected to a black neck, and a brown headstock. It has four gray strings. To interact with this item, a player can click on their screen with the Banjo equipped to play music.

wiki.availability: The Baseball Toy is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70 or 199 from Small or Big Gifts. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Baseball Toy features a rounded, off-white ball with red stitching along the seams. When interacted with, the Baseball Toy is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Basic Egg is a common egg in Adopt Me! that was released on September 12, 2025. It can be purchased for 400, which are earned through using the Pet Releaser, or obtained through trading. The Basic Egg takes 5 tasks to hatch.
wiki.notes: The pets available from the Basic Egg rotate over time as new pets are added and older ones are removed. Players can only hatch pets that are currently available in the game through standard methods, with some exceptions: The Chihuahua, Pain au Chat, Kiwi Kiwi, Dango Penguins, Dragonfruit Fox, and Strawberry Tortle are exclusive to the Basic Egg and Crystal Egg.

wiki.availability: The Fossil Isle Pickaxe is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on November 22, 2024, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Fossil Isle Pickaxe features a pickaxe with an orange head. The head of the pickaxe is secured on a brown stick by brown rope. There is a brown rope intertwined around the bottom of the stick. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Basilisk Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 25, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Halloween Event (2024). As the event has ended and the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon has closed, it can only be obtained through opening any remaining Halloween 2024 Sticker Packs or trading.
wiki.notes: The Basilisk Sticker features a cartoon Basilisk.

wiki.availability: The Basilisk is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released along with the Halloween Event (2022) on October 6, 2022. It was priced at 25,000. It can now only be obtained through trading, as the event is over.
wiki.notes: The Basilisk features a long green body with light green flecks throughout. It has sharp white teeth, a thin red tongue, beige ruffles above its eyes, and a light green underbelly. It has a slithering animation when idle. These are the tricks the Basilisk learns in order: The Neon Basilisk glows bright green on the spots on its back and the ruffles above its eyes. The Mega Neon Basilisk glows in the same areas as its Neon version, except these areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Basilisk Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 25, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Halloween Event (2024). As the event has ended and the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon has closed, it can only be obtained through opening any remaining Halloween 2024 Sticker Packs or trading.
wiki.notes: The Basilisk Sticker features a cartoon Basilisk.

wiki.availability: The Bat is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 28, 2020, alongside the Halloween Event (2020). It can be obtained through opening a Bat Box, which was purchasable for 1,000. Since the event ended on November 11, 2020, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players or by opening any remaining Bat Boxes.
wiki.notes: There is an 80% chance of obtaining a Bat from the Bat Box. The Bat is tiny, with big ears with pink insides, beady black eyes, and a small pink nose. It has light gray fur around its neck, small gray wings, and black feet. Here are the tricks the Bat learns in order: The Neon Bat glows orange on its stomach, the inside of its ears, and on its nose. The Mega Neon Bat glows in the same areas as the Neon Bat, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Bat Backpack is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released along with the Halloween Event (2022) on October 6, 2022. Players could have obtained the Bat Backpack by purchasing it for 5,280. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Bat Backpack features a black backpack with two white fangs near its front, two horns and a handle on the top, and small bat wings on its sides. This pet accessory goes on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Bat Box is a limited rare gift in Adopt Me! that was released on October 28, 2020, as part of the Halloween Event (2020). Players could purchase it in the Halloween Shop for 1,000. Since the event ended, the Bat Box is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: Players can receive a Bat or an Albino Bat from a Bat Box. There is a 4 in 5 (80%) chance of obtaining a Bat, while there is a 1 in 5 (20%) chance of obtaining an Albino Bat. The Bat Box features a round, golden bird cage with a dark violet/magenta cloth over it. It has golden bat-like wings as the handle on top of the box. The Bat Box also has white sparkles surrounding it.

wiki.availability: The Bat Candy Earrings are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on October 6, 2022, along with the Halloween Event (2022). Players could have obtained the Bat Candy Earrings by purchasing them for 300. As the event has ended, they can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Bat Candy Earrings feature magenta lollipops with black swirls and white sticks; each lollipop has two purple bat wings and a hook. These pet accessories go on a pet's ears.

wiki.availability: The Bat Dragon is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released during the Halloween Event (2019), along with the Evil Unicorn. It could have been purchased for 180,000 in the Candy Trading Shop. Since its event has ended, the Bat Dragon is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bat Dragon has a light brown body, two small orange horns on its head, two beady black eyes, black bat-like ears with a light brownish color inside, an orange nose on its snout, black and red curved wings, and two small fangs protruding from its mouth. Its underbelly is a light tan color, with the tip of its tail being black with an orange tip that is pointed. It has orange tail spikes on the back of its body. Here are the tricks the Bat Dragon learns in order: The Neon Bat Dragon's wings and the tip of its tail glow in a deep neon orange color, while its horns, nose, and the spikes on its tail glow in a light orange color. The Mega Neon Bat Dragon glows in the same areas as the Neon Bat Dragon, except those areas cycle through white, magenta, lavender, and turquoise.

wiki.availability: The Bat Dragon Cuddle Animated Sticker is a legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: There is a 0.01% chance of unboxing it from the Premium Sticker Pack, which costs 50. It can also be obtained through trading. The Bat Dragon Cuddle Animated Sticker features a cartoon Bat Dragon that lifts and closes its wings while holding a heart.

wiki.availability: The Bat Dragon Sticker is a legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Premium Sticker Pack for 50; players have a 10% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Bat Dragon Sticker features a cartoon Bat Dragon.

wiki.availability: The Bat Face Roller Skates are a limited uncommon single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 31, 2022, as part of the new gifts rotation. It could be purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation and can now only be obtained through trading.

wiki.notes: The Bat Key Pogo Stick features a faint blue-gray pogo stick with a black vine wrapped around its middle. It has two wings protruding from its top with black designs, a footrest, and multiple purple gems embedded throughout. It serves no other purpose aside from being a fun pogo stick to jump around on.

wiki.notes: The Bat Sticker features a cartoon Bat.

wiki.availability: The Bat Wing Balloon is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 6, 2022, along with the Halloween Event (2022). Players could obtain it by purchasing it for 2,000 at the Halloween Shop. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Bat Wing Balloon features a long black handle with a white string curled around it; it is topped with a sphere with white fangs, pointed ears, and wings, bearing a similar appearance to a bat. Like all other balloons in the game, the Bat Wing Balloon's only function is letting a player jump higher.

wiki.availability: The Bat Wings are limited ultra-rare pet accessories that were released on April 11, 2020, alongside the Dress Your Pets Live Event. They could have been purchased for 2,000 when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The base of the Bat Wings are black and the sinews are red. These pet accessories go on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Bathtub is a limited legendary three-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released in 2018. It could have been obtained by opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, or 499, respectively. As the Bathtub is no longer part of the gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bathtub takes the appearance of a standard household double-ended tub, with the water tap located on the front side. The tub itself is a snow-white and the water tap is a charcoal gray. The tub has small black wheels attached to each of the corners, allowing it to propel itself forward. The Bathtub is filled with water, which constantly emits bubble particles. Both of the bathtub's passengers sit on the side of the tub, while the driver sits inside it. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Battery Backpack is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on January 30, 2026, it can only be obtained through trading.

The Battle Axe is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 2.2% and 0.83% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on September 29, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Battle Axe features a brown handled axe with a golden blade at the top. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.
