wiki.availability: The Bauble Balloon is a limited common toy item in Adopt Me! that was obtainable from the 2019 Advent Calendar. It could be claimed on the twenty-second day during the Christmas Event (2019). It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bauble Balloon is a regular balloon with multicolored skin and a thin white string for players to hold onto. Its design is the same as the Ornament Throw Toy. When equipped, the Bauble Balloon allows the player to jump higher.

wiki.addedEvent: It could be claimed on the twenty-second day during the Christmas Event (2019)
wiki.availability: The Bauble Buddies Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on January 3, 2025, alongside the fifth week of the Winter Festival (2024). It can now only be obtained through trading or unboxing any remaining Winter 2024 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000 until January 17, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Bauble Buddies Sticker features cartoon Bauble Buddies.

wiki.availability: The Bauble Buddies are limited ultra-rare pets in Adopt Me! that were released on December 6, 2024, alongside the Winter Festival (2024). Players could have purchased them for 85,000 until January 17, 2025. As the event has ended, they can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Bauble Buddies learn in order: The Neon Bauble Buddies glow green on one ornament’s body and light blue on the bottom half of the other. The Mega Neon Bauble Buddies glow in the same areas as the Neon Bauble Buddies, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Bauble Buddies Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on January 3, 2025, alongside the fifth week of the Winter Festival (2024). It can now only be obtained through trading or unboxing any remaining Winter 2024 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000 until January 17, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Bauble Buddies Sticker features cartoon Bauble Buddies.

wiki.availability: The Bauble Necklace is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 29, 2025. It was given to players for free as a part of the Admin Abuse on November 29, 2025, and was obtainable from day 3 of the 2025 Advent Calendar, which was released as a part of the Winter Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through trading, as the day to claim it has passed.
wiki.notes: The Bauble Necklace features two yellow chains; one being decorated with red beads and the other having red and green ornaments hanging from it. This pet accessory is worn around a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Bauble Throw Toy is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 13, 2024, alongside week 2 of the Winter Festival (2024). Players could have purchased it for 6,000. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 17, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Bauble Throw Toy features a purple and white ornament with a yellow cap. When the Bauble Throw Toy is interacted with, the player will throw it and their equipped pet will fetch and return it to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Beach Buggy is a limited ultra-rare vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2023, along with the Summer Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it for 50,000. As its event has now passed, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Beach Buggy features a bright orange car with a gray frame. There are two circular yellow lights attached to the upper frame and two on the front frame. It has dark brown seats and four large black wheels. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Beach Necklace is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on January 30, 2026, it can only be obtained through trading.

The Beach Umbrella is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2023, along with the Summer Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Summer Shop for 500. As its event has now passed, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Beach Umbrella is a large, closed beach umbrella with red and white patterns. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Beachgoer is a limited rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on June 22, 2023, as part of the second week of the Summer Festival (2023). It could have been purchased for 45,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Beachgoer features a tall van with the front featuring two circular headlights aside a small, gray grille, as well as a stripy hood and a bumper underneath. It features orange seating, while the roof has a Party Surfboard and a Beach Umbrella on top. The back features two circular tailights and a license plate with a paw-print emblem. The Beachgoer was color-customizable upon purchase, which affected the exterior and the Party Surfboard, which were respectively colored cyan and yellow by default. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Bear Cap is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 9, 2023. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 4.5% and 2.7% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on May 10, 2024, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bear Cap features a brown cap with two round ears, a tuft of fur on the top, and two black crosses on the front. Each of its ears has pink insides. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Bear Head Plush is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 18, 2024, as part of the third week of the Halloween Event (2024). Players could have purchased it for 450 or 1. It can now only be obtained through trading, as the event has ended.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with the Bear Head Plush equipped, they will hug it.

wiki.availability: The Bear Hood is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 2.9% and 8.6% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On April 20, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Bear Hood was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Bear Hood features a light brown hood with two black buttons sewed on using beige string. There is a small black nose and two ears with beige and dark brown insides. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Bear Keychain is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 9, 2023. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 4.5% and 2.7% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on May 10, 2024, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bear Keychain features a gray keychain with a brown bear head attached to it. The bear has black eyes and a black nose with tan inner ears and tan around the nose. This pet accessory goes on a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Bear Winter Hat is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on December 15, 2020. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 150 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Bear Winter Hat features a light gray hat with a brown trim and two brown ears at the top; this hat is modeled to look like a bear. There is a face on the front of the hat with two eyes, a nose connected to a small mouth, and three small whiskers. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Beaver is a rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2019, along with the Pets update. Originally, players could obtain it by hatching a Cracked Egg, a Pet Egg, or a Royal Egg, but as of July 21, 2022, the Beaver can only be obtained by hatching a Retired Egg or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 6.75% chance of hatching a Beaver from a Retired Egg. The Beaver has a brown body, a flat dark-brown tail, light brown feet, and a beige snout with a small, round black nose. Its head is round and is topped with two half-circle-shaped brown ears with beige insides. On the front of its face, it has two flat white teeth sticking out and small black eyes. Here are the tricks the Beaver learns in order: The Neon Beaver's inner ears, tail, nose, and feet glow bright orange. The Mega Neon Beaver glows in the same areas as the Neon Beaver, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Beaver Sticker is a common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Sticker Pack for 250; players have a 40% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Beaver Sticker features a cartoon Beaver.

wiki.availability: The Bee is an ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on November 8, 2019. It is obtainable by using a Honey in the Coffee Shop, which costs 169. The Bee can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 35 out of 40 (87.5%) chance of taming a Bee with Honey. The Bee has a round yellow body with brown stripes. It has a yellow head, bluish-white wings, brown antennae and feet, and beady black eyes. It also has a small, pointy black stinger. Listed below are the tricks the Bee learns in order: The Neon Bee glows fluorescent green on its brown stripes, wings, antennae, stinger, and feet. The Mega Neon Bee glows in the same areas as the Neon Bee, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Bee Hive is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 13, 2021. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 250 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Bee Hive features a yellow beehive with a small darker toned entrance in front and a bee flying to its right. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Bee Shuttle is a limited legendary five-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on November 9, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update, replacing the Growing Flower Hat. It could be obtained through opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, or 499 respectively. It was otherwise obtainable through opening Admin Abuse Boxes. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it was replaced by the Micro Car on January 30, 2026. The Bee Shuttle could only be opened from gifts when it was on rotation, being available for one week at a time every four weeks.
wiki.notes: The Bee Shuttle features a black and yellow striped vehicle with yellow honey dripping from the bottom of the vehicle. The Bee Shuttle has two black antennas with yellow lights, two outlined headlights, and four membraneous wings sprouting from the top of the vehicle. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Bee Sticker is an ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Sticker Pack for 250; players have a 14% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Bee Sticker features a cartoon Bee.

wiki.availability: The Bee Wings are limited ultra-rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on March 6, 2021. They could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 1,500 when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Bee Wings feature a pair of thin, translucent wings that are based on a Bee's wings. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Belgium Scarf is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 12, 2024. Players could purchase it for 300 until July 19, 2024. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Belgium Scarf features a scarf with red, yellow and black stripes as well as a white fringe. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Bell Flower Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had an 1.7% and 0.4% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Bell Flower Hat was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Bell Hat features a dark blue hat with lighter blue accents near its bottom. It has a small yellow and green stem near the top, presumably to represent an upside-down flower. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Beluga Badge is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on June 8, 2021, as part of the World Oceans Day update. It was obtainable in the WDC (Whale and Dolphin Conservation) Pin Badges Board for free. This pin left the game on July 8, 2021, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Beluga Badge features a decagon-shaped pin with a gray border. The center has a dark blue background showing a light blue beluga whale with multiple white circles that seem to resemble bubbles. This pet accessory goes on a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Beluga Whale is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on November 30, 2023, along with the Winter Festival (2023). Players were able to purchase this pet for 3,300. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Beluga Whale features a gray main body, fins, a tail, and black eyes. Listed below are the tricks the Beluga Whale learns in order: The Neon Beluga Whale glows light green on its fins and tail. The Mega Neon Beluga Whale glows in the same areas as the Neon Beluga Whale, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Bench is a limited uncommon toy that was added to Adopt Me! on March 17, 2022. It could have been obtained by purchasing it at the Camping Shop for 900. It was removed from the game on February 16, 2023, and has been replaced with the Camper's Bench. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bench features a log with dark brown bark, and a light brown center. The Bench can be placed on flat surfaces in Adoption Island and can seat two players or pets.

wiki.availability: The Beret is an uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 11, 2020, as part of the Dress Your Pets update. It can be purchased in the Accessory Shop for 300 when on rotation. It is also obtainable through completing the "Paint Your Pet" achievement in the "Explore" section of the Guide, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Beret features a basic burgundy-colored hat. It has a stalk sticking up on top of the middle of the hat. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Berry Cool Cube is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 13, 2024, alongside the second week of the Winter Festival (2024). Players could have purchased the Ice Tray for 18,000 until January 17, 2025. As the event has ended, the Berry Cool Cube can only be obtained through trading or opening any remaining Ice Trays.
wiki.notes: Players have a 5% chance to obtain a Berry Cool Cube from an Ice Tray. Here are the tricks the Berry Cool Cube learns in order: The Neon Berry Cool Cube glows blue on the outer layer of its body, and red on the strawberry inside its body. The Mega Neon Berry Cool Cube glows in the same areas as the Neon Berry Cool Cube, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Bethink Skateboard is a limited rare single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released in 2018. It could have been obtained by opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, or 499, respectively. As it is now no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bethink Skateboard features a skateboard with an image of Bethink, one of the lead developers of Adopt Me!. It has four small white wheels. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Bewitched Hat is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 750 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Bewitched Hat features an indigo hat with a yellow bow around the sides. Two white ghosts float on the side of the hat while a yellow star hangs off the tip. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Bi Dodo Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on June 14, 2024, along with the Summer State Fair (2024).
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Pride Sticker Pack for 50. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Bi Dodo Sticker features a cartoon Dodo with purple and blue beak, wings, and tail. It also has light blue feet. It's reminiscent of the Bi Flag colors.

wiki.availability: The Bi Flag is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 9, 2022. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand for 50; the Pride Stand could be found near the Playground and left the game on June 16, 2022. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bi Flag features a bisexual flag with a white handle; this handle has a small yellow knob on its tip. The colors of the flag include bright pink, purple, and blue. On the flag, the pink and blue parts are larger than the purple part. It has a pet accessory counterpart, the Bi Pride Pin. To wave the flag, the player can click anywhere on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Bi Flag 2023 is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 1, 2023. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand near the Playground for 50. It can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Bi Flag 2023 features a Bi Flag, the only difference being the rainbow string that is intertwined along the flagpole and a Pride Paw Flying Disc at the top of the pole. To wave the flag, a player can click anywhere on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Bi Pride Pin is a common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 31, 2020. It could have been found in the Accessory Shop and taken for free. One pride pin could be taken by a player every hour. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: It features a heart-shaped pin with a gold border and colors that represent the bisexual flag. The colors include magenta, purple, and blue. This pet accessory goes on a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Bicycle is a common single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 3, 2022, along with the Vehicle Dealership revamp. Players can obtain it by purchasing it in the Vehicle Dealership for 75 or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bicycle features a bike with a similar design to the Bike, but with pedals added to it, as well as more detailed features and a black paw-print emblem on the front of the bike. Like all Vehicle Dealership vehicles, the Bicycle is color-customizable. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: Shops are accessible buildings in Adopt Me! located in several places around Adoption Island. Shops have a variety of different items that are available for purchase, such as pets, vehicles, toys, strollers and foods.
wiki.notes: The Coffee Shop is located next to the entrance to the neighborhood. The building is shaped like a red mug with whipped cream on top. Players can purchase drinks such as Tea and Coffee or purchase Honey for 169 to tame a Bee, King Bee, or Queen Bee. The Toy Shop is located behind the Pizza Shop. Players can purchase toys in the shop. Different variations of the toys that are in the Toy Shop can be found in Gifts or can be bought during events. The Ice Cream Shop is located beside the entrance to the neighborhood, and is one of the two places where players can buy ice cream cones (the other being the Ice Cream Truck). Players can also purchase Golden Goldfish for 195 to tame a Choco Penguin, Vanilla Penguin, or Strawberry Penguin. A Cone or Cup is required to add these toppings, and up to three toppings can be added to each. The Pizza Shop is located beside the Toy Shop. It is a shop that gives players the ability to get jobs, provides players with food items, and fulfills the 'Pizza Party' ailment. It has a jukebox, as well as several tables which players and pets can sit at. There is a kitchen with pizza ovens and a table full of ingredients, helping players customize the Pizzas to their liking. There is also a manager's office. Pizza is required to add these toppings. The Green Groceries is located next to the Safety Hub. It is a shop where players can buy various food items. The Green Groceries contains the entrance to the Farm Shop. The Camping Shop is located at the entrance to the Campsite. The Nursery is located in the center of Adoption Island. In the Nursery, players can adopt babies, buy eggs, and access the VIP Room, if they have bought the gamepass. The Retired Egg can be found and purchased in the VIP Room. The Beach Shop is a shop where players can buy different pool-related items or pets. The Beach Shop replaced the Pool Shop. The Baby Shop is located near the Playground. It sells baby-related items, such as strollers and toys. The Pet Shop is located at the center of Adoption Island, near the Hospital. It is a shop that sells pet-related items, gamepass pets, and contains the Vault. The Vehicle Dealership is located beside the entrance to the neighborhood. In the Vehicle Dealership, players can purchase vehicles. The Cat Cafe was introduced on September 18, 2026, and is located next to the Vehicle Dealership. In the Cat Cafe, players can purchase food items and tame a Cattuccino, Catte, or Matcha Cat using the Kitty Biscuit. The Sky Castle is located in the sky above Adoption Island. It can be accessed with the Hot Air Balloon, a flying pet, a Glider, a grappling hook, a furniture item from a player's house, or a propeller. It sells potions and the Balloon Stroller on the first floor. The Potion Shop was located next to the Baby Shop, which is now located next to the Playground. Players could purchase potions in the shop. The Clothing Store was located in between the Playground and the Pool Party. It was removed when the Dress Your Pets Live Event was released to make room for the Accessory Shop. Currently, the Baby Shop is in its place. Various articles of clothing could be purchased in the Clothing Store for Bucks, such as wings and trails, which can now only be found in the dressing menu. The Clothing Store was the only way players could change their Roblox avatar in Adopt Me!. The Pool Shop was previously located at the Pool Party. Players could purchase different pool-related items. The Pool Shop replaced the Hot Spring Shop. It was removed on March 7, 2024, and was replaced by the Beach Shop. The Farm Shop was a shop where players could buy food and drink items to fulfill the Hungry and thirsty tasks. The Farm Shop was an extension of the Green Groceries and the entrance could be found in one of its fridges. Players could also purchase Diamond Lavenders for 169 to tame a Ladybug, Golden Ladybug, or Diamond Ladybug.

wiki.availability: The Big Brew Potion is a rare potion in Adopt Me! that was released on January 18, 2020. It can be found and bought in the Sky Castle for 350, purchased from the Star Rewards for 3, received as a reward for aging up pets, or obtained through trading. Two Big Brew Potions were also rewarded to players for day 14 of the 2021 Advent Calendar.
wiki.notes: The Big Brew Potion consists of pastel blue liquid stored in a round, circular bottle. It has a brown stopper as a lid. The Big Brew Potion can make a pet bigger for 10 minutes. Its effect stacks up to three times; if any more Big Brew Potions are fed to the pet, it only increases the time until the effect wears off. The time left before the potion's effect wears off only runs when the pet is equipped and the player is in-game. Similar to the other pet potions, the effects only work on pets.

wiki.egg: Task Board or pet age-up reward
wiki.availability: The Big Gift is a rare gift in Adopt Me! that was released on December 21, 2017, alongside the Christmas Event (2017). It can be found at the Gifts Display with the Small Gift and Massive Gift, and purchased for 199. It is otherwise obtainable in the rotation of rewards for completing three daily tasks from the Task Board, as a reward for aging up pets, or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Big Gift was previously obtainable through the Sunshine Games Pass from the Games Event (2024), the graveyard from week two to four of the Halloween Event (2024), and the Daily Reward. Players have a 20% chance of getting a common item, 50% chance of getting an uncommon item, 20% chance of getting a rare item, 8.5% chance of getting an ultra-rare item, and a 1.5% chance of getting a legendary item. The items obtainable are displayed on the gift board, which changes according to the gifts rotation. The Big Gift features a blue gift box with a silver ribbon wrapped around it. Its design includes different-sized stars colored sky blue, cyan, and navy blue. The Big Gift is slightly larger than the Small Gift.

wiki.availability: The Big Head Potion is a common potion in Adopt Me! that can be purchased at the Sky Castle for 10 or obtained through trading. It can also be obtained as a reward for aging up pets or brewed using the Big Head Cauldron furniture item in a player's house. A Big Head Cauldron costs 200 and produces 1 potion every 45 seconds.
wiki.notes: The Big Head Potion is stored in a circular bottle topped with a black cap. Players can visibly see a light green liquid inside the bottle. The Big Head Potion allows the player to enlarge the size of their head, hair, and hats. Its effect cannot be stacked. This potion cannot be fed to a pet, with a pop-up saying that it's too dangerous for the player's pet when they attempt to feed it one.

wiki.availability: The Big Leaf Stroller is a limited common stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on March 30, 2023, as part of the second week of the Spring Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Springfest Shop for 300. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Big Leaf Stroller features a light green leaf with a green stem curved to look like a chair. Its stem curves to make two wheel and a handle bar. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Big Log Throw Toy is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on September 1, 2022. It was obtainable from the second page of the Star Rewards, requiring 120 Stars to unlock. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on September 11, 2026 when the Star Rewards were revamped.
wiki.notes: The Big Log Throw Toy features a small dark brown log with lighter brown insides. It has a small leaf protruding from its side. The Big Log Throw Toy can be thrown when it is equipped and interacted with. A player can interact with this item by clicking/pressing the screen. If the player has a pet equipped, the pet will fetch it and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.addedEvent: It was available during the Halloween Event (2021)
wiki.availability: The Big Mushroom was a temporary common toy in Adopt Me!. It was available during the Halloween Event (2021) and could have been obtained during the Potion Hunt minigame. In the minigame, it was located in a hanging cage in one of the rooms and could be used to obtain the Ghost Translucency Potion, Candle Summoning Potion, and Dog Head Potion.
wiki.notes: It could also be used to obtain the Dizzy Potion if it was not displayed on the instructions board for that round. It stayed in players' inventories until the end of the Potion Hunt minigame. As the Halloween Event (2021) has ended, this item is no longer obtainable and has been completely removed from the game. The Big Mushroom features a dark purple round top with a large beige stem.

wiki.availability: The Bike is a limited common one-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Vehicle Dealership for 75. As the Bike left the game on March 3, 2022, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bike is a fairly simple looking bicycle. Judging by the size of the wheels, it is presumably meant to resemble a BMX bike. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Billy Goat is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 24, 2023. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Urban Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Billy Goat features an orange body, feet, and head, with white on its forehead and chin, black markings around its eyes and on its ears, and a black stripe running down its back to the tip of its stubby tail. It has black beady eyes and two white curved horns protruding from its head. It has tufts of fur on its chin and cheeks. Here are the tricks the Billy Goat learns in order: The Neon Billy Goat glows green on its horns, ears, eye markings, nose, back marking, tail, and feet. The Mega Neon Billy Goat glows in the same areas as the Neon Billy Goat, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Binturong is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 2, 2023. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Southeast Asia Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 16% chance of hatching an ultra-rare pet from the Southeast Asia Egg, but only a 5.33% chance of hatching a Binturong. The Binturong features a black body, tail, eyes, feet, and fur. It has white whiskers, lining of its ears, and eyebrows. It has tufts of fur on each side of its face. Listed below are the tricks the Binturong learns in order: The Neon Binturong glows orange on its eyebrows, part of its ears, underbelly, and under its tail. Here are the tricks the Blue Dog learns in order: The Neon Blue Dog glows a vibrant ocean blue in the ears, nose, paws, and tail. The Mega Neon Blue Dog glows in the same areas as the Neon Blue Dog, except those areas cycle through the colors blue, white and yellow.

wiki.egg: Completion of related Task Board tasks
wiki.availability: The Blue Dog Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update. Players could obtain it by completing the task on the Task Board that instructed them to set up their Profile, which also rewarded the Pink Cat Sticker. As the task became unavailable on April 26, 2024, the Blue Dog Sticker can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Blue Dog Sticker features a cartoon Blue Dog.

wiki.availability: The Blue Egg is a limited rare egg in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2019, as part of the pets update. Players could obtain it during the Easter Event (2019) via a secret quest line; players had to collect a Broken Egg from the top of the Sky Castle and return it to Eggburt, who would give the player an unusable Pet Egg in return, which transformed into the Blue Egg. Since the event ended, the Blue Egg is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Blue Egg has a 100% chance of hatching a Blue Dog. The Blue Egg features a similar shape to the Pet Egg, except it is entirely blue.

wiki.addedEvent: Gifts rotation during the Christmas Event (2017)
wiki.availability: The Blue Neon Snowboard is a limited common single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was available in the Gifts rotation during the Christmas Event (2017). It was obtainable from old Massive Gifts, which cost 625. As the Gifts were updated with new items, the Blue Neon Snowboard can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Blue Neon Snowboard features a solid blue snowboard surrounded by a blue glow with two areas for a player to place their feet into. It has a non-neon counterpart known as the Blue Snowboard. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Blue Pogostick is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 6, 2025, alongside the return of the Butterfly Sanctuary. It could have been purchased for 100. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on June 13, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Blue Pogostick serves no purpose aside from being a fun pogo stick to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Blue Rider is a limited rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020. It was obtainable from the first page of the Star Rewards, requiring 320 Stars to unlock. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on September 11, 2026 when the Star Rewards were revamped.
wiki.notes: The Blue Rider is a light blue classic motorcycle with dual exhausts and a color-matching sidecar. It has fluorescent yellow lights on and below the handlebars. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Blue Ringed Octopus is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 8, 2023, along with the Danger Egg. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Danger Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 16% chance of hatching an ultra-rare pet from the Danger Egg, but only a 5.3% chance of hatching a Blue Ringed Octopus. The Blue Ringed Octopus features a similar body as the Octopus. It has a yellow body with eight tentacles, two black eyes, and cyan rings on each leg and around its head. Here are the tricks the Blue Ringed Octopus learns in order: The Neon Blue Ringed Octopus glows violet on its blue rings. The Mega Neon Blue Ringed Octopus glows in the same areas as the Neon Blue Ringed Octopus, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Blue Scooter is a limited common single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was available in the 2018 Gifts rotation. It was obtainable from the Small and Big Gifts which cost 70 and 199 respectively. As the Gifts were updated with new items, the Blue Scooter can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Glass Scooter features a dark blue base with two small black wheels. The base is connected to a long rod with two handles; there is a white strip between these handles. Its neon counterpart is the Neon Blue Scooter. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Blue Skateboard is a limited common single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was available in the 2018 Gifts rotation. It was obtainable from the Small and Big Gifts which cost 70 and 199 respectively. As the Gifts were updated with new items, the Blue Skateboard can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Blue Skateboard features an all-blue skateboard with four wheels. Its neon counterpart is the Neon Blue Skateboard. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Blue Sneakers are common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that can be purchased in the Accessory Shop for 150. They can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Blue Sneakers feature bright blue sneakers with a white sole, white laces, and a white pawprint on the sides of each shoe. These pet accessories go on a pet's feet.

wiki.addedEvent: Gifts rotation during the Christmas Event (2017)
wiki.availability: The Blue Snowboard is a limited common single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was available in the Gifts rotation during the Christmas Event (2017). It was obtainable from the old Small and Big Gifts, which cost 99 and 149 respectively. As the Gifts were updated with new items, the Blue Snowboard is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Blue Snowboard features a solid blue snowboard with two areas for a player to place their feet into. Its neon counterpart is the Blue Neon Snowboard. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Blue Whale is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 28, 2026, alongside the Endangered Egg. It was obtainable through hatching Endangered Eggs for 750, Basic Eggs for 400, Crystal Eggs for 4,000, or Admin Abuse Eggs. As the Endangered Egg left the game on August 29, 2026, it can now only be obtained through hatching any remaining Endangered Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 1.5% chance of hatching the Blue Whale from the Endangered Egg. Here are the tricks the Blue Whale learns in order: The Neon Blue Whale glows light blue on its spots and underbelly, while its baleen glows peach. The Mega Neon Blue Whale glows in the same areas as the Neon Blue Whale, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Bluebell Flower was a temporary common item in Adopt Me! that was released on July 24, 2026, alongside the Bee Pass. Players could obtain it through purchasing the Bluebell Seeds from the Seed Shop next to the Bee Pass for 45, planting them in a patch of dirt around Adoption Island, and waiting 11 minutes for it to grow. The Bluebell Flower was not tradable, and disappeared from player inventories when the Bee Pass left the game on August 7, 2026. Players were also refunded 45 for any Bluebell Flowers that were removed from their inventories.
wiki.notes: The Bluebell Flower could be arranged in the pots near the Bee Pass to earn Bee Pass XP. It could only be used once before being consumed.

wiki.availability: The Blueberry Pie is a limited common food item that could be purchased for 3 at the Green Groceries, next to the Soda. It takes five interactions to fully consume and fulfills the 'hunger' need on pets and babies. As this item was removed after the Farm Shop was released, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Blueberry Pie has a beige crust with a blueberry filling and lattice toppings.

wiki.availability: The Bluebottle Fly is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 24, 2023, along with the Urban Egg. As it is now unavailable, the Bluebottle Fly can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Urban Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bluebottle Fly features a round, blue body and head with darker blue stripes on its torso and nose. It has a tuft of dark blue fur on top of its head, two large black eyes, and two light blue wings. Here are the tricks the Bluebottle Fly learns in order: The Neon Bluebottle Fly glows red on its nose stripes, tuft of hair, wing webbings, and abdomen stripes. The Mega Neon Bluebottle Fly glows in the same areas as the Neon Bluebottle Fly, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Boba Tea Chew Toy is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: When interacted with, the player throws the Boba Tea Chew Toy, and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. The pet holds it in its mouth until the player picks up the item. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Bolero Hat is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 5% and 3% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On April 20, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Bolero Hat was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Bolero Hat features a black hat with a pink band and edges. There is a small light pink feather tucked into the band. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Bone Booties are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.8% and 5.5% chance of getting them from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Bone Booties were removed from the game. They can now only be obtained through trading. The Bone Booties feature black high heels with a white trim. It has a skull at the toe of the shoe, and two bones acting as laces. These pet accessories go on a pet's feet.

wiki.availability: The Bone Throw Toy is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was previously purchasable for 250 in the Pet Shop. However, it was removed in the new Pet Shop update that came out on February 22, 2020. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bone Throw Toy features a long thin rod with curves along the opposite sides. This appearance, as true to its name, is made to imitate a pet bone. Similar to all other throw toys in the game, it can be thrown for an equipped pet to fetch and bring back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Bone Wings are limited legendary pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on October 2, 2020. They could have been obtained by digging for fossils during the Fossil Isle Excavation (2020). As the event has ended, they can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Upon discovering a fossil, players could take the said fossil to the NPC Henry, who would in turn give players some information regarding the fossil that they have discovered. After taking two fossils to Henry, he would reward players with the Bone Wings, since they would have uncovered all the legendary pets in the Fossil Egg. The Bone Wings feature white bones that form as wings. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Bone Xylophone is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! which could previously be found when digging for fossils at the Fossil Isle Excavation (2020). This item is now only obtainable through trading, as its respective event has ended.
wiki.notes: The Bone Xylophone features a white xylophone with bone-shaped keys and two wooden sticks with stones at the tips. To interact with this item, the player can click or press their screen with it equipped to play one of several sounds at random. This instrument plays the same sounds as the Steel Drum.

wiki.availability: The Bongos are limited uncommon toys in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased at the Camping Shop for 200. They were removed from the game on February 16, 2023, and have been replaced with the Camper's Bongos. They can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bongos feature two drums with light brown drum heads, a black rim, a dark brown shell, and gray hooks connected by a center block. A player can click their screen with the Bongos equipped to play music. They will play one of several different tunes when using the Bongos, but cannot choose which one.

wiki.availability: The Bonus Aging Potion is an uncommon potion in Adopt Me! that was released on May 15, 2026. Players can earn it as a reward for aging up their pets, or obtain it through trading. One was also given to players for free during the Admin Abuse on September 26, 2026.
wiki.notes: From May 15, 2026 to May 22, 2026, the Bonus Aging Potion was not available as a reward for aging up pets, and could instead be brewed in Tim's cauldron using 3 Tim's Eaten Sandwich and 4 Definitely Not a Fork! ingredients. The Bonus Aging Potion can be fed to a pet to give it a 1.2x XP bonus for 15 minutes. The time left until the effect wears off will only go down while the pet the Bonus Aging Potion was fed to is equipped.

wiki.availability: The Bonus Bucks Potion is a rare potion in Adopt Me! that was released on May 15, 2026. Players can earn it as a reward for aging up their pets, or obtain it through trading. One was also given to players for free during the Admin Abuse on September 26, 2026.
wiki.notes: From May 15, 2026 to May 22, 2026, the Bonus Bucks Potion was not available as a reward for aging up pets, and could instead be brewed in Tim's cauldron using 5 Definitely Not a Fork! and 6 Is That a Mustache? ingredients. The Bonus Bucks Potion can be fed to a pet to give a 1.2x Bucks bonus to its completed needs for 15 minutes. The time left until the effect wears off will only go down while the pet the Bonus Bucks Potion was fed to is equipped.

wiki.availability: The Book of Binding Leash is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on August 22, 2025 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, a black chain will connect the Book of Binding Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The Book of Binding Leash is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on August 22, 2025 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, a black chain will connect the Book of Binding Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The Boomerang Throw Toy is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was previously obtainable through opening Gifts. It was available in the Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. As of the 2021 Gift Refresh update, the Gifts were updated with another set of items, therefore it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Boomerang Throw Toy features a brown boomerang with a pattern of light and dark brown stripes on it. When a player clicks their screen with the Boomerang Throw Toy equipped, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Boots are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on November 17, 2022, as part of the Puss in Boots event. They were one of the gear accessories players had to locate to obtain a Persian Cat from Puss in Boots. As the event has ended, the Boots can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Boots feature black boots with brown strings wrapped around their middles. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's feet.

wiki.availability: The Border Collie is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 23, 2023, along with the Spring Festival (2023). It was available for purchase in the Springfest Shop for 150. As its event has now passed, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Border Collie features a light black body with white spots on its face, chest, and paws. It has a black nose, black eyes, and a pink tongue. These are the tricks the Border Collie learns in order: The Neon Border Collie glows blue on its face, under its ears, underbelly, tip of its tail, and feet. The Mega Neon Border Collie glows in the same areas as the Neon Border Collie, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Border Collie Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2026, alongside the second week of the Sugar Festival Event (2026). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Sugarfest 2026 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Border Collie Sticker features a cartoon Border Collie.

wiki.availability: The Borhyaena Gigantica is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 8, 2023. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Danger Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 25% chance of hatching an uncommon pet from the Danger Egg, but only a 12.5% chance of hatching a Borhyaena Gigantica. The Borhyaena Gigantica features a light brown head with two black eyes, two ears, and brown inner ears, and a dark brown snout with a black nose. It has a light brown, round body with four dark brown feet, four cream-colored stripes, and a brown tail with a dark brown tip. Here are the tricks the Borhyaena Gigantica learns in order: The Neon Borhyaena Gigantica glows purple on its ears, muzzle, tail, paws, and on the stripes on its back. The Mega Neon Borhyaena Gigantica glows in the same areas as the Neon Borhyaena Gigantica, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.egg: Small, Big Gift, or Massive Gift
wiki.availability: The Bouncy Ball Pogo is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on November 3, 2022, as part of the 2022 Gift Refresh Update. It could be purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Bouncy Ball Pogo features a long blue middle with two black handlebars. It has a circular blue footrest with black areas for the player to place their feet into. There is a round half-sphere below the footrest. It serves no other purpose aside from being a fun pogo stick to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Bouquet Chew Toy is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on July 26, 2024, alongside the Games Event (2024). Players could obtain the Bouquet Chew Toy by leveling their Sunshine Games Pass. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bouquet Chew Toy features a bouquet of yellow and purple flowers with green stems. Around the stems, there is a red and yellow bow. When interacted with, the Bouquet Chew Toy is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Bow Shoes are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They were obtainable through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As they were removed from the game on August 22, 2025, they can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bow Shoes feature a pink bow with white polka dots and two hanging ribbons. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's feet.

wiki.availability: The Bow Tie is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 16, 2023, during the Gorilla Fairground event. If a player unboxes an Albino Gorilla from the Premium Gorilla Box, they will also receive the Top Hat and Walking Cane with the Bow Tie. As its respective event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading or opening any remaining Premium Gorilla Boxes.
wiki.notes: Despite the Bow Tie coming with the Albino Gorilla, players are able to place it on any pet. As its name implies, the Bow Tie features a black tie in the shape of a bow. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Bowler is a common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that can be purchased in the Accessory Shop for 150. It can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Bowler is a plain, round black hat that is worn on a pet's head. It resembles a Bowler hat.

wiki.availability: The Box of Jokes is a limited uncommon gift box in Adopt Me! that was released on August 9, 2024, as part of the Jokes Update. Players could purchase it near the Pizza Shop for 555. It left the game on August 16, 2024, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 35% chance of getting a common item, 30% chance of getting an uncommon item, 20% chance of getting a rare item, 10% chance of getting an ultra-rare item, and a 5% chance of getting a legendary item from the Box of Jokes. The Box of Jokes features a blue box with darker blue spots all over it. It has a pair of eyes on the top of the box, a set of teeth, and a pink tongue visible from under the lid.

wiki.availability: The Box of Jokes is a limited uncommon gift box in Adopt Me! that was released on August 9, 2024, as part of the Jokes Update. Players could purchase it near the Pizza Shop for 555. It left the game on August 16, 2024, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 35% chance of getting a common item, 30% chance of getting an uncommon item, 20% chance of getting a rare item, 10% chance of getting an ultra-rare item, and a 5% chance of getting a legendary item from the Box of Jokes. The Box of Jokes features a blue box with darker blue spots all over it. It has a pair of eyes on the top of the box, a set of teeth, and a pink tongue visible from under the lid.

wiki.availability: The Boxing Glove Necklace is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.7% and 0.6% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On April 20, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Boxing Glove Necklace was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Boxing Glove Necklace features two red boxing gloves with beige edges tied to a beige string. The string is knotted near the middle. This pet accessory is worn around a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Brachiosaurus is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, alongside the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024) event. Players were able to obtain it by placing 20 Brachiosaurus Fossils in the Fossil Sequencer 7000 and spending 25 to turn the fossils into a Brachiosaurus. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Brachiosaurus features a long green neck with a yellowish-beige underbelly and yellow spots throughout its body. It has a small ledge on its head, a pointed tar, and four green feet. It also has two black eyes and two small nostrils on its snout, and carries a small twig in its mouth. Here are the tricks the Brachiosaurus learns in order: The Neon Brachiosaurus glows light blue on its spots, underbelly, and neck. The Mega Neon Brachiosaurus glows in the same areas as the Neon Brachiosaurus, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Brachiosaurus Fossil is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024) event. Players could obtain it by mining in the Fossil Isle Mine or purchasing a set of five for 60. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: During the event, once the player had at least twenty Brachiosaurus Fossils, they could put them in the Fossil Sequencer 7000 and spend 25 to turn the fossils into a Brachiosaurus.

wiki.availability: The Brachiosaurus Sticker is a common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Fossil Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Brachiosaurus Sticker features a cartoon Brachiosaurus.

wiki.availability: The Brain Jar is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 0.4% and 0.1% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On September 29, 2022, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Brain Jar were removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Brain Jar features a green jar with a pink brain encapsulated inside. It has a gray base, with red and green buttons. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Brainworm is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It is obtainable through purchasing and opening the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. It is otherwise obtainable through opening Admin Abuse Boxes, purchasing it for 500 when it is on rotation in the Accessory Shop, or trading.

The Bready Necklace is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 5.6% and 3.3% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Bready Necklace was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Bready Necklace features a piece of bread with the center chewed out. This pet accessory goes on a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Beaked Whale Badge is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released as part of the World Oceans Day update. It was obtainable in the WDC (Whale and Dolphin Conservation) Pin Badges Board for free. It was displayed on a wooden board along with the other WDC Pin Badges. A player can attain a maximum of one pin badge every hour. This pin, along with the other ocean badges, was released on June 8, 2021, and left on July 8, 2021. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Beaked Whale Badge features a decagon-shaped pin with a green border. The center has a light blue background showing the Beaked Whale's blue-colored tail, with multiple curve lines that resemble cartoon ocean waves. This pet accessory goes on a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Brick Pile is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on November 22, 2024, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The brick pile features six light orange bricks placed on a yellow board. A brown and gray brick scraper sits at the top of the stack.

wiki.availability: The Briefcase is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 5.5% and 3.3% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As the Briefcase was removed from the game on September 29, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Briefcase features a brown briefcase with gold corners and a golden latch. It shares the same appearance as the Briefcase Ingredient. This pet accessory goes on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Briefcase Ingredient is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released along with the Monkey Fairground event. This item is obtainable through trading, or by unboxing any remaining Monkey Boxes or Premium Monkey Boxes.
wiki.notes: There is a 5% chance of acquiring it through opening regular Monkey Boxes and a 10% chance through Premium Monkey Boxes; these boxes cost 600 and 195 respectively. When a player combined three Briefcase Ingredients and a Monkey during the event, the Monkey was transformed into a Business Monkey. Players did this by talking to the Business Monkey in the Monkey Fairground. The Briefcase Ingredient features a brown briefcase with yellow details on its handle and corners, as well as a yellow lock. The Briefcase Ingredient behaves as a throw toy. When a player clicks their screen with the Briefcase Ingredient equipped, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Brim Beanie is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update.
