wiki.notes: The Buzz Off! Skateboard features a black and blue skateboard with an imprinted pattern of the Bee. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Buzzing Honeypot Hat is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 3, 2026. It could have been obtained by pre-ordering the Bee Fleece Blanket Hoodie through the merch tab of the in-game Shop Menu, until it went off-sale on July 27, 2026. The Buzzing Honeypot Hat can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Buzzing Honeypot Hat features a Honey surrounded by a Bee effect. When on a pet, an animated Queen Bee peeks out from under the lid of the pot before leaving it, flying around in a circle, and going back in. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The CD Stack is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on November 22, 2024, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The CD Stack features a pile of five CD's in colorful cases, with white rims, with the top having the 2D version of the dog. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.egg: Small, Big Gift, or Massive Gift
wiki.availability: The CD Throwing Disc is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on November 3, 2022, as part of the 2022 Gift Refresh Update. It could be purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The CD Throwing Disc features a flat circular disc with a small hole in its center. It is multicolored in its middle, with various shades of blue, purple, orange, and yellow. When interacted with, the CD Throwing Disc is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Cabbit is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 18, 2025, alongside the third week of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). Players were able to purchase it for 490 during the event or from the item rotation in the Cherry Blossom Wagon. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Cabbit learns in order: The Neon Cabbit glows orange on its underbelly, cheek fur, tail, and ear tips. The Mega Neon Cabbit glows in the same areas as the Neon Cabbit, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Cabbit Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 25, 2025, alongside week 4 of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Cherry Blossom 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Cabbit Sticker features a cartoon Cabbit.

wiki.availability: The Cabin Crew Hat is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on June 20, 2026, alongside the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could have purchased it for 4,800. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 24, 2026.

The Cactus Balloon is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 20, 2022, as part of the Snow Weather Update. It can be found and purchased in the Desert Shop for 800 when the Desert Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cactus Balloon features a green cactus in the shape of three round balls. There are several small spikes spread throughout the cactus and a yellow flower on top of the largest part. It is attached to a long black string. The Cactus Balloon increases a player's jump height when equipped.

wiki.availability: The Cactus Bat is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It was obtainable through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on August 22, 2025, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cactus Bat features a green cactus attached to a brown handle. There is a pink flower with a yellow center on top of the cactus. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Cactus Friend is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 25, 2024. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Desert Eggs, Royal Desert Eggs, or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cactus Friend features a round green body with small darker green spikes sticking out, two green arms, two green feet, and two beady black eyes. It has a pink flower on its head. Here are the tricks the Cactus Friend learns in order: The Neon Cactus Friend glows light green on its arms, feet, spikes, and the flower on its head. The Mega Neon Cactus Friend glows in the same areas as the Neon Cactus Friend, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Cactus Friend Hat is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 2.2% and 0.83% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on September 29, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cactus Friend Hat features a round, spherical green cactus with two short legs and a flat pink flower on the top of its head. It has small spikes all over its body, and features a face on its front. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Cactus Friend Plushie is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 20, 2022, during the Desert Weather Map Update. It can be purchased in the Desert Shop for 95 when the shop is on rotation, or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cactus Friend Plushie resembles a green cactus with a pink flower on top of it. It has small spikes all over its body, and features a face on its front. The Cactus Friend Plushie serves no purpose other than just being a cosmetic and interactable item. To hug this toy, the player can click on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Cactus Grappling Hook is a limited rare toy that was added to Adopt Me! as part of the gifts rotation on September 2, 2021. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from the Small, Big, or Massive Gifts. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cactus Grappling Hook features a green cactus accompanied by a brown handle. The cactus sits on top of a brick-colored pot along with a cream-colored base. Similar to other grappling hooks, a brown string will appear from the middle when launched by the player. To interact with this item, a player can click/press anywhere on their screen to fire a hooked-cable; this allows them to be pulled towards their target location. Like most other grappling hooks, players cannot use this item on non-solid graphical objects or if they are on a vehicle, doing an obby, flying or riding a pet.

wiki.availability: The Cactus Plushie Chew Toy is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on September 2, 2021, as part of the 2021 Gift Refresh Update. It could be purchased for 70 or 199 from the Small or Big Gifts. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cactus Plushie Chew Toy features a sage green cactus with white spikes along its sides. It is fit with a brick-colored pot. When interacted with, the Cactus Plushie Chew Toy is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. The pet holds the toy in its mouth until the player picks up the item. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Caelum Cervi is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on June 1, 2023, along with the Pride Event (2023). Players were able to purchase this pet at the Pride Stand near the Playground or the Shop menu for 650. As it has left the game, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Caelum Cervi features a light brown body with a beige underbelly and brown feet. It has a brown nose, antlers, brown curves on its wings, and black eyes. Here are the tricks the Caelum Cervi learns in order: The Neon Caelum Cervi glows yellow on its antlers, inner ears, muzzle, the area around its eyes, the curves on its wings, underbelly, and feet. The Mega Neon Caelum Cervi glows in the same areas as the Neon Caelum Cervi, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Cake is a limited common food in Adopt Me! that was purchasable for 3 in Green Groceries, and was found next to the Popcorn. It was also available for free during the 2019 Valentines Update. This item was removed from the game after the Farm Shop was released and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: It can be fully consumed in two interactions/bites, and can be used to replenish a baby or pet's hunger ailment. The Cake features a chocolate cake with pink icing and three layers, with a glacé cherry on top. There is white cream on the top and bottom.

wiki.availability: The Cake Friend is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 7, 2026, in honor of the game's 9th birthday. Players could have purchased it for 99. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on August 14, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Cake Friend learns in order: The Neon Cake Friend glows sea green on its icing, middle and bottom layers, and on parts of the dollops on top of it. The Mega Neon Cake Friend glows in the same areas as the Neon Cake Friend, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The California Condor is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 28, 2026, alongside the Endangered Egg. It was obtainable through purchasing and hatching Endangered Eggs for 750, or Basic Eggs for 400. As the Endangered Egg left the game on August 29, 2026, it can now only be obtained through hatching any remaining Endangered Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 17.5% chance of hatching the California Condor from the Endangered Egg. Here are the tricks the California Condor learns in order: The Neon California Condor glows golden yellow on its chest, tail, feet, and on parts of its wings, head, and beak. The Mega Neon California Condor glows in the same areas as the Neon California Condor, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Camel is an uncommon pet that was released in Adopt Me! on July 21, 2022. Players are able to hatch it from the Pet Egg, Cracked Egg, Royal Egg, Basic Egg or Admin Abuse Egg. It can otherwise be obtained through trading. The Camel was formerly obtainable from the Crystal Egg from September 12, 2025 to February 20, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Camel has a yellow-tan colored body with a long neck and two humps on its back. It has a brown nose and brown inner ears. It also has two beady black eyes. Listed below are the tricks the Camel learns in order: The Neon Camel glows yellow on the main area of its body as well as inside of its ears. The Mega Neon Camel glows in the same areas as the Neon Camel, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Camera is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on September 15, 2022. It could have been obtained by purchasing it at the stand near the Playground for 130. As the stand is now unavailable, the Camera can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Camera features a black body with a lens, eyepiece, and controls. The Camera is a cosmetic item. When equipped by a player, it will occasionally flash.

wiki.availability: The Camera Hat is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on January 30, 2026, it can only be obtained through trading.

The Camp Patch Sash is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on June 20, 2026, alongside the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could have purchased it for 2,500. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 24, 2026.

The Camper Van is a limited rare six-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released in May 2019. Players could purchase it in the Vehicle Dealership for 1,600. As the Camper Van left the game on March 3, 2022, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Camper Van takes the appearance of a classic minibus, specifically the original Volkswagen Camper. It also has a roof rack installed with various types of bags on it, including a body-color matching backpack. Like the Limo, it has three rows of seating with the last two rows facing each other. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Camper's Bench is an uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released during the Camping Shop Refresh on February 16, 2023. It can be obtained by purchasing it at the Camping Shop for 900 or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Camper's Bench features a log with brown bark with a beige center. The Camper's Bench can be placed on flat surfaces in Adoption Island and can seat two players or pets.

wiki.availability: The Camper's Bongos are uncommon toys in Adopt Me! that were released during the Camping Shop Refresh on February 16, 2023. They can be purchased at the Camping Shop for 200, or obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Camper's Bongos features two light yellow drum heads with black rims, gray tuning hooks, and a light brown shell, connected together by a center block. To interact with this item, a player can click their screen to play music.

wiki.availability: The Camper's Flashlight is an uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released during the Camping Shop Refresh on February 16, 2023. It can be obtained by purchasing it at the Camping Shop for 30 or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Camper's Flashlight features a black handle, with a red rim around the on/off button, with a red cap and head that emits a white light. To interact with this item, players click or press their screen to turn the Camper's Flashlight on or off.

wiki.availability: The Camper's Guitar is a rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released during the Camping Shop Refresh on February 16, 2023. It can be purchased at the Camping Shop for 500. It can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Camper's Guitar features a beige body with a brown rim, and a dark brown neck connected to a light brown headstock with tuning controls. Six strings cover the length of the guitar. To interact with this item, a player can click their screen for the Camper's Guitar to play music.

wiki.availability: The Camper's Sleeping Bag is an uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on February 16, 2023, along with the Camping Shop revamp. It can be obtained by purchasing it from the Camping Shop for 1,000. It can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Camper's Sleeping Bag is similar to the Sleeping Bag, except that it is longer, features sections, and has a black underside. It is color-customizable, but its color cannot be changed after purchase. The Camper's Sleeping Bag can be placed on flat surfaces in Adoption Island and can hold one player or pet. It relieves the 'sleepy' ailment for babies and pets.

wiki.availability: The Camper's Smore Treat is an uncommon food item in Adopt Me! that was released on February 16, 2023, as part of the Camping Shop Refresh. It can be obtained by purchasing it at the Camping Shop for 4 or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Camper's Smore Treat features two tan graham crackers with a melted white marshmallow and dark brown chocolate sandwiched in between the crackers. This item can be used to fulfill a baby or pet's "Hungry" task. It takes 3 bites to completely consume the Camper's Smore Treat.

wiki.availability: The Camper's Sparkler is an uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on February 16, 2023, as part of the Camping Shop Refresh. It is obtainable by purchasing it in the Camping Shop for 20 or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Camper's Sparkler features a brown stick and a black sleeve at the top. At the tip of the stick it glows yellow and emits bright yellow sparkles. When equipped, the Camper's Sparkler only emits bright shining sparkles from the tip.

wiki.availability: The Camper's Tent is an uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released during the Camping Shop Refresh on February 16, 2023. It can be obtained by purchasing it at the Camping Shop for 1,200 or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Camper's Tent features brown wooden poles holding color customizable fabric together with string. Inside the tent is a light brown base and a sleeping bag with a white pillow. The Camper's Tent can be placed on flat surfaces in Adoption Island and can hold one player or pet. It replenishes the 'sleepy' ailment for babies and pets.

wiki.availability: The Camper's Wheelbarrow Stroller is an uncommon stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on February 16, 2023, during the Camping Shop Refresh. It can be purchased at the Camping Shop for 400 or obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Camper's Wheelbarrow Stroller features a red container, a black wheel, red hand grips, two gray legs and two handlebars. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Campfire Cookies Bait Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on March 28, 2025, alongside the second week of the Ice Dimension Event (2025). It can only be obtained through unwrapping any remaining Fire Dimension Sticker Packs, which cost 400, or trading, as it left the game on April 4, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Campfire Cookies Bait Sticker features a cartoon Campfire Cookie.

wiki.availability: The Campfire Stories Mega Neon Paint is a limited legendary toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 26, 2026, alongside week two of the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could have purchased it for 49. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 24, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Campfire Stories Mega Neon Paint can be used in the Salon to temporarily change the Mega Neon color cycle of a pet, applying a cycle consisting of red, light brown, and two different shades of orange. It can be used an unlimited number of times.

wiki.availability: The Camping Sandals are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on June 20, 2026, alongside the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could have purchased them for 900. They are now only obtainable through trading, as they left the game on July 24, 2026.

The Camping Tent is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 17, 2022, as part of the Woodland Egg update. It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Camping Shop for 1,200. Since the Camping Shop's revamp on February 16, 2023, the Camping Tent was replaced with the Camper's Tent and is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Camping Tent features brown stakes holding together a color-customizable fabric with a sleeping bag inside. The Camping Tent was color-customizable, though its color could not be changed after purchase. The Camping Tent can be placed on flat surfaces in Adoption Island and can hold one player or pet. It replenishes the 'Sleepy' ailment for babies and pets.

wiki.availability: The Camping Van is an Ultra-Rare four-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released during the Camping Shop Refresh on February 16, 2023. It can be obtained by purchasing it at the Camping Shop for 3,000, or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Camping Van features a van with a black bumper and white headlights. It has gray door handles. On the hood of the van, there is an empty rack. It is color-customizable upon purchase. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Canadian Goose is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on November 2, 2023. Players were able to purchase this pet in the Farm Zone next to the Accessory Shop for 600. It can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Canadian Goose features a white body with two brown wings, and a black neck, head, and feet. It has a white stripe on its head, two beady black eyes and a black beak. Here are the tricks the Canadian Goose will learn in order: The Neon Canadian Goose glows orange on the wings, feet, beak, and the white part of its face. The Mega Neon Canadian Goose glows in the same areas as the Neon Canadian Goose, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Candicorn is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 13, 2026, alongside the Sugar Festival Event (2026). Players could purchase it for 1,000. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Candicorn learns in order: The Neon Candicorn glows pink on its feet and parts of its mane and tail. The Mega Neon Candicorn glows in the same areas as the Neon Candicorn, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Candicorn Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2026, alongside the second week of the Sugar Festival Event (2026). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Sugarfest 2026 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Candicorn Sticker features a cartoon Candicorn.

wiki.availability: The Candihorn Instrument is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 13, 2026, alongside the Sugar Festival Event (2026). Players could purchase it for 9,000. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
wiki.notes: To interact with this item, a player can click on their screen with the Candihorn Instrument equipped to play music. It will play one of several different tunes when used, but the player cannot choose which one.

wiki.availability: The Candle is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 14, 2019, along with the Christmas Event (2019). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading or by opening any remaining Christmas Gifts.
wiki.notes: Players have a 10% chance of opening a Candle from a Christmas Gift. The Candle features a white wax bottom with a small flicker of orange-yellow flame. It casts a bright yellow light. The Candle provides a small area of light.

wiki.availability: The Candy Apple is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 11, 2022. It can be found and purchased in the Fall Shop for 500 when the Fall Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Candy Apple features a melting red apple on a brown stick. This pet accessory is worn on top of a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Candy Camper is a limited ultra-rare five-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on December 24, 2023, as part of the Winter Festival (2023). It was obtainable by claiming it from the event's Advent Calendar on day twenty-four. Since its day has passed, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Candy Camper features a light brown van with white icing dripping on it, blue windows, and yellow headlights, giving it the appearance of a van made of gingerbread. There is a line of candy cane spirals lining the bottom and four wheels resembling chocolate cookies. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Candy Cane is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me!. Players could claim this pet accessory from the 2021 Advent Calendar on day twenty-one. As that day has passed, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Candy Cane, as true to its name, features a red and green candy cane with a large red and gold bow in the middle. This pet accessory goes on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Candy Cane Cake is a limited common food item in Adopt Me! that was released on December 4, 2023. Players could have claimed this on day four of the 2023 Advent Calendar that was present in the Winter Festival (2023) event. Since its day has passed, the Candy Cane Cake is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Candy Cane Cake can be used to fulfill the 'Hunger' ailment for babies and pets, taking three uses to fully consume. The Candy Cane Cake features a cake with white icing and red layers. It has small pieces of red-and-white peppermint and a candy cane on top.

wiki.availability: The Candy Cane Chew Toy is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me!. It was introduced during the Winter Holiday (2020) event on December 15, 2020. It cost 240. The Candy Cane Chew Toy can now only be obtained through trading, as its respective event has ended.
wiki.notes: The Candy Cane Chew Toy features a red-and-white striped candy cane with a green bow in the middle. When interacted with, the Candy Cane Chew Toy is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. The pet holds the chew toy in its mouth until the player picks up the item or unequips the pet. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Candy Cane Grappling Hook is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me!. It could be obtained from the 2021 Advent Calendar on December 16, 2021, during the Winter Holiday (2021). As its Advent Calendar day has passed, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Candy Cane Grappling Hook features red and white candy canes wrapped with Christmas string lights and tucked into a red and white sock. By tapping or clicking anywhere on their screen, the player is pulled in the direction that they tap or click on.

wiki.addedEvent: It could be claimed on the fifteenth day during the Christmas Event (2019)
wiki.availability: The Candy Cane Pogo Stick is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me!, which was obtainable from the 2019 Advent Calendar. It could be claimed on the fifteenth day during the Christmas Event (2019). Since this day has passed, it is only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Candy Cane Pogo Stick, as the name suggests, is a white cane-shaped pogo stick with red stripes. There are two white handlebars on the top and red pegs on the bottom. In addition to its design, it has a green bow attached in the middle. As it is a pogo stick, it provides transportation by bouncing instead of walking.

wiki.availability: The Candy Cane Snail is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 28, 2024, as part of the second week of the Easter Event (2024). Players were able to purchase this pet for 50,000 in the Easter Shop. As the event has ended, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Candy Cane Snail features a purple snail with lavender parts. Its shell is patterned in white, yellow, red, and blue stripes. It also has two beady black eyes. Here are the tricks the Candy Cane Snail learns in order: The Neon Candy Cane Snail glows pink on its white stripes and lavender part. The Mega Neon Candy Cane Snail glows in the same areas as the Neon Candy Cane Snail, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Candy Cane Wings are limited uncommon wing pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on December 14, 2023, as part of the third week of the Winter Festival (2023). Players were able to purchase them for 12,000. As the event has ended, they can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: These pet accessories can be used to customize a pet's default wings when it is flown. The Candy Cane Wings are heart-shaped wings that have red and white stripes, resembling a candy cane. It has a pink bow in the center of the two wings. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back when the pet is flown.

wiki.availability: The Candy Cannon is a limited legendary toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game in October 2018, as part of Halloween Event (2018). It could have been purchased for 2,000. Since the event has ended, the Candy Cannon is now unavailable and can only be obtained by trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Candy Cannon features a sleek black cannon topped with a round, yellow-glowing bulb. It has an orange handle at the back and a small orange compartment on its bottom. The Candy Cannon shot out Candy (Currency) during the Halloween Event (2018). When the event ended, it was changed to shoot Candy (Food). Some time later, Candy (Food) was replaced with the Candy Corn and removed from the game. The Candy Corn is a food item rather than a currency. The Candy Cannon used to shoot an unlimited amount of Candy (Food), which turned into lollipops when a player picked it up. The way the Candy Cannon functioned was changed to fix lag issues. The Candy Cannon can shoot out five Candy Corn at a time; however, if the player attempts to shoot out more, the Candy Corn will despawn.

wiki.availability: The Candy Cliffs Hat is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 13, 2026, alongside the Sugar Festival Event (2026). Players could purchase it for 5,000. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.

The Candy Copper Hat is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2026, alongside the second week of the Sugar Festival Event (2026). Players could purchase it for 3,750. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
The Candy Corn is a common food item in Adopt Me! that is shot out of the Candy Cannon. It can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: When the Candy Cannon shoots out Candy Corn, players can go up to the Candy Corn and collect it. The Candy Corn automatically appears in the player's inventory once they collect it. Players can feed the Candy Corn to their pets or eat it themselves. When eaten, it increases the speed of the player, similar to the Hyperspeed Potion, Candy (Food), Chocolate, Chocolate Twist, Chocolate Drop, Ice Tub, Cookie, Monkey Fairground Cotton Candy, and Honey Candy. The more Candy Corn the player eats, the faster their speed becomes. The Candy Corn is triangular shaped with yellow, orange, and white stripes. It leaves a white trail when held, which fades around the back.

wiki.availability: The Candy Corn Cape is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2026, alongside the second week of the Sugar Festival Event (2026). Players could purchase it for 850. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.

The Candy Corn Hat is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released along with the Halloween Event (2022) on October 6, 2022. Players could obtain the Candy Corn Hat by purchasing it for 450. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Candy Corn Hat is in the shape of a candy corn and has three different colors on it. The bottom is yellow, the middle is orange, and the top is white. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Canine Cruiser is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was available at the Redemption Kiosk in the Safety Hub. The redeemable code for this item was AMTRUCK2024. The Canine Cruiser can now only be obtained through trading, as its code has expired.

wiki.availability: The Capricorn is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 30, 2022. It is available for purchase in the Pet Shop and in the Shop GUI for 1,060 (formerly 1,250), while it was initially located outside of the Nursery for the first two weeks of its release; it comes with the Space Bundle gamepass. Listed below are the tricks the Capricorn learns in order: The Neon Capricorn glows bright yellow on its body, ears, head, feet, and the ends of its tail. wiki.availability: The Captain's Wheel Throw Toy is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on February 9, 2023, as part of the Rain Weather Update. Players can purchase it in the Rain Gift Shop for 200 when the Rain weather is on rotation. It can also be obtained through trading.

Being a throw toy, the player will throw the Captain's Wheel Throw Toy when interacted with. Their equipped pet will fetch and bring it back to them afterwards. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Capuchin Monkey is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 5, 2024, along with the Capuchin Fairground. Players were able to purchase it for 300. Players were able to combine a Capuchin Monkey with 3 Toy Handcuffs, Cool Sunglasses, Tutus or Compasses to get a themed type of the Capuchin Monkey. You could get the Inmate Capuchin Monkey, the Preppy Capuchin Monkey, Princess Capuchin Monkey and the Pirate Ghost Capuchin Monkey. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Capuchin Monkey has black fur on its forearms, feet, tail, back, and head. It has tan fur on its stomach, upper arms, face, and ear insides. It has two black eyes, a nose, and a tuft of black hair on its head. Here are the tricks the Capuchin Monkey learns in order: The Neon Capuchin Monkey glows bright red on its hands, feet, nose, inner ears, and arms. The Mega Neon Capuchin Monkey glows in the same areas as the Neon Capuchin Monkey, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Capybara is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 31, 2019, along with the Jungle Egg. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by trading or by hatching any remaining Jungle Eggs.

The Capybara has a brown body, triangle-shaped ears with black insides, dark brown feet, a black nose, and two beady black eyes. It also has a white bucktooth. Listed below are the tricks the Capybara learns in order: The Neon Capybara glows bright pink on its inner ears, nose, and feet. The Mega Neon Capybara glows in the same areas as the Neon Capybara, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Car is a limited uncommon two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that could be purchased in the Vehicle Dealership for 900. The Car left the game on March 31, 2022, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Car has the design of a common everyday coupe. It has a simplistic design where it only features the body with windows, two simple seats with a steering wheel inside, a grille, glowing yellow headlights, glowing red taillights, and four simplistic wheels with light gray rims. Its design slightly resembles a pre-facelift Tesla Model S. It was color-customizable upon purchase. Initially, the Car had a less realistic and blocky shape. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Car Stroller is a limited uncommon stroller in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Baby Shop for 450. It was removed from the game on June 24, 2021, and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Car Stroller resembles the front side of a basic car in Adopt Me!. It has four black wheels and has two yellow headlights in the front. Where the baby or pet sits, there is a black seat. At the back, there is also a black and blue handle that a player holds onto when the stroller is equipped. Upon purchase, players were able to color-customize it. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Carousel Propeller is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game as part of the Gorilla Fairground event on March 16, 2023. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through opening any remaining Standard Gorilla Boxes, or through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 10% chance of unboxing this item from the Standard Gorilla Box and a 20% chance from the Premium Gorilla Box. The Carousel Propeller features a carousel. The central pole are red and blue, with yellow lines in between, connecting down to the handle of the carousel propeller. As it is a propeller, its function is similar to other propellers: it is used to propel players into the air.

It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Celestial Balloon features a yellow star, a pink crescent moon, and a pink ring connected by a white pole. It has two yellow stars with a white handlebar. Just like any other balloon, its only function is allowing a player to jump higher.

wiki.availability: The Celestial Carrier is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts. As it is no longer in the Gifts rotation, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Celestial Carrier features a dark blue car with small yellow stars throughout its design. It has two orange lights and a yellow star at the front, a yellow fender, light blue seats, and light brown insides. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Celestial Leash is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 18, 2021. It was available in the Small and Big Gifts, which cost 70 and 199 respectively. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Celestial Leash features a blue and brown planet connected to a black handle. Yellow rings surround the planet, and around it orbits two moons. When in use, it has a black string. When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, a black line will connect the Celestial Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The Celestial Propeller is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Celestial Propeller features an off-white handle with a purple circle with a star in it dark lavender ribbon spiralling around it. It has yellow decorations on its handle, and is topped with a yellow star. It has small off-white wings on its sides. To interact with this toy, a player can click or press their screen to be propelled upward; they can press the spacebar or the jump button to stop.

wiki.availability: The Cerberus is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 28, 2020, as part of the Halloween Event (2020). It cost 500 and was on sale for 400 in the Final Stop Shop. As it has left the game on May 18, 2023, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cerberus could also have been purchased from the Shop icon on the top right of a player's screen and was previously located in the Pet Shop. The Cerberus is a three-headed dark gray hound. Parts of its heads, along with its eyes, ears, noses, and paws, are colored black, with the exception of a light gray underbelly. Each of the three heads have a pink tongue sticking out, two ears, two black eyes, a black nose, and gray head fur. Listed below are the tricks the Cerberus learns in order: The Neon Cerberus glows bright lavender on the insides of its ears, the fur on its chest, and its tail. The Mega Neon Cerberus glows in the same areas as the Neon Cerberus, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Cerberus Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2025, alongside the second week of the Halloween Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Halloween 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Cerberus Sticker features a cartoon Cerberus.

wiki.availability: The Chainsaw Rattle is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on November 3, 2022, as part of the 2022 Gift Refresh Update. It could be purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Chainsaw Rattle features an orange base with a black handle. It has a gray saw with darker edges and is presumably based off the design of a chainsaw. It serves no purpose other than being a fun cosmetic item to interact with. To interact with this item, a player can click/press their screen to shake the rattle.

wiki.availability: The Chair Swing Propeller is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 28, 2024, as part of the third week of the Summer State Fair (2024). Players could purchase the Chair Swing Propeller for 1,400. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Chair Swing Propeller features a red and white striped canopy with the top ending in a yellow base and red ball. It is framed by a curved yellow border with a series of white circular lights. Hanging from the canopy are several red swing chairs with yellow armrests. The handle is in a red and white stripe pattern as well, and there is a yellow circular base at the bottom. To interact with this item, the player can click anywhere on their screen to be propelled upwards. To stop, a player must jump while the propeller is in use.

wiki.availability: The Chairlift is a limited rare three-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on December 6, 2024, alongside the Winter Festival (2024). Players can purchase it for 45,000 or obtain it through trading.
wiki.notes: The Chairlift features three red seats attached to a yellow frame that is secured to a black cable. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Chakram Flying Disk is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It can be opened from Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. It can otherwise be obtained through opening Admin Abuse Boxes or trading.
wiki.notes: When interacted with, the Chakram Flying Disk is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Chakram Flying Disk is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It can be opened from Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. It can otherwise be obtained through opening Admin Abuse Boxes or trading.
wiki.notes: When interacted with, the Chakram Flying Disk is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Chameleon is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 27, 2022, during the Task Board update. It can be obtained through opening RGB Reward Boxes at a 2.25% chance or trading.
wiki.notes: The Chameleon features a green body with a pastel yellow underbelly and a curled tail. It has bright green stripes on its head and casque, with yellow-outlined stripes placed horizontally down its back. Additionally, the tips of its feet are pastel yellow. The Chameleon has two beady black eyes and black nostrils. Here are the tricks the Chameleon learns in order: The Neon Chameleon glows cyan on the tips of its feet and stripes. The Mega Neon Chameleon glows in the same areas as the Neon Chameleon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Chameleon Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on August 1, 2024. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Pets Plus Sticker Packs, which were received when purchasing the Pets Plus subscription for 299, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Chameleon Sticker features a cartoon Chameleon.

wiki.availability: The Chandelier Pogo Stick is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: It serves no other purpose aside from being a fun pogo stick to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Chanekeh is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 12, 2025. It could have been obtained through purchasing and hatching Aztec Eggs for 750, or Basic Eggs for 400. As the Aztec Egg left the game on February 28, 2026, it can now only be obtained through hatching any remaining Aztec Eggs and Royal Aztec Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 12% chance of hatching the Chanekeh from the Aztec Egg, and a 17% chance of hatching it from the Royal Aztec Egg. Here are the tricks the Chanekeh learns in order: The Neon Chanekeh glows golden yellow on its face spots, feet, claws, the bottom half of its face, and on the front side of its body. The Mega Neon Chanekeh glows in the same areas as the Neon Chanekeh, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Charon's Boat is a limited ultra-rare four-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on October 12, 2023, as part of the Halloween Event (2023). It could have been purchased in the Asylum Shop for 68,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Charon's Boat features a brown boat with white ridges at the bottom of the boat. At the front and ends of the boat, there are sharp white spikes. Connected to the end of the boat, there is an orange lantern that curves into the boat. At the front of the boat, there is a white skull. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Chattering Teeth Grappling Hook is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Chattering Teeth Grappling Hook features red gums with straight, white teeth. By tapping or clicking anywhere on their screen, the player is pulled in the direction that they tap or click on.

wiki.availability: The Chattering Teeth Toy is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on August 9, 2024, as part of the Jokes Update. Since the Jokes Update left on August 16, 2024, the Chattering Teeth Toy can now only be obtained through trading, or through opening any remaining Box of Jokes.
wiki.notes: The Chattering Teeth Toy features red gums, straight white teeth, and a pair of eyes.

wiki.notes: The Cheeky Yellow Lipped Sea Krait Sticker features a cartoon Yellow-lipped Sea Krait.

wiki.availability: Cheese is a common food item in Adopt Me! that can be purchased for 2 in the Green Groceries, received as a reward for aging up pets, or obtained through trading. The Cheese was also purchasable in the Farm Shop before its removal, and one was given to players for free during the Admin Abuse on August 15, 2026, and September 5, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Cheese features a bright yellow, triangle-shaped cheese with holes along its sides. This item can be used to fulfill the 'hungry' ailment on pets and babies. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. It takes two uses to fully consume.

wiki.availability: The Cheese Hat is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.8% and 0.7% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Cheese Hat was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Cheese Hat features a yellow slice of cheese with small holes throughout. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Cheese and Lettuce Collar is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 3, 2026, alongside week three of the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could have purchased it for 4,900. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 24, 2026.

The Cheesecake Hat is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 27, 2026, alongside the third week of the Sugar Festival Event (2026). Players could purchase it for 5,300. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.

The Cheetah is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 26, 2024, alongside the Games Event (2024). Players could obtain it by leveling their Sunshine Games Pass. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cheetah features a yellow-orange body with brown spots and an orange and white head. On its face, there is a brown nose, whiskers, two beady black eyes, and a few dark spots. At the top of its head, there are three dark brown lines and two orange ears with darker insides. It has a white chest and underbelly, four orange feet, and an orange tail with a white tip. Here are the tricks the Cheetah learns in order: The Neon Cheetah glows a bright golden orange-yellow on the spots on its lower body and on the three stripes on its forehead. The Mega Neon Cheetah glows in the same areas as the Neon Cheetah, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Chef Hat is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 150 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Chef Hat features a cylindrical white hat with a slightly tilted round area near the top. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Chef Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released during the Gorilla Fairground event on March 16, 2023. It could have been obtained by creating a Chef Gorilla (combining a normal Gorilla and three Rolling Pins) during the event. Once a player created a Chef Gorilla, the Chef Hat would be automatically added to the player's inventory.
wiki.notes: Despite the Chef Hat coming with the Chef Gorilla, players are able to place it on any pet. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.

wiki.availability: The Cherry Balloon is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70 or 199 from Small or Big Gifts. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on August 22, 2025 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: As it is a balloon, its only function is to allow a player to jump higher.

wiki.availability: The Cherry Blossom 2025 Sticker Pack is a limited rare sticker pack in Adopt Me! that was released on April 25, 2025, alongside week 4 of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). Players were able to purchase it for 1,000 during the event or from the item rotation in the Cherry Blossom Wagon. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Players receive 10 stickers when they unwrap a Cherry Blossom 2025 Sticker Pack. There is a 40% chance of getting a common, 25% chance of getting an uncommon, 16.25% chance of getting a rare, 14.75% chance of getting an ultra-rare, a 3.95% chance of getting a non-animated legendary, and a 0.5% chance of getting the legendary Super Saru Animated Sticker.

wiki.availability: The Cherry Blossom Earring are a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 23, 2023, along with the Spring Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Springfest Shop for 1,680. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Cherry Blossom Earring, as true to its name, feature a pair of earrings that depicts a pink cherry blossom. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's ears or on the sides of its head.

wiki.availability: The Cherry Blossom Flower Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 25, 2025, alongside week 4 of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Cherry Blossom 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Cherry Blossom Flower Sticker features a cartoon cherry blossom.

wiki.availability: The Cherry Blossom Glasses are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They were obtainable through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As they were removed from the game on August 22, 2025, they can now only be obtained through trading.

The Cherry Blossom Hang Glider is a limited legendary toy in Adopt Me! that was released on April 4, 2025, alongside the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). Players could have purchased it for 90,000 during the event or from the item rotation in the Cherry Blossom Wagon. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cherry Blossom Hang Glider features a pink cover decorated with a cherry blossom flower and petals, and supported by a dark gray frame. When a player clicks their screen with the Cherry Blossom Hang Glider equipped, it grows in size and they are lifted upwards. They can then click their screen again to be boosted upwards while using it. To stop gliding, they can use the jump button or collide into an object.

wiki.availability: The Cherry Blossom Tree Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 25, 2025, alongside week 4 of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Cherry Blossom 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Cherry Blossom Tree Sticker features a cartoon cherry blossom tree.

wiki.availability: The Cherry Earrings are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on March 13, 2021. They could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 750. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Cherry Earrings feature a pair of red cherries and green leaves worn on each ear of the pet. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's ears or on the sides of its head.

wiki.availability: The Cherry-on-Top is a legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 15, 2024. It can be obtained by redeeming a code from the purchase of an Ice Cream Truck or Adopt Me! Salon playset. It can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cherry-on-Top features three stacked scoops of ice cream: one strawberry, one vanilla, and one chocolate. The scoops are topped with rainbow sprinkles and a single cherry. When worn by a pet, this item emits a sprinkle effect. This pet accessory is worn on a pet’s head.

wiki.availability: The Cherub Chipmunk is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 6, 2026, alongside the Valentine's Event (2026). Players could have purchased it for 1,600 or hatched it from a Basic Egg or Crystal Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on February 20, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Cherub Chipmunk learns in order: The Neon Cherub Chipmunk glows white on its belly, ears, feet, back stripes, and on the bottom half of its tail and face. The Mega Neon Cherub Chipmunk glows in the same areas as the Neon Cherub Chipmunk, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Cherub Staff Throw Toy is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on February 6, 2026, alongside the Valentine's Event (2026). Players could have purchased it for 1,100. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on February 20, 2026.
wiki.notes: When interacted with, the Cherub Staff Throw Toy is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Chest Monster is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on November 22, 2024, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Chest Monster features a black base and orange tentacles emerging from the base. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Chestnut Glyptodon is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 18, 2026, during that day's Admin Abuse. Players could have purchased it for 20,000. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 24, 2026.
wiki.notes: It was originally planned to be given out for free during the Admin Abuse on July 18, 2026 if Jesse received the most Admin Votes for the fourth week of the Summer Camp Event (2026), but was not due to Dagi receiving the most votes. Here are the tricks the Chestnut Glyptodon learns in order: The Neon Chestnut Glyptodon glows light blue on its face spots and on the inside of its shell. The Mega Neon Chestnut Glyptodon glows in the same areas as the Neon Chestnut Glyptodon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Chew Ball is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was available in the Small and Big Gifts, which cost 70 and 199 respectively. As the Gifts have been updated with new items, the Chew Ball is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Chew Ball features a ball made of colorful bands wrapped around one another. When a player interacts with the Chew Ball, an equipped pet will 'chew' on it by holding it in its mouth, staying in the same area until the player picks up the item again. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Chick is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released along with the Easter Event (2020). In the event, participating players were given a free Easter 2020 Egg that has 100% chance of hatching the Chick. As its respective event has left the game, the Chick can only be obtained through trading or by hatching any remaining Easter 2020 Eggs.
wiki.notes: Once the player received the Chick during the event, they also got a badge and an exclusive avatar item, the Chick Head. Players can still hatch this egg and obtain a Chick, but the exclusive avatar item is no longer obtainable. The Chick has small wings on both sides of its bright yellow body along with a tufted tail and small orange feet. It has a round yellow head, on top of which are two black eyes and an orange beak. Here are the tricks the Chick learns in order: The Neon Chick glows yellow on its tail, feet, and wings. The Mega Neon Chick glows in the same areas as the Neon Chick, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Chick Backpack is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could be found in the Easter Event (2021). It could be bought in the event for 250, which were scattered throughout the map for players to collect. The Chick Backpack is no longer purchasable and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Chick Backpack features a squashed chick with rosy pink cheeks. It has two tiny orange legs, an orange beak, two large black eyes, and two tiny yellow wings. This pet accessory goes on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Chick Hat is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 29, 2021, as part of the Easter Event (2021). It could have been purchased for 250 at the Easter Stand. As its event has passed, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Chick Hat features a chick with a bright yellow body and head, yellow wings, and black eyes. It also has an orange beak and small orange feet. It closely resembles the Chick. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Chick Plush is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was obtainable during the Easter Event (2019). It cost 7 Easter Eggs, which were scattered around the map for players to find. As its respective event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Chick Plush features a round, oval-shaped chick with beady black eyes, short eyelashes, and an orange beak. Its upper part is yellow, while its lower part is colored pink with two yellow zigzag stripes. There is a small yellow tuft sticking off the top of it. To interact with the Chick Plush, a player can click or press their screen to hug it.

wiki.availability: The Chick Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on August 1, 2024. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Pets Plus Sticker Packs, which were received when purchasing the Pets Plus subscription for 299, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Chick Sticker features a cartoon Chick.

wiki.availability: The Chickatrice is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 13, 2022, along with the Halloween Event (2022). Players could purchase it in the Halloween shop for 15,000. As the event has ended, the Chickatrice can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Chickatrice features a red body with a violet underbelly. It has yellow feathers on the tip of its tail and above its wings, which have dark violet ridges and lighter insides. The Chickatrice has two black eyes, a red comb, a dark gray beak, and a red spot of feathers on its face. It has two small violet feet and violet wing spurs. Here are the tricks the Chickatrice learns in order: The Neon Chickatrice glows light purple on its wings, the tip of its tail, and its crown. The Mega Neon Chickatrice glows in the same areas as the Neon Chickatrice, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Chickatrice Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 25, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Halloween Event (2024). As the event has ended and the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon has closed, it can only be obtained through opening any remaining Halloween 2024 Sticker Packs or trading.
wiki.notes: The Chickatrice Sticker features a cartoon Chickatrice.

wiki.availability: The Chicken is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2019, along with the Farm Egg. As the it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by trading with other players or by hatching any remaining Farm Eggs.

wiki.availability: The Chicken Hat is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 500 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
