wiki.availability: The Chill Leviathan Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 3, 2026, as a part of the Pets Plus Refresh Update. It can be obtained through purchasing the Pets Plus subscription and opening the Vol. 2 Pets Plus Sticker Pack, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Chill Leviathan Sticker features a cartoon Leviathan.

wiki.availability: The Chilling Spider is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2025, alongside the second week of the Halloween Event (2025). It could have been obtained through hatching a Basic Egg or Crystal Egg. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Spider Boxes or trading, as it left the game on November 7, 2025.
wiki.notes: There is a 10% chance of obtaining a Chilling Spider from the Spider Box. It has a white body with 4 bright blue eyes on its spherical head. It has 8 legs and padded feet. Its abdomen resembles a snowball and it has sharpened fangs. In Arachnophobia mode, its feet become disconnected and it loses its fangs and two of its eyes. Here are the tricks the Chilling Spider learns in order: The Neon Chilling Spider glows light blue on parts of its legs and fangs. The Mega Neon Chilling Spider glows in the same areas as the Neon Chilling Spider, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Chimera is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 6, 2022, as part of the Halloween Event (2022). It could have been found and purchased for 110,000 in the Halloween Shop. As the event ended on November 3, 2022, it can now only be obtained by trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Chimera features a body with three parts: its front resembles a lion with a brown mane, yellow face and ears, black eyes and nose, and two long horns. To the right, there is gray head with small rounded horns and black eyes: this resembles a goat. The Chimera has a green snake with a beige underbelly for a tail. These are the tricks the Chimera learns in order: The Neon Chimera glows purple on its mane, the underside of the snake part, and its hind legs. It glows peach on its horns, inner ears, and the tongue of the snake. The Mega Neon Chimera glows in the same areas as the Neon Chimera, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Chimney Hat is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 0.4% and 0.1% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On September 29, 2022, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Chimney Hat were removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Chimney Hat features two long dark blue tubes with black tops and bottoms. The tops are slightly cone-shaped. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Chinese Lantern is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on February 16, 2018, alongside the Chinese New Year (2018). It could have been purchased for 195. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Chinese Lantern features a red lantern with a golden dog depicted on it. It has a copper handle attached to it with bronze lining. It emits red smoke when used and it leaves a trail below it when released into the sky.

wiki.availability: The Chinese Tea Tray is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on November 22, 2024, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Chinese Tea Tray features a brown circular tray with three small blue teacups. Next to the teacups, there is a blue teapot and a blue cup that is bigger than the teacups. This accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Chipmunk is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 7, 2023. Players could purchase it in the Pet Shop for 1,300, though it was displayed outside the Nursery for the first two weeks of its release. The Chipmunk left the game on April 19, 2024, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Chipmunk features an orange body with a beige underbelly and lower face. It has an orange and brown tail with four feet. It has two orange ears with light pink inner ears, two beady eyes, a pink nose, and whiskers. On its face, there's a triangular brown marking that connects from the nose to the top of its head, where there's a tuft of brown fur. Here are the tricks the Chipmunk learns in order: The Neon Chipmunk glows orange on its tuft of fur, brown markings, outer ears, whiskers, and feet. The Mega Neon Chipmunk glows in the same areas as the Neon Chipmunk, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Choccybunny Box is a limited legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was released on April 3, 2026, alongside week four of the Sugar Festival Event (2026). Players could purchase it for 15,000. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
wiki.notes: Players have a chance to obtain a rare Milk Choccybunny, an ultra-rare White Choccybunny, or a legendary Dark Choccybunny from the Choccybunny Box.

wiki.availability: The Choco Penguin is an ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on November 7, 2025. Players can tame it by using a Golden Goldfish in the Ice Cream Shop, which costs 195. It is otherwise obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: There is an 87.5% chance of obtaining a Choco Penguin from the Golden Goldfish. Here are the tricks the Choco Penguin learns in order: The Neon Choco Penguin glows blue on its wings and the rim of its cone. The Mega Neon Choco Penguin glows in the same areas as the Neon Choco Penguin, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Chocolate is a limited common food item in Adopt Me! that was previously obtainable during the Sweet Street event in May 2018 alongside the Ice Tub, Chocolate Drop, and the Chocolate Twist. It could have been bought for 5. Since its event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Chocolate features a flat brown rectangle with six trapezoid-shaped bumps on top. This item can be used to fulfill a baby or pet's 'hungry' ailment. It takes three uses to fully consume. When eaten by a player, the Chocolate boosts their walk speed.

wiki.availability: The Chocolate Bunny Balloon is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was obtainable during the 2019 Easter Event and is now only obtainable through trading. It cost 7 Easter Eggs, which were scattered around Adoption Island for players to find.
wiki.notes: The Chocolate Bunny Balloon features a small brown bunny attached to a white string. The bunny is modeled similarly to the Bunny pet. This item is used to let players jump higher than usual.

wiki.availability: The Chocolate Chip Bat Dragon is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on November 30, 2023, along with the Winter Festival (2023). Players were able to purchase this pet for 1,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Chocolate Chip Bat Dragon features a dark brown body, two white and beige curls of chocolate horns, brown and beige ears, two beady black eyes, brown freckles, a brown nose on its snout, brown-and-beige-striped wing frames, and two small brown fangs protruding from its mouth. It has a tail with a beige cookie tip and feet with brown bottoms and beige tops, dotted with chocolate. The Chocolate Chip Bat Dragon is a reskin of the Bat Dragon. Here are the tricks the Chocolate Chip Bat Dragon learns in order: The Neon Chocolate Chip Bat Dragon glows orange on its underbelly, parts of its horns, tail, ears, wing casings, beige cookie tail-tip, feet, and freckles. The Mega Neon Chocolate Chip Bat Dragon glows in the same areas as the Neon Chocolate Chip Bat Dragon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Chocolate Chip Bat Dragon Backpack is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It is obtainable through purchasing and opening the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. It is otherwise obtainable through opening Admin Abuse Boxes, purchasing it for 25,000 when it is on rotation in the Accessory Shop, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 0.03% chance of obtaining it from the Standard Chest, and a 0.1% chance of obtaining it from the Regal Chest or Admin Abuse Box. The Chocolate Chip Bat Dragon Backpack features a beige and brown backpack with many features of the Chocolate Chip Bat Dragon, including its ears, brown nose, freckles, horns, two brown fangs, and a miniature version of its wings. It also has cookies on its side pockets, two black eyes above its freckles, and gives off a cookie and chocolate chip effect. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Chocolate Chow-Chow is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released in the VIP room refresh on July 28, 2022. It can be obtained through buying a Golden Bone for 209 or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 10% chance of obtaining a Chocolate Chow-Chow from the Golden Bone. The Chocolate Chow-Chow features a head and tail that are dark brown, with the tail having a lighter brown tip. It has two ears with darker brown insides, two black eyes, a dark brown nose on top of its muzzle, and a blue tongue sticking out. Its body is a lighter brown and has a circular shape. It has four brown colored feet. Listed below are the tricks the Chocolate Chow-Chow learns in order: The Neon Chocolate Chow-Chow glows bright blue on its muzzle, the fur around its body, the insides of its ears, and the back of its tail. The Mega Neon Chocolate Chow-Chow glows in the same areas as the Neon Chocolate Chow-Chow, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Chocolate Drop is a limited common food item in Adopt Me! that was released in May 2018, as part of the Sweet Street event. It was purchasable for 5. Since its event has ended, the Chocolate Drop is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Chocolate Drop features a wide, teardrop-shaped chocolate. This item can be used to fulfill a baby or pet's 'hungry' ailment. It takes three uses to fully consume. When eaten by a player, the Chocolate Drop boosts their walk speed.

wiki.availability: The Chocolate Dutch Guinea Pig is an ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 3, 2026, replacing the Hummingbirds from the Golden Petunia. It is obtainable through purchasing the Pets Plus subscription for 299 and using the Golden Lettuce, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is an 87.5% chance of obtaining a Chocolate Dutch Guinea Pig from the Golden Lettuce. The Chocolate Dutch Guinea Pig features a light brown body with two tufts of fur on its face and a partially white tuft of fur on its head. It has a white facial marking, a white marking on its chest, underbelly, and sides. It has a pink nose, four pink paws, as well as two light pink ears with darker pink inner ears, and two beady black eyes. Here are the tricks the Chocolate Dutch Guinea Pig learns in order: The Neon Chocolate Dutch Guinea Pig glows pink on its forehead, inner ears, and on patches of its body. The Mega Neon Chocolate Dutch Guinea Pig glows in the same areas as the Neon Chocolate Dutch Guinea Pig, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Chocolate Egg is a limited common food in Adopt Me! that was obtainable during the Easter Event (2018). Players could obtain a Chocolate Egg by finding Dr. Eggburt, an NPC, each in-game day, or purchase it for 50. It was also used as a currency during that event. Players could purchase the Egg Rattle, Hugging Egg, and Egg Stroller with Chocolate Eggs. Since the event is over, players can now only obtain the Chocolate Egg through trading.
wiki.notes: The Chocolate Egg features brown chocolate in the shape of an egg. This item can be used to fulfill a baby or pet's 'hungry' ailment. It takes one use to fully consume. When eaten by a player, the Chocolate Egg boosts their walk speed.

wiki.availability: The Chocolate Labrador is an uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2019, along with the Pets update. Originally, players could obtain it by hatching a Cracked Egg, a Pet Egg, or a Royal Egg, but as of July 21, 2022, the Chocolate Labrador can only be obtained by hatching a Retired Egg or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have an 8.75% chance of hatching a Chocolate Labrador from a Retired Egg. The Chocolate Labrador is brown and has dark brown ears and legs. It has two beady black eyes, a nose with a short pink tongue that hangs out of its mouth, and a stubby brown tail. It is a recolor of the Dog, with a brown body instead of beige. Listed below are the tricks the Chocolate Labrador learns in order: The Neon Chocolate Labrador glows yellow on its ears and paws. The Mega Neon Chocolate Labrador glows in the same areas as the Neon Chocolate Labrador, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.egg: VIP Room or pet age-up reward
wiki.availability: The Chocolate Milk is a common food item in Adopt Me! that can be purchased for 2 from the Green Groceries, received as a reward for aging up pets, or be obtained through trading. The Chocolate Milk was also purchasable in the Farm Shop before its removal.
wiki.notes: A variant of the Chocolate Milk, known as the VIP Chocolate Milk, can be found in the VIP room inside the Nursery. VIP players may enter the room and consume it for free. However, the VIP Chocolate Milk will disappear from the player's inventory after they leave the game. The Chocolate Milk is a glass cup filled up with dark-brown chocolate milk. It has a red-and-white straw protruding from the cup. This item can be used to fulfill the 'thirsty' ailment on pets and babies. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. It takes five uses to fully consume.

wiki.availability: The Chocolate Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2026, alongside the second week of the Sugar Festival Event (2026). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Sugarfest 2026 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Chocolate Sticker features a brown chocolate bar.

wiki.availability: The Chocolate Twist is a limited common food item in Adopt Me!. It was obtainable during the Sweet Street event in May 2018 for 5 alongside the Chocolate, Chocolate Drop, and Ice Tub. As its event is over, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Chocolate Twist features a thin brown stick of chocolate. This item can be used to fulfill a baby or pet's 'hungry' ailment. It takes three uses to fully consume. When eaten by a player, the Chocolate Twist boosts their walk speed.

wiki.availability: The Choo Choo Train is a limited legendary six-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that could have been obtained from Small, Big, and Massive Gifts which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. As it is no longer in the rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Choo Choo Train is headed by an antique steam-powered locomotive with a navy blue base, a gold trim, and two lanterns attached to it, one in the front and one on the left side. The lanterns glow at night, and steam blows out of the blast-pipe while it moves. The design seems to be based on typical American steam locomotives built in the 19th century (the 1800s). The Choo Choo Train has 5 box-shaped railcars connected to it. Five out of the six available seats are railcars, with the driver's seat being in the locomotive. The railcars have the same color pattern as the locomotive itself, also sharing the same wheels. The railcars of the Choo Choo Train don't resemble any sort of real-life railcar, but they do share a similarity to mine-carts (despite the fact that mine-carts aren't pulled by steam locomotives). This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Choosy Potion is a rare potion in Adopt Me! that was released on May 15, 2026. Players can earn it as a reward for aging up their pets, or obtain it through trading. One was also given to players for free during the Admin Abuse on September 26, 2026.
wiki.notes: From May 15, 2026 to May 22, 2026, the Choosy Potion was not available as a reward for aging up pets, and could instead be brewed in Tim's cauldron using 5 Tim's Eaten Sandwich and 6 Is That a Mustache? ingredients. The Choosy Potion can be fed to a pet to give it the 'Choose' need.

wiki.availability: The Christmas Boots are limited ultra-rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on December 10, 2023, as part of the Winter Festival (2023). They could have been claimed from the 2023 Advent Calendar on day ten. As their day has passed, they are now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Christmas Boots feature a black sole, a shiny red footbed, a black strap with a yellow buckle, and a white lining at the opening of the boot. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's feet.

wiki.availability: The Christmas Cat Rattle is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that could be obtained from Small Gifts in the December 2017 gifts rotation. It is no longer available and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Christmas Cat Rattle features a white cat with red ears, beady blue eyes, a green ribbon on the neck, and a small Santa Hat on its tail. It is held up by a white stick. This rattle leaves a red and white trail when equipped. The rattle's appearance is based on the Meowy Christmas shoulder accessory on the Roblox catalog. To interact with this toy, a player can click on their screen to shake it back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Christmas Dog Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on December 12, 2025, alongside the second week of the Winter Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Winter 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Christmas Dog Sticker features a cartoon Dog wearing a Santa Hat and a red scarf.

wiki.addedEvent: It was obtainable during the Christmas Event (2017)
wiki.availability: The Christmas Doge Rattle is a limited common toy in Adopt Me!. It was obtainable during the Christmas Event (2017) through the Small Gifts. It is now no longer available and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Similar to the Doge Rattle, the Christmas Doge Rattle features a beige-colored doge head, complete with a red Santa hat. It is connected to a white handle, which is where the rattle is held. This rattle leaves behind a red and green trail. To interact with this toy, a player can click their screen to shake it back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Christmas Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on December 14, 2019, as part of the Christmas Event (2019).
wiki.notes: There is a 30% chance of obtaining a Christmas Egg when opening a Christmas Gift ( 1,440), and an 80% chance from a Golden Gift ( 4,300). The following pets can be hatched from a Christmas Egg: the Robin, the Wolf, the Polar Bear, the Swan, the Arctic Fox, or the Arctic Reindeer. As the Christmas Event (2019) ended on January 11, 2020, the Christmas Egg is now only obtainable by trading with other players or by opening any remaining Christmas Gifts or Golden Gifts. The Christmas Egg features a brown egg adorned with pine boughs, colored ornaments, and a yellow star; this is presumably made to resemble a Christmas tree. Spherical ornaments, colored blue, green, red, and yellow, are scattered around the egg. Note: This table only includes the pets that are obtainable from the Christmas Egg. To view all pets released alongside the event, including the pets that cost Gingerbread or Robux, see the Christmas Event (2019) page.

wiki.availability: The Christmas Future Egg is a limited uncommon egg in Adopt Me! that was released on December 7, 2023, as part of the second week of the Winter Festival (2023). Players could obtain this egg by collecting it in the Frostclaw's Fury minigame and winning the minigame. This egg had a 1 in 3 (33.3%) chance of appearing in the minigame for each player. Since the event ended, the Christmas Future Egg is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: This egg has a 100% chance of hatching an Eggnog Dog, and takes four tasks to hatch. The Christmas Future Egg features a light blue egg wrapped in a bright pink ribbon. It has an off-white tag with black scribbles tied to the egg with a black string.

wiki.availability: The Christmas Gift is a limited legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was released during the Christmas Event (2019) along with its counterpart, the Golden Gift. It was available for purchase from December 14, 2019, up to January 11, 2020, and cost 1,440. It is now only obtainable through trading. When opened, the player will receive a toy, vehicle, or Christmas Egg.
wiki.notes: The Christmas Gift features a green box with a bright red ribbon around the four sides, which joins at the top to create a traditional standard bow.

wiki.availability: The Christmas Pudding Pup is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 20, 2023, during the Advent Calendar of the Winter Festival (2023). As its day has passed, it can now only be obtained through trading or by placing any remaining Christmas Pudding Pup Baits in a Box Lure or Cozy Home Lure.
wiki.notes: Players have a 100% chance of getting a Christmas Pudding Pup from a Christmas Pudding Pup Bait. The Christmas Pudding Pup resembles a Christmas pudding, where it has a brown and spotted body with white frosting and a mistletoe on top. It has a face with two beady black eyes, a brown nose, and a red tongue. It has two brown ears covered in frosting, a small brown tail, and four brown feet. The Christmas Pudding Pup emits a blue, Northern Light aura above its head. Listed below are the tricks the Christmas Pudding Pup learns in order: The Neon Christmas Pudding Pup glows blue on its icing and red on its mistletoe berries and nose. The Mega Neon Christmas Pudding Pup glows in the same areas as the Neon Christmas Pudding Pup, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.egg: Opening 20 doors in the 2023 Advent Calendar
wiki.availability: The Christmas Pudding Pup Bait is a limited ultra-rare food item in Adopt Me! that was released on December 20, 2023. Players could have claimed it by opening twenty doors of the 2023 Advent Calendar during the Winter Festival (2023). As the 2023 Advent Calendar has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Players can place the Christmas Pudding Pup Bait in a Box Lure or Cozy Home Lure to obtain an ultra-rare Christmas Pudding Pup after a 25-minute cooldown. The Christmas Pudding Pup Bait features brown, bone-shaped treat topped with white frosting and cherries. It is sitting on a white plate.

wiki.availability: The Christmas Pudding Pup Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on March 28, 2025, alongside the second week of the Ice Dimension Event (2025). It can only be obtained through unwrapping any remaining Fire Dimension Sticker Packs, which cost 400, or trading, as it left the game on April 4, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Christmas Pudding Pup Sticker features a cartoon Christmas Pudding Pup.

wiki.availability: The Christmas Spirit is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 12, 2025, alongside week two of the Winter Event (2025). It occasionally spawned in the area between Santa's Workshop and the Snowball Pug taming area, which allowed players to purchase it for 150,000. It was also available in the Crystal Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 9, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Christmas Spirit learns in order: The Neon Christmas Spirit glows light blue on its wing feathers, the tips of its antlers, and on its chest, head, and inner ear fur. The Mega Neon Christmas Spirit glows in the same areas as the Neon Christmas Spirit, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Christmas Spirit Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on December 12, 2025, alongside the second week of the Winter Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Winter 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Christmas Spirit Sticker features a cartoon Christmas Spirit.

wiki.availability: The Christmas Star Flying Disc (formerly known as Christmas Star Frisbee) is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that could have been obtained during the Christmas Event (2019) by purchasing and opening Christmas Gifts, which cost 1,440. This toy can now only be obtained through trading or opening any remaining Christmas Gifts, as the Christmas Event (2019) has ended.
wiki.notes: The Christmas Star Flying Disc features a flat, golden eight-pointed star. It bears the exact same appearance as the Star Ornament, which was also available in the Christmas Event (2019). When a player interacts with the Christmas Star Flying Disc, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Christmas Star Flying Disc (formerly known as Christmas Star Frisbee) is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that could have been obtained during the Christmas Event (2019) by purchasing and opening Christmas Gifts, which cost 1,440. This toy can now only be obtained through trading or opening any remaining Christmas Gifts, as the Christmas Event (2019) has ended.
wiki.notes: The Christmas Star Flying Disc features a flat, golden eight-pointed star. It bears the exact same appearance as the Star Ornament, which was also available in the Christmas Event (2019). When a player interacts with the Christmas Star Flying Disc, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Christmas Tree Earrings are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on November 30, 2023, alongside the Winter Festival (2023). Players were able to purchase them for 500. As the event has ended, they can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Christmas Tree Earrings feature a pair of green Christmas trees with brown trunks, a black smiley face, and ornaments of assorted colors. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's ears or on the sides of its head.

wiki.availability: The Christmas Tree Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on January 3, 2025, alongside the fifth week of the Winter Festival (2024). It can now only be obtained through trading or unboxing any remaining Winter 2024 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000 until January 17, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Christmas Tree Sticker features a cartoon Christmas tree.

wiki.availability: The Cicada Brooch is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It is obtainable through purchasing and opening the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. It can otherwise be purchased for 200 when on rotation in the Accessory Shop, or obtained through trading.

The Cinnamon Roasted Almonds are a limited common food in Adopt Me! that were released on May 16, 2025, alongside the Gibbon Fairground. As the event ended on May 30, 2025, they are now only obtainable through trading or opening any remaining Standard Gibbon Boxes.
wiki.notes: The Cinnamon Roasted Almonds can be used to fulfill the 'Hungry' ailment for babies and pets, taking one use to fully consume. When eaten by a player, they slightly increase their speed.

wiki.availability: The Cinnamon Roll is a limited uncommon food item in Adopt Me! that was released on August 11, 2022, along with the Fall Weather Update. Players can purchase it in the Fall Shop for 3 or obtain it through trading.
wiki.notes: It can only be found in the Fall Shop for 36 hours at a time, along with the other items in the shop. The Cinnamon Roll features a small tan roll with white icing glazed on the top. By eating this food, the player's walk speed will slightly increase. The Cinnamon Roll's effects can be stacked infinitely, further increasing the player's speed each time one is eaten. This effect remains until the player resets or leaves. This item can be used to fulfill the 'hungry' ailment on pets and babies. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. It takes one use to fully consume.

wiki.availability: The Cinnamon Stick is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on August 11, 2022. It can be found and purchased in the Fall Shop for 300 when the Fall Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cinnamon Stick features a pile of brown sticks tied together with a red ribbon. When the Cinnamon Stick is thrown, an equipped pet will chase it and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, the Cinnamon Stick provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Cinnamon Swirl Propeller is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It can be opened from Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. It can otherwise be obtained through opening Admin Abuse Boxes or trading.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with the Cinnamon Swirl Propeller equipped, they will be propelled upwards. To stop ascending, the player can unequip the item or jump.

wiki.availability: The Circus Ball Skates are a limited uncommon single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on April 5, 2024, alongside the Capuchin Fairground. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through opening any remaining Standard Capuchin Boxes or through trading.
wiki.notes: This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Circus Ball Unicycle is a limited uncommon single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 16, 2023, alongside the Gorilla Fairground. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through opening any remaining Standard Gorilla Boxes and Premium Gorilla Boxes, or through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 30% chance of unboxing this item from the Standard Gorilla Box and a 45% chance from the Premium Gorilla Box. The Circus Ball Unicycle features a yellow seat, with a blue, yellow, and blue triangular pattern on the edge of the seat. It has blue and yellow rods that connects to a blue and orange circus ball. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Circus Tent Propeller is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on May 16, 2025, alongside the Gibbon Fairground. As the event ended on May 30, 2025, it is now only obtainable through trading or opening any remaining Standard Gibbon Boxes.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with the Circus Tent Propeller equipped, they will be propelled upwards. To stop ascending, the player can unequip the item or jump.

wiki.availability: The City Hat is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on January 30, 2026, it can only be obtained through trading.

The Clam Stroller is a common stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on June 8, 2021, as part of the World Oceans Day update. It could have been obtained for free at the Oceans Day Stand, which was next to the main bridge between Adoption Island and the Neighborhood. As it left the game on July 8, 2021, it is now no longer obtainable. The Clam Stroller cannot be traded; players could only have obtained it if they attended its event.
wiki.notes: The Clam Stroller features an open golden clam with a glowing pearl at the center. The insides of the clam are magenta-pink. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Clam Wings are limited common wing pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on September 15, 2022. They could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Wing Chest for 150; players had a 45% chance of unboxing them. As their rotation has left the game, the Clam Wings can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Clam Wings feature two yellow clams with wavy curves and thick yellow edges. There is a white pearl on each wing, along with several green vines wrapped around the clams. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back when it is flown.

wiki.availability: The Clan Banner is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 0.94% and 0.22% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on September 29, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Clan Banner features a large flag dangling from a long golden rod. The right side of the flag is purple, while the left is a deep violet; in the center, there is a depiction of an orange-yellow sun. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Classic Airplane is a common two-seater flying vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 3, 2022. It can be purchased for 4,000 in the Vehicle Dealership. It can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Classic Airplane features a propeller plane with three black wheels, two black seats, black propellers, and cosmetic lights on its airfoils. The exterior of the Classic Airplane is colored in yellow by default, and can be changed by the player upon purchase. Its secondary color, white, cannot be changed. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Classic American Car is a limited ultra-rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on June 14, 2024, alongside the Summer State Fair (2024). It could be purchased for 70,000. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Classic American Car features a purple body with an open roof. There is a wide grille in the front of the car with double rounded headlights on both sides. The Classic American Car also has a windshield on top, two gray rearview mirrors, two purple wings at the back of the car, and four gray wheels with black rims. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Classic Boat is a common eight-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 3, 2022. It can be purchased for 2,750 in the Vehicle Dealership. It can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Classic Boat features a large boat with a white stripe looping around its sides, along with a white bottom. It has eight black seats inside, as well as a black support rail. No engine or propellers can be found anywhere around the exterior of the vehicle. The exterior of the boat is colored blue by default, however, it can be changed by the player after purchase. The secondary white color cannot be changed. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Classic Helicopter is a common four-seater flying vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 3, 2022. It can be purchased for 3,500 in the Vehicle Dealership. It can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Classic Helicopter, as true to its name, features a helicopter with gray door handles and four black seats inside. It is topped with a black spinning propeller. The exterior of the helicopter is colored sleek red by default, however, the color can be changed by the player after purchase. The secondary black color cannot be changed. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Classic Teapot is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on May 23, 2024, as part of the Roblox Classic Event. It could have been obtained by interacting with the NPC, NooBurt. Players could age the pet until Full Grown to obtain RoCoin, the event currency that could be used in the Roblox Hub. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Classic Teapot features a light purple teapot, with a spout, lid, and handle. The inside of the pot is shadowed, with two circular, white eyes, and four dark gray fingers around the rim. Listed below are the tricks the Classic Teapot learns in order: The Neon Classic Teapot glows purple on its lid. The Mega Neon Classic Teapot glows in the same area as the Neon Classic Teapot, except that area cycles through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Classic Trade Stand is an ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 28, 2024. Players are able to purchase it for 95 or through trading.
wiki.notes: When placed, the Classic Trade Stand will allow other players to start a trade with the stand owner, no matter where the owner is. The owner will also be able to choose the item to display on the stand.

wiki.availability: The Claw is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that could previously have been found when digging for fossils at the Fossil Isle Excavation (2020). As its respective event has ended, this item can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Claw, as true to its name, features a gray, sharp, claw-shaped toy. To interact with this item, a player can click or press the screen to throw. When thrown, a player's equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Claw Grabber is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.8% and 5.5% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Claw Grabber was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Claw Grabber includes a gray claw with yellow joints and base. At the tip of each claw, there is a black grip. This pet accessory goes on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Claw Machine Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on August 22, 2025 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Clear Glasses are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on September 8, 2020. They could have been purchased for 150 in the Accessory Shop when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Clear Glasses feature a pair of glasses with translucent white frames and clear lenses. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Clementine Owl is an ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released into the Green Groceries on January 9, 2026, replacing the Ladybugs. Players can obtain it with a Golden Seed Ball, which costs 195, or through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 77.5% chance of obtaining a Clementine Owl from the Golden Seed Ball. Here are the tricks the Clementine Owl learns in order: The Neon Clementine Owl glows orange on its feet, wing tips, and body spots. The Mega Neon Clementine Owl glows in the same areas as the Neon Clementine Owl, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Clockwork Wings are limited ultra-rare wing pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on May 11, 2023. They can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Wing Chest for 130; players have a 3% chance of unboxing them. The Clockwork Wings can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Clockwork Wings feature four gold gears in their center and thin metal pieces that extend outwards. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back when the pet is flown.

wiki.availability: The Cloud is a limited legendary single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that used to be obtainable in the November 2018 Gifts rotation. It was obtainable from Small, Big, and Massive Gifts which cost 99, 199, and 499 respectively. As the Gifts have been updated to contain new items, the Cloud can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cloud is a small white cloud that levitates slightly off the ground and leaves behind a unique rainbow trail. It contains only one seat, no steering wheel, and no wheels. Despite being a cloud, it cannot fly and is only restricted to levitating. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Cloud Grappling Hook is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 20, 2026, alongside the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could have purchased it for 1,700. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 24, 2026.
wiki.notes: To interact with this item, a player can click anywhere on their screen to fire a cable that allows them to be pulled towards their target location. Like other grappling hooks, players cannot use this item on non-solid graphical objects, if they are on a vehicle, doing an obby, or flying or riding a pet.

wiki.availability: The Cloud Wings are limited ultra-rare wing pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on May 11, 2023. They can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Wing Chest for 130; players have a 3% chance of unboxing them. The Cloud Wings can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cloud Wings feature off-white clouds with blue accents and bumps throughout. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back when the pet is flown.

wiki.availability: The Clouds & Rainbow Rattle is a rare rattle in Adopt Me! which can be found and bought in the Baby Shop for 400.
wiki.notes: The Clouds & Rainbow Rattle is a white rattle topped with a rainbow, which stretches from two clouds at either end. It has a cloud as its handle. Each of these clouds are decorated with two beady black eyes and a curved smile. The rainbow has only three colors: orange, green, and blue. A player can click their screen with this item equipped to shake it back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Clout Goggles are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased for 250 in the Accessory Shop. As they are no longer part of the rotation, they can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Clout Goggles feature a pair of glasses with white oval frames and black lenses. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Clover Balloon is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on March 31, 2022, as part of the 2022 Gift Refresh Update. It could be purchased for 70 or 199 from Small or Big Gifts. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Clover Balloon features a bright-green four leaf clover connected to a long stem. There is a darker green accent in the clover's center. Just like any other balloon, its only function is allowing a player to jump higher.

wiki.availability: The Clover Cow is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 14, 2025, alongside the St. Patrick's Day Update. Players were able to purchase it for 1,850. As it left the game on March 21, 2025, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Clover Cow learns in order: The Neon Clover Cow glows light green on its clover-shaped detailing, horns, inner ears, feet, and the tip of its tail. The Mega Neon Clover Cow glows in the same areas as the Neon Clover Cow, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Clown Umbrella is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on May 28, 2020, as part of the Monkey Fairground event. Since the event ended, players can obtain it by opening any remaining Monkey Boxes and Premium Monkey Boxes, which cost 600 and 195, respectively, or through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: There is a 7.5% chance of obtaining this item from a Monkey Box, and a 22.5% chance from a Premium Monkey Box. The Clown Umbrella features an umbrella with a red rod and a blue and yellow handle. On the very top of the rod connects a red and yellow striped canopy with a blue trim. The Clown Umbrella behaves like a balloon; it only increases a player's jump height.

wiki.availability: The Clown Unicycle is a limited uncommon single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released during the Monkey Fairground. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through opening remaining Monkey Boxes or Premium Monkey Boxes, or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Clown Unicycle features a red-seated unicycle with a long seat post. The seat post is connected to a blue rod and a bright wheel, which is layered with colors of red, yellow, and blue. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Clown Wig is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on November 22, 2024, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Clown Wig features a wig containing red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple. This pet accessory is worn on the pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Clown Car is a limited ultra-rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released alongside the Monkey Fairground on May 28, 2020. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by opening any remaining Monkey Boxes and Premium Monkey Boxes (at a 3.33% and 6.66% chance respectively), or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Clown Car features a cartoonish and exaggerated design, taking the shape of a compact car. It has a red body with yellow spots scattered around it a white bumper on each side, a short grille at the front in between two large circular headlights, blue side-mirrors, two rectangular-shaped taillights, a massive air horn on the roof, and four wheels with white rims with a red star in the middle with large blue fenders above each one. Its windows lack transparency. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Clownfish is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 16, 2021, alongside the Ocean Egg. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by hatching any remaining Ocean Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 10% chance of hatching a Clownfish from an Ocean Egg. The Clownfish features a striped orange, black, and white fish with two beady black eyes on the side. It has two fins on its side, a double fin on its back and underside, and a large tail fin, all of which are outlined in black. Here are the tricks the Clownfish learns in order: The Neon Clownfish glows light orange on its white stripes. The Mega Neon Clownfish glows in the same areas as the Neon Clownfish, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Clownfish Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on September 20, 2024, alongside the second week of the Ocean Event (2024).
wiki.notes: As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Ocean Sticker Packs or through trading. The Clownfish Sticker features a cartoon Clownfish.

wiki.availability: The Clubtail Dragonfly is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 20, 2026, alongside the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could have purchased it for 13,000, or hatched it from a Basic Egg or Admin Abuse Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 24, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Clubtail Dragonfly learns in order: The Neon Clubtail Dragonfly glows orange on its wings, antennae, underside, and feet. The Mega Neon Clubtail Dragonfly glows in the same areas as the Neon Clubtail Dragonfly, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Clubtail Dragonfly Wings are limited ultra-rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on June 20, 2026, alongside the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could have purchased them for 7,250. They are now only obtainable through trading, as they left the game on July 24, 2026.

The Clumpty is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 29, 2026, alongside the Fairytale Egg. It is obtainable through hatching Fairytale Eggs for 750, Royal Fairytale Eggs for 14, Basic Eggs for 400, Crystal Eggs for 4,000, Admin Abuse Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 10% chance of hatching the Clumpty from the Fairytale Egg, and a 20% chance of hatching it from the Royal Fairytale Egg. Here are the tricks the Clumpty learns in order: The Neon Clumpty glows orange on the edges and buttons of its shirt, and on the dark blue stripes of its pants. The Mega Neon Clumpty glows in the same areas as the Neon Clumpty, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Cobra is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 17, 2021. It could have been purchased for 500 in the Sky Castle. It was removed on May 11, 2023, along with a revamp to the Sky Castle, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cobra has brown spots throughout its orange-colored skin and has a light tan underbelly. It has a large hood, with two beady black eyes on its face. It also has a flickering red forked tongue with two white pointy fangs on each side. Here are the tricks the Cobra learns in order: The Neon Cobra glows peach on its spots and tongue. The Mega Neon Cobra glows in the same areas as the Neon Cobra, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Cockroach is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 24, 2023, along with the Urban Egg. As it is now unavailable, the Cockroach can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Urban Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cockroach features a brown body, a dark brown thorax, dark brown wings, black beady eyes, long, curvy, dark brown antennae, and three pairs of dark brown feet. Here are the tricks the Cockroach learns in order: The Neon Cockroach glows yellow on its antennae, body, and legs. The Mega Neon Cockroach glows in the same areas as the Neon Cockroach, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Cocoadile is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 13, 2026, alongside the Sugar Festival Event (2026). Players could purchase it for 14,000, or hatch it from a Basic Egg or Admin Abuse Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Cocoadile learns in order: The Neon Cocoadile glows light yellow on its underbelly, feet, and around its eyes. The Mega Neon Cocoadile glows in the same areas as the Neon Cocoadile, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Cocoadile Cape is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 13, 2026, alongside the Sugar Festival Event (2026). Players could purchase it for 4,500. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.

The Cocoadile Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 13, 2026, alongside the Sugar Festival Event (2026). Players could purchase it for 7,500. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.

The Cocoadile Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2026, alongside the second week of the Sugar Festival Event (2026). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Sugarfest 2026 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Cocoadile Sticker features a cartoon Cocoadile.

wiki.availability: The Coconut Drink is a limited uncommon food item in Adopt Me! that was released on February 9, 2023. Players can purchase it in the Rain Gift Shop for 2 when the Rain weather is on rotation. It can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Coconut Drink features half of an opened coconut with a yellow straw sticking out of it. This item can be used to fulfill the 'thirsty' ailment on pets and babies. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. It takes five uses to fully consume.

wiki.availability: The Coconut Friend is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 11, 2025, alongside week two the Summer Festival (2025). Players could have purchased it for 145,000. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Coconut Friend learns in order: The Neon Coconut Friend glows light green on its feet and the leaves on its back, while the blush under its eyes glows pink. The Mega Neon Coconut Friend glows in the same areas as the Neon Coconut Friend, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Coconut Friend Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on July 25, 2025, alongside week four of the Summer Festival (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Summer 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Coconut Friend Sticker features a cartoon Coconut Friend.

wiki.availability: The Coconut Shoes are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on July 4, 2025, alongside the Summer Festival (2025). Players could have purchased them for 700. They can now only be obtained through trading.

The Coconut Stroller is a limited uncommon stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Coconut Stroller features a hollowed coconut shell with a fourth of it cut away. It has a pink umbrella with a cream colored handle, along with a pink blanket. There is a cream colored stroller handle, along with four cream colored wheels with brown axles. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: Coffee is a common food item in Adopt Me! that can be purchased for 3 in the Coffee Shop, received as a reward for aging up pets, or be obtained through purchasing a Coffee Maker in the furniture catalog for 500. It can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: This item can be used to fulfill the 'thirsty' ailment on pets and babies. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. It takes six uses to fully consume if obtained from the Coffee Shop and five uses to consume if obtained from the Coffee Maker.

wiki.availability: The Cold Cube is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 13, 2024, alongside the second week of the Winter Festival (2024). Players could have purchased the Ice Tray for 18,000 until January 17, 2025. As the event has ended, the Cold Cube can only be obtained through trading or opening any remaining Ice Trays.

Here are the tricks the Cold Cube learns in order: The Neon Cold Cube glows teal on the inner and outer layers of its body. The Mega Neon Cold Cube glow in the same areas as the Neon Cold Cube, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Combat Target Dummy is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 9, 2023. As it was removed from the game on May 10, 2024, it can now only be obtained through trading.

wiki.availability: The Compass is a limited legendary toy in Adopt Me! that was released on April 5, 2024, as part of the Capuchin Fairground event. As the event has ended, this item is only available through opening any remaining Standard Capuchin Boxes or Premium Capuchin Boxes, or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Compass features a compass with a gold rim and a blue face. A blue spiral aura surrounds it and there is a small chain at the top. When a player combined three Compasses and a Capuchin Monkey during the event's duration, their Capuchin Monkey would be transformed into a Pirate Ghost Capuchin Monkey. It now only behaves as a throw toy. When a player clicks their screen with the Compass equipped, their pet will fetch it and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Conductor Hat is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 250 while on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Conductor Hat is a white, puffy hat with thin gray stripes. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Constellation Cape is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It was obtainable through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on August 22, 2025, it can now only be obtained through trading.

The Construction Hat is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 14, 2020, during the Pet Accessory Update. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 125 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Construction Hat features a plain, bright-yellow construction hat. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Controller Balloon is a limited uncommon toy that was added into Adopt Me! on March 18, 2021, as part of the new gifts rotation. It allows players to jump higher, similar to other balloons. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Controller Balloon resembles a blue-gray video game console connected to a white string. The Controller Balloon allows a player to jump higher when equipped.

wiki.availability: The Convertible is a limited rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Vehicle Dealership for 2,100. As the Convertible left the game in May 2019, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The old design of the Convertible was a very basic, blocky design, similar to that of the Car's old design, but without a roof. The Convertible was remodeled in 2018 to better resemble a modern real-life convertible. Its new design is based on a Nissan 370z roadster. Like the other vehicles in the Vehicle Dealership, the Convertible was color-customizable upon purchase. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.addedEvent: Small Gifts during the Christmas Event (2017)
wiki.availability: The Cookie is a limited common food item in Adopt Me!. There are two variations of the Cookie. The first version could have been bought for 20 on the first floor of the old Coffee Shop before it was remodeled, and was also obtainable through Small Gifts during the Christmas Event (2017). It was removed from the Coffee Shop on November 9, 2019, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The second version can be obtained for free from the Cookie Jar furniture item, which was only available on June 28, 2025. It was earned through logging in alongside a Roblox friend, with duplicates being rewarded for every 20 minutes spent in-game with a friend, and was given to players through the FUNiture 2025 Box. As the Cookie Jar is no longer available, the Cookie dispensed from it can only be obtained through taking them from any existing Cookie Jars or trading. It disappears from a player's inventory when they leave the game. Both versions of the Cookie can be used to restore a baby or pet's hunger ailment. The Cookie from the Coffee Shop takes one use to fully consume, while the Cookie from the Cookie Jar takes three. When consumed by a player, both versions of the Cookie boost their walk speed. The Cookie from the Coffee Shop features a flat, golden-brown cookie with scattered chocolate chips throughout the cookie. The Cookie from the Cookie Jar features a golden-brown cookie in the shape of a head with two ears, and topped with light brown and dark brown icing in a design resembling the Chocolate Chip Bat Dragon.

wiki.availability: The Cookie Dough Plush is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that could have been obtained during the Christmas Event (2019) by purchasing and opening Christmas Gifts, which cost 1,440. The Cookie Dough Plush can now only be acquired through trading or opening any remaining Christmas Gifts.
wiki.notes: The Cookie Dough Plush features a round-shaped, light brown cookie with a chunk missing off its top; there are chocolate chips and multicolored sprinkles spread throughout each of its two sides. To interact with the Cookie Dough Plush, a player can click their screen with it equipped to hug it.

wiki.availability: The Cookie Flying Disc (formerly known as Cookie Frisbee) is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was obtainable during an old gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: Players were able to obtain the Cookie Flying Disc from the Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. wiki.availability: The Cotton Candy Stand is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! added on September 29, 2022, that could have been obtained by purchasing the Cotton Candy Stand Gamepass for 50.

wiki.availability: The Croc Plush is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was obtainable from an old gifts rotation during 2018. It was available in the Small and Big Gifts, which cost 70 and 199 respectively. As the Gifts were updated to contain new items, the Croc Plush can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Croc Plush features a light green crocodile with yellow dorsal scales, two black eyes, several pointed white teeth, and a pink tongue. To interact with the Croc Plush, a player can click their screen with it equipped to hug it.

wiki.availability: The Crocodile is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 31, 2019, along with the Jungle Egg. As it has now left the game, it only obtainable through trading or by hatching any remaining Jungle Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 15% chance of hatching an ultra-rare pet from the Jungle Egg, but only a 7.5% chance of hatching a Crocodile. The Crocodile features an emerald green body and a long snout lined with small white teeth. It has two beady black eyes on the sides of its head. It has dark green scales going down its back all the way to its tail. Its underbelly is a light shade of green. It has four green web-like feet, similar to the Platypus. The Crocodile opens and closes its snout as part of its animation. Here are the tricks the Crocodile learns in order: The Neon Crocodile glows bright green on its scales and feet. The Mega Neon Crocodile glows in the same areas as the Neon Crocodile, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Crook Throw Toy is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 20, 2022, during the Desert Weather Map Update. It can be purchased in the Desert Shop for 250 when the shop is on rotation, or obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Crook Throw Toy features a long rod with a curve to its top; it is meant to portray a crook staff. It is colored entirely with blue and yellow stripes. When the Crook Throw Toy is thrown, an equipped pet will chase it and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Crossbow Grappling Hook is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was obtainable from the Candy Trading Shop for 14,000 during the Halloween Event (2019). As the event has left the game, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Crossbow Grappling Hook features a brown body with lighter brown highlights and a silver arrow. When fired, a gray chain is launched from the grappler. To interact with this item, a player can click/press anywhere on their screen to fire a hooked-cable; this pulls them towards the target location. Like most other grappling hooks, players cannot use this item on non-solid graphical objects or if they are on a vehicle, doing an obby, flying or riding a pet.

wiki.availability: The Crow is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2019, along with the Farm Egg. As the Farm Egg is now unavailable, players can only obtain the Crow by trading with other players or by hatching any remaining Farm Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 3% chance of hatching a legendary pet from the Farm Egg, but only a 1.5% chance of hatching a Crow. The Crow features black feathers, a dark gray beak, dark gray talons, a feathery tail, two black eyes, two small feather tufts on its head, and black wings. Listed below are the tricks the Crow learns in order: The Neon Crow glows bright white everywhere on its body except for its beak, eyes, and feet. The Mega Neon Crow glows in the same areas as the Neon Crow, except those areas cycle through pink, orange and yellow.

wiki.availability: The Crow's Nest Balloon is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on February 9, 2023, as part of the Rain Weather Update. It can be found and purchased in the Rain Gift Shop for 99 when the Rain Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Crow's Nest Balloon features a brown crows nest with a pointed black flag. It has a yellow string connected to the bottom. Like all other balloons in the game, its only function is letting a player jump higher.

wiki.availability: The Crow's Nest Propeller is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on July 4, 2025, alongside the Summer Festival (2025). Players could have purchased it for 650. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with the Crow's Nest Propeller equipped, they will be propelled upwards. To stop ascending, the player can unequip the item or jump.

wiki.availability: The Crown Flying Disc (formerly known as Crown Frisbee) is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was available in an old Gifts rotation. It could have been opened from the Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. As the Gifts have been updated to contain new items, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Crown Flying Disc features a dark red with gold-framed crown complete with golden lining. It bears the most resemblance to a modern royal crown. Its model is very similar to the crown found on top of the Royal Egg. To interact with the Crown Flying Disc, a player can click or press their screen to throw it and their equipped pet will bring it back to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Crown Flying Disc (formerly known as Crown Frisbee) is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was available in an old Gifts rotation. It could have been opened from the Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. As the Gifts have been updated to contain new items, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Crown Flying Disc features a dark red with gold-framed crown complete with golden lining. It bears the most resemblance to a modern royal crown. Its model is very similar to the crown found on top of the Royal Egg. To interact with the Crown Flying Disc, a player can click or press their screen to throw it and their equipped pet will bring it back to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Cryptid is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 17, 2025, alongside the third week of the Halloween Event (2025). Players could have purchased it for 1,500. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on November 7, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Cryptid has four forms. In its main form, it appears as a dog with thick neck fur, a red tongue, and a white underbelly. Its upper body is orange, while its eyebrows and inner ears are brown, and its feet are white. Players can transform it into one of three evil forms, which are all mostly green. The first is a goat with a long white beard, black horns, and large glowing green eyes. The second is a fox-like creature with large ears, glowing green eyes, and a fluffy tail. The third is a dragon with green horns, a large dark green head covered in lighter green spots, and glowing green eyes. Here are the tricks the Cryptid learns in order: The Neon Cryptid's dog form glows light blue on its face, chest, underbelly, feet, inner ears, and tail tip. Its goat form glows light green on its tail, chest, beard, body and ear spots, ear tips, and on parts of its head. Its fox-like form glows light green on its inner ears, chest, and on the underside of its tail. Its dragon form glows light green on its claws, horns, wing membranes, head and body spots, and on the underside of its body and tail. The Mega Neon Cryptid glows in the same areas as the Neon Cryptid, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow. The eyes of its goat, dragon, and fox-like forms remain glowing green.

wiki.addedEvent: Halloween Shop during the Halloween Event (2020)
wiki.availability: The Crystal Ball Rattle is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that could be obtained for 400 in the Halloween Shop during the Halloween Event (2020). Since the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Crystal Ball Rattle features a glowing pink orb on a gold base, resting on a purple handle. A player can click their screen with this item equipped to shake it back and forth.

wiki.addedEvent: Halloween Shop during the Halloween Event (2020)
wiki.availability: The Crystal Ball Rattle is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that could be obtained for 400 in the Halloween Shop during the Halloween Event (2020). Since the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Crystal Ball Rattle features a glowing pink orb on a gold base, resting on a purple handle. A player can click their screen with this item equipped to shake it back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Crystal Ball Stroller is a limited rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on October 6, 2022, along with the Halloween Event (2022). Players could purchase it for 4,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Crystal Ball Stroller features a curved black handle, a black seat with a purple cushion, four purple wheels with black and gray insides, and a purple translucent sphere on top of the cushion. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Crystal Egg is a legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on September 12, 2025. It can be purchased for 4,000, which are earned through using the Pet Releaser, or obtained through trading. The Crystal Egg takes 5 tasks to hatch.
wiki.notes: The pets available from the Crystal Egg rotate over time as new pets are added and older ones are removed. Players can only hatch pets that are currently available in the game through standard methods, with some exceptions: The Chihuahua, Pain au Chat, Kiwi Kiwi, Dango Penguins, Dragonfruit Fox, and Strawberry Tortle are exclusive to the Crystal Egg and Basic Egg. The Crystal Egg features a sky-blue shell with dozens of interconnecting swirls on it. There is a translucent gel-like coat on the egg, and a white sparkle effect coming off it.

wiki.availability: The Crystal Necklace is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 2.2% and 0.83% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on September 29, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Crystal Necklace features a circular, yellow necklace with three violet crystals hanging from its side; there are two small crystals and a large one. This pet accessory goes around a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Cuddly Candle is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on May 11, 2023, alongside a revamp to the Sky Castle.
wiki.notes: It is obtainable by purchasing it in the Sky Castle or on the Shop menu for 430 (formerly 500). It is otherwise obtainable through trading. The Cuddly Candle features a pale yellow candle with two feet and small arms. It has a melted top and its wick is lighted with a layered yellow-green glow. Listed below are the tricks the Cuddly Candle learns in order: The Neon Cuddly Candle glows yellow on its melted top, wick, and flame. The Mega Neon Cuddly Candle glows in the same areas as the Neon Cuddly Candle, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Culinary Wizard Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 19, 2026. It was obtainable through completing 15 special "Tim's Trial Tonics!" tasks from the Task Board. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on May 22, 2026.

The Cupcake Hat is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on January 30, 2026, it can only be obtained through trading.

The Cupcake Scooter is a limited rare single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me!. It was available in an old Gifts rotation during 2018. It was obtainable from the Small, Big, and Massive Gifts which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. As the Gifts were updated with new items, the Cupcake Scooter is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cupcake Scooter features a classic scooter with an image of a cupcake with blue frosting on its deck. It has black handles with a white stripe between them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Cupcake Sprinkle Wings are limited ultra-rare wing pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on March 28, 2024, as part of the second week of the Easter Event (2024). Players were able to purchase them for 35,000. As the event has ended, the Cupcake Sprinkle Wings are now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cupcake Sprinkle Wings are rainbow gradient wings that have purple frosting covering the top of the wings. The frosting is covered in purple, yellow, and light blue sprinkles. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back when the pet is flown.

wiki.availability: The Cupid Dragon is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 14, 2025, alongside the Valentine's Event (2025). It was purchasable for 1,000. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on February 28, 2025.
