wiki.notes: The Cupid Dragon features a pink dragon with a white heart-shaped underbelly, white spots throughout its face and belly, and a white muzzle. It has two pink inward curling horns on its head, and a pair of pink wings with lighter pink hearts. Here are the tricks the Cupid Dragon learns in order: The Neon Cupid Dragon glows pink on its wings, chest, tail details, horns, and head spots. The Mega Neon Cupid Dragon glows in the same areas as the Neon Cupid Dragon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Cupid's Bow Grappling Hook is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on February 21, 2025, alongside the second week of the Valentine's Event (2025). Players were able to purchase it for 1,600. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on February 28, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Cupid's Bow Grappling Hook features a pink bow with yellow curled ends and a black string. A brown arrow with white feathers and a red, heart-shaped tip is loaded into the bow. When the Cupid's Bow Grappling Hook is equipped, the player is pulled in the direction that they tap or click on.

wiki.availability: The Cupid's Coupe is a legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on January 18, 2024. Players can obtain it by purchasing the Mega Car Pack for 680 (formerly 800) or through trading.
wiki.notes: This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.addedEvent: It was previously obtainable in an old Gifts during December 2018 and from the 2019 Advent Calendar during the 2019 Christmas Event
wiki.availability: The Cure All Potion is a rare potion in Adopt Me!. It can be received a reward for aging up pets or obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: It was previously obtainable in an old Gifts during December 2018 and from the 2019 Advent Calendar during the 2019 Christmas Event. Players would receive four Cure All Potions on the fourth, tenth, and twenty-third day of the 2019 Advent Calendar. It was also obtainable by leveling up the Sunshine Games Pass and doing certain Task Board tasks from January 27, 2022, to November 14, 2025, and free ones were given to players during the Admin Abuse events on April 18, 2026 and May 16, 2026. The Cure All Potion can be used on a baby or pet to complete all of their existing tasks. However, it would not cure both the baby and equipped pet, only the one who drank or was fed with the potion. In other words, if it was only used on the baby, the equipped pet's needs will remain. The Cure All Potion features an oval-shaped bottle with a round black cap. In the bottle, players can see a neon green liquid.

wiki.availability: The Cursed Skull Balloon is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on July 11, 2025, alongside week two of the Summer Festival (2025). Players could have purchased it for 8,700. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cursed Skull Balloon allows a player to jump higher when equipped.

wiki.availability: The Curved Bow is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.2% and 0.3% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On September 29, 2022, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Curved Bow was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Curved Bow features a red curved bow with a beige string. It has a light red grip in its middle. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Cute Circle Glasses are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that can be purchased in the Accessory Shop for 150 when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Cute Circle Glasses feature a pair of gray, round wire glasses. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Cute-A-Cabra is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 12, 2023, as part of the Halloween Event (2023). It could have been found and purchased in the Asylum Shop for 9,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cute-A-Cabra features a dark brown head with a gray-pink snout, two black eyes, brown horns, and two large ears with beige inner ears. It has a brown body with light brown patches, a brown tail, and four feet. These are the tricks the Cute-A-Cabra learns in order: The Neon Cute-A-Cabra glows purple on its horns, spots, and feet. The Mega Neon Cute-A-Cabra glows in the same areas as the Neon Cute-A-Cabra, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Cute-A-Cabra Sticker is a limited uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 25, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Halloween Event (2024). As the event has ended and the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon has closed, it can only be obtained through opening any remaining Halloween 2024 Sticker Packs or trading.
wiki.notes: The Cute-A-Cabra Sticker features a cartoon Cute-A-Cabra.

wiki.availability: The Cutlass is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that is a part of the Pirate's Costume, which could be purchased for 250. On April 24, 2026, the Pirate's Costume was added to the Final Stop Shop and discounted to 175 before leaving the game on May 1, 2026. The Cutlass can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Cutlass is a gray sword with a lighter gray edge, along with a brown and gold curved handle. The handle is topped with a golden sphere. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Cyber Headphones are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As they were removed from the game on January 30, 2026, they can only be obtained through trading.

The Cyborg Eye is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 5.6% and 3.3% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Cyborg Eye was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Cyborg Eye features a white base with an orange stripe. On top of the base, it has a black outer rim along with a glowing orange eye. It also has several wires protruding out. This pet accessory goes over a pet's eye.

wiki.availability: The Cyborg Shades are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that can be purchased in the Accessory Shop for 555 when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Cyborg Shades feature a light gray frame around a black covering with a horizontal blue line in the middle. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Cymbal Ingredient is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released along with the Monkey Fairground event. This item is obtainable through trading, or by unboxing any remaining Monkey Boxes or Premium Monkey Boxes.
wiki.notes: There is a 15% chance of acquiring it through opening Monkey Boxes and a 30% chance through Premium Monkey Boxes; these boxes cost 600 and 195 respectively. During the event, when a player combined three Cymbal Ingredients and a Monkey, the Monkey was transformed into a Toy Monkey. Players did this by talking to the Toy Monkey in the Monkey Fairground. The Cymbal Ingredient features a flat yellow cymbal with a slightly rounder area in the center. There is a small circular red handle that sticks up from the center of the cymbal. The Cymbal Ingredient behaves as a throw toy. When a player clicks their screen with the Cymbal Ingredient equipped, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Dino Truck is a limited legendary four-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on April 8, 2021, as part of the gifts rotation. It could have been obtained from the Small, Big, or Massive Gifts for 70, 199, or 499 respectively. It was removed on March 31, 2022, during the release of the 2022 Gift Refresh. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dino Truck slightly resembles the Skele-Rex, as the front of the vehicle is styled as a large skeleton of a dinosaur. It features gray teeth, black spikes, and glowing light blue headlights at the nostrils. It also has four stone wheels with leather straps surrounding the majority of the vehicle. There are two seats in the front, and two seats in the back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The DJ Snooze is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 24, 2025, alongside the fourth week of the Halloween Event (2025). Players could have purchased it for 44,000 or hatched it from a Basic Egg or Crystal Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on November 7, 2025.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the DJ Snooze learns in order: The Neon DJ Snooze glows orange on its cloak. The Mega Neon DJ Snooze glows in the same area as the Neon DJ Snooze, except that area cycles through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Da Vinci Propeller is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020. It was obtainable from the first page of the Star Rewards, requiring 180 Stars to unlock. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on September 11, 2026 when the Star Rewards were revamped.
wiki.notes: The Da Vinci Propeller features a beige-colored spiral, which is connected by three supports to a brown plate. A long brown rod is connected to this plate; this rod has a light beige area for the player to hold onto. Its appearance is meant to reference Leonardo da Vinci's aerial screw. As it's a propeller, it will propel a player in the air once interacted with. They can jump to stop the propeller.

wiki.availability: The Da Wingci Wings are limited common wing pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on September 15, 2022. They could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Wing Chest for 600; players had a 45% chance of unboxing it. As their rotation has now passed, the Da Wingci Wings can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Da Wingci Wings feature brown top ridges with orange connector parts that connect to brown primaries. There is a beige material between the wings' primaries. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back when it is flown.

wiki.availability: The Daisy Flying Disc is a limited uncommon toy that was added to Adopt Me! as part of the new gift rotation on September 2, 2021. It cost 70, 199, and 499, if obtained from Small, Big or Massive Gifts, respectively. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Daisy Flying Disc is a flat flower-shaped disc with a light orange circle in the center; six white petals bloom from this circle. To interact with this item, a player has to click/press the screen to throw the toy, where an equipped pet will pick it up and retrieve it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Daisy Glasses are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on March 16, 2021. They could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 250 when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Daisy Glasses features two brown lenses, each of which are surrounded by small yellow frames; daisy petals border these frames. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Daisy Unicycle is a limited rare single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released alongside the Spring Festival (2020). It could have been purchased for 500. As the event has ended, the Daisy Unicycle can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Daisy Unicycle has a green leaf seat stretching from a light-brown pot; this pot connects to a green wheel, which has a white daisy in its center. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Daisymobile is a limited ultra-rare three-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 23, 2023, as part of the first week of the Spring Festival (2023). It could have been purchased in the Springfest Shop for 30,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Daisymobile features a light pink body with flowers on the headlights, wing mirrors, and seat. The vehicle’s rear are adorned with flowers, with vines at the sides. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Dalmatian (formerly known as the Santa Dog) is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was obtainable for 250 during the Christmas Event (2019). It was only available for three days before it went off-sale. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: As of the Dress Your Pets Update on April 11, 2020, the Santa Dog was split into two items; the pet was renamed to the Dalmatian, and its hat became an ultra-rare pet wear item known as the Santa Hat. Players that owned the Santa Dog prior to the update would obtain both the Dalmatian and the Santa Hat, which they can dress their Dalmatian or on any other pet they have with. The Dalmatian features a model similar to that of the Dog, but its body is white with black spots. It has two big black eyes and a snout, with its tongue sticking out. When it was first introduced to the game, the Dalmatian wore a Santa Hat on its head. Here are the tricks the Dalmatian learns in order: The Neon Dalmatian's ears, feet, and tail glow mint green and the Neon Santa Dog glowed in the same areas, with the addition of its Santa Hat glowing bright red. After the Dress Your Pets Update where the Santa Hat on the Dalmatian became separate, the Santa Hat no longer glows, even if the player dresses their Dalmatian with the Santa Hat. The Mega Neon Dalmatian glows in the same areas as the Neon Dalmatian, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dalmatian Sticker is an ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Premium Sticker Pack for 50; players have a 25% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Dalmatian Sticker features a cartoon Dalmatian.

wiki.egg: Special Lunar New Year Gift Box/Lunar New Year Gift Box
wiki.availability: The Daltokki Kite is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on February 8, 2024, as part of the Lunar New Year (2024) event. Players are able to obtain it by opening any remaining Special Lunar New Year Gift Boxes and Lunar New Year Gift Boxes or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Daltokki Kite features a kite shaped like the Rice Cake Rabbit.

wiki.availability: The Dance Arcade Stand is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on April 25, 2025, alongside week 4 of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). Players could purchase it for 125. On April 24, 2026, the Dance Arcade Stand was added to the Final Stop Shop and discounted to 100 before leaving the game on May 1, 2026. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: This item can be placed on flat surfaces around Adoption Island, the Neighborhood, and houses. If placed inside the owner's own house, it will remain there after they leave the game. The owner can set a Bucks price between 0 and 20 that other players can pay in order to use the Dance Arcade Stand. When used, it completes the 'Bored' ailment on babies and pets.

wiki.availability: The Dancing Dragon is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me!, which was released during the Lunar New Year (2022) event. It could be obtained by purchasing it for 800. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dancing Dragon features a long, red wingless dragon with a yellow underbelly. It resembles the Frost Fury and Midnight Dragon models with a different combination of colors. It has a long, spiked yellow tail, four intense red and yellow feet, and yellow spikes on the top part of its back. On its head, it has two brown antlers, two red ears, yellow whiskers, two yellow eyebrows, and two small black eyes. Here are the tricks the Dancing Dragon learns in order: The Neon Dancing Dragon glows bright yellow on its eyebrows, around its eyes, whiskers, claws, underbelly, the spikes along its back, and the tip of its tail. The Mega Neon Dancing Dragon glows in the same areas as the Neon Dancing Dragon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dancing Lion Mask is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 31, 2025, alongside the second week of the Lunar New Year (2025). Players could have purchased it for 5. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on February 14, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Dancing Lion Mask originally left the game on February 7, 2025, but returned on February 12, 2025 for the last 48 hours of the Lunar New Year (2025).

wiki.availability: The Dancing Tube Hat is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on November 22, 2024, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dancing Tube Hat resembles an inflatable tube man, it has a red body with blue accents, a joyful expression, and a black base. This pet accessory is worn on the pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Dandelion Hat is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released as part of the third week of the Easter Event (2023) during the Spring Festival (2023). It could have been purchased in the Springfest Shop for 700. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dandelion Hat features mutiple dandelions protruding outward. This accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Dandelion Plush is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: The Dandelion Plush serves no purpose other than just being a cosmetic and interactable item. To hug this toy, the player can click on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Dandelion Propeller is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me!. It cost 1,750 and could be bought during the 2020 Spring Festival Event. As its respective event has ended, the Dandelion Propeller is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dandelion Propeller features a large brown dandelion seed along with its white stem and widely-spread top. The Dandelion Propeller propels a player upwards, like all the other propellers. A player can click or tap their screen to activate the propeller and jump to deactivate it.

wiki.availability: The Danger Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me!. It was released on June 8, 2023, and replaced the Southeast Asia Egg. It cost 750 and was available for purchase from the Gumball Machine in the Nursery. The Danger Egg left the game on August 24, 2023, and was replaced with the Urban Egg. Danger Eggs can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Danger Egg features a dark purple egg with knubby black spikes around its exterior.

wiki.availability: The Dango Penguins are legendary pets in Adopt Me! that were released on November 7, 2025. Players can hatch them from the Basic Egg or Crystal Egg, which are purchasable for 400 and 4,000 respectively. They are otherwise obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Dango Penguins learn in order: The Neon Dango Penguins glow blue on their feet and wings. The Mega Neon Dango Penguins glow in the same areas as the Neon Dango Penguins, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dango Sticker is a limited uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2026, alongside the second week of the Sugar Festival Event (2026). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Sugarfest 2026 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Dango Sticker features light green, yellow, and pink dango on a white stick.

wiki.availability: The Dapper Friend Carrier is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on November 3, 2022. It could have been obtained by opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, or 499, respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it was removed from the rotation on November 22, 2024.
wiki.notes: The Dapper Friend Carrier is an antique automobile with four black and gray wheels, two headlights in the front, a tall grill, a windshield, and a brown seat that can hold up to two players or pets. It also features a hand crank underneath the grille, which spins around when the vehicle is in motion. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Dark Choccybunny is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 3, 2026, alongside the fourth week of the Sugar Festival Event (2026). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Choccybunny Boxes, which were purchasable for 15,000, or trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026. The Dark Choccybunny was also obtainable through hatching a Basic Egg, Crystal Egg, or Admin Abuse Egg while it was available in-game.
wiki.notes: There is a 4% chance of obtaining a Dark Choccybunny from the Choccybunny Box. Here are the tricks the Dark Choccybunny learns in order: The Neon Dark Choccybunny glows orange on its inner ears, nose, cheeks, feet, bell, and body patterns. The Mega Neon Dark Choccybunny glows in the same areas as the Neon Dark Choccybunny, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Death Cloak is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on October 5, 2023, as a part of the Halloween Event (2023).
wiki.notes: Players could obtain the Death Cloak by purchasing it for 4,200 in the Asylum shop. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading. The Death Cloak is a black cloak that goes around a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Deathstalker Scorpion is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 25, 2024. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Desert Eggs, Royal Desert Eggs, or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Deathstalker Scorpion features a beige body with a yellow underbelly. It has a stinger that consists of orange and yellow. There are six yellow feet, two beady black eyes, and two orange pinchers. Here are the tricks the Deathstalker Scorpion learns in order: The Neon Deathstalker Scorpion glows purple on its upper body, tip of its tail, and bottom of its claws. The Mega Neon Deathstalker Scorpion glows in the same areas as the Neon Deathstalker Scorpion, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Deinonychus is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2020, along with the Fossil Egg. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by trading or hatching any remaining Fossil Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 15% chance of hatching an ultra-rare pet from the Fossil Egg, but only a 7.5% chance of hatching a Deinonychus. The Deinonychus features a dinosaur with a blue body and a light orange underbelly. Between the body and the underbelly, there is a section of orange. It has blue feathers on its head, tail, and on the top of its arms. Orange feathers can be seen hanging off its arms. It also has orange back legs with slightly darker orange toes. On its face, there are two black eyes, two black nostrils, and white teeth protruding from its mouth. Here are the tricks the Deinonychus learns in order: The Neon Deinonychus glows red on the stripe along its back, the tip of its claws, and the feathers on its head, hands, and tail. The Mega Neon Deinonychus glows in the same areas as the Neon Deinonychus, except those areas cycle though the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Deinonychus Sticker is an ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Fossil Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Deinonychus Sticker features a cartoon Deinonychus.

wiki.availability: The Deinonychus Sticker is an ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Fossil Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Deinonychus Sticker features a cartoon Deinonychus.

wiki.availability: The Demi Flag is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 9, 2022. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand for 50; the Pride Stand could be found near the Playground and left the game on June 16, 2022. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Demi Flag features a demisexual flag with a white handle; this handle has a small yellow knob on its tip. On the flag, there is a small black triangle that connects to a yellow line; this yellow line is set on a white background. The colors of the flag include gray, white, violet, and black. It has a pet accessory counterpart, the Demi Pride Pin. To wave the flag, the player can click anywhere on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Demi Flag 2023 is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 1, 2023. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand near the Playground for 50. It can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Demi Flag 2023 features a Demi Flag, the only difference being the rainbow string that is intertwined along the flagpole and a Pride Paw Flying Disc at the top of the pole. To wave the flag, a player can click anywhere on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Demi Pride Pin is a common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 31, 2020. It could have been found in the Accessory Shop and taken for free. One pride pin could be taken by a player every hour. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Demi Pride Pin features a heart-shaped pin with a gold border and colors that represent the demisexual flag. On the flag, there is a small black triangle that connects to a yellow line; this yellow line is set on a white background. The colors include gray, white, violet, and black. This pet accessory is worn on the pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Demisexual Bat Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on June 14, 2024, along with the Summer State Fair (2024).
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Pride Sticker Pack for 50. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Demisexual Bat Sticker features a cartoon Bat with a white and gray body, purple ears and neck, and black wings and head. It's holding a Demi Flag.

wiki.availability: The Demisexual Bat Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on June 14, 2024, along with the Summer State Fair (2024).
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Pride Sticker Pack for 50. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Demisexual Bat Sticker features a cartoon Bat with a white and gray body, purple ears and neck, and black wings and head. It's holding a Demi Flag.

wiki.availability: The Demon Wings are limited legendary wing pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on September 15, 2022.
wiki.notes: They could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Wing Chest for 600; players had a 1.5% chance of unboxing them. The Standard Wing Chest can be found in a room in the Sky Castle. As their rotation has now passed, the Demon Wings can now only be obtained through trading. The Demon Wings feature red top ridges and wing primaries. The material between the primaries is orange and has small rips throughout. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back when the pet is flown.

wiki.availability: The Denmark Soccer Earrings are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on July 12, 2024. Players could have purchased them for 300 until July 19, 2024. They can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Denmark Soccer Earrings feature a pair of red and white Denmark flags, each wrapped around a pole with a soccer ball at the bottom. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's ears or on the sides of its head.

wiki.availability: The Desert Drum is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 20, 2022, during the Desert Weather Map Update. It can be found and purchased in the Desert Shop for 450 when the Desert Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Desert Drum features a gold-rimmed drum with cyan, red, green, and yellow designs. It has a dark brown design near its gold rims. The drum surfaces are beige. To interact with this item, a player can click on their screen with the Desert Drum equipped to play a drumming tune.

wiki.availability: The Desert Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on January 25, 2024, replacing the Urban Egg. It was available for purchase through the Gumball Machine in the Nursery for 750. The Desert Egg was replaced by the Garden Egg on May 24, 2024, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Desert Egg features a green egg with spikes around the surface and three white flowers containing yellow centers. There are two arms attached to either side of the egg. A flower is located on the ends of both arms, and on top of the egg.

wiki.availability: The Detective Hat is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could be obtained by fully aging Scoob during the Scoob Event. As the event has ended, it is now unobtainable unless through trading.
wiki.notes: The Detective Hat features a checkered double-sided gray and brown cap with a small black ribbon on top. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Detective Mustache is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 4, 2020, along with the Scoob Event. It, along with the Detective Hat and the Magnifying Glass, was given to the player if they aged Scoob to Full Grown. As the event has ended, the Detective Mustache can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Detective Mustache features a large, black, curvy mustache with a small black tip. This pet accessory goes on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Diamond Albatross is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on May 12, 2022. It can be obtained through purchasing and using a Golden Clam for 169, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Golden Clam can only be purchased and used in the Snowy Igloo Shop to tame a Diamond Albatross when the Snow Weather is active. Players have a 2.5% chance of obtaining a Diamond Albatross from the Golden Clam. The Diamond Albatross features two large wings on either side of its shiny blue body. It has a gold, wing-shaped liner around the edge of its beady black eyes, along with an orange beak. It also has pale gold feathers on its wings and tail and two yellow feet. Listed below are the tricks the Diamond Albatross learns in order: The Neon Diamond Albatross glows the same way as its other variants. The gold yellow part of the wings, ends of tail feathers, and the tiny gold yellow in the corner of the eyes glows a light blue color. The Mega Neon Diamond Albatross glows in the same areas as the Neon Diamond Albatross, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Diamond Amazon is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 9, 2023, along with the Rain Weather Update. It can be obtained through purchasing and using a Golden Plantain in the Rain Pet Shop for 169, or trading. It can only be tamed when the Rain Weather is active.
wiki.notes: There is a 2.5% chance of obtaining a Diamond Amazon from the Golden Plantain. The Diamond Amazon features a metallic blue curved body, two wings, a metallic blue beak, and two black eyes. The head is mainly gold, with blue spots under its eyes. It has gold feathers under its wings and gold feet. Here are the tricks the Diamond Amazon learns in order: The Neon Diamond Amazon glows yellow on the majority of its head and wing parts. It glows blue on part of its head, feet and tail. The Mega Neon Diamond Amazon glows in the same areas as the Neon Diamond Amazon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Diamond Butterfly is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 4, 2022. It could have been obtained through purchasing a Golden Leaf for 199 in the Butterfly Sanctuary. There is a 2.5% chance of obtaining a Diamond Butterfly from the Golden Leaf. As the Butterfly Sanctuary has left the game, it can now only be obtained through using any remaining Golden Leaves or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Diamond Butterfly has white wings with dark blue decorative lines throughout them. On these outer lines, there are tiny white circles. It has a white body with beady black eyes and two long antennae. It has a medium-sized body; the wings take up most of it. Here are the tricks the Diamond Butterfly learns in order: The Neon Diamond Butterfly glows light teal on its antennae, the outer lines, and webbed lines on its wings. The Mega Neon Diamond Butterfly glows in the same areas as the Neon Diamond Butterfly, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Diamond Dragon is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020, along with the Star Rewards. It can be obtained through hatching a Gemstone Egg, Basic Egg, Crystal Egg, Admin Abuse Egg, any remaining Diamond Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 33.3% chance of hatching a Diamond Dragon from a Diamond Egg. The Diamond Dragon is a recolor of the Dragon with a blue and yellow color scheme, and a different texture. It has a metallic-blue colored body, and golden fangs, horns, wing membranes, and underbelly. During the day, its body remain metallic blue when indoors, and becomes silvery-white in certain areas under the sun. At night, its body becomes a solid dark blue color while the golden areas become a darker yellow. Here are the tricks the Diamond Dragon learns in order: The Neon Diamond Dragon glows bright yellow on its fangs, horns, wing membranes, and underbelly. The Mega Neon Diamond Dragon glows in the same areas as the Neon Diamond Dragon, except those areas cycle through the colors of pink, white, and cyan.

wiki.availability: The Diamond Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020, as part of the Star Rewards update. It could be obtained from the second page of the Star Rewards once players had earned 660 Stars. Players had to complete the first page of the Star Rewards by reaching 660 Stars and claiming the Golden Egg, before their Stars could reset and they could work towards unlocking the Diamond Egg.
wiki.notes: It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on September 11, 2026 when the Star Rewards were revamped. The Diamond Egg is an oval shaped, turquoise blue egg. At night, its color turns to a royal blue.

wiki.availability: The Diamond Fanghorn Kite is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on February 8, 2024, as part of the Lunar New Year (2024) event. Players are able to obtain it by opening any remaining Lunar New Year Gift Boxes, which cost 4,000. It can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Diamond Fanghorn Kite features a dark blue kite with three white tails. On the kite, there is a design featuring the head of a Fanghorn Tortoise, with the rest of its body hidden by clouds.

wiki.availability: The Diamond Glasses are limited ultra-rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They are obtainable through purchasing and opening the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. They are otherwise obtainable through opening Admin Abuse Boxes, purchasing them for 4,500 when they are on rotation in the Accessory Shop, or trading.

The Diamond Griffin is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020, along with the Star Rewards. It can be obtained through hatching a Gemstone Egg, Basic Egg, Crystal Egg, Admin Abuse Egg, any remaining Diamond Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 33.3% chance of hatching a Diamond Griffin from a Diamond Egg. The Diamond Griffin is a recolor of the Griffin with a blue and yellow color scheme, and a different texture. It has a metallic-blue colored body, and golden wings, eyebrows, and break. During the day, its body remain metallic blue when indoors, and becomes silvery-white in certain areas under the sun. At night, its body becomes a solid dark blue color while the golden areas become a darker yellow. Here are the tricks the Diamond Griffin learns in order: The Neon Diamond Griffin glows bright yellow on its wings, eyebrows, and beak. The Mega Neon Diamond Griffin glows in the same areas as the Neon Diamond Griffin, except those areas cycle through the colors of pink, white, and cyan.

wiki.availability: The Diamond Hamster is a legendary pet that was released in Adopt Me! on March 14, 2024. Players have of 2.5% chance of obtaining it through a Golden Corn, which costs 199. Otherwise, it can be obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Diamond Hamster features a blue head and body, a round tail, a white underbelly, and blue feet. It has two ears, with white inner ears, a white chin, two black eyes, whiskers, a blue nose, and a tuft on its head. The Diamond Hamster shares a similar appearance to the Hamster and Golden Hamster. Listed below are the tricks the Diamond Hamster learns in order: The Neon Diamond Hamster glows pink on its feet, tail, nose, whiskers, and the insides of its ears. The Mega Neon Diamond Hamster glows in the same areas as the Neon Diamond Hamster, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Diamond Hummingbird is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 30, 2024. It is now only obtainable through using any remaining Golden Petunias, which were obtainable through purchasing the Pets Plus subscription for 299, or trading, as it was replaced by the Guinea Pigs from the Golden Lettuce on April 3, 2026.
wiki.notes: Players have a 2.5% chance of obtaining a Diamond Hummingbird from the Golden Petunia. Here are the tricks the Diamond Hummingbird learns in order: The Neon Diamond Hummingbird glows yellow on its beak, the front of its face, tips of its wings, and on its feet. The Mega Neon Diamond Hummingbird glows in the same areas as the Neon Diamond Hummingbird, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Diamond King Penguin is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 14, 2022. It could have been obtained through buying a Golden Goldfish for 195 (formerly 225). It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on November 7, 2025.
wiki.notes: Players had a 2.5% chance of obtaining a Diamond King Penguin from the Golden Goldfish. The Diamond King Penguin features a plump reflective blue body with a white underbelly and blue feet. Its beak is blue on top and has a white bottom. It has black eyes on its face and a tuft of fur on its head. Listed below are the tricks the Diamond King Penguin learns in order: The Neon Diamond King Penguin glows blue on the lower area of its head as well as its feet. The Mega Neon Diamond King Penguin glows in the same areas as the Neon Diamond King Penguin, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Diamond Ladybug is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 18, 2021, along with the Farm Shop. Players can obtain it by using any remaining Diamond Lavenders, which cost 169 (formerly 199), or trading. The Diamond Lavender and Ladybugs left the game on January 9, 2026, being replaced by the Golden Seed Ball and the Owls obtainable from it.
wiki.notes: There is a 2.5% chance of taming a Diamond Ladybug from a Diamond Lavender. The Diamond Ladybug features a metallic-blue colored body, two golden antennae, and a pair of golden front wings with metallic-blue spots on them. In the day, the body color of the Diamond Ladybug remains metallic-blue when indoors and becomes silvery-white in certain areas when under the sun. At night, the color changes and its body becomes a non-metallic dark blue color while the golden areas become a darker yellow. Here are the tricks the Diamond Ladybug learns in order: The Neon Diamond Ladybug glows light blue on its spots, antennae, wing outlines, and feet. The Mega Neon Diamond Ladybug glows in the same areas as the Neon Diamond Ladybug, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Diamond Ladybug Sticker is a legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Sticker Pack for 250; players have a 4% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Diamond Ladybug Sticker features a cartoon Diamond Ladybug.

wiki.availability: The Diamond Lavender is a limited legendary food item in Adopt Me! that was released on February 18, 2021, alongside the Farm Shop. It could have been purchased for 169 (formerly 199). It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 9, 2026, being replaced by the Golden Seed Ball.
wiki.notes: When using a Diamond Lavender, players can obtain a Ladybug, Golden Ladybug, or Diamond Ladybug. Below are all of the pets that are obtainable from the Diamond Lavender:

wiki.availability: The Diamond Mahi Mahi is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 7, 2024. Players have a 2% of obtaining it through using a Mahi Spinning Rod, which costs 600. It can otherwise be obtained through hatching Basic Eggs, Crystal Eggs, Admin Abuse Eggs, or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Diamond Mahi Mahi features a shiny blue and light blue fish with dark blue spots all over its body. It also has light blue fins with dark blue spines, two beady eyes, and a dark blue tail. Here are the tricks the Diamond Mahi Mahi learns in order: The Neon Diamond Mahi Mahi glows pink on its tail, pectoral fins, and stripes along its dorsal fin. The Mega Neon Diamond Mahi Mahi glows in the same areas as the Neon Diamond Mahi Mahi, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Diamond Pickaxe Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Fossil Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Diamond Pickaxe Sticker features a cartoon Diamond Pickaxe.

wiki.availability: The Diamond Pickaxe Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Fossil Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Diamond Pickaxe Sticker features a cartoon Diamond Pickaxe.

wiki.availability: The Diamond Unicorn is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020, along with the Star Rewards. It was obtainable through hatching a Basic Egg, Crystal Egg, or Admin Abuse Egg. It can now only be obtained through hatching any remaining Diamond Eggs or trading, as it left the game on September 11, 2026.
wiki.notes: There is a 33.3% chance of hatching a Diamond Unicorn from a Diamond Egg. The Diamond Unicorn is a recolor of the Unicorn with a blue and yellow color scheme, and a different texture. It has a metallic-blue colored body, and a golden horn, mane, and tail. During the day, its body remain metallic blue when indoors, and becomes silvery-white in certain areas under the sun. At night, its body becomes a solid dark blue color while the golden areas become a darker yellow. Here are the tricks the Diamond Unicorn learns in order: The Neon version of the Diamond Unicorn glows bright yellow on its mane, horn, and tail. The Mega Neon Diamond Unicorn glows in the same areas as the Neon Diamond Unicorn, except those areas cycle through the colors of pink, white, and cyan.

wiki.availability: The Dice Throw Toy is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dice Throw Toy features a red 20-sided dice, with each side displaying a white number between 1 and 20. When interacted with, the Dice Throw Toy is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Didgeridoo is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020. It was obtainable from the first page of the Star Rewards, requiring 360 Stars to unlock. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on September 11, 2026 when the Star Rewards were revamped.
wiki.notes: The Didgeridoo features a long, cylindrical tube that is engraved with blue, red, and white rings. The Didgeridoo produces a low-pitched drone when used, similar to the sounds of an actual Didgeridoo. It plays one of several different sounds at random each time it is used.

wiki.availability: The Dilophosaurus is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2020, along with the Fossil Egg. As it is now unavailabale, the Dilophosaurus can only be obtained through trading or by hatching any remaining Fossil Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 25% chance of hatching a rare pet from the Fossil Egg, but only an 8.33% chance of hatching a Dilophosaurus. The Dilophosaurus features a green dinosaur with a beige underbelly and a pink neck frill that has a purple edge. Part of its face is purple and there are two pink crests on the top of its head. Its arms are green while its back legs are green with purple claws. There are several spikes along its head, body, and tail. It has small white teeth inside its mouth. Here are the tricks the Dilophosaurus learns in order: The Neon Dilophosaurus glows bright blue on the crest on its head, spikes, and claws. The Mega Neon Dilophosaurus glows in the same areas as the Neon Dilophosaurus, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dilophosaurus Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Fossil Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dilophosaurus Sticker features a cartoon Dilophosaurus.

wiki.availability: Dim Sum is a limited common food item in Adopt Me! that was released on February 16, 2018, alongside the Chinese New Year (2018). It could have been purchased for 25. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: This item can be used to fulfill the "Hunger" ailment for babies and pets, and takes 3 uses for players to fully consume. The Dim Sum features three white dim sums in a circle-shaped brown steamer. The bowl of the Dim Sum bears minor resemblance to the bowl of the Ice Tub, except for the color and size difference.

wiki.availability: The Dimension Drifter is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 7, 2025, alongside the Moon Egg. It can now only be obtained through hatching any remaining Moon Eggs or Royal Moon Eggs, or through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 2% chance of hatching a Dimension Drifter from the Moon Egg, and a 3% chance of hatching it from the Royal Moon Egg. The Dimension Drifter features a jellyfish-like creature with a purple bell with blue splotches at the top. The tentacles are a lighter purple and have teal tips. Here are the tricks the Dimension Drifter learns in order: The Neon Dimension Drifter glows blue on top of its bell and on the ends of its tentacles. The Mega Neon Dimension Drifter glows in the same areas as the Neon Dimension Drifter, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dimorphodon is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, alongside the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024) event. Players were able to obtain it by placing 20 Dimorphodon Fossils in the Fossil Sequencer 7000 and spending 3,600 to turn the fossils into a Dimorphodon, or purchase an already-crafted one for 1,000. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dimorphodon has a blue body with orange-yellow wings with orange stripes. It also has light blue fur and underbelly around its neck. It has an orange beak and a light-blue sail at the tip of its tail. Here are the tricks the Dimorphodon learns in order: The Neon Dimorphodon glows orange on its neck fur, underbelly, the patterns on its face and eyes, and the stripe on its tail. The Mega Neon Dimorphodon glows in the same areas as the Neon Dimorphodon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dimorphodon Fossil is a limited legendary toy in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024) event. Players could obtain it by mining in the Fossil Isle Mine or purchasing a set of five for 250. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: During the event, once the player had at least twenty Dimorphodon Fossils, they could put them in the Fossil Sequencer 7000 and spend 3,600 to turn the fossils into a Dimorphodon.

wiki.availability: The Dimorphodon Sticker is a legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Fossil Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dimorphodon Sticker features a cartoon Dimorphodon.

wiki.availability: The Dingo is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 29, 2020, along with the Aussie Egg. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by trading or by hatching any remaining Aussie Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 25% chance of hatching a Dingo from the Aussie Egg. The Dingo has a similar appearance to the Shiba Inu color-wise and shares a similar model to the Wolf. It has brownish-beige fur, with its underbelly being a lighter shade of beige, and a brownish-beige tail. The Dingo's ears are perked up. It has two black beady eyes and a black nose. Here are the tricks the Dingo learns in order: The Neon Dingo glows bright lime-green on the inside of its triangular ears, on its paws, the tip of the nose, and tail. The Mega Neon Dingo glows in the same areas as the Neon Dingo, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dinner Discourse Cat Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on August 1, 2024. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Pets Plus Sticker Packs, which were received when purchasing the Pets Plus subscription for 299, or trading.

The Dino Hood is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.8% and 0.7% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Dino Hood was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Dino Hood features a dark green hood with pink insides and a darker pink tongue sticking out of its front. It has black eyes and two yellow spikes on its back. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Dino Truck is a limited legendary four-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on April 8, 2021, as part of the gifts rotation. It could have been obtained from the Small, Big, or Massive Gifts for 70, 199, or 499 respectively. It was removed on March 31, 2022, during the release of the 2022 Gift Refresh. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dino Truck slightly resembles the Skele-Rex, as the front of the vehicle is styled as a large skeleton of a dinosaur. It features gray teeth, black spikes, and glowing light blue headlights at the nostrils. It also has four stone wheels with leather straps surrounding the majority of the vehicle. There are two seats in the front, and two seats in the back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Dire Stag is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on October 12, 2023, as part of the Halloween Event (2023). It could have been found in the Asylum Shop during the event and cost 125,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dire Stag features two beige horns, and a cream skull with glowing orange eyes and gray teeth. It has a dark brown body with four feet, which looks similar to the Buffalo. These are the tricks the Dire Stag learns in order: The Neon Dire Stag glows orange on its horns, neck fur, nose, tongue, and tail. Its eyes also change from orange to white. The Mega Neon Dire Stag glows in the same areas as the Neon Dire Stag, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dire Wolf is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 20, 2026. Players could have purchased it for 3,000 or hatched it from a Basic Egg or Crystal Egg, which cost 400 and 4,000 respectively. It is now obtainable through trading, as it left the game on March 6, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Dire Wolf learns in order: The Neon Dire Wolf glows orange on its nose, teeth, eyebrows, inner ears, neck fur, tail underside, and paws. The Mega Neon Dire Wolf glows in the same areas as the Neon Dire Wolf, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dirt Bike Unicycle is a limited ultra-rare single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on March 31, 2022, as part of the 2022 Gift Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts respectively. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dirt Bike Unicycle features a round black wheel, wheel shield, and seat. It has a gray frame with a brown paw print in the middle. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: Dirty Ducky is an NPC in Adopt Me! that was introduced on May 29, 2026, during the Journey to Summer Camp Event (2026). They could be found next to the Rubber Ducky Box in the VIP room.
wiki.notes: Dirty Ducky has a yellow, classic rubber ducky-shaped body. They have black eyes, an orange beak with a yellow splotch on it, and brown splotches and spots that resemble dirt or mud on their wings, underside, back, and face. They bear the same appearance as their pet counterpart, the Dirty Ducky. When a player interacted with Dirty Ducky, this was their dialogue:

wiki.availability: The Disco Ball Balloon is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Disco Ball Balloon features a shiny, blue and purple disco ball attached to a black string. As it is a balloon, its only function is to allow a player to jump higher.

wiki.availability: The Discosplosion is a limited ultra-rare gamepass toy in Adopt Me!. Players could previously have purchased it for 85 in the Pet Shop or through entering the Shop GUI on the right side of their screen. It was removed from the game on January 6, 2022, and it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Discosplosion is a small white disco ball with black linings. It gives out a faint glow. When thrown, it creates a small explosion, plays music, and makes the players and pets nearby start dancing.

wiki.availability: The Disguise Glasses are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on August 9, 2024, as part of the Jokes Update. Since the Jokes Update left on August 16, 2024, the Disguise Glasses can now only be obtained through trading, or through opening any remaining Box of Jokes.
wiki.notes: The Disguise Glasses feature round glasses with thick black frames. There are furry brown eyebrows, a brown mustache, and a large pink nose attached to the frames. These pet accessories go on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Diving Fins are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on June 15, 2023, along with the Summer Festival (2023). They were obtainable by purchasing them in the Summer Shop for 1,500. As the event has now passed, they can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Diving Fins feature orange fins. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's feet.

wiki.availability: The Dodo is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2020, along with the Fossil Egg. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by trading or hatching any remaining Fossil Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 5% chance of hatching a legendary pet from the Fossil Egg, but only a 2.5% chance of hatching a Dodo. The Dodo features a small light pink bird with beady black eyes. It has pale purple and mint colored feathers on the tail with two small wings. The wings of the Dodo are lavender with sky-blue and pastel-toned feathers. It has a long yellow beak with purple on the tip and two yellow feet. There are two small pink feathers located on top of its head. Listed below are the tricks the Dodo learns in order: The Neon Dodo glows bright blue on its beak, the two little feathers on the top of its head, the tips of its wings, and its feet. The Mega Neon Dodo glows in the same areas as the Neon Dodo, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dodo Sticker is a legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Fossil Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dodo Sticker features a cartoon Dodo.

wiki.availability: The Dog is a common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2019, as part of the Pets Update. Players can obtain it by hatching a Starter Egg or a Retired Egg at a 50% and 5% chance respectively or through trading.
wiki.notes: Before July 21, 2022, players could hatch a Dog from a Cracked Egg and a Pet Egg. The Dog is a cream color with a round body, four feet, a small tail from behind, and a head with two large ears, two beady black eyes, a black round nose, and a salmon tongue that sticks out. Here are the tricks the Dog learns in order: The Neon Dog glows light blue on its ears, tail, and paws. The Mega Neon Dog glows in the same areas as the Neon Dog, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dog Backpack is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It was obtainable through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on August 22, 2025, it can now only be obtained through trading.

The Dog Food Flying Disc (formerly known as Dog Food Frisbee) is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was available in the Small and Big Gifts, which cost 70 and 199 respectively. As its Gifts rotation has passed, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dog Food Flying Disc is a blue colored dog bowl that is filled with non-feedable brown dog food. When a player interacts with the Dog Food Flying Disc, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Dog Food Flying Disc (formerly known as Dog Food Frisbee) is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was available in the Small and Big Gifts, which cost 70 and 199 respectively. As its Gifts rotation has passed, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dog Food Flying Disc is a blue colored dog bowl that is filled with non-feedable brown dog food. When a player interacts with the Dog Food Flying Disc, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Dog House Stroller is a limited rare stroller in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dog House Stroller has a pointed, dark navy roof; a red exterior and interior; four black wheels; and a white upside-down “U” shaped entry. There is a small beige comfort bedding on which the baby or pet sits. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Dog Leash is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was previously obtainable through opening Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. As of the 2021 Gift Refresh update, the Gifts were updated with another set of items. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dog Leash features a dog head similar to that of the Bloodhound. It is complete with black eyes, dark brown ears, and a brown nose. The leash is mostly tan and has a curved handle on its back. It has a pink string when in use. When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, a pink line will connect the Dog Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The Dog Sticker is a common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Sticker Pack for 250; players have a 40% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. The Dog Sticker can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Dog Sticker features a cartoon Dog.

wiki.availability: The Doge Rattle is a limited common toy in Adopt Me!. It could be bought in the Baby Shop for 175. This item could be found between the Unicorn Rattle and the Squid Rattle. When purchasing, the player had the ability to choose the color of the handle. However, this color cannot be changed later on or when the toy is traded. It was removed from the game on June 24, 2021, and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Doge Rattle, as true to its name, features a doge head attached to a white rattle stick with a handle on the bottom. It leaves behind a blue and purple trail whenever a player walks around while holding it. To interact with this toy, the player clicks their screen to shake it back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Doge Scooter is a limited rare single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released in 2018. It could have been obtained by opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499, respectively. As the Doge Scooter is no longer part of the gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Doge Scooter features an image of a doge on its deck. It has black handles with a white stripe between them. The Doge Scooter is a recolor of other scooters, the only difference being the design of its deck. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Doge Skateboard is a limited rare single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released in 2018. It could have been obtained by opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, or 499, respectively. As the Gifts were updated with new items, the Doge Skateboard can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Doge Skateboard features a beige skateboard with an image of a doge on the top. There are red letters to the left of the doge reading "What r you doing", as well as blue letters to the right of it reading "so scare". This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Doggy Door Face is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on November 22, 2024, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Doggy Door Face features a black doorframe with an open white flap. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Dogmobile is a limited legendary three-seater vehicle that was obtainable as a prize in the Small, Big, and Massive Gifts which cost 99, 199, and 499 respectively. It is no longer in the gifts rotation and is now only available through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dogmobile features a four-wheeled vehicle with a light-brown dog/dachshund that has a red tongue sticking out on its front. The vehicle is very long, and ends with a small pointed tail. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Dolphin is a limited uncommon pet that was added to Adopt Me! alongside the Ocean Egg on April 16, 2021. It was removed from the game on August 19, 2021, and can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Ocean Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 35% chance of hatching an uncommon pet from the Ocean Egg but only a 17.5% chance of hatching a Dolphin. The Dolphin has a blue body, a light-blue underbelly, and a small blowhole. It has two fins, one dorsal fin on the top, and tail fins on its back. It has two beady black eyes. Here are the tricks the Dolphin learns in order: The Neon Dolphin glows pink on its underbelly as well as underneath its tail. The Mega Neon Dolphin glows in the same areas as the Neon Dolphin, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dolphin Badge is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released as part of the World Oceans Day update. It was obtainable in the WDC (Whale and Dolphin Conservation) Pin Badges Board for free.
wiki.notes: It was displayed on a wooden board along with the other WDC Pin Badges. A player can attain a maximum of one pin badges every hour. This pin, along with the other ocean badges, was released on June 8, 2021, and left on July 8, 2021. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through trading. The Dolphin Badge features a decagon-shaped pin with a gray border and a photo of a dolphin. It has a dark blue background with white circles that resemble bubbles. The Dolphin Badge also features white highlights on the top and dark shadows across the bottom. This pet accessory goes on a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Dolphin Cruiser is a limited legendary four-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It can be obtained by opening Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499, respectively. It is otherwise obtainable through opening Admin Abuse Boxes or trading. The Dolphin Cruiser can only be opened from gifts when it is on rotation.
wiki.notes: This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Dolphin Sticker is a limited uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on September 20, 2024, alongside the second week of the Ocean Event (2024).
wiki.notes: As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Ocean Sticker Packs or through trading. The Dolphin Sticker features a cartoon Dolphin.

wiki.availability: The Donkey is an uncommon pet that was released in Adopt Me! on July 21, 2022. Players are able to hatch it from the Pet Egg, Cracked Egg, Royal Egg, Basic Egg or Admin Abuse Egg. It can otherwise be obtained through trading. The Donkey was formerly obtainable from the Crystal Egg from September 12, 2025 to February 20, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Donkey has a gray body with a peach-colored snout and inner ears. Its nose is a darker shade of gray, and its tail, mane, and eyes are black. Listed below are the tricks the Donkey learns in order: The Neon Donkey glows mint on the core of its ears, snout, and underbelly. The Mega Neon Donkey glows in the same areas as the Neon Donkey, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Donkey Sticker is a common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Sticker Pack for 250; players have a 40% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Donkey Sticker features a cartoon Donkey.

wiki.availability: The Donut Cycle is a limited legendary single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was available in the Small, Big, and Massive Gifts during a Gifts rotation in 2019. It is now only obtainable through trading, as the Gifts have been updated with new items.
wiki.notes: The Donut Cycle features a bright pink monocycle with a white inner wheel, pink steering wheel, and donut-shaped seating. It shares most of its model with the Monocycle. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Donut Flying Disc (formerly known as Donut Frisbee) is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was available in the Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. As the Gifts were replaced with new items, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Donut Flying Disc features a flat, tan-colored donut covered pink frosting with blue and yellow sprinkles scattered throughout. When a player interacts with the Donut Flying Disc, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Donut Flying Disc (formerly known as Donut Frisbee) is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was available in the Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. As the Gifts were replaced with new items, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Donut Flying Disc features a flat, tan-colored donut covered pink frosting with blue and yellow sprinkles scattered throughout. When a player interacts with the Donut Flying Disc, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Donut Rattle is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me!. It could have been obtained by opening a Small, Big, or Massive Gift, which cost 70, 199, and 499, respectively. As the Donut Rattle is no longer part of the gifts, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Donut Rattle features a beige donut with strawberry icing on the front. It is held up by a white handle with a spherical bottom. To interact with the rattle, a player can click/press their screen to shake it back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Donut Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It can be opened from Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. It can otherwise be obtained through opening Admin Abuse Boxes or trading.
wiki.notes: This item can transport one pet or baby at a time, and be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Donut Throw Toy is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me!. It could have been obtained by purchasing it in the old Pet Shop for 750. As of the Pet Shop's revamp on February 22, 2020, the Donut Throw Toy is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Donut Throw Toy features a light brown Donut with icing that was color-customizable upon purchase. As it's a throw toy, this toy is meant to be thrown, where the player's equipped pet will fetch the Donut Throw Toy and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Donut Unicycle is a limited ultra-rare single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! which could previously be found in the Small, Big and Massive Gifts which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. It is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Donut Unicycle features a bright pink seat with a lighter pink seat post. Its wheel resembles a donut with pink frosting. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Doodle Glasses are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As they were removed from the game on January 30, 2026, they can only be obtained through trading.

The Dotted Eggy is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 21, 2024, along with the Easter Event (2024). Players were able to obtain it through an Easter Eggy Box for 14,000. As the event has ended, it is now only obtainable through trading or by opening any remaining Easter Eggy Boxes.
wiki.notes: Players have a 70% chance of getting a Dotted Eggy from an Easter Eggy Box. The Dotted Eggy features a cyan egg adorned with polka dots in shades of pink, yellow, and blue. It has two yellow feet. These are the tricks the Dotted Eggy learns in order: The Neon Dotted Eggy glows green throughout its entire body, except for its polka dots. The Mega Neon Dotted Eggy glows in the same areas as the Neon Dotted Eggy, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dotted Eggy Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 25, 2025, alongside week 4 of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Cherry Blossom 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Dotted Eggy Sticker features a cartoon Dotted Eggy.

wiki.availability: The Double Pearl Earrings are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As they were removed from the game on January 30, 2026, they can only be obtained through trading.
