The Double Stroller is a limited uncommon stroller in Adopt Me! that was added in the Stroller update. It could be found and purchased in the Baby Shop for 135. It was removed from the game on June 24, 2021, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Double Stroller resembles the Stroller, but instead has two seats. Its color is customizable upon purchase, but cannot be changed afterwards or when it is traded away. This item can transport two pets or babies at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Douglas is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was previously obtainable in the Supercars Pack, which cost 1,000. As the Supercars Pack has left the game, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Douglas is an orange supercar with white windows, black tires, white headlights, a color-matching spoiler, white rims, and a lip splitter. The car is based on the Mclaren P1 LM. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Dracula Fish is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 13, 2024, alongside the Ocean Event (2024). It could be obtained through purchasing a Small Wish for 1,000. Players had a 30% chance of obtaining a Dracula Fish from the Small Wish. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dracula Fish features a dark, deep purple body with large, bulging red eyes and sharp red fangs. Its dark fins are wavy and have red accents. On its body, there are some visible red scales and a red underbelly. Here are the tricks the Dracula Fish learns in order: The Neon Dracula Fish glows blue on its eyes, fangs, scales, and on parts of its fins. The Mega Neon Dracula Fish glows in the same areas as the Neon Dracula Fish, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dracula Fish Sticker is a limited uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on September 20, 2024, alongside the second week of the Ocean Event (2024).
wiki.notes: As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Ocean Sticker Packs or through trading. The Dracula Fish Sticker features a cartoon Dracula Fish.

wiki.availability: The Dracula Parrot is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 11, 2024, as part of the second week of the Halloween Event (2024).
wiki.notes: Players had a 5.5% chance of obtaining the Dracula Parrot by checking a free gravestone each day after 15 minutes of gameplay. After the first free check, additional gravestones could be checked for 650 each. Players could guarantee obtaining a Dracula Parrot by checking all 18 gravestones. As the event has ended, the Dracula Parrot can only be obtained through trading. The Dracula Parrot features a dark gray and red feathered body, with the top half of its body being dark gray and the bottom being red. Its wings are dark gray with red tips, and its beak is dark gray and has two white fangs sticking out of it. It also has a red tail, two dark gray feet, and two black eyes. Here are the tricks the Dracula Parrot learns in order: The Neon Dracula Parrot glows orange on its wing tips, tail, and around its eyes. The Mega Neon Dracula Parrot glows in the same areas as the Neon Dracula Parrot, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dragon is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2019, along with the Pets update. Originally, players could obtain it by hatching a Cracked Egg, a Pet Egg, or a Royal Egg, but as of July 21, 2022, the Dragon can only be obtained by hatching a Retired Egg or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 1.5% chance of hatching a Dragon from a Retired Egg. The Dragon has a dark red body with a beige underbelly, as well as two wings. On each wing, there is a red spur with three beige wing membranes. It has four dark red feet. Its head features two beady black eyes, two small white fangs protruding from its mouth, and two beige-colored, slightly curved horns. Here are the tricks the Dragon learns in order: The Neon Dragon glows white on its wing spurs, feet, horns, and fangs. The Mega Neon Dragon glows in the same areas as the Neon Dragon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dragon Balloon is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me!. It was available from the Small, Big, and Massive Gifts during a Gifts rotation in 2019. It is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dragon Balloon features a recolored Dragon model on top and a thin white string attached at the bottom. However, in contrast to the Dragon's red body, the Dragon model featured in this toy is blue. When held, it allows a player to jump higher, just like many other balloons.

wiki.availability: The Dragon Breath Animated Sticker is a legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: There is a 0.01% chance of unboxing it from the Standard Sticker Pack, which costs 250. It can otherwise be obtained through trading. The Dragon Breath Animated Sticker features a cartoon Dragon that is breathing fire.

wiki.availability: The Dragon Eye Patch is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update.It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on January 30, 2026, it can only be obtained through trading.
The Dragon Sticker is a legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Sticker Pack for 250; players have a 4% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Dragon Sticker features a cartoon Dragon.

wiki.availability: The Dragon Train is a limited legendary five-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on February 3, 2022, as part of the Lunar New Year (2022). It could have been obtained by purchasing it on its display to the far left of the Lunar New Year Stand for 10,500. Since the event ended on February 17, 2022, the Dragon Train is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dragon Train features a red and yellow vehicle that resembles the Dancing Dragon. It has five seats, one being the head and the rest being a part of the body; the end seat connects to a pointed tail. Each seat is colored a vibrant red with yellow scales patterned across. Below each seat, there are small red wheels with yellow rims. The vehicle has white smoke coming out of the dragon's mouth, resembling a fire breathing dragon. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Dragonfly is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 21, 2022. Players are able to hatch it from the Pet Egg, Cracked Egg, Royal Egg, Basic Egg, Crystal Egg, or Admin Abuse Egg. It can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 2.7% chance of hatching a Dragonfly from a Royal Egg, a 1% chance of hatching it from a Pet Egg, and 0.5% chance of hatching it from a Cracked Egg. The Dragonfly features a dark teal body and a light teal head. Its tail has alternating dark teal and light teal stripes. Its wings are blue and yellow with spots of dark teal. Here are the tricks the Dragonfly learns in order: The Neon Dragonfly glows pink on its antennae, the inner lining of its wings, and on each alternating stripe on its tail. The Mega Neon Dragonfly glows in the same areas as the Neon Dragonfly, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dragonfly Fairy Wings are limited legendary wing pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on September 15, 2022. They could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Wing Chest for 150; players had a 1.5% chance of unboxing legendary wings, but only a 0.75% chance of unboxing the Dragonfly Fairy Wings. As their rotation has passed, the Dragonfly Fairy Wings can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dragonfly Fairy Wings feature golden-edged wings with a blue to purple gradient and sparkle particles around them. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back when it is flown.

wiki.availability: The Dragonfruit Feet are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on January 30, 2026, it can only be obtained through trading.

The Dragonfruit Fox is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 9, 2026. Players can hatch it from the Basic Egg or Crystal Egg, which are purchasable for 400 and 4,000 respectively. It is otherwise obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Dragonfruit Fox learns in order: The Neon Dragonfruit Fox glows green on its ear tips, inner ears, feet, head spots, and on the tips of its head and tail fur. The Mega Neon Dragonfruit Fox glows in the same areas as the Neon Dragonfruit Fox, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.egg: Special Lunar New Year Gift Box/Lunar New Year Gift Box
wiki.availability: The Dragonster is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on February 8, 2024, along with the Lunar New Year (2024) event. Players are able to obtain it by opening any remaining Special Lunar New Year Gift Boxes and Lunar New Year Gift Boxes or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dragonster consists of a deep red body. It features two large wheels at the side, with claws resting at the top. It has yellow lines bordering the windshields of the Dragonster, depicting two eyes. It also has flames coming out of its snout. The bottom front of the Dragonster is outlined with yellow lines, and has four front teeth. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Drake is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2019, along with the Farm Egg. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by trading or by hatching any remaining Farm Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 35% chance of hatching an uncommon pet from the Farm Egg, but only a 17.5% chance of hatching a Drake. The Drake features a bright green head and a brown body with a thin, white horizontal line separating the two colors near the bottom of the neck. It also has a yellow beak and feet. Listed below are the tricks the Drake learns in order: The Neon Drake glows bright green on its head, similar to the Neon Silly Duck. The Mega Neon Drake glows in the same areas as the Neon Drake, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Drinks Cooler is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2023, along with the Summer Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Summer Shop for 600. As its event has now passed, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Drinks Cooler features a blue cooler with an open lid. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Drone Propeller is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020. It was obtainable from the first page of the Star Rewards, requiring 30 Stars to unlock. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on September 11, 2026 when the Star Rewards were revamped.
wiki.notes: The Drone Propeller features a long rod with a red and white handle; this rod connects to a white cone-shaped propeller top. Surrounding the rod, there is a wide red circular piece, which holds four small propellers. The Drone Propeller's design is meant to reference that of a drone's. To interact with this item, the player can click anywhere on their screen to be propelled upwards. To stop, a player must jump while the propeller is in use.

wiki.availability: The Drone Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on August 22, 2025 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.egg: Small, Big Gift, or Massive Gift
wiki.availability: The Drooping Orchid Propeller is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on March 31, 2022, as part of the 2022 Gift Refresh Update. It could be purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Drooping Orchid Propeller features a long green rod curved around the top; at the bottom of the rod's curve, there is a flower with blue and pink petals. Small vines curl around the rod, complete with leaves; this is meant to represent the stem of the flower. To interact with this toy, a player can click or press their screen to be propelled upward; they can press the spacebar or the jump button to stop.

wiki.availability: The Droplet Stroller is a limited uncommon stroller in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Baby Shop for 300. It left the game on June 24, 2021, and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Droplet Stroller features a tall teardrop with a wheel at the bottom and a black handle at the back. The teardrop has a curved black seat in the middle. The Droplet Stroller was color-customizable, only affecting the color of the teardrop. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Drum Sticker is a limited uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on July 25, 2025, alongside week four of the Summer Festival (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Summer 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Drum Sticker features a cartoon Skull Drum.

wiki.availability: The Duck Balloon is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me!. It was available in Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. As the Gifts were refreshed to contain new items, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Duck Balloon features the classic rubber duck with a yellow body, black eyes, and an orange beak; this duck is featured as a balloon with a string attached to the bottom. The duck model used for the Duck Balloon is also seen in the Duck Stroller and Duck Rattle. Being a balloon, this item is used to allow players to jump higher than usual.

wiki.availability: The Duck Feet are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As they were removed from the game on November 22, 2024, they can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Duck Feet feature orange duck feet. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's feet.

wiki.availability: The Duck Floatie is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2023, along with the Summer Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Summer Shop for 3,750. As its event has now passed, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Duck Floatie is a yellow ring with the head of a rubber duck. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Duck Rattle is a limited common toy in Adopt Me!. Players could purchase it in the Baby Shop for 100. It left the game on June 24, 2021, and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Duck Rattle features a yellow duck with an orange beak, beady black and white eyes, and a handle with a ring-shaped bottom. The Duck Rattle was color-customizable, only affecting the color of the handle. This item leaves a yellow trail behind it. To interact with this item, a player can click their screen to shake it back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Duck Scooter is a limited rare single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released in 2018. It could have been obtained by opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, or 499, respectively. However, as the Gifts were updated with new items, the Duck Scooter can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Duck Scooter features a classic scooter with a duck pattern all along the bottom, as true to its name. The ducks are on a base of white. It has a white strip in the middle of its black handles. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Duck Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was obtainable from an old Gifts rotation. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Duck Stroller features a classic rubber duck with a yellow body and an orange beak; it has two wheels on its bottom, along with a small, black stroller handle near the rear end. The duck model used for the Duck Stroller is also seen in the Duck Balloon and Duck Rattle. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Duckling Box is a limited legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was released as part of the Easter Event (2023) event during the Spring Festival (2023). Players were able to obtain the gift by purchasing it for 12,000. Players have a 60% chance to get a Happy Duckling, a 30% chance to get a Flower Power Duckling, and a 10% chance to get a Sunrise Duckling from this box. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Duckling Box features a grassy base with stalks of grass sticking from the bottom. It has yellow edges, a cyan middle, and small pink and yellow flowers throughout its structure. It is topped with a pink bow, which has small yellow decorations.

wiki.availability: The Dueling Swords are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on April 28, 2022. They could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 5.5% and 3.3% chance of getting them from these gifts, respectively. As the Dueling Swords were removed from the game on September 29, 2022, they can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Dueling Swords feature two swords, a yellow one with a purple handle and an orange one with a black handle. Both swords feature sun designs on their handles. These pet accessories go on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Dugong is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 8, 2022. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Japan Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 22% chance of hatching a common pet from the Japan Egg, but only an 11% chance of hatching a Dugong. The Dugong features a brownish-gray body with a lighter-colored underbelly and large muzzle. It has a round, stubby tail, two black eyes, and small nose holes. The Dugong also has 2 front feet. Here are the tricks the Dugong learns in order: The Neon Dugong glows light blue on its snout and underbelly. The Mega Neon Dugong glows in the same areas as the Neon Dugong, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Dumbbell was a temporary common toy in Adopt Me!. It could have been obtained from the Dumbbells furniture item, which costs 59. Players were able to take an unlimited amount of them from the item. However, if players attempt to interact with the Dumbbells furniture item now, a pop-up will appear saying that the item is not for sale.
wiki.notes: The Dumbbell could not be traded and did not save in a player's inventory after they left the game. As a result of this, the Dumbbell is no longer obtainable. The Dumbbell features a gray handlebar with a black circular weight on each side. When a player interacted with the Dumbbell multiple times, their avatar would take on a muscular build.

wiki.availability: The Dumbbell was a temporary common toy in Adopt Me!. It could have been obtained from the Dumbbells furniture item, which costs 59. Players were able to take an unlimited amount of them from the item. However, if players attempt to interact with the Dumbbells furniture item now, a pop-up will appear saying that the item is not for sale.
wiki.notes: The Dumbbell could not be traded and did not save in a player's inventory after they left the game. As a result of this, the Dumbbell is no longer obtainable. The Dumbbell features a gray handlebar with a black circular weight on each side. When a player interacted with the Dumbbell multiple times, their avatar would take on a muscular build.

wiki.availability: The Dumpling Friend Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on January 19, 2023, as a part of the Lunar New Year (2023) event. Players were able to purchase this pet accessory at the Lunar New Year Stand near the Playground for 1,200. As its event has passed, it can now only be obtained by trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Dumpling Friend Hat features a small tan bun with a round bottom, two black eyes, pink blush, and a curved smile. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: Dylan is a limited uncommon doll pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 27, 2023, alongside River and Pistachio. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by trading or by opening any remaining Wrapped Dolls.
wiki.notes: Dylan features a small, lego-like doll with yellow skin. It has a smiling face. It wears a construction hat on its head, complete with a construction worker's orange vest.

wiki.availability: The Eagle Wings are limited rare wing pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on September 15, 2022. They could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Wing Chest for 600; players had a 7.3% chance of unboxing them. The Eagle Wings can now only be obtained through trading, as their rotation has left.
wiki.notes: The Eagle Wings feature wings with three layers of brown feathers; these layers go in a gradient of light brown to dark brown. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back when it is flown.

wiki.availability: The Easter 2020 Egg is a limited common egg in Adopt Me! that was given to players during the Easter Event 2020, from April 7, 2020, to April 28, 2020. This egg only hatches into a Chick.
wiki.notes: If a player were to hatch the egg, they were rewarded with a Roblox badge, the Chick pet, and a Chick Head for Roblox avatar customization. These items would automatically be placed in the player's in-game or Roblox inventory. Since the Easter 2020 Event has passed, the Easter 2020 Egg is no longer obtainable unless through trading. The Easter 2020 Egg represents a yellow, chick-like head with an orange beak, two black eyes, and some pink blush. It also has some fluff to the top of its structure.

wiki.availability: The Easter Bunny is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 4, 2026, during that day's Admin Abuse. It could have been earned for every 25 eggs a player hatched. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on April 6, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Easter Bunny learns in order: The Neon Easter Bunny glows white on its body patterns, face, eyebrows, tail, inner ears, ear spots, and on parts of its feet. The Mega Neon Easter Bunny glows in the same areas as the Neon Easter Bunny, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Easter Bunny Plush is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was obtainable during the Easter Event (2019). It cost 7 Easter Eggs, which were scattered around the Adopt Me! map for players to find.
wiki.notes: As its respective event has ended, it is currently only obtainable through trading. The Easter Bunny Plush is a multi-colored, striped plush. It features a bunny with floppy ears, black eyes, a black nose, a black mouth, and black whiskers. The colors of the stripes include pastel blue, pastel purple, and pastel yellow. To interact with the Easter Bunny Plush, the player can click on their screen to hug it.

wiki.availability: The Easter Chick Rattle is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 21, 2024, as part of the Easter Event (2024). Players were able to purchase it for 3,200 at the Easter Shop. As the event has ended, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Easter Chick Rattle features a yellow chick with black eyes, pink cheeks, and an orange beak. The chick has striped purple and blue egg shells on top of its head and under its body. It is held up by a purple stick with a large blue bow. The Easter Chick Rattle tends to serve no purpose other than just being a fun interactable item. To interact with this rattle, a player can click or press the screen to shake.

wiki.availability: The Easter Egg Friends are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on March 21, 2024, as part of the Easter Event (2024). Players were able to purchase them for 2,200 at the Easter Shop. As the event has ended, they can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Easter Egg Friends feature a lavender basket with yellow flowers and green vines wrapped around the handle. In the basket, there are four eggs; one egg is pink with bunny ears and black eyes and a mouth; one egg has green and pink stripes; one egg has yellow and blue stripes and a winking face; and one egg is blue with closed eyes and a smiling mouth. These pet accessories go on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Easter Egg Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 25, 2025, alongside week 4 of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Cherry Blossom 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Easter Egg Sticker features an image of the Easter Eggs currency.

wiki.availability: The Easter Egg Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2019, alongside the Easter Event (2019). It could be purchased 10 Eggs which were hidden around the map for players to find. As the event has ended, the Easter Egg Stroller can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Easter Egg Stroller features a half-open easter egg with a light-pink inner seat. It has pink and light pink stripes throughout its design and has two tiny black wheels at its bottom. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Easter Eggy Box is a limited legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was released on March 21, 2024, along with the Easter Event (2024). Players were able to purchase it for 14,000 at the Easter Shop. Players had a chance to get a rare Dotted Eggy, an ultra-rare Floral Eggy, or a legendary Striped Eggy. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.

The Eaten Donut is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 24, 2026. It could be obtained by attending the Admin Abuse on January 24, 2026 and March 21, 2026. As the Admin Abuse has now ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Eaten Donut features a pink donut with red, blue, and yellow sprinkles on it. This pet accessory goes in a pet's mouth.

wiki.availability: The Eaten Watermelon is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It is obtainable through purchasing and opening the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. It can otherwise be purchased for 200 when on rotation in the Accessory Shop, or obtained through trading.
The Eclipse Balloon is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on January 19, 2023, as a part of the Lunar New Year (2023) event.
wiki.notes: Players were able to purchase this toy at the Lunar New Year Stand near the Playground for 400. As its event has passed, it can now only be obtained by trading with other players. The Eclipse Balloon features a balloon with a yellow crescent-shaped piece (similar to the Waning Crescent phase of the moon) and a dark blue piece with yellow dots. Like all other balloons in the game, its only function is letting a player jump higher.

wiki.availability: The Eclipse Flying Disc is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on March 31, 2022, as part of the 2022 Gift Refresh Update. It was available in the Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Eclipse Flying Disc features a white-rimmed disc. In its middle, it holds a moon with purple and blue accents and orange rays extending from a purple gemstone. When interacted with, the Eclipse Flying Disc is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Eco Black Tree Motif Cap is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on October 12, 2021. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 100 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Eco Black Tree Motif Cap features a black cap with three green trees on the front. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Eco Blue Recycling Bin Badge is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 30, 2021. It could have been found in the Accessory Shop, where it was displayed on a wooden board along with two other free eco accessory pins, the Eco White Spider Web Badge and the Eco Green Vine Badge. One eco accessory pin could be taken for free by a player every hour.
wiki.notes: It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026. The Eco Blue Recycling Bin Badge features a blue round pin with a white-colored recycling symbol. This pet accessory goes on a pet's chest. Its design and colors are similar to those of the Eco Blue Recycling Bin Hat.

wiki.availability: The Eco Blue Recycling Bin Hat is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 30, 2021. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 200 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Eco Blue Recycling Bin Hat, features a small upturned recycling bin. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head. Its design and colors are similar to those of the Eco Blue Recycling Bin Badge.

wiki.availability: The Eco Blue Reusable Bottle Backpack is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 300 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Eco Blue Reusable Bottle Backpack features a light blue bottle with a blue cap. It is adorned with graphics of blue waves, a line, and raindrops. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Eco Blue Solar Panel Backpack is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 30, 2021. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 290 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Eco Blue Solar Panel Backpack, features a blue solar panel with a reddish-brown backside. Red and blue wires can also be found on both sides. This pet accessory goes on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Eco Brown Branch Headphones are limited ultra-rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on October 9, 2021, as part of the Eco Accessories Update. They could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 1,600 when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Eco Brown Branch Headphones feature a brown headband and a pair of cylindrical earpads with brown textures. There are several brown branches wrapped around the headband. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Eco Brown Earth-Wizard Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on October 5, 2021. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 1,900 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Eco Brown Earth-Wizard Hat is a brown-yellow, ombre colored hat. Brown twigs with orange leaves wrap around the hat, while tiny golden-colored light particles can be seen hovering around it. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Egg Basket Stroller is a limited rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on April 14, 2022, along with the Easter Event (2022). It could be purchased for 2,250. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Egg Basket Stroller features a curved, beige-yellow basket with thick yellow lining around its top. A red ribbon curves around it, meeting in a red bow at the front. It has a thick handle at the back. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.notes: The Egg Delivery Machine features an egg-shaped vehicle with teal and yellow stripes. At the back, it has a few contrasting dots in teal and yellow. It has two front-facing yellow lights, as well as four black wheels on its bottom. It is topped with a bright red bow. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. wiki.availability: The Egg Glasses are limited ultra-rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were available in the Easter Event (2021). They were purchasable for 400, which were hidden around the map for players to find. The Egg Glasses can now only be obtained through trading.

wiki.availability: The Egg Rattle is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was obtainable during the 2018 Easter Event. It could be purchased for 1 Chocolate Egg. Since the event is over, players can now only obtain the Egg Rattle by trading.

wiki.availability: The Egg Stroller is a limited rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on March 31, 2018, alongside the Easter Event (2018). It could be purchased for 25 Chocolate Eggs. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.

It resembles Eggburt, whose face can also be seen in the Marsh Plush and the Marsh Balloon. When a baby/pet sits in this stroller, the stroller's arms wrap around them. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Eggnog Dog is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 25, 2023, during the Winter Festival (2023). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained or through trading or by hatching any remaining Christmas Future Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 100% chance of hatching an Eggnog Dog from a Christmas Future Egg. The Eggnog Dog features a similar shape to the Dog, but some parts have been slightly reshaped, its body is less saturated and its nose is light brown instead of black. Its back is covered with chocolate chips and has whipped cream with chocolate chips and a chocolate flake on top of its head. It has two black eyes and a short beige tail. Listed below are the tricks the Eggnog Dog learns in order: The Neon Eggnog Dog glows pink where the whipped cream and chocolate flake lies on its head. The Mega Neon Eggnog Dog glows in the same areas as the Neon Eggnog Dog, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Eggnog Hare is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 14, 2023, as part of the third week of the Winter Festival (2023). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading or by opening any remaining Hare Boxes.
wiki.notes: Players have a 25% chance of getting an Eggnog Hare from a Hare Box. The Eggnog Hare features two icing swirls for ears, a maroon nose with whiskers, a circle of icing around its neck, a beige body, and white feet. Listed below are the tricks the Eggnog Hare learns in order: The Neon Eggnog Hare glows yellow on its ears, nose, feet, areas on its forehead, and around its neck. The Mega Neon Eggnog Hare glows in the same areas as the Neon Eggnog Hare, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ehecatl is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 12, 2025. wiki.notes: There is a 6% chance of hatching the Ehecatl from the Aztec Egg, and a 12.5% chance of hatching it from the Royal Aztec Egg. Here are the tricks the Ehecatl learns in order: The Neon Ehecatl glows orange on some of its head feathers, most of its beak, small parts of the detailing on its chest and wings, parts of its feet, and on the tips of its tail feathers. Parts of its face, chest, and wing detailing glow blue, while its eye spots, parts of its beak, and small areas of its chest and wing detailing glow yellow. The Mega Neon Ehecatl glows in the same areas as the Neon Ehecatl, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Elasmosaurus is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, alongside the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024) event. It also has a yellow underbelly, two beady black eyes, and white teeth protruding from its mouth. It resembles the Nessie. Here are the tricks the Elasmosaurus learns in order: The Neon Elasmosaurus glows teal green on the patterns on its back, tail, and head. The Mega Neon Elasmosaurus glows in the same areas as the Neon Elasmosaurus, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

The Emperor's Chariot could previously be found in the shop menu and purchased for 250. It is now only obtainable through trading with other players as it has left the game.
wiki.notes: This vehicle was previously displayed on a wooden pedestal in between the Pet Shop and the Hot Air Balloon. It was later removed from the game on September 15, 2022, two weeks after it was added. However, it was brought back into the game on November 3, 2022. After a sale, it was finally removed on March 30, 2023. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Emu is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 29, 2020, along with the Aussie Egg. As the Aussie Egg is now unavailable, the Emu can only be obtained by hatching any remaining Aussie Eggs or through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: Players have a 27% chance of hatching a rare pet from the Aussie Egg, but only a 13.5% chance of hatching an Emu. The Emu has a light brown head, long neck and feet, small beady black eyes, a darker brown body, and a dark gray beak. Here are the tricks the Emu learns in order: The Neon Emu glows orange on its beak, wings, and feet. The Mega Neon Emu glows in the same areas as the Neon Emu, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Enby Flag is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 9, 2022. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand for 50; the Pride Stand could be found near the Playground and left the game on June 16, 2022. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Enby Flag features a non-binary flag with a white handle; this handle has a small yellow knob on its tip. The colors of the flag include black, purple, white, and yellow. It has a pet accessory counterpart, the Enby Pride Pin. To wave the flag, a player can click anywhere on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Enby Flag 2023 is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 1, 2023. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand for 50; the Pride Stand could be found near the Playground. It can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Enby Flag 2023 features an Enby Flag, the only difference being the rainbow string that is intertwined along the flagpole and a Pride Paw Flying Disc at the top of the pole. To wave the flag, a player can click anywhere on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Enby Pride Pin is a common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 31, 2020. It could have been found in the Accessory Shop and taken for free. One pride pin could be taken by a player every hour. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Enby Pride Pin features a heart-shaped pin with a gold border and colors that represent the non-binary flag. The colors include black, purple, white, and yellow. This pet accessory goes on a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Enchanted Broomstick is a limited ultra-rare two-seater flying vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on October 11, 2024, as part of the second week of the Halloween Event (2024). Players could have purchased it for 175. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Enchanted Broomstick features a brown stick with yellow bristles on the end that are tied to the stick with brown rope. It leaves a yellow trail behind when flown. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

They were obtainable by purchasing a capsule from the Gacha Bot for 500, and had a 1% chance of dropping. They are now only obtainable through trading, as the event has ended.

It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on August 22, 2025 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.

wiki.availability: The Energy Wings are limited ultra-rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on April 18, 2025, alongside the third week of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). Players could have purchased them for 8,600 during the event or from the item rotation in the Cherry Blossom Wagon. They can now only be obtained through trading.

The England Soccer Boots are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on July 12, 2024. Players could purchase them for 300 until July 19, 2024. They can now only be obtained through trading.

The English Sheepdog is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on November 2, 2023. Players were able to purchase this pet in the Farm Zone next to the Accessory Shop for 1,300. It can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The English Sheepdog features a gray body, ears, and tail. It has a white muzzle; white fur on top of its head and on its chest; a white tail tip; and white feet. It has two black eyes and a black nose. Here are the tricks the English Sheepdog learns in order: The Neon English Sheepdog glows a bright green on its feet, the fur on its neck, the fur on its head, and on the top of its tail. The Mega Neon English Sheepdog glows in the same areas as the Neon English Sheepdog, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ermine is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was added on December 1, 2022, as part of the Winter Event (2022).
wiki.notes: It could have been found in the Candy Castle and bought for 9,000. As its event has now passed, it can only be obtained through trading with other players. The Ermine features a white body, face, tail, feet, and ears. It has pink inner ears, a pink nose, black whiskers, a black tail tip, and black eyes. Listed below are the tricks the Ermine learns in order: The Neon Ermine glows orange on its feet, nose, the tip of its tail, and the insides of its ears. The Mega Neon Ermine glows in the same areas as the Neon Ermine, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Evil Basilisk is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 6, 2022, along with the Halloween Event (2022). It could be purchased for 60,000. As the event has ended, it is now only available through trading.
wiki.notes: The Evil Basilisk features a long black body with red flecks throughout. It has sharp white teeth, a thin red tongue, red ruffles above its eyes, and a dark gray underbelly. Its eyes glow bright red. Here are the tricks the Evil Basilisk learns in order: The Neon Evil Basilisk glows bright red on its red flecks, tongue, and the ruffles above its eyes. The Mega Neon Evil Basilisk glows in the same areas as the Neon Evil Basilisk, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Evil Chick is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 18, 2024, alongside the third week of the Halloween Event (2024). As the event has ended, players can only obtain the Evil Chick by opening any remaining Halloween Chick Boxes or through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 5% chance of obtaining the Evil Chick from the Halloween Chick Box. The Evil Chick features a black body with two glowing red eyes, a brown beak, a pair of wings, and smooth cloud-like designs on its head and its neck. It also emits black smoke particles from its body. Here are the tricks the Evil Chick learns in order: The Neon Evil Chick glows purple on its wings, feet, around its neck, and on the details on its head. The Mega Neon Evil Chick glows in the same areas as the Neon Evil Chick, except those areas and its eyes cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Evil Chickatrice is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 13, 2022, during the Halloween Event (2022). It was priced at 45,000, the event currency that could be obtained through three minigames. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Evil Chickatrice features a black body with a dark blue underbelly. It has red feathers at the tip of its tail and above its wings, which have black ridges and lighter insides. The Evil Chickatrice has two red eyes, a red comb, a dark gray beak, and a red spot of feathers on its face. It has two small, dark blue feet and dark blue wing spurs. These are the tricks the Evil Chickatrice learns in order: The Neon Evil Chickatrice glows red on its crown, the tip of its tail, its wings, and its eyes. The Mega Neon Evil Chickatrice glows in the same areas as the Neon Evil Chickatrice, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Evil Headphones are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on October 5, 2023, as a part of the Halloween Event (2023). wiki.availability: The Evil Rock is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 19, 2023, as part of the Halloween Event (2023). This pet could have been purchased in the Asylum shop for 75. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Evil Rock features a black rock with a thin black line representing a mouth and a pair of salmon colored glowing eyes. These are the tricks the Evil Rock learns in order: All of these tricks are the same action; the Evil Rock would sit still through all of them and not do anything. The Neon Evil Rock glows salmon on its mouth. The Mega Neon Evil Rock glows in the same areas as the Neon Evil Rock, except those areas and its eyes cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Evil Unicorn is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 25, 2019, as part of the final week of the Halloween Event (2019). wiki.notes: The Evil Unicorn has a black body with a dark red horn, mane, and tail. It has two glowing red, beady eyes. The insides of its ears are pale pink. Listed below are the tricks the Evil Unicorn learns in order: The Neon Evil Unicorn glows bright red on its mane, horn, and tail. The Mega Neon Evil Unicorn glows in the same areas as the Neon Evil Unicorn, except those areas, as well as the eyes, cycle through the colors red, pink, and orange.

wiki.availability: The Evil Unicorn Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 25, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Halloween Event (2024). wiki.notes: The Evil Unicorn Sticker features a cartoon Evil Unicorn.

wiki.availability: The Explorer Hat is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 5, 2020. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 250 while on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.

wiki.availability: The Exposed Brain is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. wiki.availability: The Fairy Bat Dragon is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 6, 2024, alongside the Winter Festival (2024). Players could have purchased it for 1,000 until January 17, 2025. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.

The Mega Neon Fairy Bat Dragon glows in the same areas as the Neon Fairy Bat Dragon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Fairy Bell Necklace is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 9, 2023. To interact with this item, a player can click/press anywhere on their screen to fire a hooked-cable that allows them to be pulled towards their target location. Like most other grappling hooks, players cannot use this item on non-solid graphical objects, if they are on a vehicle, doing an obby, flying or riding a pet.

wiki.availability: The Fall Donut Glasses are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on August 11, 2022. They can be purchased in the Fall Shop for 450 when it is on rotation, or obtained through trading.

wiki.notes: The Fall Rains Balloon features a gray cloud with swirly white cartoon winds. It has a thin gray string attached for players to hold onto and white raindrops coming down from it. Like all other balloons in the game, its only function is letting a player jump higher.

wiki.availability: The Fall Wheelbarrow Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on August 11, 2022. It can be found and purchased in the Fall Shop for 1,200 when the Fall Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.

This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Fallow Deer is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 17, 2022, along with the Woodland Egg. As the Woodland Egg is now unavailable for purchase, players can only obtain the Fallow Deer by trading with other players, or by hatching any remaining Woodland Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 5% chance of hatching a legendary from the Woodland Egg, but only a 2.5% chance of hatching the Fallow Deer. The Fallow Deer features a brown coat with a pale brown underbelly, white spots, two antlers which slightly protrude backwards, very large ears, and black hooves. The Fallow Deer hops constantly in its idle animation and springs up when it moves. Here are the tricks the Fallow Deer learns in order: The Neon Fallow Deer glows light green on its spots, underbelly, antlers, and around its eyes. The Mega Neon Fallow Deer glows in the same areas as the Neon Fallow Deer, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Fallow Deer Sticker is an ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Sticker Pack for 250; players have a 14% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Fallow Deer Sticker features a cartoon Fallow Deer.

wiki.availability: The Family Car is an uncommon four-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 31, 2022. It can be purchased in the Vehicle Dealership for 900 or obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Family Car features the appearance of a common coupe with simplistic wheels. The front features a trapezoid-shaped grille and two yellow headlights. The upper body consists of a curved roof, three windows on each side, with the one closest to the rear being the shortest, a windshield, and a window on the roof near the back, with a small fin before it. There are also wing mirrors at the front of the upper body. This vehicle features a tall rear that has a two taillights, a license plate with a paw-print emblem, and a dark-gray bumper. It slightly resembles the Car. However, the Car is less smooth and detailed than the Family Car, and only has two seats. Like the other vehicles in the Vehicle Dealership, the Family Car is color-customizable upon purchase. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Fan Flying Disc is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released during the 2022 Lunar New Year Event. It could be obtained by purchasing it for 400. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Fan Flying Disc is a red, golden, and brown fan-shaped flying disc, resembling a Japanese hand-held fan. To interact with this item, a player can click/press their screen to throw the toy, where an equipped pet will pick it up and retrieve it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Fan Propeller is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. wiki.notes: The Fancy Balloon features a turquoise and white striped balloon attached to a straight, white string. It has the same texture as the balloon attached to the Balloon Stroller. The Fancy Balloon allows a player to jump higher when equipped.

wiki.availability: The Summer Camp Event (2026) is an event in Adopt Me! that began on June 20, 2026, during that day's Admin Abuse, and ended on July 20, 2026. Along with it came changes to the entire Adoption Island map, such as the grass being changed to a darker green color, most of the trees being changed to pine trees, with additional pine trees being placed around the map, lily pads and tall algae being added to the river, additional wooden docks being placed near fishing spots, wooden cabins being added next to the Pizza Shop and in front of the redesigned Campsite, and piles of green leaves being added to the ground.
wiki.notes: Various event areas appeared around the map as well, which included a raised ground area between the Pizza Shop and Campsite where Water Balloon Fights took place, a dig site between the Beach Party and Baby Shop, a voting area next to the Nursery, a Fishing Shop on the wooden bridge in front of the Beach Party, and a minigame queue for Ducky Drive next to Green Groceries. For Skydiving, a red and white target board was added to the river behind the School, and two red and blue airships were added across from the Playground and in the sky above the Accessory Shop. For the final day of the event, fireworks could be seen going off above the river, behind the School. NPCs Cricket, Mayor Amanda, Randi, Dagi, Jesse, Irish Setter, Storm Condor, and Grave Dave introduced players to the event. Players could earn Acorns and pets through event activities, and purchase pets and other items with Acorns over the course of the event. 250 were also rewarded for each pet need completed. During the final weekend of the event, Acorn rewards from Ducky Drive and completing pet needs were increased by 20%. When the event ended, a wagon carrying all of the event items except for temporary ones and the Stygian Owl, Rainbow Trout, Tealwood Monster, Fishing Bobber Chew Toy, and Fishing Bucket Hat appeared, and was present until July 24, 2026, allowing players to spend any leftover Acorns. Starting from week 1 of the event, players could board the Airship across from the Playground and go Skydiving. After dropping out of the Airship, players slowly fell towards the ground, and were tasked with going through as many rings in the air as possible and landing as close to the bullseye on the target board as they could. While falling, players could move in any direction, except for up. After landing on the board, players could collect their reward of Acorns at the ring near the Airship. Up to 2,500 could be earned from going through the rings, and up to 1,250 could be earned from the landing, making the maximum reward from this activity 3,750. Players could only earn Acorns from Skydiving once every in-game day. Time Trials for the Skydiving activity could be started by talking to Randi inside of the Airship, with the fastest times of players in the server being displayed on a leaderboard next to the Airship. Starting from week 3 of the event, players could talk to the Storm Condor NPC inside of the Airship to begin the Storm Condor Challenge. In the challenge, players were tasked with skydiving through all 26 storm rings. If successfully done, they unlocked the ability to purchase the Storm Condor pet next to the Airship until the next in-game morning. Starting from week 1 of the event, players could grab Water Balloons from the buckets in the Water Fight area between the Vehicle Dealership and Campsite. They could then click their screen with a Water Balloon equipped to throw it; each Water Balloon had five uses. Each time a player was hit by a thrown Water Balloon, 5 were dropped for the player who threw it. Up to 250 could be earned from hitting players with Water Balloons every in-game day. If a player was in a server with an Uplift Games staff member, hitting them with a Water Balloon rewarded more Acorns. Pets occasionally received the "Balloon Fight" ailment, which required the player to hit another player with Water Balloons or stand in the Water Fight area to complete. 250 were rewarded for completing the ailment. Starting from week 1 of the event, players could grab a free Bronze Fishing Rod from the Fishing Shop and fish for Karp or the Tealwood Monster at a fishing spot. Fishing spots could be found in the Fishing Shop and throughout Adoption Island, and had different kinds of fish populating them. The Tealwood Monster and Bronze Karp could be found in the spot in the Fishing Shop, and the spots around Adoption Island could contain Bronze Karp, Silver Karp, Gold Karp, and Rainbow Karp. The Bronze Karp was the most common fish to find, while the Rainbow Karp was the rarest. The fish respawned every in-game morning. The Tealwood Monster pet could only be caught using the Tealwood Monster Bait, while the Bronze Karp, Silver Karp, Gold Karp, and Rainbow Karp didn't require bait to catch. To catch a fish, players had to have a fishing rod equipped. After clicking with the fishing rod equipped near a fishing spot, the player had to wait for a nearby fish to bite. When a fish bit, a red icon with an exclamation mark would appear, and the player had a limited amount of time to react and click their screen. Bronze Karp could always be caught after successfully reacting in time once, while other Karp could have needed to bite multiple times depending on the fishing rod the player had. The Silver Fishing Rod could be earned after catching 50 fish with the Bronze Fishing Rod, while the Gold Fishing Rod could be earned after catching 250 fish with the Silver Fishing Rod. These rods lowered the amount of times the Tealwood Monster, Silver Karp, Gold Karp, and Rainbow Karp needed to bite before they were caught, and lengthened the amount of time that a player had to react when they bit, making them easier to catch. Higher rarity Karp required faster reaction times to catch. Once a Karp was successfully caught, it went into the player's inventory. Karp could be traded in for various items, including the Tealwood Monster Bait and Rainbow Trout in the Fishing Shop, or sold for Acorns. Bronze Karp were worth 50, Silver Karp were worth 100, Gold Karp were worth 500, and Rainbow Karp were worth 5,000. Starting from week 3 of the event, players could interact with the three Ranger Beaver NPCs around Adoption Island and trade in Acorns and Karp for a sculpture to be built. The sculptures provided a permanent boost to Fishing for the rest of the event. The Owl Sculpture cost 5,000 and one Bronze Karp, and made Karp easier to catch. The Hare Sculpture cost 10,000 and one Silver Karp, and made Karp more likely to bite. The Fox Sculpture cost 15,000 and one Gold Karp, and made an extra Gold Karp appear each day. Starting from week 2 of the event, players could find one Bone in a Bottle washed ashore in the Beach Party area at the beginning of every hour. While players were offline, up to three could accumulate on the shore over the course of three hours before they had to be collected in order for more to spawn. After collecting a Bone in a Bottle, they could then talk to the Irish Setter NPC and give it to him in order to receive rewards that he dug up. For each Bone in a Bottle handed in, there was a 65% chance of receiving a Campfire Story Page and 500, a 30% chance of receiving a Campfire Story Page and 1,000, and a 5% chance of receiving a Campfire Story Page and an Age-Up Potion. Players also had the opportunity to purchase one Irish Setter pet every time they handed in a Bone in a Bottle. Once 13 Campfire Story Pages were collected, players could give them to Grave Dave at the Campsite to unlock the "Heated Fall" campfire story and receive one Stygian Owl. Starting from week 4 of the event, players could access the Ducky Drive minigame queue next to Green Groceries, which ran on a repeating 10-minute timer. In this minigame, players had 90 seconds to ride on a Ruddy Duck Waddler around Adoption Island and collect as many Acorns as possible. Each brown acorn collected rewarded 20, and each golden acorn collected rewarded 60. There were also scattered green boost pads that give players a short speed boost when touched. Once the time was up, the minigame ended and players received the Acorns they collected, up to a maximum of 5,000. Starting from week 1 of the event, each player could cast a vote for Jesse or Dagi at the stand next to the Nursery. After voting, a Team Jesse or Team Dagi icon was added next to the player's name above their head. Votes could not be changed after casting them. The stand next to the Nursery displayed the total votes of all of the players currently in the server. The votes reset each week during the following Admin Abuse, and the winning team's corresponding reward was given to every attending player. There were different rewards available each week. For the first week of voting, Jesse's pet accessory was the Glyptodon's Here Helmet, while Dagi's was the Sheepdog Army Hair. The voting period was active from June 20, 2026, to June 27, 2026. Dagi won with 65% of the total votes, and four Sheepdog Army Hairs were handed out to players during the Admin Abuse on June 27, 2026. The second voting period began afterwards. For the second week of voting, Jesse's pet accessory was the Glyptodon Shell Shoes, while Dagi's was the Sheepdog Fluff. The voting period was active from June 27, 2026, to July 4, 2026. Dagi won with 56% of the total votes, and three Sheepdog Fluffs were handed out to players during the Admin Abuse on July 4, 2026. The third voting period began afterwards. For the third week of voting, Jesse's vehicle was the Glyptodon Van, while Dagi's was the Personal Sheepdog Car. The voting period was active from July 4, 2026, to July 11, 2026. Dagi won with 60% of the total votes, and two Personal Sheepdog Cars were handed out during the Admin Abuse on July 11, 2026. The fourth voting period began afterwards. For the fourth week of voting, Jesse's pet was the Chestnut Glyptodon, while Dagi's was the General Sheepdog. The voting period was active from July 11, 2026, to July 18, 2026. Dagi won with 51% of the total votes, and one General Sheepdog was handed out during the Admin Abuse on July 18, 2026. The Glyptodon's Here Helmet, Glyptodon Shell Shoes, Glyptodon Van, and Chestnut Glyptodon were put on sale for Acorns after the final vote results were announced. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 2.2% and 6.7% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
