wiki.notes: The Foragers Reward has a brown wooden background featuring a large mushroom with a red cap with white spots and a small mushroom with a blue cap and white spots. This pet accessory goes on a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Forest Sprite is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 10, 2026, alongside week four of the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could have purchased it for 3,700, or hatched it from a Basic Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 24, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Forest Sprite learns in order: The Neon Forest Sprite glows light green on its face spots, head leaves, and on the arrow on its abdomen. The Mega Neon Forest Sprite glows in the same areas as the Neon Forest Sprite, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Forest Warden Hat is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 29, 2026, alongside the Journey to Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could have obtained it through purchasing the Beaver Bob Bundle for 99. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on June 19, 2026.

wiki.egg: Obtainable via excavating during the Fossil Isle Excavation (2020
wiki.availability: The Forgotten Flower is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! which players could obtain through digging for fossils during the Fossil Isle Excavation (2020) Event. It can now only be obtained through trading, as its respective event has ended.
wiki.notes: Upon discovering a fossil, players may take the said fossil to the NPC Henry, who will in turn give players some information regarding the fossil that they have discovered. After taking two fossils to Henry, he would reward the player with a Forgotten Flower since they would have uncovered all the ultra-rare pets. The Forgotten Flower features four green leaves topped with a pink-red flower. This pet accessory goes on the side of a pet's head. It is based on its real-life counterpart, the Scabiosa.

wiki.availability: The Formal Big Bow Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had an 1.7% and 0.4% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Formal Big Bow Hat was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Formal Big Bow Hat features a dark blue hat with a light pink ribbon tied around the middle. The middle of the hat features a large light pink bow. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Fortune Teller Hood is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It was obtainable through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on August 22, 2025, it can now only be obtained through trading.

The Fortune Wheel Flying Disc is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 21, 2024, as part of the Summer State Fair (2024). Players could purchase the Fortune Wheel Flying Disc for 800. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Fortune Wheel Flying Disc features a circular wheel with segments in different colors of the rainbow. It has a red arrow pointer at the top, and a dark purple outline around the wheel with evenly spaced small lights. In the center, there is a dark purple circle with a red outline and a paw print. When interacted with, the Fortune Wheel Flying Disc is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Fossa is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on August 3, 2023, along with the Jungle Zone.
wiki.notes: Players were able to purchase this pet in the Jungle Zone for 500. As the Jungle Zone has now left the game, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players. The Fossa features a brown body with a maroon underbelly, brown ears with maroon insides, black beady eyes, a dark brown nose, and a brown tail and feet. Here are the tricks the Fossa will learn in order: The Neon Fossa glows yellow on its ears, nose, underbelly, and tail. The Mega Neon Fossa glows in the same areas as the Neon Fossa, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Elasmosaurus Fossil is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024) event. Players could obtain it by mining in the Fossil Isle Mine or purchasing a set of five for 625. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: During the event, once the player had at least twenty Elasmosaurus Fossils, they could put them in the Fossil Sequencer 7000 and spend 1,200 to turn the fossils into an Elasmosaurus.

wiki.availability: The Fossil Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that could be purchased for 750. It was released on October 10, 2020, replacing the Aussie Egg. It was replaced by the Ocean Egg on April 16, 2021, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Fossil Egg is a green, brown, and tan-colored egg. The egg has a green tail with a yellow bottom. There are little dirt smudges around the egg as well as brown scales on its back. The Fossil Egg represents many features of the T-Rex; these features are shown in the egg's spikes, tail, and color.

wiki.availability: The Fossil Isle Pickaxe is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on November 22, 2024, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Fossil Isle Pickaxe features a pickaxe with an orange head. The head of the pickaxe is secured on a brown stick by brown rope. There is a brown rope intertwined around the bottom of the stick. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Fossil Paw Helicopter is a limited rare four-seater flying vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on September 16, 2021. It could have been purchased for 4,000 on a wooden pedestal next to the Racing Monoplane and in front of the Hot Air Balloon. As it left the game on September 30, 2021, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Fossil Paw Helicopter, as true to its name, features a helicopter with a white paw print on the far end. It is topped with a black spinning propeller. The exterior of the helicopter is colored sleek red by default; however, this color can be changed by the player after purchase. The secondary gray color cannot be changed. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Fossil Sticker Pack is a limited rare sticker pack in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, alongside the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024) event. Players could purchase it for 250 or obtain it for free by clearing the Fossil Isle Mine each day during the event. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: When the Fossil Sticker Pack is opened, the player receives ten stickers. For each sticker, there is a 40% chance of getting a common, a 25% chance of getting an uncommon, a 17% chance of getting a rare, a 14% chance of getting an ultra-rare, and a 4% chance of getting a legendary. When the event ended, the Fossil Sticker Pack was moved to Adoption Island. It was available to purchase until May 17, 2024.

wiki.availability: The Founder's Key Throw Toy (formerly known as the Founder's Key) is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me!.
wiki.notes: After diving into the water where Burt was stationed, players could find a sunken ship and search for three pieces of the key. The first piece was located straight ahead of the player in a small sandy cove. The second piece was located near a wooden staircase section, close to the first piece. The third piece of the key was located on the very top of the highest tree. After the player obtained all fragments, the Founder's Key appeared in their inventory. It is now only obtainable through trading. The Founder's Key Throw Toy features a yellow and orange key with one end of it being in the shape of a paw. When the Founder's Key Throw Toy is interacted with, the player will throw it and their equipped pet will fetch and return it to them. When thrown, it squeaks. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. Before the Founder's Key was renamed, it could be used to open the Vault in the Pet Shop. It was found in a sunken ship that later became the Accessory Shop, right beneath Burt's new station spot.

wiki.availability: The Founder's Crown is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 3, 2020. It was obtainable through finding all three pieces of the Founder's Key in an underwater area, then unlocking the Vault in the Pet Shop. It sat on a pedestal inside and could be claimed for free. It became unavailable once the Dress Your Pets Live Event was released on April 11, 2020, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Founder's Crown features a golden crown encrusted with purple jewels, and has a red plush interior. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Fox Ear Beret is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.8% and 5.5% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Fox Ear Beret was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Fox Ear Beret features an orange beret with two fox tails sticking out. The two fox tails have white ends. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Fox Sticker is an uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Premium Sticker Pack for 50; players have a 35% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Fox Sticker features a cartoon Red Fox.

wiki.availability: The Fragile Box is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 9, 2023. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.8% and 0.7% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on May 10, 2024, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Fragile Box features a cardboard box with white marks across it and a black arrow pointing down. This pet accessory goes on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The France Soccer Cap is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 12, 2024. Players could purchase it for 300 until July 19, 2024. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The France Soccer Cap features a cap with soccer ball patterns on its panels and a striped visor with the colors blue, white and red. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Frankenfeline is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 4, 2024, as part of the Halloween Event (2024). Players could have purchased it for 3,600 from the lab building or the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon. It was also purchasable for 10 during the first two weeks of the Halloween Event (2024). As the Halloween Event (2024) has ended and the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon has left, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Frankenfeline features a mismatched body with stitches, whiskers, glowing orange eyes, and a gray bolt sticking out of its head. Here are the tricks the Frankenfeline learns in order: The Neon Frankenfeline glows yellow on its stitches, bolts, inner ears, and whiskers. Its eyes remain orange. The Mega Neon Frankenfeline glows in the same areas as the Neon Frankenfeline, except those areas and its eyes cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Frankenfeline Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 25, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Halloween Event (2024). As the event has ended and the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon has closed, it can only be obtained through opening any remaining Halloween 2024 Sticker Packs or trading.
wiki.notes: The Frankenfeline Sticker features a cartoon Frankenfeline.

wiki.availability: Popcorn is a common food item in Adopt Me!. It can be used/interacted with five times before it disappears from the player's inventory. Popcorn can be fed to a baby or a pet to fulfill the "Hungry" ailment.
wiki.notes: It was previously could be found between the Hotdogs and Cake at Green Groceries for 2, but was removed after the Farm Shop was released. It can now only be obtained for free in the VIP room or through trading. The Popcorn's appearance is a red and white striped popcorn box. The shape of the box is square shaped. The Popcorn itself is a light pastel yellow.

wiki.availability: The Sandwich is a common food item in Adopt Me! that can be obtained for free by simply joining the game, and from the School's and Hospital's cafeterias. It is also obtainable through trading. Any free Sandwiches will disappear from the player's inventory when they leave the game, and cannot be favorited.
wiki.notes: The Sandwich has slices of green lettuce and red tomatoes that are held together by two pieces of white bread. This item can be used to fulfill the 'hungry' ailment on pets and babies. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. It takes three uses to fully consume.

wiki.availability: The French Bulldog is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 5, 2025, as a part of the second week of the Homepass. Players were able to earn it through leveling the Homepass by completing tasks on their Task Board and completing pet needs. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on September 12, 2025.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the French Bulldog learns in order: The Neon French Bulldog glows pale yellow on its muzzle, underbelly, feet, inner ears, and on the stripe running down the middle of its head. The Mega Neon French Bulldog glows in the same areas as the Neon French Bulldog, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The French Fries Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was obtainable from an old Gifts rotation. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The French Fries Stroller is comprised of a red french fries box full of golden french fries. The box features a yellow stripe with slightly smaller white stripes above and below it. On the two lower corners, there are two black wheels; each wheel has a white center. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Fried Egg is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me!. It could have been purchased for 150 at the Accessory Shop. As it has left the game, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Fried Egg, features a fried egg with a yellow-orange yolk in the center of an untidy pool of egg white. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Frigid Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 9, 2023. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.7% and 0.4% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on May 10, 2024, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Frigid Hat features a dark blue hat with a white ribbon and a light blue diamond in the middle. It has two white drop-down accessories on each side. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Christmas Star Flying Disc (formerly known as Christmas Star Frisbee) is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that could have been obtained during the Christmas Event (2019) by purchasing and opening Christmas Gifts, which cost 1,440. This toy can now only be obtained through trading or opening any remaining Christmas Gifts, as the Christmas Event (2019) has ended.
wiki.notes: The Christmas Star Flying Disc features a flat, golden eight-pointed star. It bears the exact same appearance as the Star Ornament, which was also available in the Christmas Event (2019). When a player interacts with the Christmas Star Flying Disc, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Flying Disc Umbrella (formerly known as the Frisbee Umbrella) is a limited common toy in Adopt Me!.
wiki.notes: It could have been obtained by opening a Small or Big Gift, which cost 70 and 199, respectively. As the Flying Disc Umbrella is no longer part of the gifts, it is now only obtainable through trading. The Flying Disc Umbrella features a pink frisbee-shaped top with a beige handle that has a round bottom. True to its name, it resembles an umbrella in its shape. It behaves like a balloon, where its only function is to allow a player to jump higher.

wiki.availability: The Frog is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 29, 2020, along with the Aussie Egg. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by trading or by hatching any remaining Aussie Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 15% chance of hatching an ultra-rare pet from the Aussie Egg, but only a 7.5% chance of hatching a Frog. The Frog features green skin, two beady black eyes, four green feet, and a pastel yellow underbelly. When the Frog moves, it produces a hopping animation. Listed below are the tricks the Frog learns in order: The Neon Frog glows bright neon yellow on its underbelly. The Mega Neon Frog glows in the same areas as the Neon Frog, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Frog in a Pitcher Leash is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It can be opened from Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. It can otherwise be obtained through opening Admin Abuse Boxes or trading.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, a pink line will connect the Frog in a Pitcher Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The Frog Sticker is an uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Premium Sticker Pack for 50; players have a 35% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Frog Sticker features a cartoon Frog.

wiki.availability: The Froggy Hat is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 4, 2021. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 250 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Froggy Hat, features a green bonnet with two large eyes; it resembles a frog. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Froggy Stroller is a limited rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on September 1, 2022. It was obtainable from the second page of the Star Rewards, requiring 180 Stars to unlock. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on September 11, 2026 when the Star Rewards were revamped.
wiki.notes: The Froggy Stroller features a green handle that connects to two axles and four wheels with white centers. It has a small green seat with lighter green insides; this seat is based on the design of a frog, complete with eyes and a mouth. The seat has a dark green cushion. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Frogspawn is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 2, 2023, as part of the Meme Pets Update. It could be purchased at the update's stand near the Playground for 600. It left the game on February 9, 2023, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Frogspawn features a semi-transparent cluster of light blue frogspawns and has two black beady eyes. There is a slightly transparent layer around the cluster of frogspawns. Each Frogspawn has a light-colored outside with a round blue inside. Here are the tricks the Frogspawn learns in order: The Neon Frogspawn glows green on its outer semi-transparent layer. The Mega Neon Frogspawn glows in the same area as the Neon Frogspawn, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Frost Dragon is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 20, 2019. Players could purchase it in the event shop for 1,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Frost Dragon resembles the Shadow Dragon in appearance. It has the same mesh but with slight differences: retextured icy blue scales, pastel-blue neon eyes, bright light-blue smoke particle effects coming out of its mouth, two horns shaped like those of a ram, and spikes protruding from its back. It has sharp teeth and a forked tongue. Unlike the Shadow Dragon, the Frost Dragon does not have an exposed ribcage. It has more spikes on its back than the Shadow Dragon. The wings are unchanged aside from the color. It also has a different head shape compared to the Shadow Dragon. Here are the tricks the Frost Dragon learns in order: The Neon Frost Dragon glows light blue on its wings, spikes, eyes, horns, feet, teeth, and tongue. The Mega Neon Frost Dragon glows in the same areas as the Neon Frost Dragon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Frost Phoenix is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 19, 2025, alongside week three of the Winter Event (2025). Players could have purchased it for 500. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 9, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Frost Phoenix learns in order: The Neon Frost Phoenix glows light blue on the roots of its head feathers and on the tips of its wing feathers, while its beak and feet glow a darker blue. The Mega Neon Frost Phoenix glows in the same areas as the Neon Frost Phoenix, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Frost Unicorn is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 23, 2023. It could have been obtained by purchasing it from a stand outside the Nursery or on the Shop GUI for 1,000. It left the game one week later on March 2, 2023, and can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Frost Unicorn features a light blue body, head, outer ears, and part of its feet. Its mane, horn, tail, part of its feet, and inner ears are light cyan. It has two light, cyan-colored beady eyes. Its horn emits snowflake particles. Here are the tricks the Frost Unicorn learns in order: The Neon Frost Unicorn glows purple on its mane, horn stripes, eyes, tail, part of its feet, and outer ears. The Mega Neon Frost Unicorn glows in the same areas as the Neon Frost Unicorn, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Frostbite Bear is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 21, 2025, alongside the Ice Dimension Event (2025). It is obtainable through placing an Ice Soup Bait or any remaining Shiver Cone Baits or Subzero Popsicle Baits into a Box Lure or Cozy Home Lure, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 0.01% chance of obtaining a Frostbite Bear from the Ice Soup Bait, Shiver Cone Bait, or Subzero Popsicle Bait. Here are the tricks the Frostbite Bear learns in order: The Neon Frostbite Bear glows light blue on its forehead and underbelly, while its eyes glow dark blue. The Mega Neon Frostbite Bear glows in the same areas as the Neon Frostbite Bear, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Frostbite Bear Sticker is a limited uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on March 21, 2025. It is obtainable through placing an Ice Soup Bait into a Box Lure or Cozy Home Lure, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 6.1% chance of obtaining a sticker from the Ice Soup Bait, but only a 1.5% chance of getting a Frostbite Bear Sticker. The Frostbite Bear Sticker features a cartoon Frostbite Bear.

name: Frostbite Bear and Cub Animated Sticker

wiki.availability: The Frostbite Bear and Cub Animated Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on March 21, 2025. It is obtainable through placing an Ice Soup Bait into a Box Lure or Cozy Home Lure, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 6.1% chance of obtaining a sticker from the Ice Soup Bait, but only a 0.1% chance of getting a Frostbite Bear and Cub Animated Sticker. The Frostbite Bear and Cub Animated Sticker features an animated cartoon Frostbite Bear and Frostbite Cub.
wiki.sourceTitle: Frostbite Bear and Cub Animated Sticker

wiki.availability: The Frostbite Cub is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 3, 2025, alongside the fifth week of the Winter Festival (2024). Players could have purchased it for 70,000 until January 17, 2025. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Frostbite Cub learns in order: The Neon Frostbite Cub glows light blue on its entire body, excluding its eyes, inner ears, and nose. The Mega Neon Frostbite Cub glows in the same areas as the Neon Frostbite Cub, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Frostbite Grapple is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020. It was obtainable from the first page of the Star Rewards, requiring 230 Stars to unlock. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on September 11, 2026 when the Star Rewards were revamped.
wiki.notes: The Frostbite Grapple features a light blue grappling hook with darker blue and neon details. The hook on the end has eight icicle-like spikes on it. By clicking on their screen, a player will be pulled in the location that they clicked. Players cannot use this item if they are in a vehicle, riding a pet, doing an obby, or sitting down, like most grapples.

wiki.availability: The Frostclaw Animated Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on January 3, 2025, alongside the fifth week of the Winter Festival (2024). It can now only be obtained through trading or unboxing any remaining Winter 2024 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000 until January 17, 2025.
wiki.notes: Players have a 0.05% chance of getting a Frostclaw Animated Sticker from the Winter 2024 Sticker Pack. The Frostclaw Animated Sticker features an animated cartoon Frostclaw.

wiki.availability: The Frostclaw Plush is a limited legendary toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 7, 2023, as part of the second week of the Winter Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Winter Village for 9,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Frostclaw Plush resembles Frostclaw, but with simpler features, including non-glowing eyes, a missing mouth, a shorter body with two buttons, and arms connected to its body. Being a plush, the player will only hug the Frostclaw Plush when interacted with.

wiki.availability: The Frosty Glow Mega Neon Paint is a limited legendary toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 12, 2025, alongside the week two of the Winter Event (2025). Players could have purchased it for 49. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 9, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Frosty Glow Mega Neon Paint can be used in the Salon to temporarily change the Mega Neon color cycle of a pet, applying a cycle consisting of cyan and white. It can be used an unlimited number of times.

wiki.availability: The Frozen Balloon is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 21, 2025. It is obtainable through placing an Ice Soup Bait into a Box Lure or Cozy Home Lure, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 0.8% chance of obtaining a Frozen Balloon from the Ice Soup Bait. The Frozen Balloon features a light blue balloon surrounded by darker blue ice that is jagged near the bottom. The balloon is connected to a black string. The Frozen Balloon allows a player to jump higher when equipped. As of February 5, 2026, it is currently bugged. By zooming in, jumping, and walking backwards, players can travel faster than normal.

wiki.availability: The Frozen Crown is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 21, 2025. It is obtainable through placing an Ice Soup Bait into a Box Lure or Cozy Home Lure, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 0.8% chance of obtaining a Frozen Crown from the Ice Soup Bait.

wiki.availability: The Frozen Penguin is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 21, 2025. It is obtainable through placing an Ice Soup Bait into a Box Lure or Cozy Home Lure, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 1.49% chance of obtaining an ultra-rare pet from the Ice Soup Bait, but only a 0.5% chance of obtaining a Frozen Penguin. The Frozen Penguin features a mostly dark blue body with a light blue underbelly, a black beak covered in light blue frost, glowing light blue eyes, and two black feet. Light blue icicles cover its back, head, and flippers. Here are the tricks the Frozen Penguin learns in order: The Neon Frozen Penguin glows light blue on its feet, eyes, and the frost on its beak, while its underbelly and the icicles covering its body glow a darker blue. The Mega Neon Frozen Penguin glows in the same areas as the Neon Frozen Penguin, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Futuristic Grapple is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on September 11, 2026 when the Star Rewards were revamped.

To interact with this item, a player can click/press anywhere on their screen to be pulled towards the location that was clicked on. wiki.availability: The Ghost Dog is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on October 12, 2023, as a part of the second week of the Halloween Event (2023). During the event, the Ghost Dog could have been found in the Asylum shop and purchased 34,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Ghost Dog features a white head with two floppy ears, a black snout, two black, beady eyes, and a white tail connected to a draping body. It has similar features to the Dog. These are the tricks the Ghost Dog learns in order: The Neon Ghost Dog glows orange on its ears, nose, and tail. The Mega Neon Ghost Dog glows in the same areas as the Neon Ghost Dog, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ghost Dog Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2025, alongside the second week of the Halloween Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Halloween 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Ghost Dog Sticker features a cartoon Ghost Dog.

wiki.availability: The Ghost Finder Rattle is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 11, 2024, as part of the second week of the Halloween Event (2024). Players could have purchased it for 10 or 3,700. It can now only be obtained through trading, as the event has ended.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with the Ghost Finder Rattle equipped, they will shake it back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Ghost Hat is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released along with the Halloween Event (2022) on October 6, 2022. Players could obtain the Ghost Hat by purchasing it for 1,500. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Ghost Hat features a round white hat with two large black eyes, a black mouth, pink dots of blush, and two arms. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Ghost Kitty Backpack is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released along with the Halloween Event (2022) on October 6, 2022. Players could obtain the Ghost Kitty Backpack by purchasing it for 4,320. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Ghost Kitty Backpack features a white backpack with a handle near the top. It is in the shape of a cat, having ears with pink insides, black whiskers, and a face. There are several bumps near the bottom. This pet accessory goes on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Ghost Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 25, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Halloween Event (2024). As the event has ended and the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon has closed, it can only be obtained through opening any remaining Halloween 2024 Sticker Packs or trading.
wiki.notes: The Ghost Sticker features a cartoon Ghost.

wiki.availability: The Ghost Vehicle is a limited ultra-rare single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released along with the Halloween Event (2018). It could have been purchased in the Halloween shop for 8,000. As the event has ended, the Ghost Vehicle can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Ghost Vehicle features a white, slightly transparent ghost with two arms sticking out of its body, as well as two bent ears. It has two large black eyes on its face and a small black mouth. The Ghost Vehicle reflects the design of the Ghost Puppy, an item that players could receive by redeeming a code from a Roblox gift card in October 2016. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Ghost Wolf is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 20, 2022. There is an 87.5% chance of obtaining this pet from a Wolf Box, which players were able to purchase for 14,000 inside the Halloween Shop of the Halloween Event (2022). As the event has ended, the Ghost Wolf is now only obtainable through trading or by opening any remaining Wolf Boxes.
wiki.notes: The Ghost Wolf features a white body, ears, and face with light teal ear insides and nose. It has two black eyes and bits of fur sticking out of the sides of its face. These are the tricks the Ghost Wolf learns in order: The Neon Ghost Wolf glows orange-yellow on the underside of its tail, inside of its ears, underbelly, and underside of its snout. The Mega Neon Ghost Wolf glows in the same areas as the Neon Ghost Wolf, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ghostly Cat is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 24, 2025, alongside the fourth week of the Halloween Event (2025). Players could have purchased it for 70,000 or hatched it from a Basic Egg or Crystal Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on November 7, 2025.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Ghostly Cat learns in order: The Neon Ghostly Cat glows white on the sheet covering its body. The Mega Neon Ghostly Cat glows in the same area as the Neon Ghostly Cat, except that area cycles through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ghostly Opera Glasses are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on October 3, 2025, alongside the Halloween Event (2025). Players could have purchased them for 1,900. They are now only obtainable through trading, as they left the game on November 7, 2025.

The Giant Anteater is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 3, 2023, along with the Jungle Zone. Players were able to purchase this pet in the Jungle Zone for 100. As the Jungle Zone has now left the game, it can only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Giant Anteater features a brown, beige, and gray striped body, a brown head with a long snout, small ears, brown back feet and white front feet, a brown fluffy tail, and a pink tongue sticking out. Parts of its head and snout are light brown. Here are the tricks the Giant Anteater learns in order: The Neon Giant Anteater glows beige on its face, stripes, feet, and under its tail. The Mega Neon Giant Anteater glows in the same areas as the Neon Giant Anteater, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Giant Black Scarab is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 20, 2022, along with the Desert Weather Map Update. It can be obtained through purchasing and using a Mud Ball in the Desert Shop for 169, or trading. It can only be tamed when the Desert Weather is active.
wiki.notes: There is a 60% chance of obtaining the Giant Black Scarab from a Mud Ball. The Giant Black Scarab is a black scarab beetle with a black body. It has a dark gray head, a pair of black antennae, six feet, and beady, black eyes. Listed below are the tricks the Giant Black Scarab learns in order: The Neon Giant Black Scarab glows gray on its wings and on part of its head; it glows white in between its wings and on its antennae. The Mega Neon Giant Black Scarab glows in the same areas as the Neon Giant Black Scarab, except those areas cycle through the colors white, neon white, gray, and black.

wiki.availability: The Giant Blue Scarab is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 20, 2022, along with the Desert Weather Map Update. It can be obtained through purchasing and using a Mud Ball in the Desert Shop for 169, or trading. It can only be tamed when the Desert Weather is active.
wiki.notes: There is a 37.5% chance of obtaining a Giant Blue Scarab from the Mud Ball. The Giant Blue Scarab is a scarab beetle with a black body. It has two black antennae with golden tips, six legs, and a pair of beady black eyes. Underneath its blue elytra are golden flight wings. It also has metallic blue wing casings and a metallic blue head. The Giant Blue Scarab's body remains metallic blue when under the sun. When at night and indoors, its color changes and its body becomes a non-metallic dark blue color. Listed below are the tricks the Giant Blue Scarab learns in order: The Neon Giant Blue Scarab glows blue on its head and wing casings. Its antennae glow yellow and the gap between the wing casings glow white. The Mega Neon Giant Blue Scarab glows in the same areas as the Neon Giant Blue Scarab, except those areas cycle through the colors pink, lavender, blue, violet, and indigo.

wiki.availability: The Giant Cheetah Mount is a limited legendary single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on July 20, 2023. It was obtainable by purchasing it at the Safari Zone next to the Accessory Shop or in the Shop menu for 900. Since the Safari Zone left the game on August 3, 2023, the Giant Cheetah Mount is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Giant Cheetah Mount features a cheetah with an orange body with a white underbelly, an orange tail, orange feet, a white chin, brown nose, and orange ears with white insides. Dark brown spots cover the body. The cheetah also has a saddle on. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Giant Gold Scarab is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 20, 2022, along with the Desert Weather Map Update. It can be obtained through purchasing and using a Mud Ball in the Desert Shop for 169, or trading. It can only be tamed when the Desert Weather is active.
wiki.notes: Players have a 2.5% chance of obtaining a Giant Gold Scarab from the Mud Ball. The Giant Gold Scarab is a scarab beetle with a brown body, a golden head, and wings. It has two brown antennae with golden tips, six legs, and a pair of beady black eyes. Listed below are the tricks the Giant Gold Scarab learns in order: The Neon Giant Gold Scarab glows gold on its back and orange on its antennae and in between its wings. The Mega Neon Giant Gold Scarab glows in the same areas as the Neon Giant Gold Scarab, except those areas cycle through the colors yellow, orange, and red.

wiki.availability: The Giant Panda is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 12, 2025. It was obtainable from the Basic Egg and Crystal Egg from September 12, 2025 to February 27, 2026, when it was replaced by the Silverback Gorilla. It was also purchasable for 2,000,000 from February 20, 2026 to March 6, 2026. The Giant Panda can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: There was a 0.01% chance of hatching the Giant Panda from the Basic Egg, and a 0.1% chance of hatching it from the Crystal Egg. Here are the tricks the Giant Panda learns in order: The Neon Giant Panda glows purple on a patch around its neck and on its back, as well as on its ears, feet, and eye spots. The Mega Neon Giant Panda glows in the same areas as the Neon Giant Panda, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Giant Snowball is a limited ultra-rare single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on December 1, 2022, as a part of the Winter Event (2022). It could have been found in the Candy Castle and cost 60,000. As its event has passed, it can now only be obtained by trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Giant Snowball features a large white sphere in the shape of a snowball. It leaves a small white cloud trail behind it when in use. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Gibbon is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on May 16, 2025, alongside the Gibbon Fairground. Players were able to purchase it for 300. It can now only be obtained through trading, as the event ended on May 30, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Gibbon could have been traded in along with 3 of the same ingredients obtained from Standard Gibbon Boxes and Premium Gibbon Boxes to create an Officer Gibbon, Firefighter Gibbon, Hero Gibbon, or Villain Gibbon. Here are the tricks the Gibbon learns in order: The Neon Gibbon glows orange on its hands, feet, and underbelly. The Mega Neon Gibbon glows in the same areas as the Neon Gibbon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Gift Sack Pogo is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 13, 2024, alongside week 2 of the Winter Festival (2024). Players could have purchased it for 7,800. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 17, 2025.
wiki.notes: It serves no other purpose aside from being a fun pogo stick to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Gift Stack Pogo Stick is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me!. It could be bought during the Winter Holiday (2021) for 17,500. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading. It serves no use other than being a fun pogo to jump around on.
wiki.notes: The Gift Stack Pogo Stick features a pogo that resembles a red and green gift stack with decorative ribbons. It is topped with a yellow handle in the shape of a bow. It serves no other purpose aside from being a fun pogo stick to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Gift Throw Toy is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 1, 2019. It was obtainable by claiming it from the 2019 Advent Calendar on day one. Since its day has passed, the Gift Throw Toy is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Gift Throw Toy features a purple gift wrapped with a golden ribbon. It looks very similar to the Massive Gift, but smaller. When a player interacts with the Gift Throw Toy, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Giggle Puff Balloon is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: As it is a balloon, its only function is to allow a player to jump higher.

wiki.availability: The Gila Monster is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 25, 2024. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Desert Eggs, Royal Desert Eggs, or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 25% chance of hatching an uncommon from the Desert Egg, but only a 12.5% chance of hatching the Gila Monster. The Gila Monster features a dark brown and beige marble-like body, with two beady black eyes, a striped tail, and four dark brown feet feet. Here are the tricks the Gila Monster learns in order: The Neon Gila Monster glows yellow on the gold markings on its body. The Mega Neon Gila Monster glows in the same areas as the Neon Gila Monster, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Gilded Snake is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 24, 2025, alongside the Lunar New Year (2025). Players could have purchased it for 325. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on February 14, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Gilded Snake features a black body with tan, diamond-shaped detailing, a tan underbelly, tan and black horns, and tan spots around its glowing yellow eyes. Here are the tricks the Gilded Snake learns in order: The Neon Gilded Snake glows orange on its body detailing, underbelly, horns, and the spots around its eyes. The Mega Neon Gilded Snake glows in the same areas as the Neon Gilded Snake, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ginger Cat is an ultra-rare pet added to Adopt Me! on March 20, 2020, as a part of the Star Rewards Update. It can be obtained through hatching Gemstone Eggs, Basic Eggs, Crystal Eggs, or Admin Abuse Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Ginger Cat was formerly obtainable from the first page of the Star Rewards until September 11, 2026, requiring 210 Stars to unlock. The Ginger Cat, as true to its name, features a bright orange tabby cat topped with light brown stripes on both its head and back. It is quite plump in shape, with a lighter orange belly. It has beady black eyes, a small pink nose, triangular orange ears, orange paws, and black whiskers. Listed below are the tricks the Ginger Cat learns in order: The Neon version of a Ginger Cat has its inner ears, nose, whiskers, paws, stripes, and tip of the tail glowing a very light yellow with a hint of orange. The Mega Neon Ginger Cat glows in the same areas as the Neon Ginger Cat, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ginger Cat Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Premium Sticker Pack for 50; players have a 30% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Ginger Cat Sticker features a cartoon Ginger Cat.

wiki.addedEvent: It could have been claimed from the 2022 Advent Calendar during the Winter Event (2022)
wiki.availability: The Gingerbread Balloon is a limited common toy in Adopt Me!. It could have been claimed from the 2022 Advent Calendar during the Winter Event (2022) on day twenty-two. As its Advent Calendar day has passed, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Gingerbread Balloon features a flat brown balloon with white lining near its edges. The balloon itself has a curl of white near the top, two dark brown eyes, a brown smile, a red nose, and two circular spots of pink. The handle of the balloon has red stripes near the top. Like all other balloons in the game, its only function is letting a player jump higher.

wiki.availability: The Gingerbread Bear Balloon is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on December 22, 2022, as a part of the Winter Event (2022).
wiki.notes: It could have been found in the Candy Castle and cost 750. As its event has passed, the Gingerbread Bear Balloon can only be obtained by trading with other players. The Gingerbread Bear Balloon features a dark brown string topped with a flat brown balloon; this balloon resembles a bear, featuring brown ears, dark brown eyes, pink blush, and a light brown muzzle with a darker color nose. There is white icing around the top of the balloon and colored sprinkles. Like all other balloons in the game, its only function is letting a player jump higher.

wiki.availability: Gingerbread is a currency in Adopt Me! that is used to purchase items in the Christmas Event (2019), Winter Holiday (2020), Winter Holiday (2021), Winter Event (2022), Winter Festival (2023), Winter Festival (2024), and Winter Event (2025).
wiki.notes: In this event, Gingerbread could be earned by ice skating, reindeer training, or decorating the Christmas Tree. In this event, Gingerbread could be earned by ice skating, by playing the Frost Fury Feeding Frenzy minigame, by building snowmen, or by opening gifts. In this event, Gingerbread could be earned by playing the Present Shuffle minigame, ice skating, and playing the Pet Rescue minigame. In this event, Gingerbread could be earned by ice skating, or by playing the Snowball Fight minigame, the Frost Bridge minigame, or the Reindeer Race minigame. In this event, Gingerbread could be earned by ice skating or playing the Pet Rescue, Cocoa Chaos, Santa's Workshop and Frostclaw's Fury minigames. In this event, Gingerbread could be earned by ice skating, exchanging 700 for 9,000 with Billy once every real-life day, or playing the Melt Off, Frostclaw's Revenge, and Code A.D.O.P.T. minigames. In this event, Gingerbread could be earned by ice skating, riding the train, completing event-exclusive ailments, exchanging 550 for 5,000 with Billy up to three times every real-life day, and playing the Bah Humbug, Sleighball, and Starry Bounce minigames.

wiki.availability: The Gingerbread Face Flying Disc is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 1, 2021, as part of the Winter Holiday (2021). It was obtainable from the 2021 Advent Calendar on day one. Since its day has passed, this toy is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Gingerbread Face Flying Disc features a red-bordered disc with a brown center; this center is decorated with a red-and-white bow, a thin white curl, a large white smile, and two beady black eyes. There are white stitches around the brown center. When a player interacts with the Gingerbread Face Flying Disc, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Gingerbread Hare is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 14, 2023, as part of the third week of the Winter Festival (2023). It could have been obtained for 20,000 from a Hare Box in the Winter Village. As the event has ended, it is now only obtainable through trading or by opening any remaining Hare Boxes.
wiki.notes: Players have a 10% chance of getting a Gingerbread Hare from a Hare Box. The Gingerbread Hare features a brown body with decorative white icing on the tip of its tail, the top of its feet, the inside of the ears, on its head, and around its neck. It has two beady black eyes, whiskers, eyebrows, a round red nose, and two red cheeks. On its neck and head, the icing has some multicolored sprinkles on it. Listed below are the tricks the Gingerbread Hare learns in order: The Neon Gingerbread Hare glows orange on its nose, whiskers, feet, inner ears, cheeks, and the icing surrounding its neck and forehead. The Mega Neon Gingerbread Hare glows in the same areas as the Neon Gingerbread Hare, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Gingerbread Hare Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on January 3, 2025, alongside the fifth week of the Winter Festival (2024). It can now only be obtained through trading or unboxing any remaining Winter 2024 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000 until January 17, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Gingerbread Hare Sticker features a cartoon Gingerbread Hare.

wiki.availability: The Gingerbread Heart Flying Disc is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me!. It could be bought during the Winter Holiday (2021) for 11,500. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Gingerbread Heart Flying Disc features a heart-shaped gingerbread cookie decorated with white icing. When interacted with, the Gingerbread Heart Flying Disc is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Gingerbread Holly Flying Disc is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 21, 2022, during the Winter Event (2022). It could have been claimed from the 2022 Advent Calendar on day twenty-one. As its Advent Calendar day has passed, it is now only available through trading.
wiki.notes: The Gingerbread Holly Flying Disc features a flat brown disc with white lining at its edges. It has three flat red holly berries depicted in its center. When a player interacts with the Gingerbread Holly Flying Disc, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Gingerbread House Throw Toy is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released as a part of the Winter Holiday (2021) event. Players could claim this toy from the 2021 Advent Calendar on the twenty-second day. As this day has passed, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Gingerbread House Throw Toy features a brown gingerbread decorated with white frosting, candy canes, and peppermint. It has a green door and two windows, with a white frame. Above the door there is a red wreath with a green bow. When a player interacts the with the Gingerbread House Throw Toy, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Gingerbread Kitty Throw Toy is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was obtainable from the 2022 Advent Calendar on December 1, 2022, as a part of the Winter Event (2022). The Gingerbread Kitty Throw Toy can no longer be claimed since its day has passed, and is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Gingerbread Kitty Throw Toy, as true to its name, features a brown gingerbread cookie with white icing; it has small white pointed ears, black eyes, and whiskers to resemble a cat. When interacted with, the Gingerbread Kitty Throw Toy is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Gingerbread Leash is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! obtainable on December 7, 2022, as a part of the 2022 Advent Calendar. The Gingerbread Leash can no longer be claimed from the 2022 Advent Calendar and is now only obtainable by trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Gingerbread Leash features a dark brown gingerbread man complete with eyes, a red nose, mouth, ribbon on its face, and buttons. It has white arms and a white line on its neck, and is connected to a red handle at the side. It has a pink string when in use. When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, a pink line will connect the Gingerbread Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The Gingerbread Mouse is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 25, 2023, during the Winter Festival (2023). It was obtainable through opening the twenty-fifth door of the Advent Calendar. Since its day has passed, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Gingerbread Mouse features a brown body, brown head, four brown feet, big brown ears, a tail and a red nose. It has white freckles and white frosting decorating the edge of the ears and feet, below its head, and white dots around its body. Listed below are the tricks the Gingerbread Mouse learns in order: The Neon Gingerbread Mouse glows pink where the white icing is on its body and red on its nose. The Mega Neon Gingerbread Mouse glows in the same areas as the Neon Gingerbread Mouse, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Gingerbread Pogo Stick is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on December 22, 2022, as a part of the Winter Event (2022).
wiki.notes: It could have been found in the Candy Castle and cost 1,350. As its event has now passed, the Gingerbread Pogo Stick can now only be obtained by trading with other players. The Gingerbread Pogo Stick features a large brown gingerbread man with a curl of dark brown on its face, dark brown eyes, curved footrests, and white stripes near its arms and legs. The Gingerbread Pogo Stick serves no use other than being a fun pogostick to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Gingerbread Rattle is a limited common toy in Adopt Me!. It could have been obtained from the 2022 Advent Calendar on December 13, 2022, during the Winter Event (2022). As its day has passed, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Gingerbread Rattle features a red, white, and brown rod topped with a circular brown piece; this piece has two dark brown eyes and smile, a red nose, and two circles of pink. It is topped with a red bow. This rattle tends to serve no purpose other than just being an intractable item. To interact with this rattle, a player can click or press the screen to shake.

wiki.availability: The Gingerbread Reindeer is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 25, 2022, during the Winter Event (2022). It could have been obtained from the 2022 Advent Calendar on day twenty-five. As the Advent Calendar has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Gingerbread Reindeer features a brown body and head, a light brown underbelly, and dark brown feet, eyes, nose, and antlers. It has a red and green beaded neckpiece, small red and green spheres on its antlers, and white decorations on its ears and tail. Listed below are the tricks the Gingerbread Reindeer learns in order: The Neon Gingerbread Reindeer glows red and light green on its antler ornaments, white on its ear designs, and yellow-green and red on its neck. The Mega Neon Gingerbread Reindeer glows in the same areas as the Neon Gingerbread Reindeer, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Gingerbread Reindeer Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on December 23, 2025. It could have been claimed on day twenty three of the 2025 Advent Calendar, which was released as a part of the Winter Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through trading, as the day to claim it has passed.
wiki.notes: The Gingerbread Reindeer Sticker features a cartoon Gingerbread Reindeer.

wiki.availability: The Gingerbread Sleigh is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on December 22, 2022, alongside the fourth week of the Winter Event (2022). It could have been found in the Candy Castle and bought for 100,000. As the event has ended, it can now only obtained by trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Gingerbread Sleigh features brown sides with white swirl decorations, presumably to resemble icing. It has red and white striped edges and has a front and back seat. It is tied to two Gingerbread Reindeers with red harnesses on their bodies. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Gingerbread Star Eye Patch is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me!. It could have been obtained from the 2022 Advent Calendar on December 4, 2022, during the Winter Event (2022). As its day has passed, it is now only obtainable through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Gingerbread Star Eye Patch features a six-pointed star with white and brown edges and a stripe of brown along the middle. On the back, it has a brown bar with a white bottom. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's face, over their left eye.

wiki.availability: The Gingerbread Star Propeller is a limited legendary toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on December 22, 2022, as a part of the Winter Event (2022).
wiki.notes: It could have been found in the Candy Castle and cost 6,000. As its event has now passed, the Gingerbread Star Propeller can now only be obtained by trading with other players. The Gingerbread Star Propeller features a five-pointed brown star with white, red, and green decorations near its tips, two dark brown eyes, and a curved smile. To interact with this item, the player can click anywhere on their screen to be propelled upwards. To stop, a player must jump while the propeller is in use.

wiki.availability: The Glider is an ultra-rare gamepass toy in Adopt Me!. It could be obtained by purchasing the Glider Gamepass with Robux from the display to the left of the main square. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Players are able to walk around normally while holding the Glider. However, it is possible to get stuck as the Glider can still collide with walls and other objects while in this state. The Glider cannot be used while in vehicles or in Obbies, but it can be used while riding a pet. Players can also hold pets whilst flying. The Glider is very similar to the Propeller and it is known as being one of the only toys that have the ability to take flight and change directions during flight. The Glider is known to have the advantage of lateral movement. Despite being categorized as a toy, the Glider's use is similar to that of a vehicle, with an ability to be used as transportation. The Glider has unique controls, with clicking used to take flight and is controlled by camera movements instead of the usual controls. To use the Glider, the player would have to first equip it through the ‘Toys’ section of their inventory. After equipping it, the player would then click on the equipped item to take flight. The player can move their camera around to change the direction they glide. To stop gliding, the player can press the jump button at any time during the flight.
