wiki.notes: The Golden Clam can only be purchased and used in the Snowy Igloo Shop to tame a Golden Albatross when the Snow Weather is active. Players have a 37.5% chance of obtaining a Golden Albatross from the Golden Clam. The Golden Albatross features two large wings on either side of its shiny pale gold body. It has a blue, wing-shaped liner around the edge of its beady black eyes, along with a yellow and dark blue-colored beak. It also has metallic blue feathers on its wings and tail. Listed below are the tricks the Golden Albatross learns in order: The Neon Golden Albatross glows pink on the blue part of its wings, ends of its tail feathers, and the tiny blue markings in the corner of its eyes. The Mega Neon Golden Albatross glows in the same areas as the Neon Golden Albatross, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Golden Bone is a legendary food item in Adopt Me! that was released in the VIP room refresh on July 28, 2022. Players are able to use this item to obtain a Black Chow-Chow, Tan Chow-Chow, Chocolate Chow-Chow, or a Golden Chow-Chow. Players can obtain the Golden Bone by purchasing the VIP Gamepass for 640. Once players own VIP, they can purchase Golden Bones in the VIP room inside of the Nursery for 209. The Golden Bone can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: From August 1, 2024 to August 30, 2024, players were able to receive a Golden Bone as a part of the Pets Plus monthly subscription, which cost US$2.99. The Golden Bone features a golden-colored bone that resembles a dog treat. Below are all of the pets that can be tamed using a Golden Bone.

wiki.availability: The Golden Chow-Chow is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released in the VIP room refresh on July 28, 2022. It can be obtained through buying a Golden Bone for 209 or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 2.5% chance of obtaining a Golden Chow-Chow from the Golden Bone. The Golden Chow-Chow's head and tail are dark yellow, with the tail having a lighter yellow tip. It has two ears with a lighter yellow color inside, two black eyes, a dark yellow nose on top of its dark yellow muzzle, and a blue tongue sticking out. Its body is yellow and circular-shaped, with a light yellow front and underbelly. It has four yellow colored feet. Listed below are the tricks the Golden Chow-Chow learns in order: The Neon Golden Chow-Chow glows bright green around its muzzle, the fur around its body, the insides of its ears, and the back of its tail. The Mega Neon Golden Chow-Chow glows in the same areas as the Neon Golden Chow-Chow, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Golden Circlet is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 9, 2023. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.8% and 0.7% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on May 10, 2024, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Golden Circlet features a gold circlet with a green gem in the center. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Golden Clam is a limited legendary food in Adopt Me! that was released on May 12, 2022, as part of the Snow Weather Update. It can be purchased for 169 when its respective weather is on rotation, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Upon throwing a Golden Clam, players can either tame an Albatross, Golden Albatross, or Diamond Albatross. The Golden Clam can only be used to tame a pet in the Snowy Igloo Shop, when it is on rotation. Below are all the pets that can be tamed using the Golden Clam.

wiki.availability: The Golden Corn is a legendary food item in Adopt Me! that was released on March 14, 2024. Players are able to purchase it in the Pet Shop for 199 or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Golden Corn will allow players to tame one of three Hamster pets: the Hamster, the Golden Hamster, and the Diamond Hamster. The Golden Corn, true to its name, features a yellow cob of corn with large green leaves connected to the base of the plant. Below are all of the pets that can be tamed using the Golden Corn.

wiki.availability: The Golden Dandelion is a legendary food in Adopt Me! that was released on May 1, 2026, as a part of the Salon Revamp Update. Players can purchase it in the Salon for 195 or obtain it through trading.
wiki.notes: Players can use the Golden Dandelion in the Salon to obtain a Peachick, Peahen, or Moonbeam Peacock. Below are all of the pets that are obtainable from the Golden Dandelion.

wiki.availability: The Golden Dragon is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020, along with the Star Rewards update. It can be obtained through hatching a Gemstone Egg, Basic Egg, Crystal Egg, Admin Abuse Egg, any remaining Golden Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 33.3% chance of hatching a Golden Dragon from a Golden Egg. The Golden Dragon is a reskin of the Dragon. During the day, it has a metallic golden body and a sky blue underbelly. It also has sky blue horns and inner wings. At night, the gold areas become non-metallic, and the sky blue is replaced with black. Here are the tricks the Golden Dragon learns in order: The Neon Golden Dragon glows pale blue on its horns, wing membranes, and underbelly. The Mega Neon Golden Dragon glows in the same areas as the Neon Golden Dragon, except those areas cycle through the colors of indigo, white, and yellow.

wiki.availability: The Golden Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020, as part of the Star Rewards update. It could be obtained from the first page of the Star Rewards after reaching 660 Stars. After claiming the Golden Egg, their Stars reset and players could earn rewards from the second page of the Star Rewards. After reaching 660 Stars and claiming the Diamond Egg, players could work towards earning the Golden Egg again.
wiki.notes: The Golden Egg can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on September 11, 2026 when the Star Rewards were revamped. The Golden Egg is an oval shaped, golden egg. At night, its color turns to a dark yellow.

wiki.availability: The Golden Gift is a legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was obtainable during the Christmas Event (2019) along with its counterpart, the Christmas Gift. It was available from December 14, 2019, to January 11, 2020. It cost 4,300. A Christmas Egg, toy or a vehicle could be obtained from it. As the Christmas Event (2019) has passed, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Golden Gift features a tall glossy golden yellow box with purple ribbons around it, and a purple bow on the top of it.

wiki.availability: The Golden Goblet is a limited legendary toy in Adopt Me! that was released along with the Gorilla Fairground event on March 16, 2023. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through opening any remaining Premium Gorilla Boxes, or through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 5% chance of obtaining the Golden Goblet from a Premium Gorilla Box. When a player combined three Golden Goblets and a Gorilla during the event, their Gorilla would be transformed into an Emperor Gorilla. Players were able to do this by talking to the Emperor Gorilla (NPC) in the Gorilla Fairground. True to its name, the Golden Goblet features a gold-colored goblet. It emits a sparkle effect. The Golden Goblet behaves as a throw toy. When a player clicks their screen with the Golden Goblet equipped, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Golden Goldfish is a legendary food item in Adopt Me! that was released on August 24, 2019. It can be purchased for 195 (formerly 225) or obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: When using a Golden Goldfish in the Ice Cream Shop, players can obtain a Choco Penguin, Vanilla Penguin, or Strawberry Penguin. Below are all of the pets that are or were obtainable from the Golden Goldfish:

wiki.availability: The Golden Griffin is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020, along with the Star Rewards update. It can be obtained through hatching a Gemstone Egg, Basic Egg, Crystal Egg, Admin Abuse Egg, any remaining Golden Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 33.3% chance of hatching a Golden Griffin from the Golden Egg. The Golden Griffin is a recolor of the Griffin. During the day, it has a gold, metallic body with light blue talons. Half of its wings is light blue while the other half is gold. During the night, the gold parts become a darker gold and non-metallic while the blue parts become black. Here are the tricks the Golden Griffin learns in order: The Neon Golden Griffin glows blue on its eyebrows, wings, and beak. The Mega Neon Golden Griffin glows in the same areas as the Neon Golden Griffin, except those areas cycle through the colors indigo, white, and yellow.

wiki.availability: The Golden Hair is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 0.4% and 0.1% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Golden Hair was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Golden Hair features a golden-yellow wig with multiple ridges throughout. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Golden Hamster is a legendary pet that was released in Adopt Me! on March 14, 2024. Players have of 10% chance of obtaining it through a Golden Corn which costs 199. Otherwise, it can be obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Golden Hamster features a yellow head and body, a round tail, a white underbelly, and yellow feet. It has two ears, with white inner ears, a white chin, two black eyes, whiskers, a yellow nose, and a tuft on its head. The Golden Hamster shares a similar appearance to the Hamster and Diamond Hamster. Listed below are the tricks the Golden Hamster learns in order: The Neon Golden Hamster glows yellow on its feet, tail, nose, whiskers, and the insides of its ears. The Mega Neon Golden Hamster glows in the same areas as the Neon Golden Hamster, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Golden Headset is a limited rare pet accessory that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 750 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Golden Headset features a golden and bronze pair of headphones with a bronze/golden microphone attached to the side. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Golden Hummingbird is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 30, 2024. It is now only obtainable through using any remaining Golden Petunias, which were obtainable through purchasing the Pets Plus subscription for 299, or trading, as it was replaced by the Guinea Pigs from the Golden Lettuce on April 3, 2026.
wiki.notes: Players have a 10% chance of obtaining a Golden Hummingbird from the Golden Petunia. Here are the tricks the Golden Hummingbird learns in order: The Neon Golden Hummingbird glows yellow-orange on its beak, feet, the edges of its wings, and parts of its face and upper chest. The Mega Neon Golden Hummingbird glows in the same areas as the Neon Golden Hummingbird, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Golden Jaguar is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on November 1, 2024, alongside the first week of the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024). Players could obtain the Golden Jaguar for 8 Stamps, earning one stamp each day by playing for 45 minutes.
wiki.notes: Once a player earned all 8 Stamps, they could purchase extra Golden Jaguars for 2,000 each. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading. Here are the tricks the Golden Jaguar learns in order: The Neon Golden Jaguar glows orange on its body markings, nose, and inner ears. The Mega Neon Golden Jaguar glows in the same areas as the Neon Golden Jaguar, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Golden King Penguin is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 14, 2022. It could have been obtained through buying a Golden Goldfish for 195 (formerly 225). It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on November 7, 2025.
wiki.notes: There was a 10% chance of obtaining a Golden King Penguin from the Golden Goldfish. The Golden King Penguin features a plump yellow body with a white underbelly, yellow feet, and a tuft of fur on its head. It has black eyes and a yellow beak. Listed below are the tricks the Golden King Penguin learns in order: The Neon Golden King Penguin glows bright yellow on the lower area of its head as well as its feet. The Mega Neon Golden King Penguin glows in the same areas as the Neon Golden King Penguin, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Golden Ladybug is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was added on February 18, 2021, along with the Farm Shop. Players can obtain it by using any remaining Diamond Lavenders, which cost 169 (formerly 199), or trading. The Diamond Lavender and Ladybugs left the game on January 9, 2026, being replaced by the Golden Seed Ball and the Owls obtainable from it.
wiki.notes: There is a 10% chance of taming a Golden Ladybug from a Diamond Lavender. The Golden Ladybug features a yellow round body, wings with golden spots on them, and a round head. It also has two golden antennae, white wings, six feet, and large black beady eyes. Here are the tricks the Golden Ladybug learns in order: The Neon Golden Ladybug glows a golden color on its spots, antennae, wing outlines, and feet. The Mega Neon Golden Ladybug glows in the same areas as the Neon Golden Ladybug, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Golden Leaf is a limited legendary food item in Adopt Me! that was released on August 4, 2022. Players were able to purchase it for 199 in the Butterfly Sanctuary, however, now that the Butterfly Sanctuary has been removed from the game, the Golden Leaf can only be obtained by trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Golden Leaf is used to obtain one of three different butterfly pets. When using the Golden Leaf, players have a 60% chance of obtaining an Orange Butterfly (Ultra-Rare), a 37.5% chance of obtaining a Green Butterfly (Legendary), and a 2.5% chance of obtaining a Diamond Butterfly (Legendary). The Golden Leaf features a yellow-gold leaf and stem with lighter yellow lines on the inside. In order to tame a butterfly, a player must firstly equip the Golden Leaf from their inventory. After doing so, a player may click anywhere on their screen to open the Golden Leaf, then once it is opened, a player will receive either an Orange Butterfly, a Green Butterfly, or a Diamond Butterfly.

wiki.availability: The Golden Lettuce is a legendary food in Adopt Me! that was released on April 3, 2026, replacing the Golden Petunia. Players receive one every month as a part of the Pets Plus monthly subscription, which costs 299. Players who were already subscribed to Pets Plus received a Golden Lettuce on the day of its release, without needing to wait for their subscription to renew. The Golden Lettuce is otherwise obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: Players can use the Golden Lettuce to obtain a Chocolate Dutch Guinea Pig, Red Dutch Guinea Pig, or Tortoiseshell Guinea Pig. Below are all of the pets that are obtainable from the Golden Lettuce.

wiki.availability: The Golden Maned Unicorn Rattle is an ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was added on June 24, 2021, along with updates to the Baby Shop. It can be found in the Baby Shop and costs 615. It can otherwise be obtained by trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Golden Maned Unicorn Rattle is a golden rattle topped with a pink unicorn. This unicorn has a golden mane, black eyes, and a long white horn on its forehead. Its head shape of the unicorn is similar to that of the Unicorn pet. To interact with this item, a player can click their screen to shake it back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Golden Mistletoe is a limited legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was released on December 20, 2024, alongside the third week of the Winter Festival (2024). Players could have purchased it for 199 until January 17, 2025. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Players can use it to obtain an ultra-rare Merry Mistletroll, a legendary Naughty Mistletroll, or a legendary Royal Mistletroll.

wiki.availability: The Golden Penguin is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 24, 2019. Players could tame it with a Golden Goldfish, which cost 225 at the time. It was replaced by the King Penguins on July 14, 2022, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: There was a 10% chance of obtaining a Golden Penguin from the Golden Goldfish. The Golden Penguin is a reskin of the Penguin. The only difference between the two is that the Golden Penguin has a vibrant yellow body and flippers instead of black. Here are the tricks the Golden Penguin learns in order: The Neon Golden Penguin glows bright yellow on its back and arms. The Mega Neon Golden Penguin glows in the same areas as the Neon Golden Penguin, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Golden Petunia is a limited legendary food in Adopt Me! that was released on August 30, 2024. Players received one every month as a part of the Pets Plus monthly subscription, which costs 299. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it was replaced by the Golden Lettuce on April 3, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Golden Petunia can be used to obtain a Hummingbird, Golden Hummingbird, or a Diamond Hummingbird. Below are all of the pets that can be tamed using a Golden Petunia.

wiki.availability: The Golden Plantain is a limited legendary food item in Adopt Me! that was released on February 9, 2023, along with the Rain Weather Update. It can be purchased for 169 when its respective weather is on rotation, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Upon throwing a Golden Plantain, players can tame a Green Amazon, White Amazon, or Diamond Amazon. The Golden Plantain can only be used to tame a pet in the Rain Pet Shop, when it is on rotation. Below are all of the pets that can be tamed using the Golden Plantain.

wiki.availability: The Golden Rat is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released as part of the Lunar New Year (2020) event. As its respective event has left the game, it is now only obtainable through trading or by opening any remaining Rat Boxes.
wiki.notes: Players have a 6.67% chance of obtaining the Golden Rat from a Rat Box. The Golden Rat has an oval-shaped body covered with white fur, white oval-shaped ears that are golden inside, and a small round shaped golden nose. It also has beady black eyes and a thin golden tail. The Golden Rat is a reskin of the Rat. Here are the tricks the Golden Rat learns in order: The Neon Golden Rat glows bright yellow on its inner ears, nose, tail, and paws. The Mega Neon Golden Rat glows in the same areas as the Neon Golden Rat, except those areas cycle through the colors of magenta, white, red, and pink.

wiki.availability: The Golden Rings Flying Disc is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 12, 2025, alongside week two of the Winter Event (2025). Players could have purchased it for 1,750. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 9, 2026.
wiki.notes: When interacted with, the player throws the Golden Rings Flying Disc, and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Golden Scale Pogo Stick is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: It serves no other purpose aside from being a fun pogo stick to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Golden Seed Ball is a legendary food item in Adopt Me! that was released into the Green Groceries on January 9, 2026, replacing the Diamond Lavender. Players can purchase it for 195 or obtain it through trading.
wiki.notes: When using a Golden Seed Ball in the Green Groceries, players can obtain a Clementine Owl, Apple Owl, Peach Owl, or Pineapple Owl. Below are all of the pets that are obtainable from the Golden Seed Ball:

wiki.availability: The Golden Tortoise Beetle is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on May 24, 2024, alongside the Garden Egg. It could have been obtained by trading a Neon Garden Snake to Moss or 6 Moles to Ross in the Vault. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Golden Tortoise Beetle features a golden-shelled beetle with numerous darker golden spots on the outer-shell. It has two light yellow antennae, six yellow legs, and two beady black eyes. These are the tricks the Golden Tortoise Beetle learns in order: The Neon Golden Tortoise Beetle glows yellow on its head and inner shell. The Mega Neon Golden Tortoise Beetle glows in the same areas as the Neon Golden Tortoise Beetle, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Golden Unicorn is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020, along with the Star Rewards update. It can be obtained through hatching a Gemstone Egg, Basic Egg, Crystal Egg, Admin Abuse Egg, any remaining Golden Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 33.3% chance of hatching a Golden Unicorn from the Golden Egg. The Golden Unicorn is a metallic reskin of the Unicorn. During the day, it has a golden body, a light blue horn, mane, and tail, and golden ears. At night, it becomes non-metallic, where the blue is replaced with black and the gold replaced with a deep shade of yellow. Here are the tricks the Golden Unicorn learns in order: The Neon Golden Unicorn glows blue on its horn, mane, and tail. The Mega Neon Golden Unicorn glows in the same areas as the Neon Golden Unicorn, except those areas cycle through the colors indigo, white, and yellow.

wiki.availability: The Golden Walrus is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 1, 2021, as part of the Winter Holiday (2021). As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading or by opening any remaining Walrus Boxes at a 4% chance.
wiki.notes: When a player unboxes a Golden Walrus, they will also receive a Golden Walrus Crown. The Golden Walrus is a recolor of the Walrus, but with a golden body. Also, it appears to be holding a scepter with its right front flipper, which is part of the pet and is not removable. These are the tricks the Golden Walrus learns in order: Like other Walruses, the Neon Golden Walrus glows blue on its tusks, whiskers, and freckles. The Mega Neon Golden Walrus glows in the same areas as the Neon Golden Walrus, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.egg: Received from obtaining a Golden Walrus from a Walrus Box.
wiki.availability: The Golden Walrus Crown is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me!. Once a player obtains a Golden Walrus from a Walrus Box, the Golden Walrus Crown will automatically be added to the player's inventory. It can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Despite the Golden Walrus Crown coming with the Golden Walrus, players are able to place it on any pet. The Golden Walrus Crown features a golden crown with an interior of red plush. It has purple gems encrusted on its outside, white fur lining on its bottom, and a small paw print model on its top. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Golden Wheat is a limited legendary food in Adopt Me! that was released on August 11, 2022, along with the Fall Weather Update. It can be purchased in the Fall Shop for 169 when its respective weather is on rotation, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Upon throwing a Golden Wheat, players can tame a Brown-Chested Pheasant, Green-Chested Pheasant, or Black-Chested Pheasant. The Golden Wheat can only be used to tame a pet in the Fall Shop, when it is on rotation. The Golden Wheat features a thin yellow stalk with thicker yellow leaves at the top. Below are all of the pets that can be tamed using the Golden Wheat.

wiki.availability: The Goldenrod Flower is a limited legendary food in Adopt Me! that was released as a part of the return of the Butterfly Sanctuary on June 6, 2025. Players could have purchased it for 199. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on June 20, 2025.
wiki.notes: When using a Goldenrod Flower, players are able to obtain a Vermilion Butterfly, Violet Butterfly, or Orchid Butterfly. Below are all of the pets that are obtainable from the Goldenrod Flower.

wiki.availability: The Goldfish is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 9, 2023.
wiki.notes: Players were able to purchase this pet for 1,400 in the revamped Pool Shop. As it was removed from the Pool Shop on March 9, 2024, it can now only be obtained through trading. The Goldfish features a round orange fish with large black eyes, dorsal fins along its back, a tail, and small flippers near the front. Here are the tricks the Goldfish learns in order: The Neon Goldfish glows blue on its front flippers, dorsal fins, and tail. The Mega Neon Goldfish glows in the same areas as the Neon Goldfish, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Goldhorn is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 19, 2021, along with the Mythic Egg. As it has left the game, it can now only be obtained through trading or by hatching any remaining Mythic Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 5% chance of hatching a legendary from the Mythic Egg, but only a 2.5% chance of hatching a Goldhorn. The Goldhorn has a cream-colored body with multiple small pink flowers on its mane, tail, as well as on its chest fur. It has a pair of large beady black eyes, a pink nose, white ears, a white tail, and golden hooves. It also has a long golden pair of horns on its head with two golden halos in between the horns, a relatively larger one and a smaller one. Here are the tricks the Goldhorn learns in order: The Neon Goldhorn glows bright yellow on its horns, halos, and hooves. The Mega Neon Goldhorn glows in the same areas as the Neon Goldhorn, except those areas cycles through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Goldhorn Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on August 1, 2024. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Pets Plus Sticker Packs, which were received when purchasing the Pets Plus subscription for 299, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Goldhorn Sticker features a cartoon Goldhorn.

wiki.availability: The Goofy Potion is a common potion in Adopt Me! that was released on May 15, 2026. Players can earn it as a reward for aging up their pets, or obtain it through trading.
wiki.notes: From May 15, 2026 to May 22, 2026, the Goofy Potion was not available as a reward for aging up pets, and could instead be brewed in Tim's cauldron using 1 Is That a Mustache? and 2 Definitely Not a Fork! ingredients. The Goofy Potion can be fed to a pet to change its facial expression for 10 minutes. The time left until the effect wears off will only go down while the pet the Goofy Potion was fed to is equipped.

wiki.availability: The Googly Eye Conker Plush is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70 or 199 from Small or Big Gifts. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: The Googly Eye Conker Plush serves no purpose other than just being a cosmetic and interactable item. To hug this toy, the player can click on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Googly Eye Glasses are a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that were released on April 28, 2022, as part of the first Accessory Chest rotation.
wiki.notes: It could have been be obtained through unboxing the Regal Chest or the Standard Chest; players have a 20% and 60% chance of getting a common item from these boxes, respectively, although only a 2% and 6% chance of getting Googly Eye Glasses. These boxes can be found in the Accessory Shop. On September 29, 2022, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Googly Eye Glasses were removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained by trading with other players. The Googly Eye Glasses feature a pair of red-framed glasses. It has hexagonal googly eyes as its lenses; these eyes have black irises and protrude from the frames. This pet accessory goes on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Goose is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 30, 2023, as part of the second week of the Spring Festival (2023).
wiki.notes: It could have been obtained by purchasing it in the Springfest Shop or through the shop menu for 150. Since the event ended on April 20, 2023, the Goose is now only obtainable through trading. The Goose features a white body with a long neck and two white wings. It has two orange feet, two beady black eyes, and an orange beak. Here are the tricks the Goose learns in order: The Neon Goose glows blue on its beak, wings, and feet. The Mega Neon Goose glows in the same areas as the Neon Goose, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Goose Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2026, alongside the second week of the Sugar Festival Event (2026). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Sugarfest 2026 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Goose Sticker features a cartoon Goose.

wiki.availability: The Gorilla is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on March 16, 2023, as a part of the Gorilla Fairground.
wiki.notes: It is obtainable through the regular Standard Gorilla Box at a 100% chance for 600, or through the Premium Gorilla Box at a 90% chance for 195. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through opening any remaining Standard Gorilla Boxes and Premium Gorilla Boxes, or through trading with others. The Gorilla has black fur all over its body and a tan face, ears, underbelly, and feet. Here are the tricks the Gorilla learns in order: The Neon Gorilla glows orange on its face, ears, feet, and underbelly. The Mega Neon Gorilla glows in the same areas as the Neon Gorilla, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Goth Shoes are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on March 4, 2021. They could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 750 when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Goth Shoes feature black shoes with high platforms, a pair of white socks, and black buckles. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's feet.

wiki.availability: The Goth Spike Boots are limited ultra-rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They are obtainable through purchasing and opening the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. They are otherwise obtainable through opening Admin Abuse Boxes, purchasing them for 4,500 when they are on rotation in the Accessory Shop, or trading.

wiki.availability: The Honey Bee Collar is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on November 22, 2024, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Honey Bee Collar features two golden necklaces on top of each other. At each end of the necklace, there are two light-blue wings with black veins, totaling four wings on the pet accessory. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's neck.

wiki.addedEvent: The Honey Candy was previously obtainable from the Candy Cliffs during the Sugar Festival Event (2026)
wiki.availability: Honey Candy is a common food item in Adopt Me! that can be obtained through collecting the candy shot out from a BEES! Blaster. It can otherwise be obtained through trading. The Honey Candy was previously obtainable from the Candy Cliffs during the Sugar Festival Event (2026).
wiki.notes: When the BEES! Blaster shoots out Honey Candy, the player's equipped pet will go up to the Honey Candy and eat it. To get Honey Candy in their inventory, players must collect it before their equipped pet eats it. This task is easier to do without a pet equipped. A maximum of five Honey Candies can be held in a player's inventory when picking them up from the BEES! Blaster. The Honey Candy features an orange inner shell with yellow stripes. Its appearance is similar to the Bee Hive. This item can be used to fulfill a baby or pet's 'hungry' ailment. It takes one use to fully consume. When eaten by a player, the Honey Candy boosts their walk speed.

wiki.availability: The Honey Dipper Rattle is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 23, 2023, along with the Spring Festival (2023). It could have been obtained by purchasing it in the Springfest Shop for 5,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Honey Dipper Rattle features a gold colored honey dipper with clear honey dripping down. To interact with this rattle, a player can click or press the screen to shake.

wiki.availability: The Honey Jar is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022, as part of the first Accessory Chest rotation.
wiki.notes: It could have been be obtained through unboxing the Regal Chest or the Standard Chest; players have a 20% and 60% chance of getting a common item from these boxes, respectively, although only a 2% and 6% chance of getting a Honey Jar. These boxes can be found in the Accessory Shop. On September 29, 2022, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Honey Jar was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained by trading with other players. The Honey Jar features an orange honey jar with a salmon colored rim that spills out golden-yellow honey onto the pet. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Hook Earrings are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on July 18, 2025, alongside week three of the Summer Festival (2025). Players could have purchased them for 800. They can now only be obtained through trading.

The Hook Hand Grappling Hook is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on July 4, 2025, alongside the Summer Festival (2025). Players could have purchased it for 2,200. It can now only be obtained through trading.

wiki.availability: The Hook Hand Grappling Hook is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on July 4, 2025, alongside the Summer Festival (2025). Players could have purchased it for 2,200. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Players can click anywhere with the Hook Hand Grappling Hook equipped to be pulled in that direction.

wiki.availability: The Hoop Earrings are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 250 when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Hoop Earrings feature a pair of silver round earrings worn on each ear of the pet. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's ears or on the sides of its head.

wiki.availability: The Hopbop is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 7, 2025, alongside the Moon Egg. It can now only be obtained through hatching any remaining Moon Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 35% chance of hatching a Hopbop from the Moon Egg. The Hopbop features a flat beige snail with an orange shell with white polka dots. It has two beige anntennas sticking out of its head. Here are the tricks the Hopbop learns in order: The Neon Hopbop glows orange on its antennae and body spots. The Mega Neon Hopbop glows in the same areas as the Neon Hopbop, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Horse is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2019, along with the Pets update. Players could purchase it in the Pet Shop or on the Shop menu for 300. As the Horse left the game on January 6, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Horse features a chocolate brown body, feet, and head, with its head having two beady black eyes, two small ears with lavender-pink insides, and a fluffy black mane. It also has a fluffy black tail. Here are the tricks the Horse learns in order: The Neon Horse glows a bright, diamond-like blue on its mane, tail, hooves, and ears. The Mega Neon Horse glows in the same areas as the Neon Horse, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Horse Cycle is a limited legendary single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me!. It was previously available in gifts, which cost 70, 199, or 499 depending on the size of the gift. However, as the gift items were changed, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Horse Cycle is a brown vehicle that resembles the Horse pet. It has a horse face with black eyes, ears with pink insides, and a black mane at the front. There is also a black tail at the back of the vehicle. Additionally, there are two wheels and a curved section in the middle for the player to sit on. Its model is very similar to its Unicorn counterpart, the Unicorn Cycle. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Horse Plush is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that could have been obtained through opening Small and Big Gifts, which cost 70 and 199 respectively. As its Gifts rotation has passed, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Horse Plush resembles a Quarter Horse with two white ankles, two brown ankles, a white strip in the front of its face, and a white muzzle. To interact with the Horse Plush, players can click their screen with it equipped to hug it.

wiki.availability: The Horse And Carriage is a limited legendary three-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 31, 2022. Players could have purchased it for 549 in the Vehicle Dealership. As it has been removed from the game, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Horse And Carriage is a carriage pulled by two Horses; each horse is based on the model of the pet itself. The carriage section of this vehicle is mostly merlot red with yellow ascents for driver seat and carriage wheels. There is also brown-colored framing for the carriage itself. The inside of the carriage is the same merlot red as the outside. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Hot Air Balloon is a method of transport in Adopt Me! that takes players up to the Sky Castle. It costs 5 to sponsor. To purchase/sponsor a ride, players must interact with Captain Arg, the ship's NPC. It is an alternative form of transportation to flyable pets, grapple hooks, propellers, and gliders.
wiki.notes: The Hot Air Balloon features a large blue-and-white striped balloon; this balloon is tethered with six strings to a brown and beige cart. The cart features several brown benches. When the Hot Air Balloon is in its regular docking spot, it hovers slightly above the water. When the player sits down in the balloon, a message asks them to buy a trip for 5. After they make the purchase, notifications will be given in the chat when there are 60 to 30 seconds left to board and when the flight is about to take off. No further messages are shown in the chat after it takes off. As the Hot Air Balloon flies, a message can be read at the front of the balloon, reading, "" and then "" (XXX being the name of the player who paid 5). When it reaches the Sky Castle, the message reads, "". When 15 seconds pass, the Hot Air Balloon flies back down to where Captain Arg stands; on its way back, it bears a message reading, "". After it reaches its regular spot, it reads "" until its next use.

wiki.availability: The Hot Cocoa is a limited common food item in Adopt Me! that was released on December 14, 2023, as part of the third week of the Winter Festival (2023). It is obtainable by purchasing it from another player's Hot Cocoa Stand for a price between 0 and 20 or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Hot Cocoa can be used to fulfill the 'Thirst' ailment for babies and pets, taking three uses to fully consume. The Hot Cocoa features a red mug that has large white snowflake designs and white edges. In the mug is brown liquid with whipped cream, marshmallows, and a brown flake on top.

wiki.availability: The Hot Cocoa Hat is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on December 22, 2023, as part of the Winter Festival (2023). It was obtainable by claiming it from the event's Advent Calendar on day twenty-two. Since its day has passed, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Hot Cocoa Hat features a white saucer, holding a green cup and handle, with a red lip and base. The center of the cup has a white heart, and the inside contains hot chocolate, a candy cane, marshmallows, and a smiling gingerbread. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Hot Cocoa Stand is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 14, 2023, as part of the third week of the Winter Festival (2023). It could have been obtained by purchasing it for 80. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: When the Hot Cocoa Stand is selected from the player's inventory, it will appear transparent and float in front of the player until it is placed with the left mouse button, or through tapping the screen. It cannot be placed on a slope or object. Once placed, the player can either set a price for the stand or take it down and put it back in their inventory. The Hot Cocoa Stand gives the player the ability to sell Hot Cocoas at a price ranging from 0 to 20. If the price is set to 0, only one Hot Cocoa obtained from the stand can be held in the player's inventory at a time.

wiki.availability: The Hot Cocoa Stroller is a limited rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on December 12, 2023, as part of the Winter Festival (2023). It was obtainable by claiming it from the event's Advent Calendar on day twelve. Since its day has passed, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Hot Cocoa Stroller features a red cup on a white plate with beige frosting around the tip of the cup. Inside the cup, there is chocolate liquid and a large cube marshmallow in the center. It also has peppermint patterned handles and wheels, as well as a Christmas holly at the bottom of the cup. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Hot Doggo is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2023, along with the Summer Festival (2023). It was available for purchase in the shop for 600. As its event has passed, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Hot Doggo features a brown dog wrapped in a beige hot dog bun for its outer body, with green lettuce near the front of the bun. It has multiple condiments along its back as well as some on the tip of its head. It has two black eyes, a black nose, four brown feet, and a pink tongue sticking out. These are the tricks the Hot Doggo learns in order: The Neon Hot Doggo glows orange on its bun, the condiments on top of its head and the items located on its back. The Mega Neon Hot Doggo glows in the same areas as the Neon Hot Doggo, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Hot Doggo Sticker is an ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on July 5, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Summer State Fair (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained by opening any remaining State Fair Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Hot Doggo Sticker features a cartoon Hot Doggo.

wiki.availability: The Hot Rod Sleigh is a limited ultra-rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on December 20, 2024. wiki.notes: This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Hot Tub Muscle Car is a limited legendary six-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on November 3, 2022. It could have been purchased from a stand near the Hot Air Balloon for 200. As the Hot Tub Muscle Car left the game on November 17, 2022, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Hot Tub Muscle car features a red 60s-style car with the front having a long light-gray grille, a light-gray bumper with a black license plate with a paw-print emblem, four circular headlights, and a hood with two black stripes. wiki.availability: The Hotdog is a common food item in Adopt Me! that can be purchased for 2 in the Green Groceries or from the Hotdog Stand for anywhere between 0 and 50. It can otherwise be obtained through trading. The Hotdog was also purchasable in the Farm Shop for 2 before its removal.

This item can be used to fulfill the 'hungry' ailment on pets and babies. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. It takes two uses to fully consume.

wiki.availability: The Hotdog Stand, also known as the BBQ Stand, is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on September 7, 2019, as part of the Hotdog Stand Update. Players could purchase it for 85. On April 24, 2026, the Hotdog Stand was added to the Final Stop Shop and discounted to 50 before leaving the game on May 1, 2026. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Hotdog Stand features a wooden stand with gray poles on either side of it that hold up a banner reading "<Player>'s Hotdogs". Several furniture items such as the cash register, ketchup and mustard bottles, and loaf of decorative bread can be seen on the Hotdog Stand. A red grill also sits next to it. When the Hotdog Stand is selected from the player's inventory, it will appear transparent and float in front of the player until it is placed with the left mouse button, or through tapping the screen. wiki.availability: The Hourglass is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 9, 2023. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 4.5% and 2.7% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on May 10, 2024, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Hourglass features a translucent hourglass with yellow sand, a brown top and bottom, and small yellow string at the side. This pet accessory goes on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Hover Stroller is an ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on June 24, 2021, along with the Baby Shop remodel. It can be purchased from the Baby Shop for 1,150. It can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Hover Stroller features a futuristic-looking stroller with a white handle that has black tips. It has four white circles of varying sizes, all of which enclose a pattern of black and blue lights. The central platform has padding and is significantly larger than its other counterparts; its support has black grooves. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Hoverboard is a limited legendary single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released in 2019. It could have been obtained by opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, or 499, respectively. As the Hoverboard is no longer part of the gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Hoverboard is a futuristic-looking vehicle that has the ability to levitate off the ground with the help of two blue flames originating from two exhausts located on the bottom of the Hoverboard. It is reminiscent of a floating skateboard without wheels, however, it is slightly faster than any skateboard. The Hoverboard is mostly beige, with two pieces of black trim wrapped near the edges of the vehicle. In contrast, the bottom of the vehicle is mostly black, with two of what appear to be blue exhausts on either side, with flames always shooting through them. The middle also has a glowing blue line going through it, which has the same exact color as the two exhausts. The Hoverboard's blue flames light up at night in a manner similar to the Ice Queen Sleigh's lantern. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Hovercar is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 18, 2021. As the Hovercar is no longer part of the gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Hovercar is a large, futuristic-looking boat-like vehicle with a primarily white-colored body; it has a black secondary color surrounding its interior and bottom. It also has a spoiler, a windshield, a big lightbar with two additional, smaller taillights at the back, and two vintage headlights. Despite its size, the Hovercar only has two seats, with the steering wheel being on the left-hand side. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Hovercraft is a limited ultra-rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on September 1, 2022. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Huggable Pillow is a common toy that was added into Adopt Me! on March 18, 2021, as part of the new gifts rotation. To interact with the pillow, a player can click or press the screen to hug it.

wiki.availability: The Hugging Egg is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released in March 2018, as part of the Easter Event (2018). It could have been purchased for 5 Chocolate Eggs at a stand near the Baby Shop. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Hugging Egg features an off-white egg that has a crack near its top and large white eyes with black pupils. It shares the same mesh as a Roblox Accessory, the Scrambled Egg. To interact with this toy, a player can click or press their screen to hug it.

wiki.availability: The Human Bubble is a limited rare single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020. It was obtainable from the first page of the Star Rewards, requiring 140 Stars to unlock. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on September 11, 2026 when the Star Rewards were revamped.
wiki.notes: The Human Bubble is a transparent sphere with several lines around its exterior. The lines are probably to help distinguish whether the bubble is moving or stationary. The player can be seen sitting in the Human Bubble, despite visually having no seats. The Human Bubble moves without any sort of apparent way of propulsion. The transparent bubble usually reflects the sky. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Human Feet Shoes are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. As it was removed from the game on November 22, 2024, it can only be obtained through trading.

wiki.availability: The Humbug is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 5, 2025, alongside the Winter Event (2025). Players could have found it in varying places around Adoption Island and purchased it for 11,000, or hatched it from a Basic Egg or Crystal Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 9, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Humbug learns in order: The Humbug resembles a bee, having a forest-green head with cheek fur tufts, a pale lime unibrow above its black eyes, angled as if it were angry and ragged black fur on the top of its head. Its antennae share the same color as its head, and have a large ball of fluff at the tips, ending with a small, curved spike. Its body and abdomen are striped black and green, and its feet are colored the same pale lime from its unibrow and part of its antennae. The Neon Humbug glows a yellowish-green on its eyebrows, feet, and part of its antennae. The Mega Neon Humbug glows in the same areas as the Neon Humbug, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Humbug Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on December 12, 2025, alongside the second week of the Winter Event (2025). wiki.availability: The Humbug Stroller is a limited rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on December 26, 2025, alongside the fourth week of the Winter Event (2025). Players could have purchased it for 18,000. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 9, 2026.
wiki.notes: This item can transport one pet or baby at a time, and be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Hummingbird is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 30, 2024. Here are the tricks the Hummingbird learns in order: The Neon Hummingbird glows light green on its tail, feet, the edges of its wings, and parts of its face and upper chest. The Mega Neon Hummingbird glows in the same areas as the Neon Hummingbird, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Huntsman Robin is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 29, 2026, alongside the Fairytale Egg. Here are the tricks the Huntsman Robin learns in order: The Neon Huntsman Robin glows red on its hat feather, belt, scarf, bowstring, beak, feet, tail tip, eye spots, arrow fletchings, and on parts of its wings. The Mega Neon Huntsman Robin glows in the same areas as the Neon Huntsman Robin, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Husky is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 1, 2021, as part of the Winter Holiday (2021).

wiki.availability: The Hydra is a limited ultra-rare pet that was released in Adopt Me! along with the Mythic Egg on August 19, 2021. It can now only be obtained through trading or by opening any remaining Mythic Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 20% chance of hatching an ultra-rare from the Mythic Egg, but only a 10% chance of hatching the Hydra. The Hydra is a three-headed serpent that has a blue body, beige underbelly, dark-blue gray paws, and black beady eyes. It also has beige and blue frills on top of its head, all the way down to its tail. Here are the tricks the Hydra learns in order: The Neon Hydra glows a bright cyan blue on its fins/spikes, underbelly, and nostrils. The Mega Neon Hydra glows in the same areas as the Neon Hydra, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Hyena is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 5, 2019, along with the Safari Egg. As it is now unavailable, it is only obtainable by hatching any remaining Safari Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 37% chance of hatching a rare pet from the Safari Egg, but only an 18.5% chance of hatching a Hyena. The Hyena features a tan body with dark brown spots on its back. Its muzzle, paws, mane, tail and inner ears are dark brown, with the nose being slightly darker than the muzzle. There is a gap between the nose and the muzzle, with two beady black eyes above. Here are the tricks the Hyena learns in order: The Neon Hyena glows yellow on its spots, mane, tail, nose, paws, and inner ears. The Mega Neon Hyena glows in the same areas as the Neon Hyena, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Hyperspeed Potion is a common food item in Adopt Me!. It is obtainable by purchasing it in the Sky Castle for 40, purchasing it from the Star Rewards for 1, brewing it in a house using a Speed Cauldron furniture item (which costs 650 and can produce 1 potion per minute), as a reward for aging up pets, or through trading. Five were also given to players for free during the Admin Abuse on July 25, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Hyperspeed Potion is stored in a clear, triangular-shaped bottle with a curve in the middle. It has a black cap and players can visibly see the glowing pink liquid inside. By drinking this potion, the player's walk speed will slightly increase. The Hyperspeed Potion's effects can be stacked infinitely, further increasing the player's speed each time one is used. wiki.availability: The Ice Club Rattle is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 14, 2019, along with the Christmas Event (2019). wiki.egg: Ice Cream Shop or Ice Cream Cones
wiki.availability: The Ice Cream is a common food item in Adopt Me! that can be purchased from the Ice Cream Shop or another player's Ice Cream Cones for 1, or from another player's Ice Cream Truck for 0 to 20. The house owner can take it from the Ice Cream Cones furniture item for free once they have purchased it for 600. It can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: If a player takes the Ice Cream from the Ice Cream Cones for free or purchases an Ice Cream from the Ice Cream Truck, it will be untradable and disappear from their inventory when they leave the game. Ice Creams purchased from the Ice Cream Shop or another player's Ice Cream Cones save and are tradable. When purchased from the Ice Cream Shop or Ice Cream Cones, the Ice Cream starts off as a cone that can have ice cream scoops and toppings added to it. If purchased from the Ice Cream Truck, it will consist of a cone with a scoop of White Ice Cream. With an Ice Cream, players can add up to three scoops onto it. The different available scoops in the Ice Cream Shop include White Ice Cream, Pink Ice Cream, Brown Ice Cream, and Green Ice Cream. There were also Red Ice Cream, Purple Ice Cream, and Blue Ice Cream scoops that were eventually removed from the game. Any scoop color can be added with the Ice Cream Scoop Bowl furniture item. Players can also add sauces and toppings to their Ice Cream once at least one scoop of ice cream is added to it. The Ice Cream features a beige cone with a wide top. Any extensions that have been added will be inside of the cone. In a player's inventory, it holds a vanilla scoop and a strawberry scoop above it, with Chocolate Sauce and a Cherry Topping on top. Before November 16, 2023, the Ice Cream had a proper cone-shaped cone, and was a bit smaller. In a player's inventory, it held a Purple Ice Cream scoop, a White Ice Cream scoop and a Pink Ice Cream scoop on top. This item can be used to fulfill the 'hungry' ailment on pets and babies. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. It takes one to three uses to fully consume depending on how many scoops are present.

wiki.availability: The Ice Cream Cone Hat is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on July 21, 2022.
wiki.notes: This pet accessory was given to players who bought a Golden Goldfish from 3 p.m. on July 14, 2022, to 10 p.m. for free on July 16, 2022, because the board next to the Golden Goldfish in the Ice Cream Shop displayed the wrong chances of obtaining different types of King Penguins. Because of this, everyone who purchased a Golden Goldfish while the chances were incorrect received the Ice Cream Cone Hat. The Ice Cream Cone Hat is now unavailable, and can now only be obtained by trading with other players. The Ice Cream Cone Hat features a light brown ice cream cone with pink ice cream that fell onto the pet's head.

wiki.egg: Ice Cream Shop or Ice Cream Cups
wiki.availability: The Ice Cream Cup is a temporary common food in Adopt Me! that was released on February 28, 2025. It can be purchased from the Ice Cream Shop or another player's Ice Cream Cups for 1. The house owner can take it from the Ice Cream Cups furniture item for free once they have purchased it for 600. It can otherwise be obtained through trading. The Ice Cream Cups taken from the Ice Cream Cups furniture for free are untradable and disappear from the player's inventory when they leave the game.
wiki.notes: When purchased or taken, the Ice Cream Cup starts out as an empty cup. In the Ice Cream Shop, up to three scoops of White Ice Cream, Pink Ice Cream, Brown Ice Cream, or Green Ice Cream can be added to the Ice Cream Cup for free. Any scoop color can be added using the Ice Cream Scoop Bowl furniture item. Sauces and other toppings can be added once there is at least one scoop in the Ice Cream Cup. The Ice Cream Cup features a white cup with any scoops and toppings the player has added inside. In a player's inventory, it appears as a white cup with three scoops of Pink Ice Cream topped with a Chocolate Wafer and Cherry Topping. This item can be used to fulfill the 'Hunger' ailment on pets and babies, taking anywhere from one to three uses to fully consume depending on the amount of scoops present. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. At least one scoop of ice cream must be present before it can be consumed by babies, while pets can consume an empty Ice Cream Cup.

On the eyestalks, there are two beady black eyes. It has an ice cream shell made of a pale yellow scoop and a pink scoop. There is chocolate sauce and a cherry on the top scoop, and sprinkles spread throughout. Listed below are the tricks the Ice Cream Hermit Crab learns in order.
