wiki.availability: The Iced Cake Stroller is a limited rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on April 3, 2026, alongside the fourth week of the Sugar Festival Event (2026). Players could purchase it for 10,000. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
wiki.notes: This item can transport one pet or baby at a time, and be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Icey Aura is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me!. It appeared on the Adopt Me! website as early as 2023 and was listed as part of the Accessory Shop rotation, though there are no known reports of it ever appearing in the shop. Prior to its official release, Bethink reportedly gave one copy to a single player. The item was officially released on January 10, 2026. It can be obtained from the Admin Abuse Box with a 0.1% chance or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Icey Aura features a halo made up of twelve light blue sparks. This pet accessory goes on top of a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Icicle Pogo Stick is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me!. Players could claim this toy from the 2021 Advent Calendar on day thirteen. As its Advent Calendar day has passed, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Icicle Pogo Stick features a brown pogo stick resembling a tree trunk. It is topped with blue snow and has a spiral-like design on the bottom. The Icicle Pogo Stick, as true to its name, also has clear icicles dangling below its handlebars and footpegs. As it is a pogo stick, it provides transportation by bouncing instead of walking.

wiki.availability: The Ice Cube Throw Toy is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 21, 2025. It is obtainable through placing an Ice Soup Bait into a Box Lure or Cozy Home Lure, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 0.8% chance of obtaining an Ice Cube Throw Toy from the Ice Soup Bait. When interacted with, the player throws the Ice Cube Throw Toy and their equipped pet will chase after it and bring it back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Icing Bag Leash is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on August 22, 2025 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, a pink line will connect the Icing Bag Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The Icy Porcupine is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 21, 2025. It is obtainable through placing an Ice Soup Bait into a Box Lure or Cozy Home Lure, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 1.49% chance of obtaining an ultra-rare pet from the Ice Soup Bait, but only a 0.5% chance of obtaining an Icy Porcupine. Here are the tricks the Icy Porcupine learns in order: The Neon Icy Porcupine glows a light blue to dark blue gradient on its spines, while its feet and nose glow dark blue. The Mega Neon Icy Porcupine glows in the same areas as the Neon Icy Porcupine, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Icy Porcupine Sticker is a limited uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on March 21, 2025. It is obtainable through placing an Ice Soup Bait into a Box Lure or Cozy Home Lure, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 6.1% chance of obtaining a sticker from the Ice Soup Bait, but only a 1.5% chance of getting an Icy Porcupine Sticker. The Icy Porcupine Sticker features a cartoon Icy Porcupine.

wiki.availability: The Illusionary Throw Hat is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that released on April 5, 2024, as a part of the Capuchin Fairground event. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through opening any remaining Standard Capuchin Boxes or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Illusionary Throw Hat features a black and white checkered top hat with a red band above its black brim. When used, the player's equipped pet picks up the toy in its mouth and brings it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Imagination Box is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on March 25, 2021, as part of the new gifts rotation. It could be obtained from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts for 70, 199, or 499. It was removed from the gifts as part of the 2023 Refresh on April 20, 2023, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Imagination Box is a brown cardboard box, open on the top with two flaps protruding on either side. It has two large black, drawn-on circles that are meant to represent headlights and a flap on the back. It has a bumper, bearing a paw print design, attached with duct tape. A cardboard outline in the front acts as the windshield. The inside of the box features two seats made out of cardboard material, both of which are also attached with duct tape. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Indian Flying Fox is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 4, 2024, as part of the Halloween Event (2024). Players could have purchased it for 61,000 from the lab building or the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon. As the events have ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Indian Flying Fox features black fur with lighter beige patches on its belly and around its eyes. Its wings have black outlines and an orange wing membrane. It has a black head, large black ears with orange insides, two black eyes, a black nose, and two small white fangs. On its body, it also features a fluffy orange tail and orange fur around its neck. Here are the tricks the Indian Flying Fox learns in order: The Neon Indian Flying Fox glows a bright yellow on its nose, around its eyes, inner ears and wings, chest fluff, feet, and tail. The Mega Neon Indian Flying Fox glows in the same areas as the Neon Indian Flying Fox, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Indian Flying Fox Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 25, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Halloween Event (2024). As the event has ended and the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon has closed, it can only be obtained through opening any remaining Halloween 2024 Sticker Packs or trading.
wiki.notes: The Indian Flying Fox Sticker features a cartoon Indian Flying Fox.

wiki.availability: The Indian Leopard is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 24, 2023. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Urban Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 20% chance of hatching a rare pet from the Urban Egg, but only 10% chance of hatching an Indian Leopard. The Indian Leopard has orange fur with a white underbelly. Its ears are white on the inside, and it has two beady black eyes, thick black whiskers and a large pink nose. On the Indian Leopard's fur, there are gray colored spots and markings. Here are the tricks the Indian Leopard learns in order: The Neon Indian Leopard glows blue on its spots, eye markings, underbelly, and feet, The Mega Neon Indian Leopard glows in the same areas as the Neon Indian Leopard, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Inflatable Sword is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that could be obtained from an old gifts rotation. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, and 499 from the Small, Big, or Massive Gifts. However, as the gifts were updated to contain new items, it is no longer available and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Inflatable Sword features a metallic silver blade connected to a shiny golden handle. The handle has a dark red section between its gold parts. To interact with this rattle, a player can click or press the screen to shake.

wiki.availability: The Influencer Gibbon is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on May 16, 2025, alongside the Gibbon Fairground. It is now only obtainable through trading or opening any remaining Standard Gibbon Boxes or Premium Gibbon Boxes, as the event ended on May 30, 2025.
wiki.notes: When unboxed, the Influencer Gibbon comes with the Influencer Hair and Mobile Phone. Here are the tricks the Influencer Gibbon learns in order: The Neon Influencer Gibbon glows light pink on its skirt, the straps of its top, and hands. The Mega Neon Influencer Gibbon glows in the same areas as the Neon Influencer Gibbon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Influencer Hair is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 16, 2025, alongside the Gibbon Fairground. If a player unboxes an Influencer Gibbon from any remaining Standard Gibbon Boxes or Premium Gibbon Boxes, they will also receive the Mobile Phone and Influencer Hair. It can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Despite the Influencer Hair coming with the Influencer Gibbon, players are able to place it on any pet. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Inmate Cap is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 5, 2024, along with the Capuchin Fairground. Players could obtain it by crafting an Inmate Capuchin Monkey (combining a normal Capuchin Monkey and three Toy Handcuffs). As the event has ended, the Inmate Cap can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Despite the Inmate Cap coming with the Inmate Capuchin Monkey, players are able to place it on any pet. The Inmate Cap features a round, flat topped hat, with black and white stripes.

wiki.availability: The Inner Tube is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released as part of the 2019 Summer Update. It could have been found and purchased in the Pool Shop for 150. It was removed from the game on March 9, 2023, and was replaced by the Party Innertube. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: It is a donut-shaped tube and could be customized to whatever color the player chose upon purchase. However, once players chose a certain color, they could not change it afterwards. When interacted with, the Inner Tube is dropped on the ground. If a player moves close enough to it, they will be seated on it. This item floats on water. The Inner Tube can seat one player at a time.

wiki.availability: The Inspector Cape is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 16, 2026. Players could have purchased it for 400. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.

The Inspector Sherbet Bus is a limited legendary six-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2026, alongside the second week of the Sugar Festival Event (2026). Players could purchase it for 95,000. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
wiki.notes: This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Inspector Siren Collar is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 16, 2026. Players could have purchased it for 2,500. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.

The Instant Photo Necklace is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on January 30, 2026, it can only be obtained through trading.

The Intersex Flag is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 9, 2022. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand for 50; the Pride Stand could be found near the Playground and left the game on June 16, 2022. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Intersex Flag features an Intersex flag with a white handle; this handle has a small yellow knob on its tip. The flag features a violet circle on a yellow background. It has a pet accessory counterpart, the Intersex Pride Pin. To wave the flag, the player can click anywhere on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Intersex Flag 2023 is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 1, 2023. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand near the Playground for 50. It can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Intersex Flag 2023 features an Intersex Flag, the only difference being the rainbow string that is intertwined along the flagpole and a Pride Paw Flying Disc at the top of the pole. To wave the flag, a player can click anywhere on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Intersex Pride Pin is a common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 31, 2020. It could have been found in the Accessory Shop and taken for free. One pride pin could be taken by a player every hour. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Intersex Pride Pin features a heart-shaped gold pin and colors that represent the intersex flag. The flag features a violet circle centered on a yellow background. This pet accessory goes on the pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Intersex Pride Pin is a common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 31, 2020. It could have been found in the Accessory Shop and taken for free. One pride pin could be taken by a player every hour. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Intersex Pride Pin features a heart-shaped gold pin and colors that represent the intersex flag. The flag features a violet circle centered on a yellow background. This pet accessory goes on the pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Intersex Ringed Octopus Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on June 14, 2024, along with the Summer State Fair (2024).
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Pride Sticker Pack for 50. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Intersex Ringed Octopus Sticker features a cartoon Blue Ringed Octopus with violet rings throughout its six tentacles. It's reminiscent of the Intersex Flag colors.

wiki.availability: The Invisible Wings are limited rare wing pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on September 15, 2022. They could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Wing Chest for 600; players had a 7.3% chance of unboxing them. As their rotation has now passed, the Invisible Wings can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Invisible Wings removes a pet's default wings. When the Invisible Wings are placed on a pet, no visible wings show up. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back when the pet is flown. In a player's inventory, the Invisible Wings feature several black dots in the shape of two wings.

wiki.availability: The Irish Elk is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 1, 2022, as part of the Winter Event (2022). Players could have bought this pet for 35,000 during the Winter Event (2022). As its event has passed, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Irish Elk features a brown top coat and a fluffy white underbelly, large, yellow-beige antlers, four brown feet, white inner ears, and tufts of extra white fur, black eyes, and a small black nose. Listed below are the tricks the Irish Elk learns in order: The Neon Irish Elk glows light yellow on its underbelly, antlers, white tufts of fur, and tail. The Mega Neon Irish Elk glows in the same areas as the Neon Irish Elk, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Irish Setter is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 26, 2026, alongside week two of the Summer Camp Event (2026). From June 26, 2026 to July 20, 2026, players were required to give a Bone in a Bottle to the Irish Setter NPC before purchasing each Irish Setter pet for 16,000. When the Summer Wagon arrived on July 20, 2026, this requirement was removed. It was otherwise available through hatching a Basic Egg or Admin Abuse Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 24, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Irish Setter features a brown dog with fluffy, floppy ears and a medium-length fluffy tail, a dark brown nose, four brown feet, a light brown underbelly, two black eyes, and a pink tongue sticking out of its mouth. Here are the tricks the Irish Setter learns in order: The Neon Irish Setter glows yellow on its underbelly and feet. The Mega Neon Irish Setter glows in the same areas as the Neon Irish Setter, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Irish Water Spaniel is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was added on July 14, 2022. It could have been obtained through buying 5 UGC items in the Accessory Shop. The least expensive UGC items cost 59 and the most expensive UGC items cost 100. For all 5 UGC items necessary to unlock the Irish Water Spaniel, the price ranged from 295 to 500. It was replaced by the Glacier Moth on January 12, 2023, and can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Irish Water Spaniel features a chocolate-brown body with large brown ears and head fur. It has a small tail, a pink tongue sticking out of its mouth, two black eyes, and a black nose. Listed below are the tricks the Irish Water Spaniel learns in order: The Neon Irish Water Spaniel glows yellow on top of its head, on its two ears, and on its paws. The Mega Neon Irish Water Spaniel glows in the same areas as the Neon Irish Water Spaniel, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Iron Pickaxe Sticker is an uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Fossil Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Iron Pickaxe Sticker features a cartoon Iron Pickaxe.

wiki.availability: The Iron Pickaxe Sticker is an uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Fossil Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Iron Pickaxe Sticker features a cartoon Iron Pickaxe.

wiki.availability: The Island Tarsier is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 25, 2025, alongside the fourth week of the Summer Festival (2025). Players could have purchased it for 3,400. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Island Tarsier learns in order: The Neon Island Tarsier glows red on its ears, nose, hands, feet, and around its eyes. The Mega Neon Island Tarsier glows in the same areas as the Neon Island Tarsier, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Island Tarsier Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on July 25, 2025, alongside week four of the Summer Festival (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Summer 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Island Tarsier Sticker features a cartoon Island Tarsier.

wiki.availability: The Italy Scarf is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 12, 2024. Players could purchase it for 300 until July 19, 2024. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Italy Scarf features a scarf with green, white and red stripes as well as a white fringe. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Ivy Necklace is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 16, 2021. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 150. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Ivy Necklace features a necklace with a shape of green ivy vines. This pet accessory goes around a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Jack O'Bounce Pogo Stick is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 11, 2024, as part of the second week of the Halloween Event (2024). Players could have purchased it for 1,900 from the lab building or the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon. It was also purchasable for 5 during week two of the Halloween Event (2024). The Jack O'Bounce Pogo Stick can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: As it is a pogo stick, it provides transportation by bouncing instead of walking.

wiki.availability: The Jack-O-Lantern Light is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on October 5, 2023, as a part of the Halloween Event (2023).
wiki.notes: During the event, the Jack-O-Lantern Light was found in the Asylum shop for 950. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading. The Jack-O-Lantern Light features a brown branch. On its tip there is a black lamp and an orange pumpkin inside with two triangular eyes, a triangular nose, and a smiling mouth. The Jack-O-Lantern Light has no other usage besides emitting a slight glow.

wiki.availability: The Jack-O-Lantern Shades are a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on October 5, 2023, as a part of the Halloween Event (2023).
wiki.notes: Players could obtain the Jack-O-Lantern Shades by purchasing it for 950 in the Asylum shop. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading. The Jack-O-Lantern Shades are two orange jack-o-lanterns both with a pair of glowing yellow eyes and a black mouth, as well as a green stem. The two jack-o-lanterns are connected by an orange frame. This pet accessory goes on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Jackhammer is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that could be obtained around November 2018 in an old Gifts rotation. As the Gifts were updated with new items, this item is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Jackhammer, as true to its name, features a dark orange jackhammer with two pegs for the handle and two pegs for the feet to rest on. There is a dark gray drill at the bottom. When the Jackhammer is in use, a dusty smoke effect comes from the drill, like dust coming from a jackhammer. Despite its name, the Jackhammer behaves as a pogo stick. When equipped, the player bounces up and down.

wiki.availability: The Jade Moth Wings are limited ultra-rare pet accessories that could have been purchased at the Accessory Shop for 2,000. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they have left the game.
wiki.notes: The Jade Moth Wings feature a pair of moth wings, each one having a detailed pattern with jade green and lime green on the inside, and a black outline on the outside. These pet accessories are worn on a pet’s back.

wiki.availability: The Jailer's Keys are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They were obtainable through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As they were removed from the game on August 22, 2025, they can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Jailer's Keys feature three dark gray keys on a dark gray keyring, with one of the keys being in the shape of a skull with glowing light blue eyes. These pet accessories go on a pet's mouth.

wiki.availability: The Japan Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on September 8, 2022, replacing the Woodland Egg. It cost 750 and was available for purchase from the Gumball Machine in the Nursery. As it was replaced by the Southeast Asia Egg on March 2, 2023, the Japan Egg can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Japan Egg resembles the design of a lantern; it has a gray circular cap on its top and bottom, as well as a round yellow middle. Its middle is decorated with lines, which are meant to mimic lantern folds, and has small golden flowers. The Japan Egg also illuminates a bright yellow glow around it.

wiki.availability: The Japanese Snow Fairy is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 26, 2025, alongside week four of the Winter Event (2025). Players could have purchased it in the Disco Dome for 3,500 or hatched it from a Basic Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 9, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Japanese Snow Fairy learns in order: The Neon Japanese Snow Fairy glows light blue on its tail, feet, and wing tips. The Mega Neon Japanese Snow Fairy glows in the same areas as the Neon Japanese Snow Fairy, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: Jeff's Nametag is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased for 500 at the Accessory Shop. As it has left the game, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Jeff's Nametag features a small white name tag with strips of red on the edges, displaying the words 'Hello Me Jeff' in white and black lettering. This pet accessory goes on a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Jegi Throw Toy is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on February 8, 2024, as part of the Lunar New Year (2024) event. Players are able to obtain it by opening any remaining Special Lunar New Year Gift Boxes and Lunar New Year Gift Boxes or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Jegi Throw Toy features three blue, yellow, and red feathers connected to a red and blue disc shaped base. When used, the player's equipped pet picks up the toy in its mouth and brings it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Jekyll Hydra is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 25, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Halloween Event (2024). Players could have purchased the Jekyll Hydra for 1,000 from the lab building or the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Jekyll Hydra learns in order: The Neon Jekyll Hydra's blue form glows green on its spots, the raised parts on its back, and on its underbelly. The green form glows in the same areas, except they are yellow. The Mega Neon Jekyll Hydra glows in the same areas as the Neon Jekyll Hydra, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Jekyll Hydra Animated Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 25, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Halloween Event (2024). As the event has ended and the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon has closed, it can only be obtained through opening any remaining Halloween 2024 Sticker Packs or trading.
wiki.notes: The Jekyll Hydra Animated Sticker features an animated cartoon Jekyll Hydra.

wiki.availability: The Jelly Propeller is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with the Jelly Propeller equipped, they will be propelled upwards. To stop ascending, the player can unequip the item or jump.

wiki.availability: The Jellybean Grappling Hook is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: To interact with this item, a player can click anywhere on their screen to fire a hooked jelly bean cable that allows them to be pulled towards their target location. Like most other grappling hooks, players cannot use this item on non-solid graphical objects, if they are on a vehicle, doing an obby, flying or riding a pet.

wiki.availability: The Jellyfish is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 4, 2024. It could be obtained by purchasing 5 UGC items in the Accessory Shop. The least expensive UGC items cost 59 and the most expensive UGC items cost 100. For all 5 UGC items necessary to unlock the Jellyfish, the price could range from 295 to 500.
wiki.notes: The Jellyfish replaced the African Wild Dog at its release in the Accessory Shop. As it was replaced by the Honey Badger on September 27, 2024, it can only be obtained through trading. The Jellyfish features a light pink body with three wavy stingers protruding from below. It has a round, lighter pink bell with small tentacles, and two black eyes. Here are the tricks the Jellyfish learns in order: The Neon Jellyfish glows light pink on its body, stingers, and the spots on its bell. The Mega Neon Jellyfish glows in the same areas as the Neon Jellyfish, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Jellyfish Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on September 20, 2024, alongside the second week of the Ocean Event (2024).
wiki.notes: As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Ocean Sticker Packs or through trading. The Jellyfish Sticker features a cartoon Jellyfish.

wiki.availability: The Jester Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.2% and 0.3% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On September 29, 2022, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Jester Hat was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading.

wiki.availability: The Jetpack is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 1,750 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Jetpack is a gray jetpack with two jet engines that have black and yellow accents. It also features a yellow strap that holds up the engines together and a yellow-colored circle particle in the center. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Kangaroo Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.

It also has a small and pointy yellow stinger. Here are the tricks the King Bee learns in order: The Neon King Bee glows yellow on its stripes, antennae, wings, feet, and stinger. The Mega Neon King Bee glows in the same areas as the Neon King Bee, except those areas cycle through the colors of white, cyan, purple, magenta, and hot pink.

wiki.availability: The King Penguin is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 14, 2022. It could have been obtained through buying a Golden Goldfish for 195 (formerly 225). Listed below are the tricks the King Penguin learns in order: The Neon King Penguin glows blue on the lower area of its head as well as its feet. The Mega Neon King Penguin glows in the same areas as the Neon King Penguin, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Kitty Bat is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 3, 2025, alongside the Halloween Event (2025). During the event, players were able to obtain it through using 10 to 20 Yarn Apples. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on November 3, 2025.
wiki.notes: At the 17th and 47th minutes of every hour, Kitty Bats spawned in a taming area at the Playground for three minutes. When using a Yarn Apple to tame one, there was a skill check minigame. In the minigame there was a Yarn Apple sliding from left to right, and a Kitty Bat head in the middle. If the player managed to time their Yarn Apple throw accurately by landing on the head, they gained 10% taming progress. Missing the head resulted in them gaining 5% taming progress. Only one Yarn Apple could be used during each spawn period. Once the player reached 100% taming progress, they received a Kitty Bat. Here are the tricks the Kitty Bat learns in order: The Neon Kitty Bat glows orange on its wing membranes, inner ears, whiskers, nose, fangs, claws, back feet, and on the tip of its tail. wiki.availability: The Lavender Dragon Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on August 1, 2024. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Pets Plus Sticker Packs, which were received when purchasing the Pets Plus subscription for 299, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Lavender Dragon Sticker features a cartoon Lavender Dragon.

wiki.availability: The Lavender Scarf is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 250 while on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Lavender Scarf features a scarf colored in light purple, which is commonly known as the color lavender. This pet accessory goes around a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Lavender Teapot Carriage is a limited legendary four-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on April 13, 2023. It could be obtained through purchasing the Regal Carriages gamepass for 850. On April 24, 2026, the Regal Carriages were added to the Final Stop Shop and discounted to 595 before leaving the game on May 1, 2026. The Lavender Teapot Carriage can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Lazy Float is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released during the Summer Update in 2019. It could have been found and purchased in the Pool Shop for 75. It was removed from the game on March 9, 2023, and has been replaced with the Floatie Raft. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Lazy Float features a rectangular color-customizable flotation device. When interacted with, the Lazy Float is dropped on the ground. If a player moves close enough to it, they will be seated on it. This item floats on water. The Lazy Float can seat two players at a time.

wiki.availability: The Lead Zeppelin Balloon is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was added as part of the 2020 Gifts refresh. It could have been obtained from Small or Big Gifts, which cost 70 and 199 respectively. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Lead Zeppelin Balloon features a dark gray zeppelin with a string attached. The Lead Zeppelin Balloon allows a player to jump higher when equipped.

wiki.availability: The Leaf is a limited ultra-rare food item in Adopt Me! that was released on August 4, 2022, and was removed on August 18, 2022. It could be found in the Butterfly Sanctuary and players were able to purchase it for 899. It can be used to obtain a Yellow Butterfly (Rare), a Scarlet Butterfly (Ultra-Rare), or a Purple Butterfly (Ultra-Rare). There is a 60% chance of obtaining a Yellow Butterfly, a 37.5% chance of obtaining a Scarlet Butterfly, and a 2.5% chance of obtaining a Purple Butterfly.
wiki.notes: In order to tame a butterfly, the player must first equip the Leaf from their inventory. After doing so, the player may click anywhere on their screen to open the Leaf. After it is opened, the player will receive either a Yellow Butterfly, Scarlet Butterfly, or a Purple Butterfly. However, when the Butterfly Sanctuary was in game, the player would have to go to the Butterfly Sanctuary and equip the Leaf. Then, the Leaf must be clicked on. The Leaf would be thrown, and a butterfly would be tamed.

wiki.availability: The Leaf Hat is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 5% and 3% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On April 20, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Leaf Hat was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Leaf Hat features a giant green leaf, curved towards its middle. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Leaf Sprout Hat is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022, as part of the first Accessory Chest rotation.
wiki.notes: It could have been be obtained through unboxing the Regal Chest or the Standard Chest; players have a 20% and 60% chance of getting a common item from these boxes, respectively, although only a 2% and 6% chance of getting a Leaf Sprout Hat. These boxes can be found in the Accessory Shop. On September 29, 2022, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Leaf Sprout Hat was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained by trading with other players. The Leaf Sprout Hat features a green leaf sprout with two small leaves atop a stem. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Leaf Wings are limited ultra-rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on March 4, 2021. They could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 2,000 when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Leaf Wings feature brown twigs with yellow and green leaves forming into a set of wings. These pet accessories go on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Leash is an uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released in July 2019. It is obtainable by purchasing it in the Pet Shop for 250 or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Leash features a flat disc with a handle for the player to hold. The Leash is color-customizable upon purchase. When used, a line that is the same color as the rest of this item appears. When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, a line that is the same color as the rest of the item will connect the Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The Lebkuchen Cookie is a limited common food item in Adopt Me! that was released on December 12, 2024. It could have been claimed on day twelve of the 2024 Advent Calendar, which was released as a part of the Winter Festival (2024). As its day has passed, the Lebkuchen Cookie can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Lebkuchen Cookie features a light brown star-shaped treat with a dark brown base and peach-colored circular detailing. The Lebkuchen Cookie can be used to fulfill the 'Hunger' ailment for babies and pets, taking three uses to fully consume.

wiki.availability: The Leek Chew Toy is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70 or 199 from Small or Big Gifts. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Leek Chew Toy features a leek with green leaves and a white bottom. It has two black eyes and a mouth. When interacted with, the player throws the Leek Chew Toy and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. The pet holds it in its mouth until the player picks up the item. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Lei is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2023, along with the Summer Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Summer Shop for 400. As its event has now passed, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Lei is a garland with several multicolored flowers strung through it. This pet accessory is worn around a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Lemonade is a common food item in Adopt Me!. Players can obtain a Lemonade by purchasing one from a Lemonade Stand, which can cost between 0 to 20, or for free as a pet age-up reward.
wiki.notes: A different version of the Lemonade can be obtained from the Lemonade Pitcher furniture item, which costs 225. Lemonades obtained from a Lemonade Pitcher disappear from a player's inventory when they leave. Both types of Lemonade can also be obtained through trading. The Lemonade is light yellow liquid and sits in a tall, clear glass. In a player's inventory, the glass appears gray. If a player grabs a Lemonade from a Lemonade Pitcher, the Lemonade also features a yellow straw, some ice cubes, and a lemon slice hanging on the glass. The Lemonade can be used to fulfill the 'Thirsty' ailment for babies and pets, taking five uses to fully consume.

wiki.availability: The Lemonade Chew Toy is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2023, along with the Summer Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Summer Shop for 500. As its event has now passed, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Lemonade Chew Toy features a glass jar with a pale liquid and ice cubes inside. It has a fruit slice on the edge, and a straw sticking out. When interacted with, the player throws the Lemonade Chew Toy and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. The pet holds it in its mouth until the player picks up the item. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Lemonade Stand is an ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on July 26, 2019. It can be obtained in the Shop menu for 40 (formerly 50) or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Lemonade Stand features a wooden stand which has a Teddy Bear, Rolling Pin and Bottles below it, as well as a Small Yellow Flowers, a jug with lemonade, two cups, and a Cash Register on top, while there are three cups from behind. Below the Cash Register is a sign that displays the Lemonade's price. The stand has a sign high up that displays "<Player>'s Lemonade" around a white background filled with lemon slices, while the back of the sign is just a white background. To the left are four balloons in different colors and sizes. When the Lemonade Stand is selected from the player's inventory, it will appear transparent and float in front of the player until it is placed with the left mouse button, or through tapping the screen. It cannot be placed on a slope or object. Once placed, the player can either set a price for the stand or take it down and put it back in their inventory. The Lemonade Stand gives the player the ability to sell Lemonades at a price ranging from 0 to 20. If the price is set to 0, only one Lemonade obtained from the stand can be held in the player's inventory at a time.

wiki.availability: The Leopard Cat is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 8, 2022. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Japan Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 34% chance of hatching a rare pet from the Japan Egg, but only an 11.33% chance of hatching a Leopard Cat. The Leopard Cat features a beige body and tail, both with dark brown spots. It has a white underbelly and bottom of its face, brown stripes along the sides and top of its face, brown whiskers, and a pink nose. It also has two ears with pink and white insides and a brown outer layer. Here are the tricks the Leopard Cat learns in order: The Neon Leopard Cat glows pink on its spots, ears, and whiskers. The Mega Neon Leopard Cat glows in the same areas as the Neon Leopard Cat, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Leopard Shark is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! was released on June 29, 2023, as part of the third week of the Summer Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it for 25,000. As its event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Leopard Shark features a dark brown shark with a light brown middle body and underbelly. It has three fins, one on its head and two on its body. It has black eyes and is a reskin of the Shark. Here are the tricks the Leopard Shark learns in order: The Neon Leopard Shark glows green on its spots and flippers. The Mega Neon Leopard Shark glows in the same areas as the Neon Leopard Shark, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Leopard Shark Sticker is a common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on July 5, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Summer State Fair (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained by opening any remaining State Fair Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Leopard Shark Sticker features a cartoon Leopard Shark.

wiki.availability: The Leprechaun Hat is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 16, 2021. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 750 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Leprechaun Hat features a green top hat with a light green clover and a golden-buckled black belt. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Leprechaun Jacket is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 14, 2025, alongside the St. Patrick's Day Update. It was obtainable through completing a two hour playtime task on the Task Board. The Leprechaun Jacket could not be claimed until after the Leprechaun Shoes had been obtained, meaning the player had to play for a total of three hours before they could receive it. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on March 21, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Leprechaun Jacket features a green jacket with dark green cuffs, a dark green collar, and yellow detailing. Around the midsection is a dark brown belt with a yellow buckle.

wiki.availability: The Leprechaun Shoes are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on March 14, 2025, alongside the St. Patrick's Day Update. They were obtainable through completing a one hour playtime task on the Task Board. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on March 21, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Leprechaun Shoes feature dark green pointed shoes with yellow detailing and raised heels. Two straps wrap around the shoe and connect to a yellow buckle. Inside of each shoe are striped socks with two alternating shades of green.

wiki.availability: The Leprechaun Tophat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 14, 2025, alongside the St. Patrick's Day Update. It was obtainable through completing a five hour playtime task on the Task Board. The Leprechaun Tophat could not be claimed until after the Leprechaun Shoes and Leprechaun Jacket had been obtained, meaning the player had to play for a total of eight hours before they could receive it. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on March 21, 2025.
The Lesbian Cat-Snake Alliance Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on June 14, 2024, along with the Summer State Fair (2024).
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Pride Sticker Pack for 50. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Lesbian Cat-Snake Alliance Sticker features a cartoon Cobra sitting on top of a cartoon Ginger Cat. The Cobra is holding a Lesbian Flag with the end of its tail.

wiki.availability: The Lesbian Flag is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 9, 2022. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand for 50; the Pride Stand could be found near the Playground and left the game on June 16, 2022. The Lesbian Flag can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Lesbian Flag features a lesbian flag with a white handle; this handle has a small yellow knob on its tip. The colors of the flag include shades of orange, white, and magenta. It has a pet accessory counterpart, the Lesbian Pride Pin. To wave the flag, a player can click anywhere on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Lesbian Flag 2023 is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 1, 2023. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand near the Playground for 50. It can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Lesbian Flag 2023 features a Lesbian Flag, the only difference being the rainbow string that is intertwined along the flagpole and a Pride Paw Flying Disc at the top of the pole. To wave the flag, a player can click anywhere on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Lesbian Pride Pin is a common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 31, 2020. It could have been found in the Accessory Shop and taken for free. One pride pin could be taken by a player every hour. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Lesbian Pride Pin features a heart-shaped pin with a gold border and colors that represent the lesbian flag. The colors include red, orange, white, indigo, and violet. This pet accessory is worn on the pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Leviathan is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! was released on June 22, 2023, as part of the second week of the Summer Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it for 130,000. As its event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Leviathan features a dark red body with off-white markings on its front and sides. It has an off-white underbelly, two large wings, two off-white horns, and two black eyes. Here are the tricks the Leviathan learns in order: The Neon Leviathan glows orange on its horns, markings, and underbelly. The Mega Neon Leviathan cycles glows in the same area as the Neon Leviathan, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Leviathan Sticker is a legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on July 5, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Summer State Fair (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained by opening any remaining State Fair Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Leviathan Sticker features a cartoon Leviathan.

wiki.availability: The Levitation Potion is a limited ultra-rare potion in Adopt Me! that previously could have been purchased in the old Sky Castle for 995. It was removed on June 10, 2021, along with the Sky Castle's renovation and it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Levitation Potion is stored in a bottle with a square-shaped base and a thinner rectangular neck. It is topped with a rectangular black cap. Players can visibly see indigo-colored liquid inside the bottle. As its name suggests, the Levitation Potion allows the player to float in the air with a simple jump. When the player is floating, they appear to have a cloud beneath them. Jumping again while afloat will allow them to fall to the ground and walk again. The effect of this potion cannot be stacked.

wiki.availability: The Life Preserver is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022, along with the Accessory Chests update. Players could obtain it by opening a Standard Chest or Regal Chest, which cost 105 and 300 respectively. As the Life Preserver is no longer part of the Accessory Chest rotation, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Players had a 6% and 2% of obtaining a Life Preserver from a Standard Chest and Regal Chest respectively. The Life Preserver, as true to its name, features a red and white striped life preserver tube that has rope around it. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Liger is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 8, 2023. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Danger Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 35% of hatching a common pet from the Danger Egg, but only an 11.66% chance of hatching a Liger. The Liger features an orange head, with dark orange stripes, black whiskers, a black nose, two black eyes, orange ears, and beige inner ears with a black outline. It has a light orange body, dark orange stripes going down its back and its long tail, ending with a black tip. The Liger also has a beige underbelly, and four feet. Here are the tricks the Liger learns in order: The Neon Liger glows green on the stripes on its back, face, whiskers, inner ears, feet, and tail. The Mega Neon Liger glows in the same areas as the Neon Liger, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Light Blue Pogostick is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 6, 2025, alongside the return of the Butterfly Sanctuary. It could have been purchased for 100. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on June 13, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Light Blue Pogostick serves no purpose aside from being a fun pogo stick to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Light Spinner Throw Toy is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 28, 2024, as part of the third week of the Summer State Fair (2024). Players could purchase the Light Spinner Throw Toy for 6,400. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Light Spinner Throw Toy features a see-through globe positioned on top of a red and blue handle, with a yellow star shining inside of the globe. When interacted with, the Light Spinner Throw Toy is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Lightbulb Hat is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 0.4% and 0.1% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On September 29, 2022, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Lightbulb Hat was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Lightbulb Hat features a yellow glowing lightbulb with a gray metal coil on the bottom. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Lighthouse Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 4, 2025, alongside the Summer Festival (2025). Players could have purchased it for 6,000. It can now only be obtained through trading.

The Lilypad Flying Disc is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70 or 199 from Small or Big Gifts. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on August 22, 2025 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: To interact with this item, a player can click/press their screen to throw the toy and their equipped pet will retrieve it. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Lime Slice Propeller is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 18, 2021, along with the first 2021 Gift Refresh update. Players could obtain it by opening a Small Gift, Big Gift, or Massive Gift, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. As the Lime Slice Propeller is no longer part of the current Gifts rotation, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Lime Slice Propeller features a circular green top printed with a pattern based on a lime slice, with a curved rod below it that uses a yellow-green gradient. By interacting with the Lime Slice Propeller, it will propel the player up until the player jumps or unequips the propeller.

wiki.availability: The Limo is an ultra-rare six-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released in 2018, replacing the GoKart in the VIP gamepass. Players can obtain it by purchasing the VIP gamepass for 640, buying the Pets Plus subscription for the first time for 299, or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Limo is a modern convertible limousine with a white interior. The Limo's second row of seats faces toward the third row, which means that passengers of the second row face toward the passengers of the third row, much like the Camper Van. While the Limo's body is generic, its headlights bear a close resemblance to those in the 2016 Dodge Dart, whilst its oval tail lights are similar to those found in the 2018-present Bentley Continental GT. The Limo's color adapts to the player's favorite color, meaning it can come in seven colors: pink, blue, purple, green, red, orange, and black. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Lion is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 5, 2019, along with the Safari Egg. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by trading or by hatching any remaining Safari Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 15% chance of hatching an ultra-rare pet from the Safari Egg, but only a 7.5% chance of hatching a Lion. The Lion features a yellow torso, tail, ears, and paws. It has beady black eyes, a beige nose, and a brown mane wrapping around its head, neck, and surrounding the ears. Here are the tricks the Lion learns in order: The Neon Lion glows white on its inner ears, nose, paws, and the tip of its tail. The Mega Neon Lion glows in the same areas as the Neon Lion, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Lion Cub is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on July 13, 2023. Players were able to purchase this pet in the Safari Zone next to the Accessory Shop or the Shop menu for 150. It can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Lion Cub features a tan body and a lighter patch of fur on its head. It has tan ear insides, whiskers, and eyebrows. On its face, it has a small brown nose and two black eyes. Here are the tricks the Lion Cub learns in order: The Neon Lion Cub glows orange on its head fur, underbelly, nose, whiskers, and feet. The Mega Neon Lion Cub glows in the same areas as the Neon Lion Cub, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Lion's Mane is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It is obtainable through purchasing and opening the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. It is otherwise obtainable through opening Admin Abuse Boxes, purchasing it for 500 when it is on rotation in the Accessory Shop, or trading.
The Lionfish Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on September 20, 2024, alongside the second week of the Ocean Event (2024).
wiki.notes: As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Ocean Sticker Packs or through trading. The Lionfish Sticker features a cartoon Lionfish.

wiki.availability: The Lionfish is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 13, 2024, alongside the Ocean Event (2024). It could be obtained through purchasing a Small Wish for 1,000 or a Big Wish for 4,000. Players had a 10% chance of obtaining a Lionfish from the Small Wish and a 40% chance of obtaining a Lionfish from the Big Wish. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Lionfish features a body that showcases vibrant stripes in shades of red, orange, and white that run along its sides. The head is slightly flattened with large, black eyes. It has spiky fins that are adorned with red and white patterns. Its dorsal fin features long, sweeping spines that fan out. Its tail is tapered and slightly forked, and sharp spines dot the back and sides. Here are the tricks the Lionfish learns in order: The Neon Lionfish glows ivory on parts of its face, tail, fins, and dorsal spines, while the spines on its fins glow yellow and red. The Mega Neon Lionfish glows in the same areas as the Neon Lionfish, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Lionfish Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on September 20, 2024, alongside the second week of the Ocean Event (2024).
wiki.notes: As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Ocean Sticker Packs or through trading. The Lionfish Sticker features a cartoon Lionfish.

wiki.availability: The Little Lamb is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 29, 2026, alongside the Fairytale Egg. It is obtainable through hatching Fairytale Eggs for 750, Royal Fairytale Eggs for 14, Basic Eggs for 400, Crystal Eggs for 4,000, Admin Abuse Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 6% chance of hatching the Little Lamb from the Fairytale Egg, and a 25% chance of hatching it from the Royal Fairytale Egg. Here are the tricks the Little Lamb learns in order: The Neon Little Lamb glows pink on its feet, tail, neck ribbon, cheeks, nose, and on parts of the flower and leaves on its head. The Mega Neon Little Lamb glows in the same areas as the Neon Little Lamb, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Living Wizard Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had an 1.7% and 0.4% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Living Wizard Hat was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Living Wizard Hat features a blue pointed hat with yellow decorations, black button eyes sewn with yellow string, and a yellow ridge for a mouth. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Llama is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2019, along with the Farm Egg. As the Farm Egg is now unavailable for purchase, players can only obtain the Llama by trading with other players or by hatching any remaining Farm Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 15% chance of hatching an ultra-rare pet from the Farm Egg but only a 7.5% chance of hatching a Llama. The Llama has a white face and beige fur. It has small triangular-shaped beige ears and gray inner ears, a dark gray nose, a long neck, black eyes, and dark beige feet. Listed below are the tricks that the Llama learns in order: The Neon Llama glows bright orange on its hooves, nose, and ears. However, the ears do not glow when a player is riding it. The Mega Neon Llama glows in the same areas as the Neon Llama, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Llama Plush is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released around September 2018. It was obtainable by opening Small or Big Gifts, which cost 70 and 199, respectively. As the Llama Plush is no longer part of the gifts, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Llama Plush features a white face and beige fur. It has two beady black eyes, red inner ears, and an indent that serves as a nose. To interact with the Llama Plush, the player can click or press their screen to hug it.

wiki.availability: The Llama Rattle is an uncommon rattle in Adopt Me! that was released as part of the 2021 Baby Shop Update. It can be found and bought in the Baby Shop for 250 or obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Llama Rattle has a yellow handle with a cloud gray-colored llama on it. This llama has a light blue saddle on its back and a yellow rope around its neck. It bears resemblance to the Llama pet. To interact with this item, a player can click their screen to shake it back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Llamalush Purse Pet is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 10, 2022. It could have been obtained by purchasing it in the Accessory Shop for 200. As it left the game on March 24, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The real-life version of the Llamalush Purse Pet is available in Amazon, Walmart, and Target stores worldwide. It was made so that players can match with their in-game pets. The Llamalush Purse Pet features an off-white purse resembling a llama with soft, thick wool, jet black eyelashes, and a pink circle on the right side of its face. Its eyes and ears are colored pink, yellow, and blue, with a hint of green around the pupils. The purse is held up by a pink strap with a buckle. As described by Adopt Me!, the Llamalush Purse Pet is animated; it can blink by opening and closing its eyes. This pet accessory goes on a pet's back.

wiki.notes: The Lobster features a red body with several segments near its tail. It has two long, red antennae on its head, two black eyes, and a tan underbelly. The lobster also has two red claws. Here are the tricks the Lobster learns in order: The Neon Lobster glows yellow on its antenna, claws, feet, tail, and underbelly. The Mega Neon Lobster glows in the same areas as the Neon Lobster, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Long Neck Throw Toy (formerly known as Long Neck Chew Toy) is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that could previously be found when digging for fossils at the Fossil Isle Excavation (2020). As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.

When thrown, the player's equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Longhorn Cow is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on November 16, 2023, and went off-sale on November 29, 2023. wiki.availability: The Love Bird is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 14, 2025, alongside the Valentine's Event (2025). It was purchasable for 2,400. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on February 21, 2025.

It has two deep orange feathers sticking out of the top of its head, a red tail, and multicolored wings with the colors orange, yellow, and green. Here are the tricks the Love Bird learns in order: The Neon Love Bird glows orange, yellow, and green on its wings, orange on its feet, and red on its tail and under its eyes. The Mega Neon Love Bird glows in the same areas the Neon Love Bird, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Lunar Gold Tiger is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 3, 2022, as part of the Lunar New Year (2022). Players could purchase a Lunar Tiger Box for 350 during the event. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading or by opening any remaining Lunar Tiger Boxes.
wiki.notes: Players have a 10% chance of getting the Lunar Gold Tiger from a Lunar Tiger Box. The Lunar Gold Tiger has a pale yellow body with red stripes on its back, head, face, tail, and behind its ears. It also has a pink nose, black beady eyes, and pink whiskers. These are the tricks the Lunar Gold Tiger learns in order: The Neon Lunar Gold Tiger glows blue on the stripes on its back, face, behind its ears, and tail. The Mega Neon Lunar Gold Tiger glows in the same areas as the Neon Lunar Gold Tiger, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Lunar Lantern is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 19, 2023, as a part of the Lunar New Year (2023) event.
wiki.notes: It was obtainable by purchasing it on the Lunar New Year Stand for 1,800. Since the event ended on January 26, 2022, the Lunar Lantern is now only obtainable through trading. The Lunar Lantern features a round red lantern with yellow lines extending from top to bottom. It has a yellow top and lines of yellow on its bottom. The Lunar Lantern is attached to a red handle with a black upper hook. When equipped, the Lunar Lantern will appear transparent and float in front of the player. When interacted with in this state, the Lunar Lantern will be placed, as long as it's on a flat surface that isn't within the boundaries of a house plot; otherwise it will appear red. After placement, there is a button to take it down, as well as another button that turns on/off a glowing red light. If a player tries to place another Lunar Lantern, the previous Lunar Lantern will be taken down automatically. Also, if a player tries to place the Lunar Lantern inside a building or house, a pop-up will appear saying "You can't place that here".

wiki.availability: The Lunar Moon Bear is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on January 19, 2023, as a part of the Lunar New Year (2023) event.
wiki.notes: It is obtainable by opening a Moon Bear Box. There is a 10% chance of obtaining it from the Moon Bear Box. As its event has passed, it can now only be obtained through trading or by opening any remaining Moon Bear Boxes. The Lunar Moon Bear features a black-blue body with a black nose and eyes. It has dark blue ear insides and underbelly with small flecks of yellow inside a crescent moon. Around its neck there is a small ruffle. Listed below are the tricks the Lunar Moon Bear learns in order: The Neon Lunar Moon Bear glows blue on its inner ears, its snout, its paws, and its moon-shaped stomach pattern. The Mega Neon Lunar Moon Bear glows in the same areas as the Neon Lunar Moon Bear, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

When thrown, an equipped pet will chase after it and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. wiki.availability: The Magic House Door (formerly known as Magic Door) is an ultra-rare gamepass item that was added to Adopt Me! on February 7, 2020. Players can purchase it for 130 (formerly 150) in the Adopt Me! Gamepass shop or through trading.

This makes it convenient if the player has to complete tasks that can only be completed at their home, such as showering pets or babies. The Magic House Door is also useful for families. The Magic House Door has the appearance of a curved wooden door. It has two tree branches sticking out with leaves on the branch, giving the appearance of a small tree.

wiki.availability: The Magic Moon Stroller is an uncommon stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on June 24, 2021, along with the Baby Shop remodel. It can be obtained by purchasing it from the Baby Shop for 550. It can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Magic Moon Stroller features a light-pink crescent moon seat with a purple handle. Small yellow decorations hang from the crescent's upper tip while a small ring surrounds the bottom one. It has two purple wheels complete with yellow axles and swirl designs. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

It could have been purchased for 70 or 199 from Small or Big Gifts. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading with other players.

There is a red circle with a yellow rim, and a red and yellow ribbon at the bottom of the scroll. When interacted with, the player throws the Magic Scroll Chew Toy, and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. The pet holds it in its mouth until the player picks up the item. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Magic Wand Grappling Hook is a limited rare toy that was added to Adopt Me! as part of the new gift rotation on March 18, 2021. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Magic Wand Grappling Hook resembles a magic wand with a wood-like base and purple, magenta, pink, and blue swirls on its body. To interact with this item, a player can click/press anywhere on their screen to fire a hooked-cable and be pulled towards the target location. Like most other grappling hooks, players cannot use this item on non-solid graphical objects, if they are on a vehicle, doing an obby, or flying or riding a pet.

wiki.availability: The Magic Wing Badge is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 11, 2025, alongside week 2 of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). It was purchasable for 1,900 during the event or from the item rotation in the Cherry Blossom Wagon. It can now only be obtained through trading.

The Magical Girl Car is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on August 5, 2021. It could be obtained through purchasing the Ultra Car Pack for 680. On April 24, 2026, the Ultra Car Pack was added to the Final Stop Shop and discounted to 499 before leaving the game on May 1, 2026. The Magical Girl Car can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Magical Girl Car features a supercar with primarily deep pink exterior with yellow star-shaped wheel rims. The front features a large dark-gray grille with a gray bumper underneath, two white headlights, and an orange star-shaped hood with a yellow outline, with the front point going through the middle of the grille. Behind the hood is a gray cylinder that connects the windshield, with two black seats with a star-shaped headrest behind it. The back has a gray top with a giant cyan bow on top, with the rear consisting of two orange taillights and a wide gray bumper that features a white license plate and four exhaust pipes with star-shaped ends. It is largely based on the Ferrari LaFerrari Aperta car. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Magical Princess Leash is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on September 2, 2021, as part of the gifts rotation.
