wiki.availability: The Monkey Box is a limited rare gift in Adopt Me! that was released on May 28, 2020, as part of the Monkey Fairground event. Players could purchase it in the circus tent for 600. Since the event ended, the Monkey Box is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: By opening a Monkey Box, players receive a guaranteed Monkey, as well as two other items. The Monkey Box features a red and yellow striped box with red frills, blue curtains, and a yellow star on top. The box resembles an wind-up jack-in-the-box toy and contains a yellow winding handle with a displayed paw print, connected by a silver rod on the side. For every Monkey Box opened, players receive a Monkey, a rare pet, as well as two of these items below:

wiki.availability: Monkey Fairground Cotton Candy (formerly known as Cotton Candy) is a common food in Adopt Me! that was released on May 28, 2020, as part of the Monkey Fairground event. It could have been obtained through purchasing and opening Monkey Boxes for 600 at a 45% chance. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Monkey Boxes or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Monkey Fairground Cotton Candy takes one use to fully consume. When eaten, it increases the player's speed. The more Monkey Fairground Cotton Candy the player eats, the faster their speed becomes. The speed effect resets when the player resets or leaves the game. The Monkey Fairground Cotton Candy features a white paper cone topped with pink colored fluff.

wiki.availability: The Monkey King Crown is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was available during the Monkey Fairground Event. If a player combined 3 Staff Ingredients and a Monkey, they would get a Monkey King, along with the Monkey King Crown. As its respective event has ended, the Monkey King Crown is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: Despite the Monkey King Crown coming with the Monkey King, players are able to put it on any pet. The Monkey King Crown features a yellow crown that meets in curves in the center. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Monkey Pogo is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on May 28, 2020, as a part of the Monkey Fairground event. It can be obtained from Monkey Boxes. There is a 5% chance of obtaining a Monkey Pogo from a regular Monkey Box, which cost 600, and a 10% chance from a Premium Monkey Box, which cost 195. As the Monkey Fairground event ended on June 5, 2020, the Monkey Pogo can now only be obtained by trading with other players or by opening any remaining Monkey Boxes.
wiki.notes: The pogo resembles the Monkey pet holding onto a branch. Like all other pogo sticks in Adopt Me!, the Monkey Pogo serves no use other than being a fun pogo to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Monkey Propeller is a limited ultra-rare toy added to Adopt Me! as a part of the Monkey Fairground Event. As its respective event as now ended, it can now only be obtained through opening any remaining Monkey Boxes and Premium Monkey Boxes; it can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Monkey Propeller features a large banana tree with wide, drooping green leaves. There is a small cluster of bananas outside the tree. On the side of the propeller, there is a decorative monkey holding a yellow banana. The monkey's tail curls around the white handle of the propeller. The Monkey on the propeller is based on the pet Monkey. To interact with this item, the player can click anywhere on their screen to be propelled upwards. To stop, a player must jump while the propeller is in use.

wiki.egg: Small Gift, Big Gift, or Massive Gift
wiki.availability: The Mono-Moped is a limited legendary single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 25, 2018. Players could obtain it by opening Small Gifts, Big Gifts, or Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499, respectively. As the Mono-Moped is no longer part of the gifts, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Mono-Moped closely resembles the Moped, with its most distinctive difference being the fact that it has a large, singular wheel, hence the name "Mono", meaning one. The Mono-Moped is bright red, having two distinctive exhausts which emit smoke particles, and the steering handles are also connected lower down than those of the Moped. Other differences include the seat being slightly thinner, and the headlight enclosure being white instead of having the same color as the rest of the body. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Monocle is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 750. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Monocle has a black strap and chain that connects to the rim of a circular glass. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's face and over one of its eyes.

wiki.availability: The Monocycle is a limited legendary single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released around April 2019 and was obtainable from Small, Big, and Massive Gifts which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. As the Gifts were refreshed with new items, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Monocycle is a black motor-powered monocycle with a red inner wheel. Though hard to tell, the Monocycle appears to be powered by a small three-cylinder engine, located directly underneath the seat. The Monocycle has a white steering wheel which is connected to the frame and curves directly towards the driver. The Monocycle also has a variant called the Donut Cycle. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Monster Friend Hat is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on October 4, 2024, as part of the Halloween Event (2024). Players could have purchased it for 1,300 or for 3 during the first week of the event. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
The Monster Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on October 5, 2023, as a part of the Halloween Event (2023).
wiki.notes: Players could obtain the Monster Hat by purchasing it for 3,250 in the Asylum shop. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading. The Monster Hat is a green hat with a black stich, and a black top. There are two gray bolts protruding from each side. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Monstera Leaf Cape is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 9, 2023. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.8% and 0.7% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on May 10, 2024, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Monstera Leaf Cape features a single Monstera plant leaf. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Monstera Plant Pot is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on November 22, 2024, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Monstera Plant Pot features a tan pot and green plants. This accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Moon Bear Box is a limited legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was released on January 19, 2023, as a part of the Lunar New Year (2023) event. Players were able to purchase the Moon Bear Box at the Lunar New Year stand near the Playground for 300. As the event as ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: When opening the Moon Bear Box, players have a 60% chance to obtain a Black Moon Bear, a 30% chance to obtain a Water Moon Bear, and a 10% chance to obtain a Lunar Moon Bear. The Moon Bear Box features a black box with a curved top. It has two small ears with tan insides, curves on the edge of the box, a tan middle area, and a yellow keyhole.

wiki.availability: The Moon Boots are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on May 2, 2025. They could have been purchased in the Moon Temple for 150. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on May 16, 2025.
wiki.notes: These pet accessories are worn on a pet's feet.

wiki.availability: The Moon Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on February 7, 2025, during the Lunar New Year (2025) and replacing the Garden Egg. It could have been purchased from the Gumball Machine in the Nursery for 750. The Moon Egg was replaced by the Aztec Egg on August 15, 2025, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: It was previously obtainable through opening Treasure Chests with Treasure Keys during the Summer Festival (2025). The Moon Egg takes 5 tasks to hatch. The Moon Egg features a gray egg with craters scattered across its surface.

wiki.availability: The Space Helmet is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.7% and 0.6% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On April 20, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Space Helmet was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Space Helmet features a white helmet with a transparent front and brown insides. It has a gray piece that loops around the bottom of the helmet, a large black top, and a small black microphone at its side. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Moon Rabbit is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on January 19, 2023, as a part of the Lunar New Year (2023) event.
wiki.notes: It could have been purchased for 375 at the Lunar New Year stand near the Playground. As its event has passed, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players. The Moon Rabbit features a white body, head, and ears with black ear insides, small tufts of fur on its head, a small tail, and four black feet. On its face it has black eyes and whiskers as well as a curved crescent moon. There are yellow speckles on the black parts of its body. Here are the tricks the Moon Rabbit learns in order: The Neon Moon Rabbit glows green on its outer ears, tuft of hair, whiskers, and part of its feet. The Mega Neon Moon Rabbit glows in the same areas as the Neon Moon Rabbit, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Moon Rabbit Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2026, alongside the second week of the Sugar Festival Event (2026). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Sugarfest 2026 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Moon Rabbit Sticker features a cartoon Moon Rabbit.

wiki.availability: The Moon Tome is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 1,500 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Moon Tome that features a purple book with gold accents. There is a large golden gem in the middle of the book cover and red lines on the pages that appear to be bookmarks. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.addedEvent: The Moon Viewing Bench is a limited ultra-rare toy that was released during the 2022 Lunar New Year Event
wiki.availability: The Moon Viewing Bench is a limited ultra-rare toy that was released during the 2022 Lunar New Year Event. It could be obtained by purchasing it for 1,800. As the event has now ended, it can only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Moon Viewing Bench features a red bench with red velvet cushions. It has black framings on its armrests with yellows dots around the bench. When placed, the Moon Viewing Bench allows up to two players or pets to sit on it. It can be placed anywhere around Adoption Island or the Neighborhood. It cannot be placed on a slope or while the player is riding or flying a pet.

wiki.availability: The Moonbeam Butterfly is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 13, 2025, replacing the Prismatic Butterfly in the Butterfly Sanctuary. Players were able to obtain it with a Snapdragon Flower, which cost 25. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it became unavailable from the Snapdragon Flower on June 20, 2025.
wiki.notes: There was a 4% chance of obtaining a Moonbeam Butterfly from the Snapdragon Flower. It was only available at night. Here are the tricks the Moonbeam Butterfly learns in order: The Neon Moonbeam Butterfly glows white on its wing veins and antennae, while its wing spots and eyes glow light blue and its wing cells glow a dark blue to light blue gradient. The Mega Neon Moonbeam Butterfly cycles through the colors of the rainbow on its antennae, wing veins, and wing spots, while its eyes remain glowing light blue.

wiki.availability: The Moonbeam Peacock is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released into the Salon on May 1, 2026, as a part of the Salon Revamp Update. Players can obtain it with a Golden Dandelion, which costs 195. It is otherwise obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 2.5% chance of obtaining a Moonbeam Peacock from the Golden Dandelion. Here are the tricks the Moonbeam Peacock learns in order: The Neon Moonbeam Peacock glows blue on its crest, face and forehead markings, wings, feet, around its beak, and on the spots of its tail feathers. The Mega Neon Moonbeam Peacock glows in the same areas as the Neon Moonbeam Peacock, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Mooncake is a limited common food item in Adopt Me! that was released on September 16, 2021, to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival.
wiki.notes: It was obtainable by purchasing it at the Moon Festival Stand near the Playground for 1. The Mooncake left the game two weeks later on September 30, 2021, and is now only obtainable through trading. The Mooncake can be used to fulfill the 'Hunger' ailment for babies and pets, taking three uses to fully consume. The Mooncake has a light tawny crust embossed with a floral-like pattern.

wiki.availability: The Moonlight Moth is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 6, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Celestial Summer Event (2024). Players could obtain it by leveling their Galactic Pass during week four of the event. As the fourth Galactic Pass is no longer available, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Moonlight Moth learns in order: The Neon Moonlight Moth glows teal on its antennae, wing patterns, and on the bottom of its abdomen. The spots around its eyes glow pink, and some of its wing details glow yellow. The Mega Neon Moonlight Moth glows in the same areas as the Neon Moonlight Moth, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Moonpine is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 7, 2025, alongside the Moon Egg. It can now only be obtained through hatching any remaining Moon Eggs or Royal Moon Eggs, or through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 12% chance of hatching a Moonpine from the Moon Egg, and a 17% chance of hatching it from the Royal Moon Egg. The Moonpine features a black body with spines sticking out of its back. The spines are orange and yellow at the tips. Here are the tricks the Moonpine learns in order: The Neon Moonpine glows orange on its quills and feet. The Mega Neon Moonpine glows in the same areas as the Neon Moonpine, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Moose Calf is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released into the Camping Shop on May 30, 2025, alongside the Muskrat. Players are able to tame it with a Maple Leaf Treat, which costs 199. It is otherwise obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 10% chance of obtaining a Moose Calf from the Maple Leaf Treat. Here are the tricks the Moose Calf learns in order: The Neon Moose Calf glows yellow on its horns, back fur, tail, and face. The Mega Neon Moose Calf glows in the same areas as the Neon Moose Calf, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Moped is a limited rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on July 17, 2018. It could have been purchased for 800 in the Vehicle Dealership. It is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Moped is a classic motor scooter, which bears a close resemblance to a Vespa. A key difference between the Moped and the Vepsa is that the headlight unit is mounted on the chassis, and not on the front fork instead of the handlebar. It is similar to the Mono-Moped. The Moped's color was color-customizable upon purchase. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Morion is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 200 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Morion features a lavender purple helmet with a crest in the middle. It does not fit very well on many pets, due to the varying sizes. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Mosquito is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 8, 2023. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Danger Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 35% of hatching a common pet from the Danger Egg, but only an 11.66% chance of hatching a Mosquito. The Mosquito features an orange abdomen, a proboscis, two black eyes, two dark brown antennae, half white, half mint green wings, and four cream colored feet. Here are the tricks the Mosquito learns in order: The Neon Mosquito glows yellow-orange on the top of its abdomen, thorax, wings, and antenna. The Mega Neon Mosquito glows in the same areas as the Neon Mosquito, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Moth Hair Clip is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on January 30, 2026, it can only be obtained through trading.
The Motorbike is a common single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 3, 2022. It can be purchased for 400 in the Vehicle Dealership. It can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Motorcycle is a limited common single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that could be purchased in the Vehicle Dealership for 400. The Motorcycle left the game on March 3, 2022, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Motorcycle's appearance resembles the 70's models of the Honda CB series. It has a white frame, two wheels with gray rims, a long black seat, and a round light in front. It was color-customizable upon purchase. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Motorized Sofa is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It can be obtained by opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts for 70, 199, or 499, respectively. It is otherwise obtainable through opening Admin Abuse Boxes or trading. The Motorized Sofa can only be opened from gifts when it is on rotation.
wiki.notes: The Motorized Sofa features a brown sofa with colorful patches. The sofa has a black base and two lights on each side of the sofa. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Mouse is a common pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on July 21, 2022, as a part of the Basic Egg refresh. It can be obtained through purchasing and hatching Cracked Eggs for 350, Pet Eggs for 600, and Basic Eggs for 400, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 22.5% chance of hatching the Mouse from the Cracked Egg, and a 10% chance of hatching it from the Pet Egg. The Mouse has a small gray body with a white spot on its snout. Its nose, tail, paws, and inner ears are colored a light pink. It has a small tuft of hair on its forehead and beady black eyes. Listed below are the tricks the Mouse learns in order: The Neon Mouse glows blue on the core of its ears, nose, and feet. The Mega Neon Mouse glows in the same areas as the Neon Mouse, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.egg: Small, Big, and Massive Old Gifts
wiki.availability: The Mouse Chew Toy is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was previously obtainable from opening Small, Big, and Massive Gifts for 70 199 or 499 respectively.
wiki.notes: As of the 2021 Gift Refresh update, the Gifts were replaced with another set of items. It can now only be obtained through trading. The Mouse Chew Toy features a simple white mouse with beady black eyes, pink inner ears, a pink tail, and a nose. When interacted with, the player drops the Mouse Chew Toy and their equipped pet starts chewing on it. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Mouse Leash is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was previously obtainable through opening Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. As of the 2021 Gift Refresh update, the Gifts were replaced with another set of items. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Mouse Leash features a round, gray handle attached to a gray mouse head; the head having two rounded gray ears with pink insides, a pink nose, and two black eyes. When used, a pink line comes out of the head. When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, a pink line will connect the Mouse Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The Field Mouse Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2026, alongside the second week of the Sugar Festival Event (2026). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Sugarfest 2026 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Field Mouse Sticker features a cartoon Field Mouse.

wiki.availability: The Mr. Whiskerpips is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 25, 2024. It could have been claimed on day twenty five of the 2024 Advent Calendar, which was released as a part of the Winter Festival (2024). It can now only be obtained through trading, as its day has passed.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Mr. Whiskerpips learns in order: The Neon Mr. Whiskerpips glows yellow on its face, ear fluff, feet, and underbelly, while its inner ears glow a pale pink. The Mega Neon Mr. Whiskerpips glows in the same areas as the Neon Mr. Whiskerpips, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.egg: 2025 Advent Calendar, Christmas Day Admin Abuse
wiki.availability: The Mrs. Whiskerpips is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 25, 2025. Players could have claimed it on day twenty five of the 2025 Advent Calendar, which was released as a part of the Winter Event (2025). It was also given out for free during that day's Admin Abuse. It is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Mrs. Whiskerpips learns in order: The Neon Mrs. Whiskerpips glows light yellow on its hands, feet, face, tail, and ear fluff. The Mega Neon Mrs. Whiskerpips glows in the same areas as the Neon Mrs. Whiskerpips, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ms. Muffet is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 29, 2026, alongside the Fairytale Egg. It is obtainable through purchasing and hatching Fairytale Eggs for 750, Basic Eggs for 400, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 17.5% chance of hatching the Ms. Muffet from the Fairytale Egg. Here are the tricks the Ms. Muffet learns in order: The Neon Ms. Muffet glows pale pink on the rim of its hat, hat ribbon, tail, and on parts of its dress. The Mega Neon Ms. Muffet glows in the same areas as the Neon Ms. Muffet, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Mud Ball is a limited legendary food in Adopt Me! that was released on January 20, 2022, as a part of the Desert Weather Map Update. It can be purchased for 169 when its respective weather is on rotation, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Upon throwing a Mud Ball, players can tame a Giant Gold Scarab, Giant Blue Scarab, or Giant Black Scarab. The Mud Ball can only be used to tame a pet in the Desert Shop, when it is on rotation. Below are all of the pets that can be tamed using the Mud Ball.

wiki.availability: The Mule is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on October 27, 2022, during week 4 of the Halloween Event (2022). It could have been found in the Halloween Shop during the event, and cost 35,000. As the Halloween Event (2022) ended on November 3, 2022, the Mule can now only be obtained by trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Mule features a gray body with a pink muzzle with two black nose holes, pink inner ears, and dark blue feet, mane, and tail. Its pet accessory, the Mule Baskets, features two light brown baskets with dark brown crisscrossing lines; these baskets are connected at its back. These are the tricks the Mule learns in order: The Neon Mule glows light green on the tuft of hair on top of its head, its hooves, its tail, and its nostrils. The Mega Neon Mule glows in the same areas as the Neon Mule, but those areas cycles through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.egg: Obtained when players purchase a Mule
wiki.availability: The Mule Baskets are a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that were added to the game on October 27, 2022, during week 4 of the Halloween Event (2022).
wiki.notes: They could have been obtained by purchasing a Mule inside of the Halloween Shop of the Halloween Event (2022) for 35,000. When a player purchased the Mule, it would have been wearing the Mule Baskets. Even though it comes with the Mule, players can remove the Mule Baskets and put it on any pet. As the Halloween Event (2022) ended on November 3, 2022, the Mule Baskets can now only be obtained by trading with other players. The Mule Baskets features two light brown baskets with dark brown crisscrossed frames; these baskets are connected in the middle by a saddle. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Multi-Bike is a limited common two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me!. Players could have purchased it in the Vehicle Dealership for 300, or from the Starter Pack for 89. As the Multi-Bike left the Vehicle Dealership on March 3, 2022, and was replaced by the Starter Bike in the Starter Pack, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Multi-Bike resembles a modern tandem bike. It is incredibly similar to the regular Bike, therefore, resembles a traditional BMX bicycle, with the addition of an extra seat behind it. It was color-customizable upon purchase. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Munchkin Cat is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 29, 2025, alongside the Homepass. Players were able to earn it through leveling the Homepass by completing tasks on their Task Board and completing pet needs. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on September 5, 2025.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Munchkin Cat learns in order: The Neon Munchkin Cat glows pale yellow on its ear tips and inner ear fur, underbelly, feet, parts of its face, and the tip of its tail. The Mega Neon Munchkin Cat glows in the same areas as the Neon Munchkin Cat, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Muscle Car is a limited ultra-rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released in May 2019. Players could purchase it in the Vehicle Dealership for 1,800. As the Muscle Car left the game on March 3, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Muscle Car has a short classic body with an open roof. The front features three grilles, with the middle one being the widest, two white and round headlights, and two bumpers that cover the sides. There is a white curvy pattern on each side, with the curved rear having two more bumpers on each sides, with two circular taillights above each one. The Muscle Car has a windshield on top, and four simplistic wheels with white rims. The Muscle Car's design is similar to the Chevrolet Corvette C1, while the rear end is based on a Chevrolet Corvette C3. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Mushroom Flying Disc is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 23, 2023, along with the Spring Festival (2023). It was purchasable in the Springfest Shop for 400. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Mushroom Flying Disc is a red mushroom cap with white spots throughout. When interacted with, the Mushroom Flying Disc is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Mushroom Friend Plushie is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on March 31, 2022, as part of the 2022 Gift Refresh Update. It could be purchased for 70 or 199 from Small or Big Gifts. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Mushroom Friend Plushie features a round beige body, arms, legs, and head; there are two black circles and a curve on its face. It wears a red hat with white dots and a beige bottom. The Mushroom Friend Plushie serves no purpose other than just being a cosmetic and interactable item. To hug this toy, the player can click on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Mushroom Pogo is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on August 11, 2022, as part of the Fall Weather Update. It can be found and purchased in the Fall Shop for 995 when the Fall Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Mushroom Pogo features a white middle with curved handles intertwined with brown vines. There is a red pointed footrest resembling a red mushroom with white dots. The Mushroom Pogo serves no purpose other than being a fun pogostick to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Music Box Hat is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 9, 2023. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 0.4% and 0.1% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on May 10, 2024, it can now only be obtained through trading.

The Musical Conch is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 8, 2021, as part of the World Oceans Day update. It could be obtained for free at the Oceans Day Stand found next to the main bridge that connects the Adoption Island and the Neighborhood. This item is untradeable, and only players that claimed it during the World Oceans Day update will have it.
wiki.notes: The Musical Conch takes shape as a spiral tan shell, with a small hole on the bottom. When players play it, they sit down, similar to the action made when playing the Didgeridoo. The Musical Conch produces soothing music with an ocean soundscape when used. Players can hear birds, ocean waves, and other sounds when it is played. It serves no purpose other than being used for the player's enjoyment.

wiki.availability: The Musk Ox is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 15, 2020, as part of the Winter Holiday (2020). It could have been obtained by purchasing it in the Snow Castle for 3,500. Since the event ended on January 19, 2021, the Musk Ox is now only obtainable through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Musk Ox has a round chocolate-brown body with four round dark brown hooves. It has lighter brown fur on its back, with its face being the same color. Its muzzle and the two horns on the top of its head are beige, while the two rounded ears are light brown with dark brown insides. It has black eyes with a black nose on its oval head. Here are the tricks the Musk Ox learns in order: The Neon Musk Ox glows bright golden orange-yellow on its layer of fur on its back, horns, inner ears, and nose. The Mega Neon Musk Ox glows in the same areas as the Neon Musk Ox, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Muskrat is an uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on May 30, 2025, alongside the Maple Leaf Treat. It replaced the Possum. Players are able to purchase it in the Camping Shop for 950, hatch it from the Basic Egg or Admin Abuse Egg, or obtain it through trading. The Muskrat was formerly obtainable from the Crystal Egg from September 12, 2025 to February 20, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Muskrat learns in order: The Neon Muskrat glows light yellow on its ears, bottom feet, and tail. The Mega Neon Muskrat glows in the same areas as the Neon Muskrat, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Mystic Wing Crown is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It was obtainable through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on August 22, 2025, it can now only be obtained through trading.

The Mythic Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me!. It was released on August 19, 2021, replacing the Ocean Egg. It cost 750 and could be purchased from the Gumball Machine in the Nursery. It was replaced by the Woodland Egg on March 17, 2022. The Mythic Egg can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: On July 16, 2021, a large red and white floating banner with multiple question marks was held by a flying Phoenix and Wyvern. The banner was used as a countdown for the Mythic Egg release. Pillars and purple crystals were also added to decorate the Nursery and Adoption Island. The Mythic Egg has a variety of colors, with a greenish-blue gradient. Pointed scales wrap around the egg.

wiki.availability: The NYE 2026 Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on December 30, 2025. Players could obtain it through logging in from December 30, 2025 to January 1, 2026, with only one being available to each account. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 1, 2026.
wiki.notes: The NYE 2026 Sticker features a Dog, Penguin, Unicorn, Cabbit, and Turtle Doves surrounding a golden disco ball. Above them is pink and white text that reads "New Years 2026".

wiki.availability: The Naga Dragon is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 2, 2023. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Southeast Asia Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 4% chance of hatching a legendary pet from a Southeast Asia Egg, but only a 2% chance of hatching a Naga Dragon. The Naga Dragon has a long green body with yellow stripes throughout, as well as a red underbelly. It has yellow spikes on its head and tail, along with four teeth sticking out of its mouth and two black eyes. Here are the tricks the Naga Dragon learns in order: The Neon Naga Dragon glows purple on the spikes on its head and back, its tail, and stripes on its body. The Mega Neon Naga Dragon glows in the same areas as the Neon Naga Dragon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Nap Mask is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.8% and 5.5% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Nap Mask was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Nap Mask features a pink sleeping mask with two closed eyes on it. This pet accessory goes over a pet's eyes.

wiki.availability: The Narwhal is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 16, 2021, along with the Ocean Egg. It was removed from game on August 19, 2021, and can now only be obtained through hatching any remaining Ocean Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 30% chance of hatching a rare pet from the Ocean Egg, but only a 15% chance of hatching a Narwhal. The Narwhal features a bright sky blue-colored body, accompanied by a light blue underbelly and a dark blue back. It has a sandy yellow tusk on top, with its tail fins at the back. Here are the tricks the Narwhal learns in order: The Neon Narwhal glows green on its top and underbelly. The Mega Neon Narwhal glows in the same areas as the Neon Narwhal, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Narwhal Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on September 20, 2024, alongside the second week of the Ocean Event (2024).
wiki.notes: As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Ocean Sticker Packs or through trading. The Narwhal Sticker features a cartoon Narwhal.

wiki.availability: The Natural Wings are limited uncommon wing pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on September 15, 2022.
wiki.notes: They could previously have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Wing Chest for 600; players had a 33% chance of unboxing it from this chest. As their rotation has passed, the Natural Wings can now only be obtained through trading. The Natural Wings feature two green, vine-like wings. The top ridge of each wing connects to three vines; each vine has a curled end. There are small pink flowers throughout the wings. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back when the pet is flown.

wiki.notes: The Nature's Crossbow features a dark brown barrel and limb, with green string string connected to the handle. By tapping or clicking anywhere on their screen, the player is pulled in the direction that they tap or click on.

wiki.availability: The Nature's Crown is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. wiki.notes: The Nature's Crown features a tree branch with leaves, a green jewel, and two vines hanging below along with a blue butterfly above. It is animated; the butterfly flies around. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Naughty Mistletroll is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 20, 2024, alongside the third week of the Winter Festival (2024). Players could have purchased the Golden Mistletoe for 199 until January 17, 2025. As the event has ended, the Naughty Mistletroll can only be obtained through trading or using any remaining Golden Mistletoes.
wiki.notes: Players have a 15% chance of obtaining a Naughty Mistletroll from a Golden Mistletoe. The Naughty Mistletroll features a fluffy brown body and tail, two brown feet, and a brown head with two off-white horns, two brown ears with dark purple insides, and two glowing yellow eyes with dark brown markings around them. It also wears a yellow scarf on its neck and over part of its face. Here are the tricks the Naughty Mistletroll learns in order: The Neon Naughty Mistletroll glows a light pink to purple gradient on its ears and tail, while the spots around its eyes glow light pink and its eyes glow white. The Mega Neon Naughty Mistletroll glows in the same areas as the Neon Naughty Mistletroll, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.notes: The Naughty Mistletroll Sticker features a cartoon Naughty Mistletroll.

wiki.notes: The Nautilus features a round dark and light blue striped shell, two beady black eyes, and light purple tentacles. Here are the tricks the Nautilus learns in order: The Neon Nautilus glows blue on the white parts of its shell. Its normal counterpart is the Black Scooter, which has no trail and does not glow. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. wiki.availability: The Nessie is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 5, 2023. It could be purchased for 500 at a stand outside the Nursery, next to the Highland Cow. As the stand has left the game on January 12, 2023, it can now only be obtained by trading.

It has webbed areas on the sides of its head, two black eyes, dark green spots throughout its body, and a dark green ridge running down to its tail. Its underbelly is a light green, and it hovers slightly above the ground. The Nessie has a similar appearance to the Elasmosaurus. Listed below are the tricks the Nessie learns in order: The Neon Nessie glows dark blue on its back ridge, spots on its back, underbelly, undersides of fins, and on its webbed head areas. The Mega Neon Nessie glows in the same areas as the Neon Nessie, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Nest is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 9, 2021. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 100 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.

wiki.availability: The Nest of Eggs is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. wiki.availability: The Netzooka is a limited legendary toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 25, 2024, as part of the fourth week of the Halloween Event (2024). wiki.availability: The Winter Holiday (2021) was an event in Adopt Me! that began on December 1, 2021. It lasted for 35 days, ending on January 6, 2022.
wiki.notes: The event brought new limited pets, toys, and vehicles to the game, as well as an Advent Calendar and two new minigames. Minigames were ways for players to earn Gingerbread. There were 3 minigames in this event. This minigame takes place on the lake of Adoption Island. In this game, the player has to skate on ice while avoiding the Penguins, which can slow the player down when ran into - they make the player stumble over, rendering them unable to move for a few seconds. As the player skates, they can collect Gingerbread by running into the animated gingerbread shapes. These shapes disappear upon collection. Each shape is worth 4. The player can get up to 640 each run. This minigame was also present in the Winter Holiday (2020) and Winter Event (2022). This minigame was located in the Winter Village. Players were randomly assigned into one of 2 teams, Team Sabertooth and Team Mammoth. The 2 teams competed with each other to be the first to break their pet free from a block of ice in two minutes, which was a Sabertooth and Woolly Mammoth for Team Sabertooth and Team Mammoth, respectively. Players were given a pickaxe, which was used to chip away the ice and free their team's pet. After enough hits, the ice block started to slide across the ice and players must chase after it to continue chipping away the ice. The ice block gained the ability to knock players down, temporarily stopping them from chipping away the ice. There were also Penguins on the ice that knocked players down as well. Players could receive a maximum of 1,200 in one game. This minigame returned in the Winter Festival (2023). This minigame, along with the Pet Rescue Minigame, is located in the Winter Village. In this game, Burt puts either coal or gingerbread in the five presents. Three presents contain gingerbread and the other two contain coal. Then, he shuffles them up. The player has to avoid opening the gifts containing coal and try to focus on the gingerbread. There are a total of three rounds in each game of present shuffle. During each round, the presents switch spots 6 times, and you can choose 3 presents to open. You can get a minimum of 150 if you do all three rounds by getting 2 coal presents and 1 present with 50 each round. You can also get a maximum of 1,200 in one game.

wiki.notes: These items can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, they provide a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Orca is an ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 1, 2022, as part of the Star Rewards Refresh update. It can be obtained through hatching Gemstone Eggs, Basic Eggs, Crystal Eggs, or Admin Abuse Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Orca was formerly obtainable from the second page of the Star Rewards until September 11, 2026, requiring 600 Stars to unlock. The Orca features a black whale with a white underbelly and white patches near its eyes. It has a patch behind its fin. It has two black flippers, a short black fin on top, a black tail, and two beady black eyes. Here are the tricks the Orca learns in order: The Neon Orca glows light yellow on its underbelly, behind its fin, and behind its eyes. The Mega Neon Orca glows in the same places as the Neon Orca, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.notes: There is a 2.5% chance of obtaining an Orchid Butterfly from the Goldenrod Flower. Here are the tricks the Orchid Butterfly learns in order: The Neon Orchid Butterfly glows deep pink on its antennae and the edges of its wings. The Mega Neon Orchid Butterfly glows in the same areas as the Neon Orchid Butterfly, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Orchid Racer is a limited ultra-rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on September 1, 2022. wiki.notes: The Orchid Racer features a brownish-orange plant pot for a car hood, green leaves for fenders, and four black wheels with yellow centers. It has three yellow lights (two on its front and one near the middle) and a pink and magenta seating area; this seating area is thought to resemble an orchid. This vehicle has two dark-blue seats. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Ornament Balloon is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 8, 2023, as part of the Winter Festival (2023). It was obtainable by claiming it from the event's Advent Calendar on day eight. Since its day has passed, the Ornament Balloon is now only obtainable through trading.

Its design is the same as the Christmas Ball Ornament and the ornament found on the Bauble Balloon. Players can click or press their screen to throw it. When thrown, an equipped pet will chase after it and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Ornate Horned Frog is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 29, 2024. Players were able to purchase it outside the Nursery for 1,500. It left the game one week after its release on March 7, 2024, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Ornate Horned Frog features a green body with red markings. It has two beady black eyes, brown horns, a beige and cream colored underbelly, and four green feet. Here are the tricks the Ornate Horned Frog learns in order: The Neon Ornate Horned Frog glows bright pink on its markings. The Mega Neon Ornate Horned Frog glows in the same areas as the Neon Ornate Horned Frog, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Oryx is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 25, 2024. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Desert Eggs, Royal Desert Eggs, or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Oryx features two long black horns, a white face with black patches, two beady eyes, white ears, and black inner ears. It has a tan body, with black fur, a black tail, a white underbelly, and white and black feet. Here are the tricks the Oryx learns in order: The Neon Oryx glows teal on the top of its feet its inner ears, its nose bridge, the markings under its eyes, its back fur, its underbelly, its tail-tip, and the stripes on its horns. The Mega Neon Oryx glows in the same areas as the Neon Oryx, except those areas cycle through the color of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ostrich is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on July 13, 2023. Players were able to purchase this pet in the Safari Zone next to the Accessory Shop for 1,300. It can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Ostrich features a beige body with a long curved neck, an orange beak, and black and white feathers. Here are the tricks the Ostrich learns in order: The Neon Ostrich glows bright purple on its beak, collar, tail, and on its feet. The Mega Neon Ostrich glows in the same areas as the Neon Ostrich, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Otter is a common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2019, along with the Pets update. Originally, players could obtain it by hatching a Cracked Egg or a Pet Egg, but as of July 21, 2022, the Otter can only be obtained by hatching a Retired Egg or trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 5% chance of hatching an Otter from a Retired Egg. The Otter has a dark brown body with two black beady eyes, feet, and a tan snout with a black nose. The Otter also has two small ears and a tail at the back of its body. It also has circular feet. Here are the tricks the Otter learns in order: The Neon Otter glows bright yellow on its tail, feet, nose, and inner ears. The Mega Neon Otter glows in the same areas as the Neon Otter, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Premium Sticker Pack for 50; players have a 35% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Otter Sticker features a cartoon Otter.

wiki.availability: The Owl is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2019, along with the Farm Egg. As it is now unavailable, the Owl can only be obtained by hatching any remaining Farm Eggs or through trading.

The Owl features a round brown body with a cream face that holds two beady black eyes and a brown beak. It has two small brown wings and two darker cream feet. Listed below are the tricks the Owl learns in order: The Neon Owl glows a bright peach color around its body and wings. The Mega Neon Owl glows in the same areas as the Neon Owl, except those areas cycle through the colors of red, magenta, white, yellow, and white.

wiki.availability: The Owl Wings are limited ultra-rare wing pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on May 11, 2023. They can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Wing Chest for 600; players have a 6% chance of unboxing them. The Owl Wings can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Owl Wings feature off-white wings with light brown feathers near the center and ends. They have a ridge of black feathers along the middle. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back when it is flown.

wiki.availability: The Owlbear is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 8, 2023. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Danger Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 4% chance of hatching a legendary pet from the Danger Egg, but only a 2% chance of hatching an Owlbear. The Owlbear features two light pink feet, and a light pink heart shaped face with two black eyes and a black beak. It has a navy blue body with two arms, and its stomach, ears, and wings are a dark blue with yellow triangle pieces scattered around. The tips of its wings are a sunset pink color. Here are the tricks the Owlbear learns in order: The Neon Owlbear glows blue on its feet, arms, the fur around its head and neck, and parts of its stomach. The Mega Neon Owlbear glows in the same areas as the Neon Owlbear, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ox is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 2, 2021, alongside the Lunar New Year (2021) event. Players could purchase the Ox Box for 350. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained by opening any remaining Ox Boxes or through trading.

It has two golden horns and gold accessories such as gold rings around its neck, gold ring on its nose, and a golden flower on its forehead. Here are the tricks the Ox learns in order: The Neon Ox glows bright orange on its horns, golden accessories, inside of the ears, and the tip of its tail. The Mega Neon Ox glows in the same areas as the Neon Ox, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ox Box is a limited ultra-rare gift in Adopt Me! that was released on February 2, 2021, as part of the Lunar New Year (2021) event. Players could purchase it on the Lunar New Year stand for 350. Since the event ended, the Ox Box is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: Players can receive an Ox, a Lunar Ox or a Metal Ox from an Ox Box. There is a 60% chance of obtaining an Ox, a 30% chance of obtaining a Lunar Ox, and a 10% chance of obtaining a Metal Ox. The Ox Box is a miniature model of the Lunar House, but with less details. It features a brown box with three holes on each side, surrounded with golden lining. On top, there is a red roof and golden edges, accommodating the size of the box.

wiki.availability: The Paddle Ball Rattle is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 21, 2024, as part of the Summer State Fair (2024). Players could purchase the Paddle Ball Rattle for 300. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Paddle Ball Rattle features a light brown handle connected to a paddle. The paddle has a blue ring around a red circle in the center. A white string with a red ball on the end is connected to the center. The Paddle Ball Rattle tends to serve no purpose other than just being a fun interactable item. To interact with this rattle, a player can click or press the screen to shake.

wiki.availability: The Pain au Chat is an ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 18, 2026, alongside the Cat Cafe. It is obtainable through hatching the Basic Egg and Crystal Egg, which can be purchased for 400 and 4,000 respectively. It is otherwise obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Pain au Chat learns in order: The Neon Pain au Chat glows pastel blue on its chest swirl, back stripes, feet, inner ears, and tail drizzle. The Mega Neon Pain au Chat glows in the same areas as the Neon Pain au Chat, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Paint Roller Truck is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on April 27, 2023. Players could have purchased it on its stand near the Playground for 5,000. The Paint Roller Truck left the game on May 11, 2023, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Paint Roller Truck features a large cylindrical roller. It has a yellow structure with gray insides and dabs of multicolored paint throughout. It has two small yellow lights at the top and multiple multicolored paintbrushes in the back trunk. It has two large black wheels with yellow axles and two brown seats. It leaves a color-customizable trail behind it as it moves. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Paint Sealer is a legendary toy that was added to Adopt Me! on April 27, 2023. It is purchasable for 20 on a stand in the Salon next to Rusty, being a permanent gamepass addition to the game. The Paint Sealer can also be obtained by placing an Ice Soup Bait into a Box Lure or a Cozy Home Lure, where there is a 2% chance of obtaining one from the lures. It can also be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: It was previously obtainable from the Campfire Cookie at a 2% chance, and was also given to players for free during the Admin Abuse on May 2, 2026. The Paint Sealer features a cyan bottle with a gray and orange top and trigger. When in use, it emits a white cloud. The Paint Sealer allows players to keep colors from Pet Paints and free color options from the Salon permanently on a pet. This permanent coloring will only stay on pets while the player owns that pet and the permanent coloring is not retained when the pet is traded or made Neon or Mega Neon. When a player attempts to use the Paint Sealer, a pop-up will appear reading, "Keep your equipped pet's color?". If the player selects "Use", the Paint Sealer will be used on the equipped pet. If the player attempts to use the Paint Sealer without dyeing their pet's color, a pop-up will appear reading, “Your pet can’t use this right now!”. This item can only be used once. Players can talk to the NPC Rusty in the Salon to undo the effects of the Paint Sealer.

wiki.availability: The Paintbrush Leash is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Paintbrush Leash features a paintbrush with a red handle and yellow bristles. There is rainbow paint dripping down the bristles of the brush. When used, a multicolored line extends from the bristles. When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, a multicolored line will connect the Paintbrush Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The Palanquin Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on February 2, 2021, as part of the Lunar New Year (2021) event. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.
