It has a bill, which is a darker brown than its fur, and webbed feet and a tail in the same dark brown color. Here are the tricks the Platypus learns in order: The Neon Platypus glows light blue on its beak, tail, and feet. The Mega Neon Platypus glows in the same areas as the Neon Platypus, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Pleading Tarsier Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 3, 2026, as a part of the Pets Plus Refresh Update. It can be obtained through purchasing the Pets Plus subscription and opening the Vol. 2 Pets Plus Sticker Pack, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Pleading Tarsier Sticker features a cartoon Tarsier.

wiki.availability: The Pleather Boots are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on May 29, 2026, alongside the Journey to Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could purchase them for 1,900. They are now only obtainable through trading, as they left the game on June 5, 2026.

wiki.egg: Standard Gibbon Box and Premium Gibbon Box
wiki.availability: The Pluboneium Chew Toy is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on May 16, 2025, alongside the Gibbon Fairground. As the event ended on May 30, 2025, it is now only obtainable through trading or opening any remaining Standard Gibbon Boxes or Premium Gibbon Boxes.
wiki.notes: To interact with this item, a player can click or press their screen to throw the toy and their equipped pet will retrieve it and sit with it. The player can then click on their pet to get the item back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. During the Gibbon Fairground, players were able to trade in 3 Pluboneium Chew Toys and a Gibbon to create a Villain Gibbon.

wiki.egg: Small, Big, or Massive Old Gifts
wiki.availability: The Plunger Grappling Hook is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! which could have previously been obtained through opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts for 70, 199, or 499 respectively. As of the 2021 Gift Refresh update, the Gifts were replaced with another set of items. It can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Plunger Grappling Hook features a green body, black handle, yellow stripe and a red plunger. Like most grappling hooks, a brown string will appear from the middle of the plunger part of the grapple when launched. To interact with this item, a player can click/press anywhere on their screen to fire a hooked-cable and be pulled towards the target location. Like most other grappling hooks, players cannot use this item on non-solid graphical objects or if they are on a vehicle, doing an obby, flying or riding a pet.

wiki.availability: The Plunger Hat is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 5.6% and 3.3% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Plunger Hat was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Plunger Hat features a brown handle with a red cup attached to it. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Pocket Protector is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 100 while on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Pocket Protector is a white pocket that goes on the left side of a pet's body. Inside, there are 3 small pens - colored blue, black, and red respectively.

wiki.availability: The Pogo Stick is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that used to be located next to the Heart Balloons in the Toy Shop before it was remodeled. It was removed from the game on May 13, 2021, and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pogo Stick features a pole that was color-customizable upon purchase with black handles and footholds. As it is a pogo stick, it provides transportation by bouncing instead of walking.

wiki.availability: The Poinsettia Hair Clip is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on December 7, 2023, as part of the Winter Festival (2023). It was obtainable by claiming it from the event's Advent Calendar on day seven. Since its day has passed, the Poinsettia Hair Clip is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Poinsettia Hair Clip features a flower with six dark red petals, two green leaves, and a yellow cyathia. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Poinsettia Leash is a limited common toy in Adopt Me!. It could be bought during the Winter Holiday (2021) for 6,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Poinsettia Leash features a handle with four green leaves, six triangular, dark red flower petals, and a yellow base. When used, a red line extends from this item. When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, a red line will connect the Poinsettia Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The Poison Dart Frog is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 8, 2023, along with the Danger Egg. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by hatching any remaining Danger Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 20% chance of hatching a rare pet from the Danger Egg, but only a 10% chance of hatching a Poison Dart Frog. The Poison Dart Frog features a round body with an orange top and dark blue underbelly. It has black spots on its underbelly, four dark blue feet, and black eyes. Here are the tricks the Poison Dart Frog learns in order: The Neon Poison Dart Frog glows green on its spots and underbelly. The Mega Neon Poison Dart Frog glows in the same areas as the Neon Poison Dart Frog, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Polar Bear is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released alongside the Christmas Event (2019) on December 14, 2019. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained by hatching any remaining Christmas Eggs at a 7.25% chance or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Polar Bear features a similar shape to the Brown Bear, except with a white body, a light-gray muzzle, and gray inner ears and tail. Listed below are the tricks the Polar Bear learns in order: The Neon Polar Bear glows cyan on its inner ears, arms, feet, and tail. The Mega Neon Polar Bear glows in the same areas as the Neon Polar Bear, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Polar Bear Plush is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released around December 2018. Players could obtain it by opening a Small Gift or Big Gift, which cost 70 and 199 respectively. The Polar Bear Plush is no longer in the current Gifts rotation and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Polar Bear Plush features a polar bear mesh that is wearing a spiky orange collar around its neck. To interact with the Plush, the player can click on their screen to hug it. The Polar Bear Plush has a pet counterpart known as the Polar Bear, but it uses a different model.

wiki.availability: The Police Cap is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 16, 2025, alongside the Gibbon Fairground. Players could have obtained it by crafting an Officer Gibbon (trading in a normal Gibbon and three Whistle Necklaces). It can now only be obtained through trading, as the event ended on May 30, 2025.
wiki.notes: Despite the Police Cap coming with the Officer Gibbon, players are able to place it on any pet. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Polymorph Potion is an ultra-rare potion in Adopt Me! that was released on May 15, 2026. Players can earn it as a reward for aging up their pets, or obtain it through trading.
wiki.notes: From May 15, 2026 to May 22, 2026, the Polymorph Potion was not available as a reward for aging up pets, and could instead be brewed in Tim's cauldron using 7 Tim's Eaten Sandwich and 7 Is That a Mustache? ingredients. The Polymorph Potion can be fed to a pet to temporarily make it appear to be another, random pet when equipped for 10 minutes. Its appearance in the player's inventory does not change. The time left until the effect wears off will only go down while the pet the Polymorph Potion was fed to is equipped.

wiki.availability: The Pomeranian is an ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 1, 2022, as part of the Star Rewards Refresh update. It can be obtained through hatching Gemstone Eggs, Basic Eggs, Crystal Eggs, or Admin Abuse Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Pomeranian was formerly obtainable from the second page of the Star Rewards until September 11, 2026, requiring 400 Stars to unlock. The Pomeranian features a tan-colored dog with fluffy, beige fur on its chest. It has a pink tongue and beige inner ears. It also has a black nose along with two black eyes. Here are the tricks the Pomeranian learns in order: The Neon Pomeranian glows light yellow on both its ears and tail. The Mega Neon Pomeranian glows in the same areas as the Neon Pomeranian, except these areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Pony Box is a limited legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was released during week two of the Winter Event (2022). Players could purchase it in the Candy Castle for 14,000. As the event has ended, the Pony Box can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: By opening a Pony Box, there is an 87.5% chance of unboxing a Shetland Pony Dark Brown, a 10% chance of unboxing a Shetland Pony White, and a 2.5% chance of unboxing a Shetland Pony Light Brown. The Pony Box features a light brown box with dark brown edges, a tuft of beige likely representing a Shetland Pony's tail sticking out of its side, and a black strap with a yellow stirrup; the top is shaped to resemble a saddle, having an orange middle and brown sides.

wiki.availability: The Ponytail is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It was obtainable through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on August 22, 2025, it can now only be obtained through trading.

The Poodle is an uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 21, 2022. Players are able to hatch it from the Pet Egg, Cracked Egg, Royal Egg, Basic Egg or Admin Abuse Egg. It can otherwise be obtained through trading. The Poodle was formerly obtainable from the Crystal Egg from September 12, 2025 to February 20, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Poodle features a white body with fluff on top of its head, the end of its tail, its paws, and its ears. On its face is a black nose and two beady black eyes. The insides of its ears are pink. Listed below are the tricks the Poodle learns in order: The Neon Poodle glows pink on its ears, paws, nose, the fluff on top of its head, and the end of its tail. The Mega Neon Poodle glows in the same areas as the Neon Poodle, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Poodle Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Premium Sticker Pack for 50; players have a 30% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Poodle Sticker features a cartoon Poodle.

wiki.availability: The Pool Noodle is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released alongside the 2019 Summer Update. It could have been found and purchased in the Pool Shop for 100. It was removed from the game on March 9, 2023, and has been replaced with the Party Pool Noodle. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pool Noodle features a long, cylindrical flotation device. It was color-customizable upon purchase. The Pool Noodle is purely a cosmetic item.

wiki.availability: Popcorn is a common food item in Adopt Me!. It can be used/interacted with five times before it disappears from the player's inventory. Popcorn can be fed to a baby or a pet to fulfill the "Hungry" ailment.
wiki.notes: It was previously could be found between the Hotdogs and Cake at Green Groceries for 2, but was removed after the Farm Shop was released. It can now only be obtained for free in the VIP room or through trading. The Popcorn's appearance is a red and white striped popcorn box. The shape of the box is square shaped. The Popcorn itself is a light pastel yellow.

wiki.availability: The Popcorn Plush is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 28, 2024, as part of the third week of the Summer State Fair (2024). Players could purchase the Popcorn Plush for 4,900. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Popcorn Plush features a striped red-and-white box with yellow popcorn inside. At the front of the box, there are two black eyes and a small mouth. Being a plush, the player will only hug the Popcorn Plush when it is interacted with.

wiki.availability: The Popsicle Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Popsicle Stroller features a blue, white, and red colored stroller in the shape of two popsicles connected to each other, with a wheel between the two. The sticks on the popsicles point upwards. This item can transport two pets or babies at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Possum is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 16, 2023, as part of the Camping Shop Refresh. Players were able to purchase it for 800 in the Camping Shop. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on May 30, 2025 when it was replaced by the Muskrat.
wiki.notes: The Possum features a light gray body and head, with a white underbelly and large white mark on its head. It has light gray outer ears and white inner ears. It also has a light gray tuft of fur on its head, along with a pink tail, nose, and feet with black whiskers on its snout. Here are the tricks the Possum learns in order: The Neon Possum glows pale blue on its inner ears, face, underbelly, and tail. The Mega Neon Possum glows in the same areas as the Neon Possum, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Postie Van is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on November 28, 2025. Players were able to obtain it through trading in any 100 pet accessories or toys from their inventory. It is now only obtainable through trading with other players, as it left the game on December 5, 2025.
wiki.notes: This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Potato Chew Toy, true to its name, features a light brown-colored potato with two large, bulging dark brown eyes and a small mouth. It also has a few darker spots around its body, imitating the surface of a potato.
wiki.notes: To interact with this item, a player can click/press their screen to throw the chew toy onto the ground, where an equipped pet will pick it up and chew it. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Potion Bottle Balloon is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 6, 2022, along with the Halloween Event (2022). It could have been purchased for 1,250 in the event's shop. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Potion Bottle Balloon features a long brown handle topped with a light yellow potion in a clear bottle; this bottle has a brown cork. The Potion Bottle Balloon allows a player to jump higher when equipped.

wiki.availability: The Potion Necklace is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.8% and 5.5% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Potion Necklace was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Potion Necklace features a small vial with visible turquoise fluid inside. It has a tan string with the vial dangling from it. This pet accessory goes around a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Potion Stroller is a limited uncommon stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on October 18, 2024, as part of the third week of the Halloween Event (2024). Players could have purchased it for 9,000 from the lab building or the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon. The Potion Stroller can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Potion Stroller features a circular bottle topped with a brown stopper, tied off with a brown ribbon with a tag imprinted with a paw print, and filled with glowing blue liquid. It has two brown wheels connected by blue drills. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Powerbike is a limited ultra-rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on April 25, 2025, alongside week 4 of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). Players were able to purchase it for 60,000 during the event or from the item rotation in the Cherry Blossom Wagon. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Praying Mantis Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2026, alongside the second week of the Sugar Festival Event (2026). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Sugarfest 2026 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Praying Mantis Sticker features a cartoon Praying Mantis.

wiki.availability: The Preferred Potion is an ultra-rare potion in Adopt Me! that was released on May 15, 2026. Players can earn it as a reward for aging up their pets, or obtain it through trading.
wiki.notes: From May 15, 2026 to May 22, 2026, the Polymorph Potion was not available as a reward for aging up pets, and could instead be brewed in Tim's cauldron using 7 Definitely Not a Fork! and 8 Tim's Eaten Sandwich ingredients. The Preferred Potion can be fed to a pet to give it a random need with a preferred item that provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Prehistoric Car is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on May 3, 2024, as part of the second week of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). Players could obtain it by purchasing the Fossil Isle Returns Bundle, which also came with the Expandable Dino House, for 800. On April 24, 2026, the Fossil Isle Returns Bundle was added to the Final Stop Shop and discounted to 499 before leaving the game on May 1, 2026. The Prehistoric Car can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Prehistoric Car features a crudely made vehicle with its body consisting of logs and bones tied together with rope. It has three stone wheels, and a red canopy draped over four bones. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Premium Camping Tent is an ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 17, 2022, as part of the Woodland Egg update. It is obtainable by purchasing the Camping Kit for 170 (formerly 200) or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Premium Camping Tent is a large circular tent that has a cream sheet with a peak at the center. The tent is held by a wooden pillar at the center as well as ten strings which are tied on the ground with pegs. Inside is a brown floor with three cream Sleeping Bags on it. The Premium Camping Tent can hold three players or pets and can be placed on flat surfaces in Adoption Island. It replenishes the 'Sleepy' ailment for babies and pets.

wiki.availability: The Premium Capuchin Box is a limited legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was released on April 5, 2024, along with the Capuchin Fairground event. It cost 100. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
The Premium Fire Pit is an ultra-rare toy that was added to Adopt Me! on March 17, 2022. It can be obtained by purchasing the Camping Kit for 170 (formerly 200) or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Premium Fire Pit features a gray pit made out of bricks, containing dark brown wooden logs, and a yellow fire. The Premium Fire Pit can be placed on flat surfaces in Adoption Island.

wiki.availability: The Premium Gibbon Box is a limited legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was released on May 16, 2025, alongside the Gibbon Fairground. It was purchasable for 100. It is now only obtainable through trading, as the event ended on May 30, 2025.
wiki.notes: When a player opens a Premium Gibbon Box, they receive two items. For every 40 Gibbon Boxes of either type a player opened, they were guaranteed a Ringmaster Gibbon, which they could have claimed from the Task Board or Ringmaster Gibbon NPC.

wiki.availability: The Premium Gorilla Box is a limited legendary gift that was released during the Gorilla Fairground event on March 16, 2023. It cost 195. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: Every time one is opened, there is a 90% chance to get a Gorilla and a 10% chance to get an Albino Gorilla, as well as two other items. If players unbox an Albino Gorilla, they also receive three pet accessories: the Bow Tie, Top Hat, and Walking Cane.

wiki.availability: The Premium Log Bench is an ultra-rare toy that was added to Adopt Me! on March 17, 2022. It can be obtained by purchasing the Camping Kit for 170 (formerly 200) or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Premium Log Bench can seat three players and can be placed on flat surfaces in the Adoption Island.

wiki.availability: The Premium Monkey Box is a limited legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was released on May 28, 2020, as part of the Monkey Fairground event. Players could purchase it in the circus tent for 195. Since the event ended, the Premium Monkey Box is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: By opening a Premium Monkey Box, players receive a Monkey or an Albino Monkey, as well as two other items. The Premium Monkey Box features a box illuminating a yellow glow. It has red and white curtains, and yellow frills containing evenly-spaced white lights. At the top of the Premium Monkey Box, there is a red and yellow tent cover and a blue flag. The box resembles an wind-up jack-in-the-box toy and contains a blue winding handle with a displayed paw print, connected by a silver rod on the side. For every Premium Monkey Box opened, players have a 90% chance of obtaining a rare Monkey, while there is a 10% chance of obtaining a legendary Albino Monkey. Players also receive two of these items below:

wiki.availability: The Premium Sticker Pack is a legendary sticker pack in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles update. It can be purchased in the Toy Shop for 50 or obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: When the Premium Sticker Pack is opened, the player receives ten stickers. For each sticker, there is a 35% chance of getting an uncommon, a 30% chance of getting a rare, a 25% chance of getting an ultra-rare, a 9.99% chance of getting a non-animated legendary, and a 0.01% chance of getting a Bat Dragon Cuddle Animated Sticker. The available stickers are displayed on the board next to it.

wiki.availability: The Preppy Sweater is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 5, 2024, along with the Capuchin Fairground. Players could obtain it by crafting a Preppy Capuchin Monkey (combining a normal Capuchin Monkey and three Cool Sunglasses). As the event has ended, the Preppy Sweater can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Despite the Preppy Sweater coming with the Preppy Capuchin Monkey, players are able to place it on any pet. The Preppy Sweater, as true to its name, features a tan sweater. This pet accessory is worn on the pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Prescription Glasses are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 100 when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Prescription Glasses have a black rim and clear lenses. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's face, and sits on the nose.

wiki.availability: The Pretty Please Snowball Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on August 1, 2024. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Pets Plus Sticker Packs, which were received when purchasing the Pets Plus subscription for 299, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Pretty Please Snowball Sticker features a cartoon Snowball Pet with a pleading expression. It has two hand symbols underneath its body, with one hand pointing to the right and the other hand pointing to the left.

wiki.availability: The Pretty Pony is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 21, 2024, as part of the second week of the Summer State Fair (2024). Players could obtain the Pretty Pony by leveling their Pony Pass in the Speedy Stables minigame. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pretty Pony features a pink body with a white underbelly and four cherry pink feet. It has a baby pink mane and tail. On its face, it has two black eyes, pink ears with white insides, and a white nose. There are red bows adorning its head, tail, and chest. It also features a small heart-shaped mark on its body. Here are the tricks the Pretty Pony learns in order: The Neon Pretty Pony glows pink on its mane, inner ears, tail, underbelly, and heart patterns. The Mega Neon Pretty Pony glows in the same areas as the Neon Pretty Pony, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Pretty Pony Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on July 5, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Summer State Fair (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained by opening any remaining State Fair Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pretty Pony Sticker features a cartoon Pretty Pony.

wiki.availability: The Pretty Red Bow is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 125 while on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Pretty Red Bow features a bright red bow. This pet accessory is placed on the back of a pet's head. It bears a similar appearance to the Red Ribbon. However, the Red Ribbon goes on the side of a pet's head instead of the back.

wiki.availability: The Pretzel Eye Patch is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on June 21, 2024, as part of the Summer State Fair (2024). Players could purchase the Pretzel Eye Patch for 400. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pretzel Eye Patch features a brown pretzel with salt sprinkled on it. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's eye.

wiki.availability: The Priceless Jewel is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on July 11, 2025, alongside week two of the Summer Festival (2025). Players could have obtained it by using Treasure Keys at a 16.67% chance or purchasing 5 Priceless Jewels for 199. It is now only obtainable through trading, as the event has ended.
wiki.notes: During the Summer Festival (2025), players could obtain a Priceless Shrimp by trading 5 Priceless Jewels and an Emperor Shrimp to the Shrimp Trader. The Priceless Jewel now acts as a plush, and is hugged when a player clicks their screen with it equipped.

wiki.availability: The Priceless Shrimp is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 11, 2025, alongside week two of the Summer Festival (2025).
wiki.notes: Players could turn an Emperor Shrimp into a Priceless Shrimp by using 5 Priceless Jewels. Players had a 16.67% chance to obtain a Priceless Jewel when opening a chest in the Summer Festival (2025) event area with Treasure Keys, which cost 550 each. The Priceless Shrimp is now only obtainable through trading, as the event has ended. Here are the tricks the Priceless Shrimp learns in order: The Neon Priceless Shrimp glows yellow on its crown, antennae, underbody, parts of its tail, and on the spots around its eyes, while the jewels on its back glow light blue, red, and purple. The Mega Neon Priceless Shrimp glows in the same areas as the Neon Priceless Shrimp, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Priceless Shrimp Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on July 25, 2025, alongside week four of the Summer Festival (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Summer 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Priceless Shrimp Sticker features a cartoon Priceless Shrimp.

wiki.availability: The Pride Balloons are limited uncommon toys in Adopt Me! that were released on June 1, 2023, along with the Pride Event (2023). They could have been purchased at the Pride Stand for 50. As the event has ended, the Pride Balloons can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pride Balloons feature several heart-shaped balloons of different colors and sizes, which are tied to white strings. The Pride Balloons increase a player's jump height when equipped.

wiki.availability: The Pride Earrings are a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on June 9, 2022, along with the Pride Event (2022). Players could purchase it on the Pride Stand for 50. As the event has ended, the Pride Earrings can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pride Earrings feature a pair of rainbow-shaped earrings with small blue hooks. The rainbows are colored with red, yellow, and blue. On either side of each rainbow, there is a small white cloud. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's ears or on the sides of its head.

wiki.availability: The Pride Flag is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 9, 2022. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand for 50; the Pride Stand could be found near the Playground and left the game on June 16, 2022. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pride Flag features a pride flag with a white handle; this handle has a small yellow knob on its tip. The colors of the flag include white, pink, light blue, brown, black, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and violet. It also has a yellow sun symbol in the corner of the flag. It has a pet accessory counterpart, the LGBTQ Pride Pin. To wave the flag, the player can click anywhere on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Pride Flag 2023 is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 1, 2023. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand near the Playground for 50. It can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Pride Flag 2023 features a Pride Flag, the only difference being the rainbow string that is intertwined along the flagpole and a Pride Paw Flying Disc at the top of the pole. To wave the flag, a player can click anywhere on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Pride Glasses are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on June 9, 2022. They were available for purchase at the Pride Stand for 50; the Pride Stand could be found near the Playground and left the game on June 16, 2022. They can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pride Glasses feature a pair of glasses with white, heart-shaped frames and rainbow lenses; these rainbow lenses are meant to reference the LGBTQ+ flag and consist of vertical color stripes. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Pride Headphones are a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on June 9, 2022. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand for 50; the Pride Stand could be found near the Playground and left the game on June 16, 2022. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pride Headphones feature red, orange, yellow, and green stripes on the outside and blue and purple stripes on the inside. White ear cushions are present on the circular part of the headphones. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Pride Paw Flying Disc is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 1, 2023, along with the Pride Event (2023). It could have been purchased on the Pride Stand for 50. As the event has ended, the Pride Paw Flying Disc can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pride Paw Flying Disc features a paw print with the LBGTQ+ flag and a white border. When interacted with, the Pride Paw Flying Disc is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Pride Sticker Pack is a rare sticker pack in Adopt Me! that was released on June 14, 2024, along with the Summer State Fair (2024). It could be purchased on the Pride Stand near the Playground for 50. It is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: When the Pride Sticker Pack is opened, the player receives ten stickers, all of which are rare.

wiki.availability: The Pride Wand Rattle is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 1, 2023, along with the Pride Event (2023). It could have been purchased on the Pride Stand for 50. As the event has ended, the Pride Wand Rattle can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pride Wand Rattle has a light blue handle with a rainbow colored ribbon winding down it, and a yellow star at the top of the rattle. To interact with the Pride Wand Rattle, the player can click on their screen to shake it.

wiki.availability: The Pride Wings are a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on June 9, 2022. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand for 50. The Pride Stand could have been found near the Playground and left the game on June 16, 2022. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pride Wings feature two large multicolored wings; each wing consists of multiple feathers, each of which are colored in different colors of the rainbow. The top edge of each wing consists of red feathers. This pet accessory can be worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Primal Kaijunior is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 18, 2025, alongside the third week of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). It was obtainable through purchasing and opening a Kaijunior Box for 12,000 during the event or from the item rotation in the Cherry Blossom Wagon. It can now only be obtained through trading or opening any remaining Kaijunior Boxes.
wiki.notes: There is a 5% chance of obtaining a Primal Kaijunior from the Kaijunior Box. Here are the tricks the Primal Kaijunior learns in order: The Neon Primal Kaijunior glows white on its underbelly, spines, nostrils, claws, and the spots around its eyes. The Mega Neon Primal Kaijunior glows in the same areas as the Neon Primal Kaijunior, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Primal Kaijunior Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 25, 2025, alongside week 4 of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Cherry Blossom 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Primal Kaijunior Sticker features a cartoon Primal Kaijunior.

wiki.availability: The Prince Carriage is a limited legendary six-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released during 2019. It was obtainable by purchasing the Royal Carriages gamepass, which cost 1,499. Since this gamepass ended up in the Final Stop Shop and left the game on May 18, 2023, the Prince Carriage is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The carriage has a wooden frame and a supplementary blue color that covers the rear arches, the doors, and the rims. It has gold seats, a gold crown on top, and wheels with blue circle pattern rims which are gold on the outside. The wheels themselves are cowered in wood and a black material that is possibly meant to resemble tires. Unlike the rest of the carriages, the Prince Carriage lacks a proper roof and doesn't have glass panes on the doors. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Princess Booties are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on April 5, 2024, along with the Capuchin Fairground. Players could obtain them by crafting a Princess Capuchin Monkey (combining a normal Capuchin Monkey and three Tutus). As the event has ended, the Princess Booties can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Despite the Princess Booties coming with the Princess Capuchin Monkey, players are able to place them on any pet. The Princess Booties feature pink boots with darker pink rims and heels, a white lining, and pink laces. These pet accessories go on a pet's feet.

wiki.availability: The Princess Booties are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on April 5, 2024, along with the Capuchin Fairground. Players could obtain them by crafting a Princess Capuchin Monkey (combining a normal Capuchin Monkey and three Tutus). As the event has ended, the Princess Booties can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Despite the Princess Booties coming with the Princess Capuchin Monkey, players are able to place them on any pet. The Princess Booties feature pink boots with darker pink rims and heels, a white lining, and pink laces. These pet accessories go on a pet's feet.

wiki.availability: The Princess Carriage is a limited legendary six-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released in 2019. It was obtainable by purchasing the Royal Carriages gamepass, which cost 1,499. Since this gamepass ended up in the Final Stop Shop and left the game on May 18, 2023, the Princess Carriage is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Princess Carriage is an opulent-looking carriage with a pink exterior with a gold crown on top, gold seats, and white and gold wheels, and a white interior. The interior itself features seating for four, and there are an additional two seats on the outside, so people can ride in the back of the carriage. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Princess Mare is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 29, 2026, alongside the Fairytale Egg. It is obtainable through hatching Fairytale Eggs for 750, Basic Eggs for 400, Admin Abuse Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 15% chance of hatching the Princess Mare from the Fairytale Egg. Here are the tricks the Princess Mare learns in order: The Neon Princess Mare glows light purple on its mane and tail. The Mega Neon Princess Mare glows in the same areas as the Neon Princess Mare, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Princess Rattle is a limited uncommon toy that was added to Adopt Me! as part of the new gift rotation on March 18, 2021. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Princess Rattle features a golden crown on the top and has a purple and gold handle. Near the middle, it has a pink bow with a blue pearl. To interact with this item, a player can click their screen with the rattle equipped to shake it.

wiki.availability: The Princess Stroller is a rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on June 24, 2021, along with the Baby Shop remodel. It can be obtained by purchasing it from the Baby Shop for 650. It can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Princess Stroller, as the name suggests, is a majestically designed stroller. It has a tan-colored cushion seat, pink inner wheels, stroller roof, gold outer wheels, push handle, and stroller holders. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Prism Snake is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 31, 2025, alongside the second week of the Lunar New Year (2025). Players could have purchased it for 40. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on February 14, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Prism Snake originally left the game on February 7, 2025, but returned on February 12, 2025 for the last 48 hours of the Lunar New Year (2025). Here are the tricks the Prism Snake learns in order: The Neon Prism Snake glows yellow on its head horns and underbelly, while the top half of its body glows blue and the bottom half glows red. The Mega Neon Prism Snake glows in the same areas as the Neon Prism Snake, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Prismatic Butterfly is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released as a part of the return of the Butterfly Sanctuary on June 6, 2025. Players were able to obtain it using a Snapdragon Flower, which cost 25. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it was replaced by the Moonbeam Butterfly on June 13, 2025.
wiki.notes: There was a 4% chance of obtaining a Prismatic Butterfly from the Snapdragon Flower. It was only available during the day. Here are the tricks the Prismatic Butterfly learns in order: The Neon Prismatic Butterfly glows the colors of the rainbow on the sections of its wings, white on the spots lining the edges of its wings, and light green on its antennae and back spots. The Mega Neon Prismatic Butterfly glows in the same areas as the Neon Prismatic Butterfly, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Propeller is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that could have been found in the Toy Shop for 1,200. It was removed from the game on May 13, 2021, and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Propeller features a beige handle connecting to four white propeller blades, topped with a pink tip surrounded by two white rings. To interact with this item, the player can click anywhere on their screen to be propelled upwards. To stop, a player must jump while the propeller is in use.

wiki.availability: The Propeller Hat is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2020. It was purchasable in the Accessory Shop for 500 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on April 28, 2022.
wiki.notes: The Propeller Hat features a brightly colored spherical hat divided into equal sections of blue, red, and yellow. It is topped with a tiny blue propeller. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.egg: Small, Big, and Massive Old Gifts
wiki.availability: The Protein Bottle Rattle is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that could have been obtained by opening Gifts. It was previously available through opening Small, Big, and Massive Gifts.
wiki.notes: As of the 2021 Gift Refresh update, the Gifts were replaced with another set of items. Protein Bottle Rattle can now only be obtained through trading. The Protein Bottle Rattle holds a brown-colored liquid inside a clear container with a blue lid. To interact with this toy, the player can click/press their screen to shake it. This rattle is only used for leisure. Other than that, it does not serve any specific purpose.

wiki.availability: The Psionic Magic Grappling Hook is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It can be opened from Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. It can otherwise be obtained through opening Admin Abuse Boxes or trading.
wiki.notes: To interact with this item, a player can click anywhere on their screen to fire a pink cable that allows them to be pulled towards their target location. Like other grappling hooks, players cannot use this item on non-solid graphical objects, if they are on a vehicle, doing an obby, flying or riding a pet.

wiki.availability: The Pterodactyl is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2020. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through trading or hatching any remaining Fossil Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 25% chance of hatching a rare pet from the Fossil Egg, but only an 8.33% chance of hatching a Pterodactyl. The Pterodactyl features a dark gray-blue body with a yellow underbelly and feet. It has a long, red bit protruding from the top of its head and a long, yellow beak coming from the bottom of its head. While its wings are mainly dark gray-blue, the tips are red. Two black eyes can be seen on its face. Here are the tricks the Pterodactyl learns in order: The Neon Pterodactyl glows purple on its crest, the edges of its wings, and its feet. The Mega Neon Pterodactyl glows in the same areas as the Neon Pterodactyl, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Pterodactyl Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Fossil Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pterodactyl Sticker features a cartoon Pterodactyl.

wiki.availability: The Pterodactyl Wings are limited uncommon wing pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on September 15, 2022.
wiki.notes: They could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Wing Chest for 150; players had a 33% chance of unboxing them. The Regal Wing Chest can be found in a room in the Sky Castle. As their rotation has now passed, the Pterodactyl Wings can now only be obtained through trading. The Pterodactyl Wings feature slim red wings with black lines through their middles. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back when the pet is flown.

wiki.availability: The Puckered Up Pufferfish Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 3, 2026, as a part of the Pets Plus Refresh Update. It can be obtained through purchasing the Pets Plus subscription and opening the Vol. 2 Pets Plus Sticker Pack, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Puckered Up Pufferfish Sticker features a cartoon Puffer Fish.

wiki.availability: The Pudding Cat is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 1, 2023, as a part of the 2023 April Fools update.
wiki.notes: It is obtainable by hatching a Fool Egg. Since the Fool Egg left the game on April 8, 2023, the Pudding Cat is now only obtainable through trading or by hatching any remaining Fool Eggs. There is a 65% chance of hatching a Pudding Cat from a Fool Egg. The Pudding Cat features a brown cat with darker brown spots throughout, giving it is the appearance of a strawberry. It has tan frosting on its head, back, ear insides, tops of its feet and on its nose. It also has small black whiskers and green leaves on its back and on its nose. Here are the tricks the Pudding Cat learns in order: The Neon Pudding Cat glows mint green on its nose and the frosting on its head, body, and feet. The Mega Neon Pudding Cat glows in the same areas as the Neon Pudding Cat, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Pudding Cat Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on August 1, 2024. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Pets Plus Sticker Packs, which were received when purchasing the Pets Plus subscription for 299, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Pudding Cat Sticker features a cartoon Pudding Cat.

wiki.availability: The Puddleducks Hood is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 0.94% and 0.22% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on September 29, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Puddleducks Hood features a large yellow hood adorned with two small black eyes and an orange beak. It has a small tuft of fur sticking off the top and is similar in appearance to the Chick. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Puffer Fish is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 8, 2023. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Danger Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 16% chance of hatching an ultra-rare pet from the Danger Egg, but only a 5.3% chance of hatching a Puffer Fish. The Puffer Fish features a yellow body with an off-white underbelly. It has spikes on its body, two yellow fins, and two large black eyes. Here are the tricks the Puffer Fish learns in order: The Neon Puffer Fish glows cyan on its spikes, fins, in the area above its eyes, and underbelly. The Mega Neon Puffer Fish glows in the same areas as the Neon Puffer Fish, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Puffer Jacket is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 5% and 3% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On April 20, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Puffer Jacket was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Puffer Jacket features a bright yellow jacket with curves along its back side and two puffy sleeves. The jacket has a white underside and gray sleeve insides. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Puffin is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 1, 2021, as part of the Winter Holiday (2021). It could have been obtained by purchasing it in the Winter Market for 120,000. Since the event ended on January 6, 2022, the Puffin is now only obtainable through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Puffin features a white-gray chest, a black-colored back, and bright orange feet. It has two black wings held on either side of its body. On its face, it has small orange and gray designs, along with an orange beak and two shiny black eyes. These are the tricks the Puffin learns in order: The Neon Puffin glows cyan on its feathers. The Mega Neon Puffin glows in the same areas as the Neon Puffin, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Puffin Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on August 1, 2024. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Pets Plus Sticker Packs, which were received when purchasing the Pets Plus subscription for 299, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Puffin Sticker features a cartoon Puffin.

wiki.availability: The Puma is an uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2019, along with the Pets update. Originally, players could obtain it by hatching a Cracked Egg, a Pet Egg, or a Royal Egg, but as of July 21, 2022, the Puma can only be obtained by hatching a Retired Egg or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have an 8.75% chance of hatching a Puma from a Retired Egg. The Puma has a tan body and a lighter sand-colored underbelly. It has black eyes, a light pink nose, and three whiskers on each side of its nose. It also has triangle-shaped ears with darker tan insides. These are the tricks the Puma learns in order: The Neon Puma glows yellow on its nose, ears, feet, whiskers, and tail. The Mega Neon Puma glows in the same areas as the Neon Puma, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.
