wiki.availability: The Pumpkin is a temporary event pet from the Halloween Event (2020) that was removed on November 11, 2020. It was obtained after a player completed the Pumpkin Smash mini game for the first time. Players could not get any more Pumpkins after they received their first one. Once a player received it from the Pumpkin Smash, it was automatically able to fly and ride, and was full grown.
wiki.notes: This pet couldn't be traded or gifted, meaning there was no legitimate way of obtaining a Neon or Mega Neon version of the Pumpkin. The Pumpkin features an orange pumpkin with flat green leaves on the bottom and a curvy brown stem on top. The yellow eyes jiggle and wobble in their dark oval eye sockets. Here are the tricks the Pumpkin learns in order:

wiki.availability: The Pumpkin Basket Plushie is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 6, 2022, along with the Halloween Event (2022). Players could obtain it by purchasing it for 3,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Pumpkin Basket Plushie features a small orange pumpkin with multicolored treats inside. It has a brown handle, eyes, and a pink mouth. The Pumpkin Basket Plushie serves no purpose other than just being a cosmetic and interactable item. To shake this toy, the player can click on their screen.

wiki.addedEvent: The Pumpkin Carriage is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle that was available for purchase during the Halloween Event (2019)
wiki.availability: The Pumpkin Carriage is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle that was available for purchase during the Halloween Event (2019) for 63,000. As its respective event has passed, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: As its name suggests, the Pumpkin Carriage features a carriage in the shape of a pumpkin. The undercarriage resembles the stems of a pumpkin, which slightly spread over the wheels. The wheels are a dark brown color, which is presumably meant to resemble wood. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Pumpkin Friend is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 4, 2024, as part of the Halloween Event (2024). Players could have purchased the Pumpkin Friend in the lab building for 150. Although it was released at the start of the event, it was not purchasable until the sixth day, as players could only collect 25 every real life day during the first week of the event. As the Halloween Event (2024) has ended, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pumpkin Friend features an orange pumpkin with four green leaves on the bottom and a curved dark green stem on top. The pumpkin has two oval-shaped holes in it that serve as eye sockets for its yellow eyes. Here are the tricks the Pumpkin Friend learns in order: The Neon Pumpkin Friend glows orange on its pumpkin head. The Mega Neon Pumpkin Friend glows in the same areas as the Neon Pumpkin Friend, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Pumpkin Rattle is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was available during the Halloween Event (2017) for 1 Candy. It was removed from game on November 1, 2017, and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pumpkin Rattle features a rattle with an orange pumpkin on top and a gold handle. When held or shaken, it leaves behind an orange and black trail. To interact with this rattle, the player can click their screen with it equipped to shake it.

wiki.availability: The Pumpkin Stroller is a limited rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on October 28, 2020, alongside the Halloween Event (2020). It could have been purchased for 1,250 in the Halloween Shop. As the event has ended, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pumpkin Stroller features a large, orange pumpkin with a gaping hole near the front to carry a baby/pet. It also comes with a yellow handle and two brown wheels near the bottom. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Punk Pony is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 21, 2024, as part of the second week of the Summer State Fair (2024). Players could obtain the Punk Pony by leveling their Pony Pass in the Speedy Stables minigame. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Punk Pony learns in order: The Neon Punk Pony glows red on its underbelly, inner ears, the markings on its flank, and its mane, and blue on its tail. The Mega Neon Punk Pony glows in the same areas as the Neon Punk Pony, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Punk Pony Sticker is an uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on July 5, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Summer State Fair (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained by opening any remaining State Fair Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Punk Pony Sticker features a cartoon Punk Pony.

wiki.availability: The Pupcake is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 3, 2026, alongside the fourth week of the Sugar Festival Event (2026). Players could purchase it for 99. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Pupcake learns in order: The Neon Pupcake glows pink on the frosting on its head, while the frosting on its cupcake body glows pink and blue-green. The Mega Neon Pupcake glows in the same areas as the Neon Pupcake, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Puppeteer Hand is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It is obtainable through purchasing and opening the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. It is otherwise obtainable through opening Admin Abuse Boxes, purchasing it for 16,000 when it is on rotation in the Accessory Shop, or trading.

The Puppy Plush is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was previously obtainable through opening gifts, during a 2018 Gifts rotation. It can be interacted with by clicking or tapping on any area of the screen.
wiki.notes: The Puppy Plush resembles a black and white dog wearing a red bandana.

wiki.availability: The Puptune is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 7, 2025, alongside the Moon Egg.It can now only be obtained through hatching any remaining Moon Eggs or Royal Moon Eggs, or through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 6% chance of hatching a Puptune from the Moon Egg, and a 12.5% chance of hatching it from the Royal Moon Egg. The Puptune features a teal, cloud-like body with a teal tail and two ears with pink insides. It has two teal antennas sticking out of its head, a black nose, and a pink tongue sticking out of its mouth. Here are the tricks the Puptune learns in order: The Neon Puptune glows light blue on its ears, antennae, feet, tongue, and tail. The Mega Neon Puptune glows in the same areas as the Neon Puptune, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Purple & Green Beads is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 6, 2021. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 150. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Purple & Green Beads features a necklace consisting of several round purple and green beads. This pet accessory goes around a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Purple Butterfly is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 4, 2022. It could have been obtained through buying a Leaf for 899 within the Butterfly Sanctuary. As the Butterfly Sanctuary has left the game, it can now only be obtained by using any remaining Leaves or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 2.5% chance of obtaining a Purple Butterfly from the Leaf. The Purple Butterfly features light purple wings with darker decorative lines throughout them. It has a black body with beady black eyes and two long antennae. As its idle animation, it flies and hovers in the air. Here are the tricks the Purple Butterfly learns in order: The Neon Purple Butterfly glows purple on its antennae and webbed lines on its wings. The Mega Neon Purple Butterfly glows in the same areas as the Neon Purple Butterfly, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Purple Heart Glasses are limited uncommon pet accessories which were released on April 11, 2020, for the Dress Your Pets Update. They could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 250 while on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Purple Heart Glasses have purple frames and heart-shaped lenses, which are a slightly darker purple. These pet accessories go on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Purple Masquerade Mask is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 6, 2021. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 750 while on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Purple Masquerade Mask features a mask with a green, purple, and violet checkered pattern on it. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Purple Mushrooms are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They are obtainable through purchasing and opening the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. They can otherwise be purchased for 200 when on rotation in the Accessory Shop, or obtained through trading.

The Purple Rose is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 500 while on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Purple Rose features a dark lavender-colored rose with a green stem and green leaves. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Purrowl is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 17, 2026. Players can earn it as a reward from aging up their pets, or obtain it through trading.
wiki.notes: The chance of receiving a Purrowl from aging up pets changes depending on the pet's age and rarity. Below is a table containing the chances of obtaining a Purrowl per reward drop, by the pet's age reached and rarity. The Purrowl features a brown, rounded body with a beige front. It has two brown wings with darker brown markings, a long, striped, and cat-like brown and dark brown tail, and two yellow feet attached to its body. Its head is brown and is topped with two cat ears of the same color, with darker brown stripes running vertically between them. It has a beige, heart-shaped face and two brown eyebrows, a pink nose, two dark brown eyes, and pink blushing cheeks with black whiskers coming from them. It bears resemblance to an internet meme known as "Meowl". Here are the tricks the Purrowl learns in order: The Neon Purrowl glows blue on its head markings, ear tufts, nose, whiskers, eyebrows, feet, tail stripes, and wing markings. The Mega Neon Purrowl glows in the same areas as the Neon Purrowl, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Pyramids Badge is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 20, 2022, during the Desert Weather Map Update. It can be purchased in the Desert Shop for 50 when the shop is on rotation. It can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Pyramids Badge is a golden pin with a picture of three pyramids under the sun. The picture is colored in various shades of orange and yellow. This pet accessory is worn over a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Quad Stroller is a limited rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released in September 2018. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Quad Stroller features four black wheels, a white canopy, four white seats, a gray stroller frame, and a gray handlebar. This item can transport four pets or babies at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Queen Bee is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on November 8, 2019. It can be obtained through purchasing and using a Honey in the Coffee Shop, which costs 169. The Queen Bee is also obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 1 in 40 chance (2.5%) of obtaining a Queen Bee from the Honey. The Queen Bee has a metallic blue round shaped body with golden stripes and wings. It has a round head with large beady black eyes and two golden antennae. Its feet and stinger are also gold in color. At night, its golden stripes turn a darker yellow. Listed below are the tricks a Queen Bee learns in order: The Neon version of the Queen Bee glows sky blue on its blue body while the golden parts stay the same. The Mega Neon Queen Bee glows in the same areas as the Neon Queen Bee, except those areas cycle through the colors pink, yellow, white, blue, and purple.

wiki.availability: The Queen Bee Slippers are limited legendary pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on July 3, 2026. They could have been obtained by pre-ordering the Bee Kind Notebook + Sticker Sheets through the merch tab of the in-game Shop Menu, until the item went off-sale on July 27, 2026. The Queen Bee Slippers can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Queen Bee Slippers feature blue and yellow striped slippers with yellow antennae and wings on them, which are similar to those seen on the Queen Bee. When worn by a pet, the wings are animated. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's feet.

wiki.availability: The Queen Bee Sticker is a legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Sticker Pack for 250; players have a 4% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Queen Bee Sticker features a cartoon Queen Bee.

wiki.availability: The Quetzalcoatl is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 12, 2025. It could have been obtained through purchasing and hatching Aztec Eggs for 750, or Basic Eggs for 400. As the Aztec Egg left the game on February 28, 2026, it can now only be obtained through hatching any remaining Aztec Eggs and Royal Aztec Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 2% chance of hatching the Quetzalcoatl from the Aztec Egg, and a 3% chance of hatching it from the Royal Aztec Egg. Here are the tricks the Quetzalcoatl learns in order: The Neon Quetzalcoatl glows orange on parts of its head and body, and on its wing feathers and detailing. The Mega Neon Quetzalcoatl glows in the same areas as the Neon Quetzalcoatl, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Quokka is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on January 4, 2024. Players were able to purchase this pet in the Aussie Zone next to the Accessory Shop for 750. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Quokka features a small brown body with a round head and two small brown ears. It has darker brown feet and nose. The insides of its ears are light brown and have tufts of fur sticking out. It also has two black eyes and a thin, smiling little mouth. Here are the tricks the Quokka learns in order: The Neon Quokka glows light mint green on its feet, nose, and the inner parts of its ears. The Mega Neon Quokka glows in the same areas as the Neon Quokka, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The RB Battles Trophy Hat is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me!. It was added to the game on December 19, 2022. It could have been obtained at the top of the Sky Castle after the player activated three crystals. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 5, 2023, at the same time as the 2022 Winter Event.
wiki.notes: To obtain this pet accessory, the player had to find three crystals that were scattered around the map; a pink one, a green one, and a blue one. The pink one was located near the Candy Castle (a building during the 2022 Winter Event), the green one in between the Hot Springs and the Baby Shop, and the blue one near the Campsite and the Farm Shop. The player had to touch these crystals to activate them. When each crystal was activated, it would glow and leave a trail to the Sky Castle. After activating all three crystals the player had to fly to the top of the Sky Castle in order to claim the RB Battles Trophy Hat.

wiki.availability: The RGB Leash is an uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 27, 2022, during the Task Board Update. It can be obtained through opening RGB Reward Boxes at a 10% chance or trading.
wiki.notes: The RGB Leash features a black handle, connected to a leash holder with a rainbow outline, and paw print in the center. When used, a black line extends from this item. When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, a black line will connect the RGB Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The RGB Collar is a common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 27, 2022, as part of the Task Board Update. It can be obtained through opening RGB Reward Boxes at a 14.66% chance or trading.
wiki.notes: The RGB Collar features a black circular band adorned with rainbow stripes. On the front of the collar, there is a black tag with a rainbow paw print, and on the back, there is a silver clip. This pet accessory is worn around a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The RGB Friend is a common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 27, 2022, during the Task Board Update. It can be obtained through opening RGB Reward Boxes at a 14.66% chance or trading.
wiki.notes: The RGB Friend resembles a gray Macintosh monitor with cat ears. It also has gray and pink paw print-shaped controller buttons. Its screen features a purple screen with a face. The RGB Friend serves no purpose other than just being a cosmetic and a hugging item. To interact with this toy, the player can click on their screen to hug it.

wiki.availability: The RGB Headset is an uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 27, 2022, during the Task Board Update. It can be obtained through opening RGB Reward Boxes at a 10% chance or trading.
wiki.notes: The RGB Headset features a pair of black headphones with a black microphone attached to the side. Rainbow accents can be found on the headband and throughout the headphones. There are rainbow paw prints on their panels. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The RGB Laptop is a rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 27, 2022, during the Task Board Update. It can be obtained through opening RGB Reward Boxes at a 4.83% chance or trading.
wiki.notes: The RGB Laptop features a black laptop with rainbow accents on its touchpad, backlight keyboard, and around the laptop's edges. This pet accessory goes on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The RGB Leash is an uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 27, 2022, during the Task Board Update. It can be obtained through opening RGB Reward Boxes at a 10% chance or trading.
wiki.notes: The RGB Leash features a black handle, connected to a leash holder with a rainbow outline, and paw print in the center. When used, a black line extends from this item. When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, a black line will connect the RGB Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The RGB Monster Truck is an ultra-rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on January 27, 2022, during the Task Board Update. It can be obtained through opening RGB Reward Boxes at a 3.5% chance or trading.
wiki.notes: The RGB Monster Truck is a large dark gray monster truck with an open roof. It glows on a rotation of multiple colors along its indents on the car's body as well as its wheels. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The RGB Phone Throw Toy is a rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 27, 2022, during the Task Board Update. It can be obtained through opening RGB Reward Boxes at a 4.83% chance or trading.
wiki.notes: The RGB Phone Throw Toy features a phone with a brown screen with many apps on it, and a black edge with rainbow lining. There is a rainbow string with a paw print connected to the top right corner of the phone. When thrown with a pet out, the pet will chase it and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The RGB Propeller is a rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 27, 2022, as part of the Task Board Update. It can be obtained through opening RGB Reward Boxes at a 4.83% chance or trading.
wiki.notes: The RGB Propeller features a black propeller adorned with rainbow colors and a wavy striped handle. To interact with this toy, a player can click or press their screen to be propelled upwards towards the sky, and press the spacebar or the jump button to stop.

wiki.availability: The RGB Reward Box is a legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was released during the Task Board update on January 27, 2022. It can be obtained by completing tasks in the "Pets" section in the Guide; up to five RGB Reward Boxes are obtainable per account. It can also be obtained as a reward for aging up pets, or through trading.
wiki.notes: Before November 14, 2025, it could have obtained by completing a task marked with a "flame" icon on the Task Board, which required players to make a Neon or Mega Neon pet as their task, which rewarded one and three RGB Reward Boxes respectively once completed. Players have a 44% chance to get a common item, a 30% chance to get an uncommon item, a 14.5% chance to get a rare item, a 7% chance to get an ultra-rare vehicle, and a 4.5% chance to get a legendary pet from an RGB Reward Box. The RGB Reward Box features a rainbow box with with a thick black rim and handles. On the front of the box, players can see a multicolored paw.

wiki.availability: The RGB Stroller is an uncommon stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on January 27, 2022, during the Task Board Update. It can be obtained through opening RGB Reward Boxes at a 10% chance or trading.
wiki.notes: The RGB Stroller features a three-wheeled black stroller with gray edges lining its main body and a rainbow pattern spanning from the front wheels to the handle. There are small rainbow patterns around the side of its seat and wheels. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The RGB Sword Rattle is a common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 27, 2022, during the Task Board Update. It can be obtained through opening RGB Reward Boxes at a 14.66% chance or trading.
wiki.notes: The RGB Sword Rattle features a black blade, with a rainbow edge, connected to a black hilt. To interact with this toy, a player can click their screen to shake it back and forth.

wiki.availability: The RGB UFO is an ultra-rare single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on January 27, 2022, during the Task Board Update. It can be obtained through opening RGB Reward Boxes at a 3.5% chance or trading.
wiki.notes: The RGB UFO is an animated gray flying disk with three dark gray rings, a small ring surrounding the driver's seat and two larger rings outlining a rainbow gradient ring. It also has ten lights on the top and ten more surrounding a larger circle-shaped light on the bottom. The driver's seat is colored in dark gray, facing two screens. The lights and screens of the vehicle glows on a rotation of multiple colors. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Rabbit is a rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2019, along with the Pets update. Originally, players could obtain it by hatching a Cracked Egg, a Pet Egg, or a Royal Egg, but as of July 21, 2022, the Rabbit can only be obtained by hatching a Retired Egg or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 6.75% chance of hatching a Rabbit from a Retired Egg. The Rabbit has white fur all over its body, complete with two long ears with pink insides that stick up. It also has black beady eyes and a pink nose. Listed below are the tricks the Rabbit learns in order: The Neon Rabbit glows bright pink on its nose, inner ears, feet, and tail. The Mega Neon Rabbit glows in the same areas as the Neon Rabbit, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Rabbit Helicopter is a limited rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released as part of the Easter Event (2023) during the Spring Festival (2023). It could be purchased in the Springfest Shop for 89. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rabbit Helicopter resembles a brown helicopter with brown ears, large eyes and white teeth. The Rabbit Helicopter has a purple bow tied in front of the ears, along with a brown tail rotor on the helicopter. The tail rotor seems to have a small purple and white flower at the tip of it. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Rabbit Rattle is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was obtainable during the 2019 Easter Event, and is now only obtainable through trading. The toy cost 2 Easter Eggs, which were scattered around Adoption Island for players to find.
wiki.notes: The Rabbit Rattle is a yellow bunny with a hint of orange on its nose. It is complete with a black stick. To interact with this toy, a player clicks or presses the screen to shake.

wiki.availability: The Raccoon is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 7, 2023. Players could purchase it in the Pet Shop for 600, though it was displayed outside the Nursery for the first two weeks of its release. The Raccoon left the game on April 19, 2024, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Raccoon features a gray body with a striped gray and black tail, four feet, and two ears with light pink undertones. It has two beady eyes with dark grey markings connecting to its white muzzle. The Raccoon also has whiskers, a dark grey nose, and two stripe marks on its face. Here are the tricks the Raccoon learns in order: The Neon Raccoon glows purple on the outside of its nose, outer ears, the black stripes on its tail, and its feet. The Mega Neon Raccoon glows in the same areas as the Neon Raccoon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Race Car Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Race Car Stroller features an elongated red cylindrical shape with rounded ends. It has a white handle and two black handlebars. It also has four large black and white wheels. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Racing Monoplane is a limited rare two-seater flying vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on September 16, 2021. It could have been purchased for 3,500 on a wooden pedestal next to the Fossil Paw Helicopter and in front of the Hot Air Balloon. As it left the game on September 30, 2021, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Racing Monoplane, as true to its name, features a monoplane with two black wheels, two black seats and black propellers. The exterior of the monoplane is colored pale blue by default, but it could be changed by the player after purchase. However, the secondary color, white, cannot be changed. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Radish Friend is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It was obtainable through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on August 22, 2025, it can now only be obtained through trading.

The Rain Badge is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on February 9, 2023. It can be found and purchased in the Rain Gift Shop for 100 when the Rain Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rain Badge features a circular badge with a white and blue background with a drop of water. It has several droplets surrounding the drop of water. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Rain Boots are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on March 9, 2021. They could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 750 while on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Rain Boots features yellow boots with black platforms. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's feet.

wiki.availability: The Rain Cloud Hat is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 9, 2023. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 0.4% and 0.1% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on May 10, 2024, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rain Cloud Hat features a white cloud with a rainbow arching through it and raindrops falling from the cloud. The raindrops are animated as they fall. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Rain Hat is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 5, 2020. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 100 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Rain Hat is a bright yellow hat with a flaps on both sides. There are gray rivets on the sides as well. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Rain Leaf Wings are limited ultra-rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on February 9, 2023. They can be found and purchased in the Rain Gift Shop for 1,300 when the Rain Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rain Leaf Wings feature four green leaves, the top two with a yellow spot and two blue spots, and the bottom two with a blue spot at the tip. The leaves are bound together by a string. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Rain Stick is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on February 9, 2023. It can be found and purchased in the Rain Gift Shop for 300 when the Rain Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rain Stick features a brown rain stick with yellow string with blue and red flaps coming out of it. To interact with this item, a player can click on their screen with the Rain Stick equipped to play music.

wiki.availability: The Rainbow Bucket Hat is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 5.5% and 3.3% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on September 29, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rainbow Bucket Hat features a white bucket hat with a rainbow design on the front. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Rainbow Cake Chew Toy is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 1, 2023. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand near the Playground for 50. It can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Rainbow Cake Chew Toy features a multicolored cake, with each layer being a different color of the rainbow. It has white icing and rainbow sprinkles on top. When interacted with, the player throws the Rainbow Cake Chew Toy, and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. The pet holds it in its mouth until the player picks up the item by interacting with the pet. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Rainbow Cloud Wings are limited rare wing pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on September 15, 2022.
wiki.notes: They could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Wing Chest for 150; players had a 14.5% chance of unboxing them. The Regal Wing Chest can be found in a room in the Sky Castle. As their rotation has passed, the Rainbow Cloud Wings can now only be obtained through trading. The Rainbow Cloud Wings feature rainbow top wing ridges and curved white material underneath, which resembles a cloud. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back when the pet is flown.

wiki.egg: Special Lunar New Year Gift Box/Lunar New Year Gift Box
wiki.availability: The Rainbow Dragon is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 8, 2024, alongside the Lunar New Year (2024) event. Players are able to obtain it by opening any remaining Special Lunar New Year Gift Boxes and Lunar New Year Gift Boxes or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rainbow Dragon features a pink body with red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple spikes across its head and spine. It has a yellow tail, beige underbelly, and two blue feet. The dragon has two beady black eyes with yellow markings, dark purple nostrils with yellow whiskers, and green fur on its chin. These are the tricks the Rainbow Dragon learns in order: The Neon Rainbow Dragon glows bright yellow on its eyebrows, whiskers, the tip of its tail, and the underside of its feet. Its head and the spikes on its back glow in their respective shades of orange, blue, red, and green. The Mega Neon Rainbow Dragon glows in the same areas as the Neon Rainbow Dragon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.egg: Special Lunar New Year Gift Box/Lunar New Year Gift Box
wiki.availability: The Rainbow Dragon Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on February 8, 2024, as part of the Lunar New Year (2024) Event. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading or by opening any remaining Special Lunar New Year Gift Boxes or Lunar New Year Gift Boxes.
wiki.notes: The Rainbow Dragon Hat features a pink body with a beige underbelly. It has red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple spikes reaching from its head and through its spine, ending with a yellow tail. It resembles the Rainbow Dragon. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.egg: Special Lunar New Year Gift Box/Lunar New Year Gift Box
wiki.availability: The Rainbow Dragon Kite is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on February 8, 2024, as part of the Lunar New Year (2024) event. Players are able to obtain it by opening any remaining Special Lunar New Year Gift Boxes and Lunar New Year Gift Boxes or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rainbow Dragon Kite features a kite resembling the Rainbow Dragon. The dragon's body contains red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple spines and has a beady black eye at the head of the kite.

wiki.availability: The Rainbow Leash is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rainbow Leash features a rainbow gradient leash that resembles a heart, with bright pink borders and stripes separating the gradient. It has a star with two sprouting wings in the center, with a bold white heart outline. When used, a multicolored line extends from this item. When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, a multicolored line will connect the Rainbow Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The Rainbow Maker is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 0.19% and 0.06% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on September 29, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rainbow Maker features a flat, translucent cloud with multicolored gears inside; it leaves a rainbow trail behind whatever pet is wearing it, similar to the Rainbow Stroller and the Cloud. This pet accessory goes on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Rainbow Popsicle Friend is limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 1, 2023. It was available for purchase at the Pride Stand near the Playground for 50. It can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Rainbow Popsicle Friend features a rainbow popsicle with a tan stick, two eyes, and a mouth. The Rainbow Popsicle Friend serves no purpose other than just being a cosmetic and interactable item. To hug this toy, the player can click on their screen.

wiki.egg: Small, Big Gift, or Massive Gift
wiki.availability: The Rainbow Rattle is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was briefly added to the game and quickly removed. It was also given away to users. It was supposed to come into the game during the March 2019 gift rotation.
wiki.notes: Very few players possess this item, as only two were known to exist prior to May 2021. This is due to when Bethink released the rattle, he forgot to add a picture for it; NewFissy then quickly removed it from Gifts. Bethink never realized he forgot to release the rattle until over a year later. This item is now only obtainable through trading; it has also been obtainable through giveaways hosted on Adopt Me! platforms. On May 12, 2021, the Adopt Me! team gave away twenty Rainbow Rattles as celebration for the launch of Uplift Games. On June 2, 2022, to celebrate Pride Month, an official giveaway for Rainbow Rattles was hosted on Adopt Me!'s Twitter, YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok channels; five Rainbow Rattles were given out per platform, to a total of twenty. The giveaway ended on June 6, 2022. The Rainbow Rattle features a white rattle topped with a small cloud similar to the Cloud (vehicle), with a rainbow reaching across the top. It is held up by a white stick. When in a player's inventory, the rainbow does not show, looking like a simple cloud with a handle turned slightly to the side. To interact with this item, a player can click their screen to shake it back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Rainbow Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Baby Shop for 2,000. It was removed from the game on June 24, 2021, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rainbow Stroller features a white cloud that floats above the ground. It has a rainbow handle with sparkles floating around. This stroller leaves behind a sparkly rainbow trail wherever and whenever a player walks. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Rainbow Sword is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on August 22, 2025 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with the Rainbow Sword equipped, it is swung towards the ground.

wiki.availability: The Rainbow Trail Magic Carpet is a limited uncommon single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on June 9, 2022, as part of the Pride Event (2022). It could have been purchased from the Pride Stand near the Playground for 250. As the event has ended, this vehicle is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rainbow Trail Magic Carpet features a rectangular purple rug with a golden lining near its edges. When driven, this vehicle levitates slightly above the ground and leaves a rainbow trail. This rainbow trail references the LGBTQ+ flag and is similar to that of the Cloud's. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Rainbow Trout is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 20, 2026, alongside the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could obtain it through exchanging one Rainbow Karp and 70,000 in the Fishing Shop. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 20, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Rainbow Trout learns in order: The Neon Rainbow Trout glows red on its body spots, fin stripes, underside, and on the bottom half of its head. The Mega Neon Rainbow Trout glows in the same areas as the Neon Rainbow Trout, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Rainbow Wand is a limited uncommon toy from an old gifts rotation in Adopt Me!. As its respective rotation has left, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rainbow Wand is a long, straight brown wand with a rainbow going through it. If graphics are turned on to the highest setting, the rainbow will appear as a circle around the width of the wand. When a player clicks their screen with the Rainbow Wand equipped, it will be shaken back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Rainy Cloud Earrings are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on February 9, 2023. They can be found and purchased in the Rain Gift Shop for 150 when the Rain Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rainy Cloud Earrings feature two gold clouds with blue droplets. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's ears or on the sides of its head.

wiki.availability: The Rake Wings are limited ultra-rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on August 11, 2022. They can be found and purchased in the Fall Shop for 1,300 when the Fall Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rake Wings feature two crossed rakes with beige handles and gray metal tops. There are brown pieces wrapped neatly around the metal tops. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Ram is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 22, 2022, as part of week four of the Winter Event (2022). wiki.notes: The Ram features a curly white outer coat, a light tan face and feet, curved horns with dark lines, and pointed ears with pink insides. Listed below are the tricks the Ram learns in order: The Neon Ram glows light blue on its nose, horns, and hooves. The Mega Neon Ram glows in the same areas as the Neon Ram, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Raspberry Pie is a common food item in Adopt Me! that can be purchased for 3 next to the Apples in Green Groceries, or obtained through trading. The Raspberry Pie was also purchasable in the Farm Shop before its removal.

When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. It takes five uses to fully consume.

wiki.availability: The Rat is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 24, 2020, along with the Lunar New Year (2020) event. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading or by opening any remaining Rat Boxes.
wiki.notes: Players have a 93.33% chance of obtaining a Rat from a Rat Box. The Rat has a dark gray body, a pink tail, beady black eyes, a pink nose, dark gray paws, and gray oval ears with pink insides. Listed below are the tricks the Rat learns in order: The Neon Rat glows bright pink on its inner ears, feet, tail, and nose. The Mega Neon Rat glows in the same areas as Neon Rat, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Rat Box is a limited legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was released on January 24, 2020, as part of the Lunar New Year (2020) event. Players could purchase it on the Lunar New Year stand for 345. Since the event ended, the Rat Box is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: Players can receive a Rat or a Golden Rat from a Rat Box. There is a 14 in 15 (93.33%) chance of obtaining a Rat, while there is a 1 in 15 (6.67%) chance of obtaining a Golden Rat. The Rat Box is a brown cardboard-looking box with six air holes on its front and back side. It has handles on the top, but players would hold the rat box from the bottom.

wiki.availability: The Rat Sticker is an uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Premium Sticker Pack for 50; players have a 35% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Rat Sticker features a cartoon Rat.

wiki.availability: The Ratatoskr is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 6, 2024, alongside the Winter Festival (2024). Players could have purchased it for 3,400 until January 17, 2025. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.

The Mega Neon Ratatoskr glows in the same areas as the Neon Ratatoskr, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ratatoskr Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on January 3, 2025, alongside the fifth week of the Winter Festival (2024). It can now only be obtained through trading or unboxing any remaining Winter 2024 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000 until January 17, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Ratatoskr Sticker features a cartoon Ratatoskr.

wiki.availability: The Rattle is a common toy in Adopt Me! that can be found in the Baby Shop. The Rattle can be purchased for 50, or obtained through trading. After purchase, players will be prompted to choose a color.
wiki.notes: The Rattle features a white, circular handle with a rod that connects to a ball. The ball is shiny and has many color options when purchased. To interact with the rattle, a player can click/press their screen to shake it back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Rattlesnake is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 25, 2024. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Desert Eggs, Royal Desert Eggs, or through trading.

The Rattlesnake features a brown body with a light brown underbelly. It has dark brown eye details, dark and light brown triangular details spanning across its body, and a bright yellow rattle at the end of its tail. It also has a flickering red forked tongue. Here are the tricks the Rattlesnake learns in order: The Neon Rattlesnake glows orange on its eye markings, body markings, tongue, and rattle. The Mega Neon Rattlesnake glows in the same areas as the Neon Rattlesnake, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Raven Collar is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. As it was removed from the game on August 22, 2025, it can now only be obtained through trading.

wiki.availability: The Raw Bone is a common toy in Adopt Me! that is currently purchasable in the Pet Shop for 150. It is otherwise obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Raw Bone features a distinct, irregular texture. It is a long and orange bone with knotted ends and a slightly curved shape. When interacted with, the Raw Bone is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Red & Yellow Beads is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 9, 2021. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 150 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.

wiki.availability: The Red Back Ribbon is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 13, 2021. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 100 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.

wiki.availability: The Red Beanie is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 11, 2020, as a part of the Dress Your Pets Update. wiki.availability: The Red Bowtie is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 100 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.

wiki.availability: The Red Butterfly is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 150 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.

wiki.availability: The Red Cardinal is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 17, 2022, along with the Woodland Egg. As the Woodland Egg is now unavailable for purchase, players can only obtain the Red Cardinal by trading or by hatching any remaining Woodland Eggs.

The Red Cardinal features a bird with red plumage, a round, somewhat egg-shaped body, a crest, an orange beak, two tail feathers, and a dark brown spot around the eyes. Here are the tricks the Red Cardinal learns in order: The Neon glows light blue on its primary feathers and the tips of its tail feathers. The glow is slightly dimmer compared to other Neon Pets. The Mega Neon Red Cardinal glows in the same areas as the Neon Red Cardinal, except those areas cycles through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Red Collar is a common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that can be purchased in the Accessory Shop for 100. It can otherwise be obtained through trading.

wiki.availability: The Red Crowned Crane is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 8, 2022. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Japan Eggs or through trading.

Here are the tricks the Red Crowned Crane learns in order: The Neon Red Crowned Crane glows light blue on its crown, neck, and on the edges of its wings. The Mega Neon Red Crowned Crane glows in the same areas as the Neon Red Crowned Crane, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Red Dutch Guinea Pig is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 3, 2026, replacing the Hummingbirds from the Golden Petunia. It is obtainable through purchasing the Pets Plus subscription for 299 and using the Golden Lettuce, or trading.

It has a white facial marking, a white marking on its underbelly and sides, a pink nose, and four pink paws, as well as two white ears, with pink inner ears, and two beady black eyes. Here are the tricks the Red Dutch Guinea Pig learns in order: The Neon Red Dutch Guinea Pig glows light blue on its face, inner ears, and part of its body. The Mega Neon Red Dutch Guinea Pig glows in the same areas as the Neon Red Dutch Guinea Pig, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Red Envelope is a limited uncommon pet accessory which was released in Adopt Me! alongside the Lunar New Year (2022) event on February 3, 2022. It could be obtained by buying it for 310. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.

wiki.availability: The Red Fox is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 17, 2022, along with the Woodland Egg. As the Woodland Egg is now unavailable for purchase, players can only obtain the Red Fox by trading with other players or by hatching any remaining Woodland Eggs.

wiki.availability: The Red Lunar New Year Slippers are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were added to the game on January 19, 2023, as a part of the Lunar New Year (2023) event. wiki.availability: The Red Panda is an ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2019, along with the Pets update. Originally, players could obtain it by hatching a Cracked Egg, a Pet Egg, or a Royal Egg, but as of July 21, 2022, the Red Panda can only be obtained by hatching a Retired Egg or through trading.

It has triangular-shaped, pinkish-brown-colored ears that are surrounded with white fur. The Red Panda has a white muzzle and some white stripes on its face and its tail. Its nose, mouth, eyes, and feet are black. Here are the tricks a Red Panda learns in order: The Neon Red Panda glows bright red on its ears, nose, feet, and the stripes on its tail. The Mega Neon Red Panda glows in the same areas as the Neon Red Panda, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Red Panda Bag is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. The Red Sneakers are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on July 31, 2020. They could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 150 when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Red Sneakers feature red sneakers with a white sole, white laces, and a white pawprint on the sides of each shoe. These pet accessories go on a pet's feet.

wiki.availability: The Red Squirrel is an ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on May 13, 2021. It was purchasable in the Pet Shop or in the shop menu for 200.
wiki.notes: On May 4, 2023, the Red Squirrel was relocated to the Final Stop Shop with a price reduction to 125; after two weeks, the Red Squirrel was removed from the game. It can now only be obtained by trading. The Red Squirrel has a chestnut-colored body except for its cream white underbelly and the beige back side of its tail. It has two small legs and arms and a large bushy tail. On its head, it has two large black eyes, a light pink heart-shaped nose, and two ears. Listed below are the tricks the Red Squirrel learns in order: The Neon Red Squirrel glows bright yellow under its neck, under its tail, and on its belly. The Mega Neon Red Squirrel glows in the same areas as the Neon Red Squirrel, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Red Wagon Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on March 31, 2022, as part of the 2022 Gift Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Red Wagon Stroller features a wide red container with four wheels; each wheel has a black axle, a gray and red middle, and black edges. There is a small black handle at one end. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Regal Chest is a legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. It can be purchased in the Accessory Shop for 300, earned from the rotation of rewards for completing three daily tasks from the Task Board, received as a reward for aging up pets, or obtained through trading. Three can also be purchased from the Star Rewards for 10.
wiki.notes: The Regal Chest was previously obtainable through the Sunshine Games Pass from the Games Event (2024), the graveyard from week two of the Halloween Event (2024), and the Daily Reward. It also could have been obtained from Treasure Chests in the Summer Festival (2025), which required Treasure Keys to unlock. New players could also obtain it by completing special tasks on the Task Board on the seventh day of joining the game until the Task Board Revamp Update on November 14, 2025. When the Regal Chest is opened, the player receives a pet accessory that appears on the board next to the Standard Chest. Players have a 17.8% chance of getting a common item, a 52.2% chance of getting an uncommon item, a 20% chance of getting a rare item, an 8.5% chance of getting an ultra-rare item, a 1.5% chance of getting a legendary item, and a 0.1% chance of getting a Chocolate Chip Bat Dragon Backpack. The Regal Chest features a treasure chest with a brown base and golden lines throughout its exterior and interior. It also has a circular golden centerpiece which includes a dark gray paw print inside.

wiki.availability: The Regal Collar is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.8% and 0.7% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Regal Collar was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Regal Collar features two round yellow circles connected by two red lines. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Regal Roller is a legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on January 18, 2024. Players can obtain it by purchasing the Mega Car Pack for 680 (formerly 800) or through trading.
wiki.notes: This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Regal Wing Chest is a legendary pet accessory gift in Adopt Me! that was released on September 15, 2022. It is available for purchase for 130 (formerly 150) in the Sky Castle.
wiki.notes: The Regal Wing Chest, when opened, gives the player wings that can customize a pet's default wings while flying. The Regal Wing Chest unboxes different wings; each of these wings are tradable and only appear on the player's pet when they are flying it. The items that players can obtain from the Regal Wing Chest can be seen on the board displayed nearby: players have a 45% chance of getting a common item, 33% chance of getting an uncommon item, 14.5% chance of getting a rare item, 6% chance of getting an ultra-rare item, and a 1.5% chance of getting a legendary item. The Regal Wing Chest features a pink chest with a yellow frame, edges, and short legs. It has a yellow-winged lock with a brown keyhole. When unboxed, the chest has brown insides.

wiki.availability: The Reindeer is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 25, 2019, as part of the 2019 Advent Calendar during the Christmas Event (2019). It was obtainable from the 2019 Advent Calendar on day twenty-five (Christmas Day). Since the 2019 Advent Calendar has concluded, the Reindeer is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Reindeer has a light chocolate brown body, black eyes, and two large beige antlers. Its feet, nose, and inner ears are colored a slightly dark brown. It also has a white counterpart, the Arctic Reindeer. Listed below are the tricks the Reindeer learns in order: The Neon Reindeer has a glowing green nose while the rest of its body stays the same. During the Christmas Event (2019), players could see a Neon Reindeer at the 2019 Advent Calendar. Until January 11, 2024, the nose glowed red. The glowing red nose was a reference to Rudolph, a popular Christmas character. The Mega Neon Reindeer has a glowing nose, just like the Neon Reindeer, except that the nose cycles through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Reindeer Antlers are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 500 when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Reindeer Antlers, feature brown antlers that are similar to the antlers of the Reindeer and Arctic Reindeer. These pet accessories go on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Reindeer Hood is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 30, 2023. It was released along with the Winter Festival (2023). Players were able to purchase this for 2,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Reindeer Hood features a brown hood with white lining and two dark brown ears with pink insides along with two dark brown antlers. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Reindeer Leash is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 7, 2019. It could have been obtained from the 2019 Advent Calendar on the 7th day, during the Christmas Event (2019). As its day has passed, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Reindeer Leash features a leash that resembles the head of the Reindeer. It has a brown face with a darker shade on its nose and inner ears, black eyes, and beige antlers. When used, a pink line extends from this item. When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, a pink line will connect the Reindeer Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The Reindeer Plush is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released sometime around 2018. It could have been obtained for 70 or 199 from the Small or Big Gifts, respectively. As the Gifts were updated to contain new items, it is no longer available and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Reindeer Plush features a golden-brown reindeer with dark brown antlers, a white muzzle, and a red collar with golden bells. The Reindeer Plush's hooves are of a darker brown. The Reindeer Plush tends to serve no purpose other than just being a cosmetic item. To interact with this plush, a player can click or press anywhere on the screen to hug it.

wiki.availability: The Reindeer Rattle is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 15, 2024. It could have been claimed on day fifteen of the 2024 Advent Calendar, which was released as a part of the Winter Festival (2024). It can now only be obtained through trading, as its day has passed.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with the Reindeer Rattle equipped, they will shake it back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Reindeer Sticker is a limited uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on January 3, 2025, alongside the fifth week of the Winter Festival (2024). It can now only be obtained through trading or unboxing any remaining Winter 2024 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000 until January 17, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Reindeer Sticker features a cartoon Reindeer.

wiki.availability: The Reindeer Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on December 17, 2019, as part of the Christmas Event (2019). It could have been claimed from the 2019 Advent Calendar on day seventeen. Since its day has passed, the Reindeer Stroller is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Reindeer Stroller is a brown-colored stroller meant to resemble a Reindeer. It has a green noseband, red cheek straps, a red saddle with a green border, and a red collar with a yellow bell. Moreover, its tail-like feature is attached to its dark brown handle, and instead of wheels, it has a dark brown rocker. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Respectful Mustache is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that is a part of the Pirate's Costume, which could be purchased for 250. On April 24, 2026, the Pirate's Costume was added to the Final Stop Shop and discounted to 175 before leaving the game on May 1, 2026. The Respectful Mustache can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Respectful Mustache features a black handlebar mustache. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Retired Egg is a rare egg in Adopt Me! that was released on July 21, 2022. It can be found and purchased in the VIP room inside of the Nursery for 600. It can also be obtained by trading with other players.
wiki.notes: On July 21, 2022, the original Cracked, Pet, and Royal eggs were refreshed to contain new pets, and subsequently, all of the pets originally present in the older version of the refreshed eggs were transferred to the new Retired Egg. This egg takes 5 tasks to hatch. The Retired Egg features a cream-colored egg, similar to the Starter Egg and the Pet Egg. It has a pair of gray-colored glasses, a white mustache, and a brown cane, symbolizing the original Pets retirement.

wiki.availability: The Retro 3D Glasses are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As they were removed from the game on January 30, 2026, they can only be obtained through trading.

The Rhino is a limited rare pet that was added to Adopt Me! on August 31, 2019. It could have been obtained through purchasing and hatching Jungle Eggs for 750. As the Jungle Egg left the game on November 22, 2019, it can now only be obtained through hatching any remaining Jungle Eggs or trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 18.5% chance of hatching a Rhino from the Jungle Egg. The Rhino has a round gray body, two beady black eyes, four gray feet, two lighter gray horns (big one and a small one located on its nose), and two thin gray ears with lighter gray inner ears. These are the tricks the Rhino learns in order: The Neon Rhino's feet, horns, inner ears, and tip of the tail glow a salmon color. The Mega Neon Rhino glows in the same areas as the Neon Rhino, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Rhino Beetle is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 8, 2022. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Japan Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 19% chance of hatching an uncommon pet from the Japan Egg, but only a 9.5% chance of hatching a Rhino Beetle. The Rhino Beetle features a red upper body with a black stripe through its middle. It has a black underbelly, a small ridge on its head, a long curved part on its face, and two palps. Here are the tricks the Rhino Beetle learns in order: The Neon Rhino Beetle glows green on its antennae and wings. The Mega Neon Rhino Beetle glows in the same areas as the Neon Rhino Beetle, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Rib Guitar is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 28, 2020, alongside the Halloween Event (2020). It could be purchased for 1,750 in the Halloween Shop. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rib Guitar features a guitar made of white bones, specifically from the ribcage and spine areas with gray accents and four black guitar strings. To interact with this item, a player can click on their screen to play music.

wiki.availability: The Rib Guitar is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 28, 2020, alongside the Halloween Event (2020). It could be purchased for 1,750 in the Halloween Shop. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rib Guitar features a guitar made of white bones, specifically from the ribcage and spine areas with gray accents and four black guitar strings. To interact with this item, a player can click on their screen to play music.

wiki.availability: The Ribbon Seal is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on May 12, 2022, as a part of the Snow Weather Update. It can be purchased for 700 in the Snowy Igloo Shop, hatched from a Basic Egg, Crystal Egg, and Admin Abuse Egg, or obtained through trading. It can only be found in the Snowy Igloo Shop and hatched from Basic and Crystal Eggs while its respective weather rotation is active.
wiki.notes: The Ribbon Seal features a gray body with white stripes and hind flippers. It has two beady black eyes, black whiskers, and a gray snout. Here are the tricks the Ribbon Seal learns in order: The Neon Ribbon Seal glows blue on the lines on its chest, back, and head. The Mega Neon Ribbon Seal glows in the same areas as the Neon Ribbon Seal, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ribcage Carriage is a limited legendary four-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was available during the Halloween Event (2020). It could have been purchased for 3,000. Since the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Ribcage Carriage is a carriage that is constructed primarily out of bones. The middle part of the carriage's body resembles an open human ribcage. The interior features two sofa-like red seats, a black floor, and a glowing lantern tied in with ropes on both sides. It has two sets of large wooden wheels. Above the wheels are two spines with small spikes. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Rice Cake Hat is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on February 8, 2024, as part of the Lunar New Year (2024) event. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained by opening any remaining Lunar New Year Gift Boxes or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rice Cake Hat features a gray top-hat with a large bow at the side which has a purple center. The bottom of the Rice Cake Hat is encircled with a purple line and has rounded purple, pink, and yellow decorations.

wiki.egg: Special Lunar New Year Gift Box/Lunar New Year Gift Box
wiki.availability: The Rice Cake Rabbit is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 8, 2024, as part of the Lunar New Year (2024) event. Players are able to obtain it by opening any remaining Special Lunar New Year Gift Boxes and Lunar New Year Gift Boxes or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rice Cake Rabbit features a gray rabbit with glowing orange eyes and an orange nose. It has long gray ears with purple insides. It has orange fur on its back and on the top of its head. Around its neck, there are rice cakes in orange, pink, and pale yellow. These are the tricks the Rice Cake Rabbit learns in order: The Neon Rice Cake Rabbit glows a light purple on the inside of its ears, eyes, tail, and the tuft of fur on the top of its head. The Mega Neon Rice Cake Rabbit glows in the same areas as the Neon Rice Cake Rabbit, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Rice Cake Rabbit Kite is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on February 8, 2024, as part of the Lunar New Year (2024) event. Players are able to obtain it by opening any remaining Lunar New Year Gift Boxes, which cost 4,000. It can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rice Cake Rabbit Kite features a bright purple kite with three yellow tails. The design on the kite features the head of a Rice Cake Rabbit.

wiki.availability: The Rice Cake Soup is a limited common food in Adopt Me! that was released on February 8, 2024, as part of the Lunar New Year (2024) event. Players are able to obtain it by opening any remaining Lunar New Year Gift Boxes, which cost 4,000. It can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rice Cake Soup consists of a brown bowl with lighter colored tiles as the exterior bowl markings. Inside the bowl, there are rice cakes, with multiple different vegetable toppings in the center.

wiki.availability: The Ride-A-Pet Potion, commonly referred to as the Ride Potion, is a legendary potion in Adopt Me! that can be found and purchased in the Sky Castle for 130 (formerly 150). It can otherwise be obtained by trading. This potion was added to the game in August 2019, shortly after the pets Update.
wiki.notes: If a player clicks its icon while they have it equipped, they will be prompted with the message: "Product Description: Feed this to any pet to make it permanently rideable." Once a player has fed a Ride-A-Pet Potion to a pet, the pet will gain the ability to be ridden. In order to activate a pet's ride ability, players will have to interact with their pet and press 2 or "Ride". Its counterpart is the Fly-A-Pet Potion. The Ride-A-Pet Potion features a clear glass bottle in the shape of a horse containing a hot pink liquid giving off a small faint glow. It is topped with an orange bottle cork.

wiki.availability: The Rift Rider is a limited rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on October 18, 2024, as part of the third week of the Halloween Event (2024). Players could have purchased it for 32,000. The Rift Rider was only purchasable for 85 during week three of the event. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.egg: Standard Gibbon Box and Premium Gibbon Box
wiki.availability: The Ring of Fire Throwing Disc is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on May 16, 2025, alongside the Gibbon Fairground. As the event ended on May 30, 2025, it is now only obtainable through trading or opening any remaining Standard Gibbon Boxes or Premium Gibbon Boxes.
wiki.notes: The Ring of Fire Throwing Disc features a gold ring with a flame effect coming off of it. To interact with this item, a player can click or press their screen to throw the toy and their equipped pet will retrieve it. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.
