wiki.availability: The Ring-tailed Lemur is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that released on August 17, 2023. Players were able to purchase it in the Jungle Zone for 100. As the Jungle Zone has left the game, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Ring-tailed Lemur features a white body with a gray back, black feet, a striped black and white tail, and white ears with black insides. Here are the tricks the Ring-tailed Lemur learns in order: The Neon Ring-tailed Lemur glows purple on its face, ear tips, neck area, and feet. The Mega Neon Ring-tailed Lemur glows in the same areas as the Neon Ring-tailed Lemur, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: River is a limited uncommon doll pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 27, 2023, alongside Dylan and Pistachio. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by trading or by opening any remaining Wrapped Dolls.
wiki.notes: River is a small, lego-like figure with yellow skin and short, black hair. It has a cartoony female face with a little smile. River wears a doctor's outfit with a stethescope around its neck.

wiki.availability: The River Otter is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 26, 2026, alongside week two of the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could have purchased it for 35,000, or hatched it from a Basic Egg, Crystal Egg, or Admin Abuse Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 24, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the River Otter learns in order: The Neon River Otter glows orange on its whiskers, nose, feet, inner ears, and tail. The Mega Neon River Otter glows in the same areas as the Neon River Otter, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Roadrunner is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 25, 2024. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Desert Eggs, Royal Desert Eggs, or through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Roadrunner learns in order: The Neon Roadrunner glows blue on its beak, wings, underbelly, the markings under its eyes, and under its tail. The Mega Neon Roadrunner glows in the same areas as the Neon Roadrunner, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Robin is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 14, 2019, as a part of the Christmas Event (2019). As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by trading or by hatching any remaining Christmas Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 45% chance of hatching a Robin from the Christmas Egg. The Robin has a dark orange underbelly and part of the face, and the outer area of its body is brown. It has a slightly lighter orange for its legs, black beady eyes, a black beak, and is complete with three tail feathers. Here are the tricks the Robin learns in order: The Neon Robin glows orange-yellow on the inside of its body, and a slightly darker version of that same color on its feet. The Mega Neon Robin glows in the same areas as the Neon Robin, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Robin Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on January 3, 2025, alongside the fifth week of the Winter Festival (2024). It can now only be obtained through trading or unboxing any remaining Winter 2024 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000 until January 17, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Robin Sticker features a cartoon Robin.

wiki.availability: The Roblox Snowboard is a limited common single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was available in an old Gifts rotation in December 2017. It was available in old Massive Gifts, which cost 625. As the Gifts were updated with new items, the Roblox Snowboard can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Roblox Snowboard features a black snowboard with a red Roblox logo and two footholds for a player to place their feet into. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Robo Arms Collar is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on January 30, 2026, it can only be obtained through trading.

The Robo Balloon is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on November 9, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It was available in the Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Robo Balloon features a black body in a red shirt. It has a glowing blue face, two arms sprouting from the sides, and three blades at the top. A curved, black string is attached to the bottom of the robot through a glowing blue square outlined in black. The Robo Balloon allows a player to jump higher when equipped.

wiki.availability: The Robo Dog is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me that was released on November 24, 2020, as part of the 'Cyber Sale' event.
wiki.notes: It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Pet Shop or on the Shop GUI for 600. During the Cyber Sale, it cost 300. The Robo Dog left the game on January 6, 2022, and is now only obtainable through trading. The Robo Dog is a mechanical-like dog with a light gray face, a red suit, body, and feet, with a red-helmet like portion on its head. It has two emerald green robot ears and a round, yellow chest plate with a pale green circle. Its tail is a curly antenna and has a spherical green bead at the end. The Robo Dog also has a gray slinky section in the middle of its body. In the middle of the gray slinky, there is a green tube. When the Robo Dog sleeps, a small green ball moves inside the slinky. Here are the tricks the Robo Dog learns in order: The Neon Robo Dog glows bright blue on its ears and tail. A circular part on its springy body also glows the same color. The Mega Neon glows in the same areas as the Neon Robo Dog, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Robo Plush is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on November 9, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70 or 199 from Small or Big Gifts. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Robo Plush is a small figurine meant to resemble a robot. It has a light gray body with blue features, including blue beaded eyes and a small blue mouth. It also wears a star on its head. The Robo Plush serves no purpose other than just being a cosmetic and interactable item. To hug this toy, the player can click on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Robo Plush 3000 is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on November 3, 2022, as part of the 2022 Gift Refresh Update. It could be purchased for 70 or 199 from Small or Big Gifts. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Robo Plush 3000 features a white box with round edges with four robotic legs. It features a blue screen with two black circles inside, resembling its eyes. It has a black antenna with a gray sphere at the end on top of its head. It bears a similar appearance to the pet Robot. The Robo Plush 3000 serves no purpose other than just being a cosmetic and interactable item. To hug this toy, the player can click on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Robo Unicycle is a limited ultra-rare one-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on November 9, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, or 499, respectively. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Robo Unicycle features a gray cube seat with glowing blue intersecting lines and a glowing blue circle with a black outline. This is connected to the unicycle through a black and blue frame. The wheel of the Robo Unicycle is white with a black rim. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Robot is an ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 21, 2022. Players are able to hatch it from the Pet Egg, Cracked Egg, Royal Egg, Basic Egg, Crystal Egg, or Admin Abuse Egg. It can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Robot is white and box-shaped with four robotic legs. It features a blue screen with two darker blue circles inside, resembling its eyes. It has a black and gray antenna on top of its head. Here are the tricks the Robot learns in order: The Neon Robot glows yellow on its screen, side knobs, antenna, and on its legs. Its eyes become a shade of dark gray. The Mega Neon Robot glows in the same areas as the Neon Robot, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Robot Arm is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It is obtainable through purchasing and opening the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. It is otherwise obtainable through opening Admin Abuse Boxes, purchasing it for 500 when it is on rotation in the Accessory Shop, or trading.

The Robotic Runners are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.8% and 5.5% chance of getting them from these gifts respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Robotic Runners were removed from the game. They can now only be obtained through trading. The Robotic Runners feature orange shoes with white soles and blue stripes running across them. These pet accessories go on a pet's feet.

wiki.availability: The Rock is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 1, 2022, during the 2022 April Fool's Weekend. Players could obtain this pet through purchasing it for 350 near the Nursery. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on April 4, 2022.
wiki.notes: The Rock's appearance is identical to that of the Pet Rock's, featuring a gray rock accessorized with googly eyes and a red pipe cleaner stuck with clear tape. Here are the tricks the Rock learns in order: All of these tricks are the same action; the Rock would sit still through all of them and not do anything. The Neon Rock glows pink on its whole body, except for the eyes and mouth. The Mega Neon Rock glows in the same areas as the Neon Rock, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Rock Pigeon is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 24, 2023. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Urban Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rock Pigeon features a small, light gray bird with a blue head and a navy blue neck line. It has gray wings with navy feathers, 2 beady black eyes, a blue-gray beak and 2 orange feet. Here are the tricks the Rock Pigeon learns in order: The Neon Rock Pigeon glows blue on the outside of its beak, chest, wing markings, and feet. The Mega Neon Rock Pigeon glows in the same areas as the Neon Rock Pigeon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Rocket Grappling Hook is a limited uncommon toy that was added to Adopt Me! as part of the gifts rotation on September 2, 2021. It cost 70, 199, and 499, if obtained from Small, Big or Massive Gifts, respectively. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rocket Grappling Hook features a red and white rocket. It has a red nose cone, red fins, a white window with gray window frame, and orange handles. To interact with this item, a player can click/press anywhere on their screen to fire a hooked-cable and be pulled towards the target location. Like most other grappling hooks, players cannot use this item on non-solid graphical objects or if they are on a vehicle, doing an obby, flying or riding a pet.

wiki.availability: The Rocket Pogo is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that could be obtained from an old Gifts rotation. It is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rocket Pogo resembles a rocket with a white structure and red fins. It has a red nose cone on top, red handles on each side, and gray edges. At the bottom is a yellow exhaust flame to make it look like it is about to launch. It bears a similar design to the Rocket Ship Stroller. As it is a pogo stick, it provides transportation by bouncing instead of walking.

wiki.availability: The Rocket Racer is a limited ultra-rare single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020. It was obtainable from the first page of the Star Rewards, requiring 500 Stars to unlock. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on September 11, 2026 when the Star Rewards were revamped.
wiki.notes: The Rocket Racer is a red open-wheel car with a bright red paint job and a dark gray line going along the air intake. The spoiler of the racer has the number 7 on it, and there are two small stickers of what appear to be sponsors on the side of the car. The Rocket Racer has four wheels with yellow rims. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Rocket Ship Hat is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It was obtainable through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on August 22, 2025, it can now only be obtained through trading.

The Rocket Ship Stroller is a rare stroller in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased from the Baby Shop for 500. It was removed from the game on June 24, 2021, and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rocket Ship Stroller features a color-customizable spacecraft with two windows and a white body that hovers slightly above the ground. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Rocket Skates are a limited rare single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on September 2, 2021. It could have been obtained by opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, or 499, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rocket Skates feature two yellow skates, each having a pointed dark blue front, four wheels, and parts sticking out of its end to resemble a rocket. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Rocket Sled is a limited legendary single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released during the Christmas Event (2017) when the Gifts first came out. The Rocket Sled could have been obtained from the Massive Gift, which cost 625. As the Gifts rotation has been updated with new items, it now can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rocket Sled features a sled with two large and symmetrical rockets attached to either side of it. This vehicle emits yellow/green fiery embers out of the two rockets that are attached to its sides. The rockets themselves have each of their sections painted in different colors, beginning from the bottom with a black color where the fire particles originate, then an orange, fire-like piece, possibly meant to symbolize where the fuel for the sled is stored in, a silver part, a chrome/glass textured piece, another black piece similar in color to the one at the bottom of the rockets, and then finally concluding at a red-colored tip. Each of the rockets is made up out of a total of six parts. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Rodeo Bull is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 5, 2024, as part of the fourth week of the Summer State Fair (2024). Players could purchase it for 10,000. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rodeo Bull features a chestnut-brown head and body with two beady black eyes, two ears with light brown insides, two pairs of dark brown eyebrows, and two curved white horns. It has a light brown nose with two large nostrils, and a golden nose ring. It also has four black feet, and dark brown head and neck tuffs as well as a dark brown tail end. Listed below are the tricks the Rodeo Bull learns in order: The Neon Rodeo Bull glows orange on its head and neck tuffs, horns, eyebrows, nose ring, ear insides, tail-tip, and feet. The Mega Neon Rodeo Bull glows in the same areas as the Neon Rodeo Bull, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Rodeo Bull Sticker is an uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on July 5, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Summer State Fair (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained by opening any remaining State Fair Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Rodeo Bull Sticker features a cartoon Rodeo Bull.

wiki.availability: The Roller Skates are a limited common single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Toy Shop for 300. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Roller Skates feature a pair of color-customizable roller skates with four wheels. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Rolling Pin is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released along with the Gorilla Fairground event on March 16, 2023. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through opening any remaining Standard Gorilla Boxes and Premium Gorilla Boxes, or through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 5% chance of acquiring it from a Standard Gorilla Box and a 10% chance from a Premium Gorilla Box. When a player combined three Rolling Pins and a Gorilla during the event, their Gorilla would be transformed into a Chef Gorilla. Players were able do this by talking to the Chef Gorilla (NPC) in the Gorilla Fairground. The Rolling Pin features a brown, long cylinder with small handles at each end. The Rolling Pin behaves as a throw toy. When a player clicks their screen with the Rolling Pin equipped, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Romania Soccer Cap is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 12, 2024. Players could purchase it for 300 until July 19, 2024. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Romania Soccer Cap features a cap with soccer ball patterns on its panels and a striped visor with the colors blue, yellow and red. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Ronin Hat is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022, as part of the first Accessory Chest rotation.
wiki.notes: It could have been be obtained through unboxing the Regal Chest or the Standard Chest; players have a 20% and 60% chance of getting a common item from these boxes, respectively, although only a 2% and 6% chance of getting a Ronin Hat. These boxes can be found in the Accessory Shop. On September 29, 2022, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Ronin Hat was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained by trading with other players. The Ronin Hat features a beige cone-shaped hat. It is surrounded by two brown rings on its outside. wiki.availability: The Rooster is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on November 16, 2023. Players could purchase this pet at the Farm Zone for 1,750. As the Rooster left the game on November 30, 2023, it can now only be obtained through trading.

Here are the tricks the Rooster learns in order: The Neon Rooster glows yellow on its crest, beak, wattle, wings, feet, and tail. The Mega Neon Rooster glows in the same areas as the Neon Rooster, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Rope Chew Toy is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was available in the Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. When a player interacts with the Rope Chew Toy, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and sit with it in its mouth. The player can then click their pet to retrieve this toy. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Rose is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 29, 2020. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 250 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.

wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Rose Dragon learns in order: The Neon Rose Dragon glows pink on the tips of the petals on its head and back. The Mega Neon Rose Dragon glows in the same areas as the Neon Rose Dragon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Royal Aztec Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on August 8, 2025, alongside the Aztec Temple Trek Event. The Royal Capuchin Cape is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 5, 2024, along with the Capuchin Fairground. If a player unboxes a Royal Capuchin Monkey from the Standard Capuchin Box or the Premium Capuchin Box, they will also receive the Royal Capuchin Saber Pin, Royal Capuchin Crown, and the Royal Capuchin Cape.

wiki.availability: The Royal Capuchin Crown is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 5, 2024, along with the Capuchin Fairground. If a player unboxes a Royal Capuchin Monkey from the Standard Capuchin Box or the Premium Capuchin Box, they will also receive the Royal Capuchin Saber Pin, Royal Capuchin Cape, and the Royal Capuchin Crown.

wiki.availability: The Royal Capuchin Monkey is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 5, 2024, along with the Capuchin Fairground. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through opening any remaining Standard Capuchin Boxes or Premium Capuchin Boxes. It is also obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Royal Capuchin Monkey comes with the Royal Capuchin Cape, the Royal Capuchin Crown, and the Royal Capuchin Saber Pin when opened. The Royal Capuchin Monkey features a white monkey, and has a similar design to the other Capuchins available during the event. It is wearing a Royal Capuchin Crown, the Royal Capuchin Saber Pin, and the Royal Capuchin Cape, which are the items that come with the pet when opened. Here are the tricks the Royal Capuchin Monkey learns in order: The Neon Royal Capuchin Monkey glows light blue on its hands, feet, eyebrows, nose, inner ears, tail, and shoulders. If it is wearing the Royal Capuchin Crown or Royal Capuchin Cape, parts of the accessories will glow light blue as well. The Mega Neon Royal Capuchin Monkey glows in the same areas as the Neon Royal Capuchin Monkey, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Royal Carriage is a limited legendary four-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released in 2019. wiki.notes: The Royal Carriage is a luxurious black and yellow striped carriage, with a gold crown, white seats, and black and yellow wheels. Just like the Princess Carriage, it has a fully covered roof and glass windows connected to the doors. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Royal Corgi is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 25, 2022. It has black spots around the sides of its face, with brown ones below the black. Listed below are the tricks the Royal Corgi learns in order: The Neon Royal Corgi glows yellow on its ears, underbelly, chest, paws, and on parts of its face. The Mega Neon Royal Corgi glows in the same areas as the Neon Royal Corgi, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Royal Crown Carriage is a limited legendary four-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on April 13, 2023. wiki.availability: The Royal Crown Pillow is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 9, 2023. wiki.availability: The Royal Desert Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on January 23, 2024. wiki.notes: The Royal Desert Egg has higher odds than its counterpart, the Desert Egg. The Royal Desert Egg is similar to the Desert Egg in appearance. However, this egg has the Nemes on it as a hat.

wiki.availability: The Royal Egg is a legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2019, as part of the pets update. Players can obtain it by purchasing it in the Nursery for 1,450 or 9 through the Starter Pack. It can otherwise be obtained through trading.

It was also obtainable through opening Treasure Chests with Treasure Keys during the Summer Festival (2025). The Royal Egg has a 25% chance of hatching an uncommon pet, 37% chance of hatching a rare, 30% chance of hatching an ultra-rare, and an 8% chance of hatching a legendary. This egg takes six tasks to hatch. On July 21, 2022, all the original pets in the Royal Egg moved into the Retired Egg and were replaced with new pets. The Royal Egg features a white retexture of the Pet Egg, but with a red and gold crown on top. The design of its crown is similar to that of the Crown Flying Disc.

wiki.availability: The Royal Fairytale Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on September 11, 2026. Player can purchase it from the Star Rewards for 14, or obtain it through trading.

The Royal Mistletroll is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 20, 2024, alongside the third week of the Winter Festival (2024). Players could have purchased the Golden Mistletoe for 199 until January 17, 2025. As the event has ended, the Royal Mistletroll can only be obtained through trading or using any remaining Golden Mistletoes.
wiki.notes: Players have a 5% chance of obtaining a Royal Mistletroll from a Golden Mistletoe. The Royal Mistletroll features a fluffy light blue body and tail, two brown feet and a light blue head with a pink nose, green ears with darker green insides, and two black eyes with green markings around them. It also has two brown, snow-coated antlers that are decorated with multicolored lights on its head and a green strand of multicolored lights wrapped around its tail. Its head and neck are also decorated with green leaves, brown pinecones, and blue and red berries. Here are the tricks the Royal Mistletroll learns in order: The Neon Royal Mistletroll glows light green on its ears, tail, and around its eyes. The Mega Neon Royal Mistletroll glows in the same areas as the Neon Royal Mistletroll, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.notes: The Royal Moon Egg features a gray egg with craters scattered across its surface, as well as a galactic belt around it.

wiki.availability: The Royal Palace Spaniel is an ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 25, 2022. Players can purchase the Royal Palace Spaniel for 259 (formerly 299) in the Pet Shop. It can also be obtained by trading with other players.

Its eyes and nose are a darker black than its body. These are the tricks the Royal Palace Spaniel learns in order: The Neon Royal Palace Spaniel glows pink on its ears, chest, and paws. wiki.availability: The Rubber Ducky Box is a limited rare gift in Adopt Me! that was released on May 22, 2026. Players could have purchased it next to the Hospital for 500 until May 29, 2026. From May 29, 2026, to June 19, 2026, the Rubber Ducky Box was only purchasable in the VIP room. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on June 19, 2026. Four Rubber Ducky Boxes were also given to players for free during the Admin Abuse on May 23, 2026, and one was given to players for free during the Admin Abuse on June 13, 2026.
wiki.notes: Players have a chance to obtain a common Rubber Ducky, rare Glyptodon Ducky, ultra-rare Unicorn Ducky, or legendary Strawberry Shortcake Ducky from the Rubber Ducky Box.

wiki.availability: The Ruby Necklace is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It is obtainable through purchasing and opening the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. It is otherwise obtainable through opening Admin Abuse Boxes, purchasing it for 4,500 when it is on rotation in the Accessory Shop, or trading.

The Ruddy Duck is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 10, 2026, alongside week four of the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could have purchased it for 29,000, or hatched it from a Basic Egg, Crystal Egg, or Admin Abuse Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 24, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Ruddy Duck features a mostly brown and beige duck with a blue beak, two black eyes, and dark purple on its head, tail, wing tips, and feet. Here are the tricks the Ruddy Duck learns in order: The Neon Ruddy Duck glows blue on its beak, wing tips, tail, and feet. The Mega Neon Ruddy Duck glows in the same areas as the Neon Ruddy Duck, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ruddy Duck Waddler is a limited ultra-rare single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on July 10, 2026, alongside week four of the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could have purchased it for 70,000. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 24, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Ruddy Duck Waddler shares much of its features with the Ruddy Duck pet, being a mostly brown and beige duck with a blue beak, two black eyes, and dark purple on its head, tail, wing tips, and feet. Unlike the Ruddy Duck, it has a brown saddle on its back, black hollowed spaces on the bottom of either side of its body, and wider-shaped feet. When driven by a player, it leaves behind a black trail from each of its feet. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Ruff is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that is a part of the Pirate's Costume, which could be purchased for 250. On April 24, 2026, the Pirate's Costume was added to the Final Stop Shop and discounted to 175 before leaving the game on May 1, 2026. The Ruff can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Ruff features a two-layered white piece of cloth with ruffled edges. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The S'mores Cookie is a common food item in Adopt Me! that can be purchased in the camping lodge located at the Campsite for 5. It can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The S'mores Cookie features a classic s'more with two tan graham crackers with a melted white marshmallow and dark brown chocolate in the center. This item can be used to fulfill the 'hungry' ailment on pets and babies. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. It takes three uses to fully consume.

wiki.availability: The S'mores Earrings are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on July 10, 2026, alongside week four of the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could have purchased them for 2,500. They are now only obtainable through trading, as they left the game on July 24, 2026.

The S'mores Pogo Stick is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on July 10, 2026, alongside week four of the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could have purchased it for 4,500. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 24, 2026.
wiki.notes: The S'mores Pogo Stick serves no purpose aside from being a fun pogo stick to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The S'mores Raccoon is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on July 10, 2026, alongside week four of the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could have purchased it for 150. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 24, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the S'mores Raccoon learns in order: The Neon S'mores Raccoon glows red on the melted chocolate in its tail, the melted marshmallow in its abdomen and on its underbelly, the spots on its tail, back, and feet, the undersides of its feet, parts of its ears and face, the underside of its head, and on its whiskers and nose. The Mega Neon S'mores Raccoon glows in the same areas as the Neon S'mores Raccoon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The S'mores Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on July 10, 2026, alongside week four of the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could have purchased it for 20,000. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 24, 2026.
wiki.notes: This item can transport three pets or babies at a time, and be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The SSBD Beanie is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on February 13, 2026. It could have been obtained by pre-ordering the Strawberry Shortcake Bat Dragon Scented Plush + Reversible Bag through the merch tab of the in-game Shop Menu, until it went off-sale on March 9, 2026. The SSBD Beanie can now only be obtained through trading.

The SSBD Sunnies are limited legendary pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on February 13, 2026. They could have been obtained by pre-ordering the Strawberry Shortcake Bat Dragon T-Shirt through the merch tab of the in-game Shop Menu, until it went off-sale on March 9, 2026. The SSBD Sunnies can now only be obtained through trading.

The SUV is a limited legendary four-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released along with the Celebrity Mansion. It could be obtained by purchasing the Celebrity Mansion gamepass for 680. On April 24, 2026, the Celebrity Mansion was added to the Final Stop Shop and discounted to 475 before leaving the game on May 1, 2026. The SUV can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The SUV is a white luxury sport utility vehicle with orange headlights, a sporty grille, black trim, and a distinctive beige interior. At the rear, it features two wiper-like elements mounted on opposite sides and facing each other. It includes a license plate holder but does not have a license plate installed. The vehicle is based on the Range Rover Sport. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Sabertooth is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2020, along with the Fossil Egg. Its release was confirmed in the Fossil Isle Excavation (2020) Event, which started on October 2, 2020. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by trading or hatching any remaining Fossil Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 15% chance of hatching an ultra-rare pet from the Fossil Egg, but only a 7.5% chance of hatching a Sabertooth. The Sabertooth features a coral-colored pelt with a light yellow underbelly. It has brown horizontal stripes on its back. Additionally, it has four brown feet and the tip of its tail is brown. The Sabertooth's inner ears are light yellow, and there are black eyes on its face with brown triangle-like shapes on top. Two long white teeth can be seen protruding downwards from its mouth. Here are the tricks the Sabertooth learns in order: The Neon Sabertooth glows green on its inner ears, nose, near its eyes, back stripes, feet, and tail stripes. The Mega Neon Sabertooth glows in the same areas as the Neon Sabertooth, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Sabertooth Sticker is an ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Fossil Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Sabertooth Sticker features a cartoon Sabertooth.

wiki.availability: The Sack of Cash is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 0.94% and 0.22% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on September 29, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Sack of Cash, as true to its name, features a tan colored sack filled with money that resembles Bucks. The sack has a brown dollar sign ($) in its center as well as a white dollar sign on each piece of money inside the sack. The sack is tied with a brown rope. This pet accessory goes on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Sado Mole is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 8, 2022, alongside the Japan Egg. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Japan Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 22% chance of hatching a common pet from the Japan Egg, but only an 11% chance of hatching a Sado Mole. The Sado Mole features a round gray body, four pink feet, and two black eyes. It has a curved snout ending in a pink nose, as well as a small circular bump on the top of its head. Here are the tricks the Sado Mole learns in order: The Neon Sado Mole glows pink on its nose, feet, and the tuft on top of its head. The Mega Neon Sado Mole glows in the same areas as the Neon Sado Mole, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Safari Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on July 5, 2019. Players could obtain it by purchasing it from the Gumball Machine in the Nursery for 750. It was replaced by the Jungle Egg on August 31, 2019, and is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Safari Egg has a 45% chance of hatching an uncommon pet, 37% chance of hatching a rare, 15% chance of hatching an ultra-rare, and a 3% chance of hatching a legendary. This egg takes six tasks to hatch. The Safari Egg features a pale yellow egg with brown pentagon-shaped blotches, resembling the Giraffe's color scheme.

wiki.availability: The Safety Pin Beanie is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 9, 2023. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 4.5% and 2.7% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on May 10, 2024, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Safety Pin Beanie, true to its name, features a black beanie with two safety pins, and a white tag on the rim. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Safety Scissors are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.8% and 5.5% chance of getting them from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Safety Scissors were removed from the game. They can now only be obtained through trading. The Safety Scissors feature silver blades with light pink covering on them. It has a black hinge and two white finger rings. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back.

wiki.egg: Standard Gorilla Boxes and Premium Gorilla Boxes
wiki.availability: The Sai is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 16, 2023, along with the Gorilla Fairground. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by opening any remaining Standard Gorilla Boxes and Premium Gorilla Boxes, or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 5% and 10% chance of obtaining a Sai from a Standard Gorilla Box and Premium Gorilla Box respectively. When a player combined three Sai and a Gorilla during the event, their Gorilla would be transformed into a Karate Gorilla. Players were able do this by talking to the Karate Gorilla (NPC) in the Gorilla Fairground. The Sai features a pointed blade with a black and white handle. It has a small pointed bottom. The Sai behaves as a throw toy. When a player clicks their screen with the Sai equipped, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Sailboat Stroller is a limited uncommon stroller in Adopt Me!. It was added to the game on November 9, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Sailboat Stroller features a brown boat with dark brown outlines and handle. It has a dark mast, a yellow mainsail, a blue jib, and a red flag at the top. It also has four dark brown wheels attached to the boat. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Sailor Cap is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 500 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Sailor Cap, features a white peaked cap with a golden anchor embroidery. It also has a navy blue brim, followed by a yellow-colored trim. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Sakura Earrings are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on April 4, 2025, alongside the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). Players could have purchased them for 450 during the event or from the item rotation in the Cherry Blossom Wagon. They can now only be obtained through trading.

The Sakura Scythe is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 4, 2025, alongside the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). Players could have purchased it for 5,000 during the event or from the item rotation in the Cherry Blossom Wagon. It can now only be obtained through trading.

The Sakura Spirit is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 4, 2025, alongside the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). It could have been purchased for 1,000 during the event or from the item rotation in the Cherry Blossom Wagon. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Sakura Spirit features a pink body with a yellow underbelly, a pink head with yellow horns, red cheek fur, pink ears, and two black eyes, and four pink feet with white claws. It has two white whiskers, white facial spots, white inner ears, and a white nose. Along its back is white, cloud-like fur that leads down to the white tip of its tail. Here are the tricks the Sakura Spirit learns in order: The Neon Sakura Spirit glows white on its back fur, whiskers, face spots, inner ears, nose, and the tip of its tail, while its underbelly glows orange and its horns glow yellow. The Mega Neon Sakura Spirit glows in the same areas as the Neon Sakura Spirit, but those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Sakura Spirit Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 25, 2025, alongside week 4 of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Cherry Blossom 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Sakura Spirit Sticker features a cartoon Sakura Spirit.

wiki.availability: The Sakura Wings are limited rare wing pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on April 25, 2025, alongside week 4 of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). Players were able to purchase them for 21,000 during the event or from the item rotation in the Cherry Blossom Wagon. They can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back when the pet is flown.

wiki.availability: The Salamander is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 17, 2022, along with the Woodland Egg. As the Woodland Egg is now unavailable for purchase, players can only obtain the Salamander by trading with other players or by hatching any remaining Woodland Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 20% chance of hatching an ultra-rare from the Woodland Egg, but only a 10% chance of hatching the Salamander. The Salamander features a long thin navy blue body with five yellow stripes, a yellow underbelly, navy blue feet, tail, head, and two beady black eyes. Here are the tricks the Salamander learns in order: The Neon Salamander has its underbelly, stripes, and the underside of its tail glowing a bright magenta. The Mega Neon Salamander glows in the same areas as the Neon Salamander, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Samoyed is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 26, 2025, alongside week four of the Winter Event (2025). Players could have purchased it in the Disco Dome for 35,000 or hatched it from a Basic Egg or Crystal Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 9, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Samoyed learns in order: The Neon Samoyed glows pale red on its ears, tail and feet. The Mega Neon Samoyed glows in the same areas as the Neon Samoyed, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Sandcastle Rattle is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2023, along with the Summer Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Summer Shop for 750. As its event has now passed, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Sandcastle Rattle features a sandcastle with a red flag and handle. This rattle tends to serve no purpose other than just being an interactable item. To interact with this rattle, a player can click or press the screen to shake.

wiki.availability: The Sandfish is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 25, 2024. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Desert Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 40% chance of hatching a common from the Desert Egg, but only a 13.33% chance of hatching the Sandfish. The Sandfish features a beige colored back, with yellow and brown stripes running from the top of its head to its tail. It has two beady black eyes, and a creme colored underbelly, with four feet. Here are the tricks the Sandfish learns in order: The Neon Sandfish glows yellow on its underbelly and the stripes on its back. The Mega Neon Sandfish glows in the same areas as the Neon Sandfish, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Sandwich is a common food item in Adopt Me! that can be obtained for free by simply joining the game, and from the School's and Hospital's cafeterias. It is also obtainable through trading. Any free Sandwiches will disappear from the player's inventory when they leave the game, and cannot be favorited.
wiki.notes: The Sandwich has slices of green lettuce and red tomatoes that are held together by two pieces of white bread. This item can be used to fulfill the 'hungry' ailment on pets and babies. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. It takes three uses to fully consume.

wiki.availability: The Sandwich Hat is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 0.19% and 0.06% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on September 29, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Sandwich Hat features two sandwiches stacked on top of each other; each sandwich appears to contain two slices of cheese, red tomatoes, and lettuce, all in between two slices of bread. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Santa Beard is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on December 22, 2025. It could have been claimed on day twenty two of the 2025 Advent Calendar, which was released as a part of the Winter Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through trading, as the day to claim it has passed. The Santa Beard was also handed out to players during the Admin Abuse on January 10, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Santa Beard features a light gray mustache and beard with glowing red, blue, yellow, and green lights sticking out of it.

wiki.availability: The Santa Copter is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on December 12, 2025, alongside the week two of the Winter Event (2025). Players could have purchased it for 74,000. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 9, 2026.
wiki.notes: This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. When a player is using the Santa Copter, they can click on it to drop gifts. When the gifts hit the ground, they disappear and snowballs fly in different directions.

wiki.availability: The Santa Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me!. Players who had the Dalmatian (then known as the Santa Dog) before the Dress Your Pets Live Event on April 11, 2020, were given this hat for free after the update. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Santa Hat features a pointy red hat with a white brim and a white pompom. It is the same hat that was previously on the Santa Dog (Dalmatian) before the update.

wiki.availability: The Santa Leash is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 14, 2019, along with the Christmas Event (2019). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading or opening any remaining Christmas Gifts.
wiki.notes: The Santa Leash features a peach-colored leash with Santa's iconic white beard and red hat. A pink line extends from the leash when used. When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, a pink line will connect the Santa Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The Santa Pet Rock Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on December 12, 2025, alongside the second week of the Winter Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Winter 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Santa Pet Rock Sticker features a cartoon Pet Rock wearing a Santa Hat.

wiki.availability: The Santa Rattle is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 13, 2019, as part of the 2019 Advent Calendar.
wiki.notes: It could have been obtained from day thirteen from the 2019 Advent Calendar during the Christmas Event (2019). Since this day has passed, the Santa Rattle is now only obtainable through trading. The Santa Rattle features a white candy cane with red stripes and a figure of Santa Claus holding onto the middle part. The figure wears a pointy red hat with a white brim, a red shirt with a black belt and white hems, red pants, and black shoes. As it's a rattle, the Santa Rattle just serves as a cosmetic toy item or a fun interactable toy, where it will shake when interacted with.

wiki.availability: The Santa Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on December 23, 2024. It could have been claimed on day twenty three of the 2024 Advent Calendar, which was released as a part of the Winter Festival (2024). It can now only be obtained through trading, as its day has passed.
wiki.notes: The Santa Sticker features a cartoon Santa head with red text reading "Ho! Ho! Ho!" around it.

wiki.availability: The Santa Throne is a limited legendary toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 21, 2023, as part of the fourth week of the Winter Festival (2023). Players could purchase this toy for 25,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Santa Throne can be placed on flat surfaces in the Adoption Island. It can seat up to two players/pets.

wiki.availability: The Santa's Bow is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on December 20, 2024, alongside week three of the Winter Festival (2024). Players could have purchased it for 4,750 until January 17, 2025. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Santa's Bow features a red bow with two red and white hanging ribbons, as well as a yellow and black buckle in the center. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Santa's Helper Stroller is a limited rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on December 14, 2025. It could have been claimed on day fourteen of the 2025 Advent Calendar, which was released as a part of the Winter Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through trading, as the day to claim it has passed.
wiki.notes: This item can transport one pet or baby at a time, and be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Santa's Sleigh is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released as part of the Christmas Event (2019). It was obtainable from the Christmas Gift and Golden Gift, which cost 1,440 and 4,300 respectively. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading or opening any remaining Christmas Gifts or Golden Gifts.
wiki.notes: There is a 1% chance of obtaining the Santa's Sleigh from the Christmas Gift, and a 2.5% chance of obtaining it from the Golden Gift. The Santa's Sleigh is a red sleigh with gold accents. As it floats, the Santa's Sleigh bobs around in the air while producing a cloud of sparkles out of the back. The Santa's Sleigh does not stop levitating or producing sparkles when parked. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Santa's Throne Sticker is a limited uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on January 3, 2025, alongside the fifth week of the Winter Festival (2024). It can now only be obtained through trading or unboxing any remaining Winter 2024 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000 until January 17, 2025.

The Sasquatch is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 19, 2021. It can be obtained by hatching a Mythic Egg. Since the Mythic Egg left the game on March 17, 2022, the Sasquatch is now only obtainable through trading or by hatching any remaining Mythic Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 34% chance of hatching a rare pet from the Mythic Egg, but only a 17% chance of hatching the Sasquatch. The Sasquatch has a spherical brown body with layers of brown fur, with a beige underside. It features two beige arms with three dark brown claws, and two large, dark brown feet. It has a beige head with two beady black eyes, a brown nose, and dark brown hair that covers most of its head, as well as a tuft of brown hair on top. Listed below are the tricks the Sasquatch learns in order: The Neon Sasquatch glows bright orange around its arms and on the fur around its head. The Mega Neon Sasquatch glows in the same areas as the Neon Sasquatch, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Sasquatch Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Premium Sticker Pack for 50; players have a 30% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Sasquatch Sticker features a cartoon Sasquatch.

wiki.availability: The Satellite Balloon is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on September 2, 2021, as part of the second 2021 gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: It could have been obtained by opening a Small, Big, or Massive Gift, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. The Satellite Balloon left the game during the first 2022 Gift Refresh on March 31, 2022, and is now only obtainable through trading. The Satellite Balloon, as true to its name, features a white string topped with a white cylindrical satellite. The satellite has two dark blue panels attached to both sides. As it's a balloon, its only function is to allow a player to jump higher.

wiki.availability: The Satellite Spinner is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 0.4% and 0.1% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Satellite Spinner was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Satellite Spinner features a wide white satellite with four gray dots in the center. It has a four-handled gray bottom, and a contraption near the front that emits light gray animations. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Saturn Balloon is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Saturn Balloon features the planet Saturn attached to a black string. As it is a balloon, its only function is to allow a player to jump higher.

wiki.availability: The Saucepan Hat is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022, as part of the first Accessory Chest rotation.
wiki.notes: It could have been be obtained through unboxing the Regal Chest or the Standard Chest; players have a 20% and 60% chance of getting a common item from these boxes, respectively, although only a 2% and 6% chance of getting a Saucepan Hat. These boxes can be found in the Accessory Shop. On September 29, 2022, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Saucepan Hat was removed from the game. wiki.availability: The Shrew (formerly known as the Elf Shrew) is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was obtainable during the 2019 Christmas Event by purchasing it for 23,000. wiki.notes: Before the Dress Your Pets Update, the Shrew used to be called the Elf Shrew and had an Elf Hat on its head. The hat was removed and placed in the owner's inventory after the update, allowing players to trade it separately as a pet accessory. Players who had a Neon Elf Shrew received four Elf Hats instead of one. Players could also receive an Elf Hat if they bought a Hedgehog. The Shrew has a brown body, feet, and tail. It has a light tan underbelly and ears. In addition, it has a pink nose and has the same pink on the insides of its ears. It has black beady eyes, with a tan circle surrounding each one. Listed below are all the tricks the Shrew learns in order: The Neon Shrew has a bright pink belly, while the Neon Elf Shrew used to have a yellow glowing bell on its hat. However, the hat stopped glowing after the Dress Your Pets update. The Mega Neon Shrew glows in the same areas as the Neon Shrew, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.
