wiki.availability: The Skelebat is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 3, 2025, alongside the Halloween Event (2025). Players could have purchased it for 76,000 on the suspension bridge, or hatched it from the Basic Egg or Crystal Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on November 7, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Skelebat features a large skull with two open nostrils and several sharp edges along the bottom. Its eye sockets contain glowing green eyes. It has large ears with brown inner sections, a ribcage made up of three ribs connected by two vertebrae, and small wings with two digits each. Here are the tricks the Skelebat learns in order: The Neon Skelebat glows light green on its wings, vertebrae, inner ears, nostrils, eye sockets, and the insides of its skull and ribs. The Mega Neon Skelebat glows in the same areas as the Neon Skelebat, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.addedEvent: The Skeleton Pogo Stick is a limited uncommon toy that was available during the Halloween Event (2019)
wiki.availability: The Skeleton Pogo Stick is a limited uncommon toy that was available during the Halloween Event (2019) from the Candy Trading Shop. It cost 4,000, and is no longer obtainable unless through trading.
wiki.notes: The Skeleton Pogo Stick features a white pogo resembling a skeleton's rib cage. As it is a pogo stick, it provides transportation by bouncing instead of walking.

wiki.availability: The Skeleton Shell is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 650 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Skeleton Shell is white with dark orange lines, with a shape similar to that of the Turtle Shell. It is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Skeleton Winged Glider is a limited legendary toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2025, alongside the second week of the Halloween Event (2025). It could have been purchased for 90,000. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on November 7, 2025.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with the Skeleton Winged Glider equipped, it grows in size and they are lifted upwards. They can then click their screen again to be boosted upwards while using it. To stop gliding, they can use the jump button or collide into an object.

wiki.availability: The Skeleton Winged Glider is a limited legendary toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2025, alongside the second week of the Halloween Event (2025). It could have been purchased for 90,000. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on November 7, 2025.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with the Skeleton Winged Glider equipped, it grows in size and they are lifted upwards. They can then click their screen again to be boosted upwards while using it. To stop gliding, they can use the jump button or collide into an object.

wiki.availability: The Sketchbook is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on March 9, 2021. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 150. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Sketchbook features a blue sketchbook and a pencil wrapped with a bright blue band on top. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Ski Goggles are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on December 15, 2020. They could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 125 when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Ski Goggles feature blue lenses with a white border and a snowflake decal on the corner. There is a white strap that goes around a pet's head. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Ski Pole Pogo is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on May 12, 2022. It can be found and purchased in the Snowy Igloo Shop for 995 when the Snow Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Ski Pole Pogo features a black stick with a pointed end. There are two blue-and-orange skis placed on the stick; one serves as the pogostick's handles while the other is its footrest. There is a small red ring in the middle of the footrest. The Ski Pole Pogo serves no use other than being a fun pogostick to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Skis are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on December 19, 2020, as a part of the Winter Holiday (2020). They could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 150 when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Skis feature a pair of light blue skis with white arrows on each ski along with other details. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Skull Bow is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on October 5, 2023, as a part of the Halloween Event (2023).
wiki.notes: Players could obtain the Skull Bow by purchasing it for 1,650 in the Asylum shop. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading. The Skull Bow is a red and black striped bow with a white skull in the center. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.addedEvent: Halloween Shop during the Halloween Event (2020)
wiki.availability: The Skull Drum is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased for 1,500 in the Halloween Shop during the Halloween Event (2020). As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Skull Drum features a white skeleton head with black eye sockets, black nose, and overlapping teeth. It also comes with a set of drumsticks resembling bones. To interact with this item, a player can click on their screen with the Skull Drum equipped to play music.

wiki.availability: The Skull Propeller is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 6, 2022, along with the Halloween Event (2022). Players could obtain the Skull Propeller by purchasing it for 5,000 in the Halloween Shop. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Skull Propeller features a long white handle with curved bone edges on its bottom; it has four propeller blades in shape of bones and is topped with a round skull with black eye holes. To interact with this item, the player can click or press anywhere on their screen to be propelled upwards. To stop, a player must jump while the propeller is in use.

wiki.availability: The Skull Toy is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.7% and 0.6% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On April 20, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Skull Toy was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Skull Toy features a black bomb topped with a beige rope. It has a skull-and-crossbones design on its front. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Sky Wings are limited ultra-rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They were obtainable through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As they were removed from the game on August 22, 2025, they can now only be obtained through trading.

The Sled is a limited rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released alongside the Christmas Event (2019). It can be obtained by opening Christmas Gifts or Golden Gifts, which cost 1,440 or 4,300, respectively. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading or opening any remaining Christmas Gifts or Golden Gifts.
wiki.notes: The Sled features a brown wooden sled with pieces of wood peeling off of it. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Sledding Penguin Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on December 12, 2025, alongside the second week of the Winter Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Winter 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Sledding Penguin Sticker features a cartoon Penguin wearing a red scarf and sitting on a red sled.

wiki.availability: The Sleeping Bag is a limited uncommon toy that was added to Adopt Me! on March 17, 2022. It could have been obtained by purchasing it at the Camping Shop for 1,100. It was removed from the game on February 16, 2023, and has been replaced with the Camper's Sleeping Bag. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Sleeping Bag features a color customizable sleeping bag with a white pillow. The Sleeping Bag can be placed on flat surfaces in Adoption Island and can hold one player or pet. It replenishes the Sleepy ailment for babies and pets.

wiki.availability: The Sleepy Armadillo Sticker is an ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 3, 2026, as a part of the Pets Plus Refresh Update. It can be obtained through purchasing the Pets Plus subscription and opening the Vol. 2 Pets Plus Sticker Pack, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Sleepy Armadillo Sticker features a cartoon Armadillo curled up, with three blue 'Z's above it.

wiki.availability: The Sleigh Bell Throw Toy is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 1, 2021, as part of the Winter Holiday (2021). It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Winter Market for 13,000. Since the event ended on January 6, 2022, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Sleigh Bell Throw Toy features three silver bells attached to a red decorative bow with gold outlines. As it's a throw toy, this toy is meant to be thrown, where the player's equipped pet would fetch the Sleigh Bell Throw Toy and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.addedEvent: It was obtainable during the Christmas Event (2019)
wiki.availability: The Sleigh Bells Rattle is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me!. It was obtainable during the Christmas Event (2019) through purchasing and opening Christmas Gifts or Golden Gifts, which cost 1,440 and 4,300. It is now unobtainable unless through trading, or opening any remaining Christmas Gifts or Golden Gifts.
wiki.notes: The Sleigh Bells Rattle features a long, beige-colored stick, topped with six golden bells. To interact with this item, a player can click their screen to shake it back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Sleigh Earrings are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on December 14, 2023, as part of the third week of the Winter Festival (2023). Players were able to purchase them for 1,200 in the Winter Village. As the event has ended, they can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Sleigh Earrings feature a wooden sled with red runners, held up by a green string with red berries at the end. These pet accessories go on a pet's ears, or the sides of its head.

wiki.availability: The Sleigh Stroller is a limited uncommon stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on November 30, 2023, along with the Winter Festival (2023). Players were able to purchase this stroller for 5,600. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Sleigh Stroller features a red sleigh with snow frosting on its sides and part of its struts. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Slime is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 26, 2023, as part of the Halloween Event (2023). During the event, it was available for purchase in the Asylum shop for 60,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Slime features a bright green translucent slime with three bubbles on its head and two black eyes. These are the tricks the Slime learns in order: The Neon Slime glows blue on its entire body. The Mega Neon Slime glows in the same areas as the Neon Slime, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Slime Backpack is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on October 5, 2023, as a part of the Halloween Event (2023).
wiki.notes: Players could obtain the Slime Backpack by purchasing it for 450 in the Asylum shop. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading. The Slime Backpack is a white backpack with green slime dripping down. This pet accessory goes on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Slime Shades are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on October 4, 2024, as part of the Halloween Event (2024). Players could have purchased them for 750 or for 2 during the first week of the event. As the event has ended, they can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Slime Shades feature bright green glasses with green slime dripping from the frame. This pet accessory is worn on a pet’s face.

wiki.availability: The Slime Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 25, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Halloween Event (2024). As the event has ended and the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon has closed, it can only be obtained through opening any remaining Halloween 2024 Sticker Packs or trading.
wiki.notes: The Slime Sticker features a cartoon Slime.

wiki.availability: The Slimingo is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 17, 2025, alongside the third week of the Halloween Event (2025). Players could have purchased it for 165,000 or hatched it from the Crystal Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on November 7, 2025.
wiki.notes: During the Halloween Event (2025), the Slimingo spawned in the swamp area every 15 minutes, allowing players to purchase it. It despawned after five minutes. The Slimingo features a model similar in shape to the Flamingo. It has a black face and beak, white head and feet, black neck, and a black torso. Its wings are black and white. Its tail is made up of a flowing black shadow, and other parts of its body give off a similar effect. When walking or being carried by a walking player, black and purple smoke appears around the Slimingo, and its body turns transparent. Here are the tricks the Slimingo learns in order: The Neon Slimingo glows red on its head, wings, and feet. The Mega Neon Slimingo glows in the same areas as the Neon Slimingo, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Slimingo Feather Teleporter is a limited legendary toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 24, 2025, alongside week four of the Halloween Event (2025). Players could have purchased it for 29. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on November 7, 2025.
wiki.notes: When held by a player, they can position the location they wish to teleport to by angling their camera to move a gray circle on the ground, and then click to teleport to that location.

wiki.availability: The Sloth is an ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released around September 2019. Players can purchase it in the Pet Shop or through the Shop menu for 169 (formerly 199). It can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Sloth features a brown body with three claws, two brown feet, black eyes, a black nose, a light brown color around the nose and its eyes, and no ears. Here are the tricks a Sloth learns in order: The Neon Sloth glows pastel yellow on its nose, claws, and feet. The Mega Neon Sloth glows in the same areas as the Neon Sloth, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Sloth Sticker is an uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Sticker Pack for 250; players have a 25% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Sloth Sticker features a cartoon Sloth.

wiki.availability: The Slug is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released along with the Halloween Event (2022) on October 6, 2022. It was priced at 9,000. As the event has ended, the Slug is now only obtainable by trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Slug features a small body, a green back, and a light green underbelly. There are little dark green dots on its sides. It has two tentacles on its head, with a black eye on each one, and two green bits of skin protruding from its head. These are the tricks the Slug learns in order: The Neon Slug glows light purple on its underbelly and the little dots on its sides. The Mega Neon Slug glows in the same areas as the Neon Slug, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Slug Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 25, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Halloween Event (2024). As the event has ended and the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon has closed, it can only be obtained through opening any remaining Halloween 2024 Sticker Packs or trading.
wiki.notes: The Slug Sticker features a cartoon Slug.

wiki.availability: The Slug Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 25, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Halloween Event (2024). As the event has ended and the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon has closed, it can only be obtained through opening any remaining Halloween 2024 Sticker Packs or trading.
wiki.notes: The Slug Sticker features a cartoon Slug.

wiki.availability: The Small Gift is a common gift in Adopt Me! that was released on December 21, 2017, alongside the Christmas Event (2017). It can be found at the Gifts display with the Big Gift and Massive Gift, and purchased for 70. It is otherwise obtainable through completing the "Buy a Gift from Santa" achievement in the "Explore" section of the Guide, aging up pets, purchasing it from the Star Rewards for 1, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Small Gift was previously obtainable through leveling up the Sunshine Games Pass from the Games Event (2024), and from the Daily Reward. Players have a 60% chance of getting a common item, 30% chance of getting an uncommon item, 7.5% chance of getting a rare item, 2% chance of getting an ultra-rare item, and a 0.5% chance of getting a legendary item. The items obtainable are displayed on the gift board, which changes according to the gifts rotation. The Small Gift has a violet exterior, designed with white and purple diamonds. It also has a silver ribbon wrapped around it, with a large silver bow on top.

wiki.addedEvent: It was available during the Halloween Event (2021)
wiki.availability: The Small Mushroom was a temporary common toy in Adopt Me!. It was available during the Halloween Event (2021) and could have been obtained during the Potion Hunt minigame. In the minigame, it was located in a small cervice of a room and could be used to obtain the Ghost Translucency Potion, Candle Summoning Potion, and Dog Head Potion.
wiki.notes: It could also be used to obtain the Dizzy Potion if it was not displayed on the instructions board for that round. It stayed in players' inventories until the end of the Potion Hunt minigame. As the Halloween Event (2021) has ended, this item is no longer obtainable and has been completely removed from the game. The Small Mushroom features a flat red top with a short brown stem.

wiki.availability: The Small Sip Potion is a rare potion in Adopt Me! that was released on January 18, 2020, as part of the Magic Update. It can be found in the Sky Castle next to the Big Brew Potion and purchased for 250, purchased from the Star Rewards for 2, received as a reward for aging up pets, or obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Small Sip Potion features a spherical flask with glowing pink liquid inside, topped with a brown cork. Its shape is similar to the Big Brew Potion, the only difference being its size. The Small Sip Potion can make a pet shrink for 10 minutes. Its effect stacks up to three times; if any more Small Sip Potions are fed to the pet, it only increases the time until the effect wears off. The time left before the potion's effect wears off only runs when the pet is equipped and the player is in-game. Similar to the other pet potions, the effects only work on pets.

wiki.availability: The Snack and Beverage Carrier is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on November 22, 2024, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Snack and Beverage Carrier features a brown box with multi-colored candy and other items in it. Connected to the back of the box, there is a black and white strap. There is a small white pawprint on the box. This pet accessory is worn around a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Snapdragon Flower is a limited legendary food in Adopt Me! that was released as a part of the return of the Butterfly Sanctuary on June 6, 2025. Players could have purchased it for 25, which were earned through doing ailments with orange icons while in a server with one or more Roblox friend. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on June 20, 2025.
wiki.notes: When using a Snapdragon Flower, players are able to obtain a Blue Butterfly, Amber Butterfly, or Seafoam Butterfly. The Prismatic Butterfly was only available from the Snapdragon Flower during the first week of the Butterfly Sanctuary's return, which ran from June 6, 2025, to June 13, 2025. During this time the Snapdragon Flower could only be thrown during the day. The Moonbeam Butterfly was only available during the second week of the Butterfly Sanctuary's return, which ran from June 13, 2025, to June 20, 2025. During this time the Snapdragon Flower could only be thrown at night. Below are all of the pets that are obtainable from the Snapdragon Flower. These pets were previously obtainable from the Snapdragon Flower.

wiki.availability: The Sneak Weasel is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 16, 2026, alongside the German Shepherd. Players could have purchased it for 1,500 or hatched it from a Basic Egg or Crystal Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Sneak Weasel learns in order: The Neon Sneak Weasel glows light blue on the stripes on its head, back, tail, and on its feet and inner ears. The Mega Neon Sneak Weasel glows in the same areas as the Neon Sneak Weasel, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Snorgle is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 7, 2025, alongside the Moon Egg. It can now only be obtained through hatching any remaining Moon Eggs or Royal Moon Eggs, or through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 25% chance of hatching a Snorgle from the Moon Egg, and a 35% chance of hatching it from the Royal Moon Egg. The Snorgle features a red body, head, arms, and feet. It has two long floppy ears with light pink tips, and a red trunk. Around its eyes, there are light pink rings. It has a light pink belly, and the bottoms of its hands are light pink as well. Here are the tricks the Snorgle learns in order: The Neon Snorgle glows a pink-red color on its antennae, underbelly, around its eyes, the ends of its front limbs, the tips of its ears, the underside of its trunk, and on the tip of its tail. The Mega Neon Snorgle glows in the same areas as the Neon Snorgle, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Snorkel Set is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 5% and 3% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On April 20, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Snorkel Set was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Snorkel Set features a set of black goggles with a transparent lens. There is a long black and blue snorkel attached to the goggles. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Snow Balloon is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on May 12, 2022. It can be found and purchased in the Snowy Igloo Shop for 800 when the Snow Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Snow Balloon features a snow cloud colored with a gradient of white to blue. It has a thin black string attached for players to hold onto and white snowflakes coming down from it. Like all other balloons in the game, its only function is letting a player jump higher.

wiki.availability: The Snow Cat is an uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2019, along with the Pets update. Originally, players could obtain it by hatching a Cracked Egg, a Pet Egg, or a Royal Egg, but as of July 21, 2022, the Snow Cat can only be obtained by hatching a Retired Egg or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have an 8.75% chance of hatching a Snow Cat from a Retired Egg. The Snow Cat has a round white body with four white feet, a white tail, and a white head with two ears with pink insides, two beady black eyes, a pink round nose, and three small whiskers on each side of the nose. It is a white reskin of the Cat. Listed below are the tricks the Snow Cat learns in order: The Neon Snow Cat glows bright pink in its inner ears, feet, tail, nose, and whiskers. The Mega Neon Snow Cat glows in the same areas as the Neon Snow Cat, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Snow Cloud Wings are limited ultra-rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on May 12, 2022. They can be purchased in the Snowy Igloo Shop for 1,600 when the Snow Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Snow Cloud Wings feature large white wings; each wing has a cyan blue piece in its center, as well as seven wing feathers lining the edges. There are cyan blue accents throughout the wings, and they leave a trail of white-blue sparkles. These pet accessories go on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Snow Cone is a common food item in Adopt Me! that was released on February 28, 2025. It is obtainable through purchasing it from another player's Snow Cone Stand for 0 to 20, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Snow Cone can be used to fulfill the 'Hungry' ailment for babies and pets, taking three uses to fully consume. The Snow Cone features a white cone with a green mound inside.

wiki.availability: The Snow Cone Stand is an ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on February 28, 2025. It can be purchased for 60 or obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: This toy is placeable on a flat surface. Once placed, the owner of the item can choose to take the stand down or set a price. The Snow Cone Stand gives players the ability to sell Snow Cones, a food item, to other players for 0 to 20. If the price is set to 0, only one Snow Cone obtained from the stand can be held in the player's inventory at a time.

wiki.availability: The Snow Globe Sticker is a limited uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on December 5, 2024. It could have been claimed on day five of the 2024 Advent Calendar, which was released as a part of the Winter Festival (2024). It can now only be obtained through trading, as its day has passed.
wiki.notes: The Snow Globe Sticker features a cartoon snow globe with a Snowball Pet in it.

wiki.availability: The Snow Globe Stroller is a limited uncommon stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on January 3, 2025, alongside the fifth week of the Winter Festival (2024). Players could have purchased it for 13,000 until January 17, 2025. As the event has ended, they can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Snow Globetrotter is a limited ultra-rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on November 30, 2023, as part of the Winter Festival (2023). Players were able to purchase this vehicle for 75,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Snow Globetrotter features a red snow globe with four red-white wheels, an orange printed paw, glowing yellow lights, and candy cane stripes at the bottom part of the snow globe. The inside of the Snow Globetrotter features a candy cane colored steering wheel, three orange glowing buttons, and constant falling snow particles. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Snow Leopard is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 1, 2021, as part of the Winter Holiday (2021). It could have been obtained by purchasing it in the Winter Market for 10,000. Since the event ended on January 6, 2022, the Snow Leopard is now only obtainable through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: These are the tricks the Snow Leopard learns in order: The Snow Leopard features a gray-colored pet with a lighter gray underbelly. It has multiple dark gray spots all over its body as well as rough fur below its head and torso. It also has two beady black eyes, a pink nose, and black whiskers. The Snow Leopard is angled down, making its rear end appear higher than the rest of the body. The Neon Snow Leopard glows a yellow-orange color on its underside, spots, inner ears, and feet. The Mega Neon Snow Leopard glows in the same areas as the Neon Snow Leopard, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Snowy Mammoth Sticker is a limited uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on March 21, 2025. It is obtainable through placing an Ice Soup Bait into a Box Lure or Cozy Home Lure, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 6.1% chance of obtaining a sticker from the Ice Soup Bait, but only a 1.5% chance of getting a Snowy Mammoth Sticker. The Snowy Mammoth Sticker features a cartoon Snowy Mammoth.

wiki.availability: The Snow Mobile Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on May 12, 2022. It can be purchased in the Snowy Igloo Shop for 1,200 when the Snow Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Snow Mobile Stroller features a cyan blue stroller with a white seat and pillow inside, as well as two glowing white headlights at the front. Its edges are outlined with black. It has two gray-and-yellow skis attached to its front, while a conveyor wheel can be found at the back. Its appearance bears a resemblance to the Tundra Exploration Machine. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Snow Monkey is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 28, 2023, as part of the fifth week of the Winter Festival (2023). Players were able to purchase this pet for 58,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Snow Monkey features a white monkey with a large white head and a round beige muzzle. It has two small white ears with beige inner parts and two black eyes surrounded by beige skin. It has a fluffy white body. Here are the tricks the Snow Monkey learns in order: The Neon Snow Monkey glows orange on its head and arms. The Mega Neon Snow Monkey glows in the same areas as the Neon Snow Monkey, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Snow Monkey Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on December 12, 2025, alongside the second week of the Winter Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Winter 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Snow Monkey Sticker features a cartoon Snow Monkey.

wiki.availability: The Snow Owl is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 15, 2020, as part of the Winter Holiday (2020).
wiki.notes: It could have been obtained by purchasing it in the Snow Castle for 10,000. Since the event ended on January 19, 2021, the Snow Owl is now only obtainable through trading with other players. The Snow Owl has a small, vibrant light blue body with white and baby blue feathers. It has a black beak and feet, and around its eyes are crescent-shaped moons that curve around its big, round, black eyes. When a player equips it, it floats up and down, and flaps its wings. Here are the tricks the Snow Owl learns in order: The Neon Snow Owl glows cyan on a few of its front feathers, the feathers above and around its eyes, and the tips of its wings. The Mega Neon Snow Owl glows in the same areas as the Neon Snow Owl, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Snow Plow is a limited ultra-rare six-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on May 12, 2022. It can be purchased for 3,000 when the Snow Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Snow Plow features a large yellow truck with a gray-white storage box on its back. It has four large black wheels, and has a yellow and gray snow plow at its front. It has three blue-tinted windows and a small steering wheel. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Snow Puma is a rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2019, along with the Pets update. Originally, players could obtain it by hatching a Cracked Egg, a Pet Egg, or a Royal Egg, but as of July 21, 2022, the Snow Puma can only be obtained by hatching a Retired Egg or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 6.75% chance of hatching a Snow Puma from a Retired Egg. The Snow Puma has white fur, triangular-shaped ears with pink inner ears, a white tail, a light gray underbelly, white paws, black eyes, a pink nose, and a muzzle with gray whiskers. It is a recolored version of the Puma, being snow-white instead of tan. Here are the tricks a Snow Puma learns in order: The Neon Snow Puma form has its ears, paws, tail, and nose glow bright pink. The Mega Neon Snow Puma glows in the same areas as the Neon Snow Puma, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Snow Snowboard is a limited common single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was available in the old Gifts rotation in December 2017. It could have been obtained through opening Massive Gifts for 625. However, as the Gifts were updated with new items, the Snow Snowboard can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Snow Snowboard features a white snowboard with a snow texture and two areas for a player to place their feet into. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Snowball Launcher is a limited common toy that was added to Adopt Me! during the Winter Holiday (2020). Since it has left the game, it is only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: Players had to look around the map for presents, which, when searched, gave players the Snowball Launcher parts. After searching through three presents players were given the Snowball Launcher, along with 800. The Snowball Launcher has two light-gray prongs with a darker gray handle. A white string stretches across the ends of the prongs; this leads to a blue snowball holder. In the center of the Snowball Launcher, there is a small teal oval. When interacted with, an animation is played and a snowball is launched from the Snowball Launcher. When the snowball comes in contact with another object, it will "explode" and emit white particle effects.

wiki.availability: The Snowball Pet is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 15, 2022, as part of week 3 of the Winter Event (2022). It could have been obtained by purchasing it in the Candy Castle or on the Shop GUI for 99. Since the event ended on January 5, 2023, the Snowball Pet is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Snowball Pet features a round white body with two black eyes, three small black freckles on each of its cheeks, and a pointed orange carrot nose. It has two white spheres for hands and two feet. Listed below are the tricks the Snowball Pet learns in order: The Neon Snowball Pet glows turquoise on its carrot nose, hands, feet, and freckles. The Mega Neon Snowball Pet glows in the same areas as the Neon Snowball Pet, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Snowball Pug is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 12, 2025, alongside week two of the Winter Event (2025). During the event, players could tame it by using 10 to 20 Yarn Beanies. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 5, 2026.
wiki.notes: Every two in-game days, Snowball Pugs spawned in a taming area behind the Pizza Shop, and remained there until night arrived. When using a Yarn Beanie food item to tame one, there was a skill check minigame. In the minigame there was a Yarn Beanie sliding from left to right, and a Snowball Pug head in the middle. If the player managed to time their Yarn Beanie throw accurately by landing on the head, they gained 10% taming progress. Missing the head resulted in them gaining 5% taming progress. Only one Yarn Beanie could be used during each spawn period. Once the player reached 100% taming progress, they received a Snowball Pug and a Yarn Beanie pet accessory. Here are the tricks the Snowball Pug learns in order: The Neon Snowball Pug glows light red on its muzzle, ears, feet, and tail. The Mega Neon Snowball Pug glows in the same areas as the Neon Snowball Pug, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Snowblower Toboggan is a limited ultra-rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on December 15, 2022, alongside the third week of the Winter Event (2022). It could have been found in the Candy Castle and bought for 50,000. As its event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Snowblower Tobbogan features a curved blue sled with yellow slats near the center. It has red reins near its front, a red snowblower at the back that emits a white trail, and small green details near the back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Snowflake Badge is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 12, 2022. It can be purchased in the Snowy Igloo Shop for 50 when the Snow Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Snowflake Badge features a gold-rimmed cyan badge with a white snowflake design in its center. This pet accessory is worn over a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Snowflake Cookie is a limited uncommon food item in Adopt Me! that was released on December 13, 2023, as part of the Winter Festival (2023). It was obtainable by claiming it from the event's Advent Calendar on day thirteen. Since its day has passed, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Snowflake Cookie can be used to fulfill the 'Hungry' ailment for babies and pets, taking three uses to fully consume. The Snowflake Cookie features a light brown cookie, decorated with white icing in the shape of a snowflake.

wiki.availability: The Snowflake Earmuffs are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on December 12, 2025, alongside week two of the Winter Event (2025). Players could have purchased them for 3,500. They are now only obtainable through trading, as they left the game on January 9, 2026.

The Snowflake Earrings are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on May 12, 2022. They can be purchased in the Snowy Igloo Shop for 250 when the Snow Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Snowflake Earrings feature a pair of white, snowflake-shaped earrings that use the same design as the Snowflake Flying Disc. These pet accessories are worn on the sides of a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Snowflake Flying Disc (formerly known as Snowflake Frisbee) is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 8, 2019. It could have been obtained from the 2019 Advent Calendar on the 8th day. As its day has passed, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Snowflake Flying Disc features a flat, pale-blue snowflake. It bears a similar appearance to the Snowflake Ornament and the Snowflake Throwing Disc. When the Snowflake Flying Disc is interacted with, it is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Snowflake Flying Disc (formerly known as Snowflake Frisbee) is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 8, 2019. It could have been obtained from the 2019 Advent Calendar on the 8th day. As its day has passed, it can now only be obtained through trading.

wiki.availability: The Snowflake Plush is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 13, 2024, alongside the second week of the Winter Festival (2024). Players could have purchased it for 750. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 17, 2025.

wiki.availability: The Snowflake Potion is a limited uncommon potion in Adopt Me! that was released in 2018. It could have been obtained by opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, or 499, respectively. As it is no longer part of the gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Snowflake Potion features a cyan potion in a twisted bottle with a black cap. When consumed, snowflakes will surround the player.

wiki.availability: The Snowflake Propeller is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on November 30, 2023, along with the Winter Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it for 6,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Snowflake Propeller features a light blue snowflake face, with a white pole, and a blue handle grip. To interact with this toy, a player can click or press their screen to be propelled upward; they can press the spacebar or the jump button to stop.

wiki.availability: The Snowflake Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on December 12, 2025, alongside the second week of the Winter Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Winter 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Snowflake Sticker features a light blue snowflake design.

wiki.notes: The Snowflake Throwing Disc features a flat snowflake. When a player equips it in-game, its color is dark blue; this is contrary to its inventory image, in which the disc is depicted as pale-blue. It bears a similar appearance to the Snowflake Ornament and the Snowflake Flying Disc. To interact with this item, a player can click/press their screen to throw the toy and an equipped pet will pick it up and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Snowman is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 15, 2020, as part of the Winter Holiday (2020). It could have been obtained by purchasing it in the Snow Castle for 2,000. Since the event ended on January 19, 2021, the Snowman is now only obtainable through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Snowman is made up of 2 white snowballs, a smaller sphere-shaped one for the head and a larger oval-shaped one for the body. It has 2 black beady eyes, a carrot nose, 3 black buttons on its body, and arms made of brown twigs. Listed below are the tricks the Snowman learns in order: The Neon Snowman glows light orange on its carrot nose and three buttons. The Mega Neon Snowman glows in the same areas as the Neon Snowman, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Snowman Nose is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on December 20, 2024, alongside week three of the Winter Festival (2024). Players could have purchased it for 1,250 until January 17, 2025. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.

wiki.availability: The Snowman Plush is a limited common toy that was available in the gifts rotation. It cost 70 or 199 in the respective Gifts. It is now only obtainable through trading.

It is a snowman, wearing a top hat with a gold sash. This toy has a resemblance to the Snowman Rattle and the Snowman pet.

wiki.availability: The Snowman Plushie Friend is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me!. It can be purchased in the Snowy Igloo Shop for 95 when the Snow Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.

Its face has a round orange carrot and two black eyes, while its body has two brown sticks attached, resembling arms, and three black buttons. To interact with this toy, a player can click/press their screen to hug it.

The snowman consists of three snowballs of different sizes, two large ones for the body and a small one for the head. It also includes a black top hat with a golden rim, sticks as the hands, and tiny details for its facial features. It is held up by a white stick. Just like any other rattle, its only usage is being a fun collectible toy to play with. To interact with this toy, a player can click their screen to shake it back and forth.

wiki.notes: The Snowman Winter Hat features a white beanie with a red trim that is meant to resemble a snowman's head. There is a snowman's face on the front of the hat that has two big eyes, a yellow nose, some freckles, and a smiley mouth. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

The Snowmobile is now only obtainable through trading. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Snowstorm Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on December 24, 2025. It could have been claimed on day twenty four of the 2025 Advent Calendar, which was released as a part of the Winter Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through trading, as the day to claim it has passed. The Snowstorm Hat was also handed out to players during the Admin Abuse on January 10, 2026.

The Mega Neon Snowy Mammoth glows in the same areas as the Neon Snowy Mammoth, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Snowy Tree Hat is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on December 3, 2024. It could have been claimed on day three of the 2024 Advent Calendar, which was released as a part of the Winter Festival (2024). It can now only be obtained through trading, as its day has passed.
wiki.notes: The Snowy Tree Hat features a green tree topped with a glowing orange star and covered in snow. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Soapy Skates is a limited common single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on November 3, 2022, as part of the new gifts rotation. It could be purchased for 70 or 199 from Small or Big Gifts. It is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Soapy Skates feature two pink rectangular bars with lighter pink insides. There are small wedged-in areas for the player's feet. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Soccer Ball Throw Toy is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was available in the Small and Big Gifts, which cost 70 and 199 respectively. Players had a 60% chance of obtaining a common item from the Small Gift, and a 20% chance of obtaining a common item from the Big Gift. As of the 2021 Gift Refresh update, the Gifts were updated with another set of items. The Soccer Ball Throw Toy can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Soccer Ball Throw Toy features a standard soccer ball with black pentagons and white hexagons outlined in black. When interacted with, the Soccer Ball Throw Toy is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

It has a green and white spoiler, light blue headlights and orange rear lights. Its interior is entirely black, as well as its bumpers and door handles. It has four soccer balls for wheels, and a black antennae with a flag attached on its roof. The flag was color-customizable upon purchasing this vehicle. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

When used, the player's equipped pet picks up the toy in its mouth and stays in one area until the toy is picked up again. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.7% and 0.6% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.

This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Sock Hat features a white upside-down sock with red spots on the front and back. There are black stitches between the red and white parts. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Socks & Sandals are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on March 6, 2021. They could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 200 when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.

wiki.availability: Soda is a common food item in Adopt Me!. There are two variations of Soda. The first version could have been bought from Green Groceries for 2, and was removed after the Farm Shop was released. The second version can be found in the Pizza Shop inside of a dispenser on the front counter.
wiki.notes: The Soda that was obtainable from the Green Groceries features a tall, cylindrical can with a dark brown label. It reads the word "BLOXY" vertically across its side. Its design is based on the Bloxy Cola, which can be also be found in the Roblox Catalog. The Soda obtainable from the Pizza Shop appears to be in a glass with orange liquid inside. This item can be used to fulfill the 'thirsty' ailment on pets and babies. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. It takes five uses to fully consume.

wiki.availability: The Soda Chew Toy is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 18, 2021, as part of a new gifts rotation. The pet holds it in its mouth until the player picks up the item. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Solar System Necklace is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. As it was removed from the game on November 22, 2024, it can only be obtained through trading.

wiki.availability: The Sombrero is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! which was released on April 14, 2020. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 300 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.

The hat is based on the classic Mexican hat, a sombrero, and is wide enough to provide shade for the entire body. This pet accessory is worn on top of a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Sorcerer Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on October 4, 2024, as part of the Halloween Event (2024). Players could have purchased it for 4,400 during the Halloween Event (2024) and Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) or for 12 during the second week of the Halloween Event (2024). As the events have ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
