wiki.notes: The Sorcerer Wand features a crooked brown stick with a yellow band wrapped around the upper portion. An off-white crescent moon is attached to the top, with a glowing yellow star hovering inside it, emitting small white stars. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Sour Glider is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 13, 2026, alongside the Sugar Festival Event (2026). Players could purchase it for 60,000. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on April 17, 2026.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with the Sour Glider equipped, it grows in size and they are lifted upwards. They can then click their screen again to be boosted upwards while using it. To stop gliding, they can use the jump button or collide into an object.

wiki.availability: The Southeast Asia Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on March 2, 2023, replacing the Japan Egg. It was replaced by the Danger Egg on June 8, 2023. It cost 750 and was available for purchase from the Gumball Machine in the Nursery. The Southeast Asia Egg can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Southeast Asia Egg features a gray tray on gold studs. The egg has a green base, with three yellow and red oval shaped patterns with blue petal like objects around the edge of each one around the egg. On the top of the egg is a yellow and green crown with a red vine like plant poking out.

wiki.availability: The Soy Sauce Stroller is a limited uncommon stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on April 4, 2025, alongside the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). Players could have purchased it for 10,000 during the event or from the item rotation in the Cherry Blossom Wagon. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: This item can transport one pet or baby at a time, and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Space Grappling Hook is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 18, 2021. It could have been obtained by opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, or 499, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Space Grappling Hook features a spaceship-like green body with white rims, yellow mini-windows, red spikes, and a black and green handle. To interact with this item, a player can click/press anywhere on their screen to fire a hooked cable and be pulled towards the target location. Like most other grappling hooks, players cannot use this item on non-solid graphical objects or if they are on a vehicle, doing an obby, flying or riding a pet.

wiki.availability: The Space Helmet is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.7% and 0.6% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On April 20, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Space Helmet was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Space Helmet features a white helmet with a transparent front and brown insides. It has a gray piece that loops around the bottom of the helmet, a large black top, and a small black microphone at its side. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Space Whale is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 30, 2022. It cost 2,499 and could have been purchased outside of the Nursery. It was available until July 14, 2022, can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Space Whale has a blue body, tail, and blue antennae. It has a darker blue underbelly with yellow speckles that assumably represent stars in space. It has pale yellow fins on its sides, back, and tail. It also has pale yellow circles on top of its antennae. During the night or in the Neon Cave, the pale yellow spots on the sides, antennae, and fins glow neon yellow. Listed below are the tricks the Space Whale learns in order: The Neon Space Whale glows light blue on the edges of its side fins and back fin. It also glows yellow on its upper fin and pieces of its body. The Mega Neon Space Whale glows in the same areas as the Neon Space Whale, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Space Whale Sticker is a legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Premium Sticker Pack for 50; players have a 10% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Space Whale Sticker features a cartoon Space Whale.

wiki.availability: The Spain Soccer Earrings are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on July 12, 2024. Players could purchase them for 300 until July 19, 2024. They can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Spain Soccer Earrings feature a pair of red and yellow Spain flag wrapped around a pole with a soccer ball at the bottom. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's ears or on the sides of its head.

wiki.availability: The Sparkler is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased at the Camping Shop for 20. It was removed from the game on February 16, 2023, and has been replaced with the Camper's Sparkler. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Sparkler features a thin brown stick coated with the top half coated in gray. The tip of the stick glows yellow and emits bright yellow and white sparkles. When equipped, it emits sparkles from the tip and shines brightly. Other than that, however, it does not serve any purpose other than being an interactable toy.

name: Special Lunar New Year Gift Box

wiki.availability: The Special Lunar New Year Gift Box is a limited legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was released on February 8, 2024, as part of the Lunar New Year (2024) event.
wiki.notes: Players were able to purchase this box for 21,000. Players will have higher chances of unboxing ultra-rare and legendary items from the Special Lunar New Year Gift Box than its common counterpart. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.sourceTitle: Special Lunar New Year Gift Box

wiki.availability: The Speedboat is a limited rare two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on August 5, 2021. It could have been purchased for 2,500 on a wooden pedestal beside the Pet Shop and in front of the Hot Air Balloon. As it left the game on October 21, 2021, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Speedboat is a small boat with a simplistic design. It has two black seats inside, and a prominent orange spoiler on the back. Despite being called a Speedboat, no engine or propellers can be found anywhere around the exterior of the vehicle. The exterior of the boat is colored cyan by default, however, it can be changed by the player after purchase. The secondary white color cannot be changed. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Spellbook Throw Toy is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on October 5, 2023, as a part of the Halloween Event (2023).
wiki.notes: During the event, the Spellbook Throw Toy was found in the Asylum shop for 1,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading. The Spellbook Throw Toy features a book with yellow edges and spine encrusted with orange gems, a dark brown cover with a yellow star in the center, dark yellow latches, and off-white pages. There are green, purple, and blue bookmarks hanging off different sides of the book. When thrown with a pet out, the pet will chase it and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Sperm Whale Badge is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on June 8, 2021, as part of the World Oceans Day update.
wiki.notes: It was obtainable by taking it for free from the WDC (Whale and Dolphin Conservation) Pin Badges Board, which had other badges and only one could have been collected every hour. Since the stand left the game of July 8, 2021, the Sperm Whale Badge is now only obtainable through trading. The Sperm Whale Badge features a decagon-shaped pin with a gray border that features a photo of a whale's tail fin with a light blue sea background with three waves. This pet accessory goes on a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Spider Box is a limited legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2025, alongside the second week of the Halloween Event (2025). The Spider Box was rewarded to all players who participated in Admin Abuse on November 1, 2025. Players also could have purchased it for 18,000. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on November 7, 2025.
wiki.notes: Players have a chance to obtain an uncommon Jumping Spider, a rare Tarantula, an ultra-rare Chilling Spider, or a legendary Black Widow from the Spider Box.

wiki.availability: The Spider Crab is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 8, 2022. It can now only be obtained through hatching any remaining Japan Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 20% chance of hatching an ultra-rare pet from the Japan Egg, but only a 10% chance of hatching a Spider Crab. The Spider Crab features a red body, a beige underbelly, two black eyes, and eight legs. Each leg has a joint, a beige underside, and a round beige foot at the bottom. It has two pointed red pincers, both ending with red tops and beige insides. Here are the tricks the Spider Crab learns in order: The Neon Spider Crab glows light pink on its feet and the undersides of its legs. The Mega Neon Spider Crab glows in the same areas as the Neon Spider Crab, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Spider Grappling Hook is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 28, 2020, as part of the Halloween Event (2020). It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Halloween Shop for 800. Since the event ended on November 11, 2020, the Spider Grappling Hook is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Spider Grappling Hook features a jet-black handle with a bright red balloon trapped inside the black casing. Four long white lines connect to a red ring, where a small gray spider clings to. The spider appears to pop out of the handle. The decorative spider appears to have a small white web in its mouth. As it's a grappling hook, it will pull the player to any location that they click/press on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Spider Grappling Hook is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 28, 2020, as part of the Halloween Event (2020). It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Halloween Shop for 800. Since the event ended on November 11, 2020, the Spider Grappling Hook is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Spider Grappling Hook features a jet-black handle with a bright red balloon trapped inside the black casing. Four long white lines connect to a red ring, where a small gray spider clings to. The spider appears to pop out of the handle. The decorative spider appears to have a small white web in its mouth. As it's a grappling hook, it will pull the player to any location that they click/press on their screen.

wiki.availability: The Spider Web Crown is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released along with the Halloween Event (2022) on October 6, 2022. Players could obtain the Spider Web Crown by purchasing it for 850. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Spider Web Crown features a crown consisting of several curved black lines; this design is meant to reflect a spiderweb. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Spider Web Flying Disc is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 6, 2022, as part of the Halloween Event (2022). It could have been obtained from the event's shop for 700. As the event has ended, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Spider Web Flying Disc features a brown-lined spiderweb with shades of orange and yellow between the lines. As it is a flying disc, this toy is meant to be thrown, where the player's equipped pet would fetch the Spider Web Flying Disc and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Spider Web Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2025, alongside the second week of the Halloween Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Halloween 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Spider Web Sticker features a black spider web design.

wiki.availability: The Spiderweb Coffin Backpack is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on October 24, 2025, alongside week four of the Halloween Event (2025). Players could have purchased it for 7,500. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on November 7, 2025.

The Spike Collar is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 18, 2020. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 500 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Spike Collar features a black collar with faded silver spikes going around it. This pet accessory is worn around a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Spikey Chariot Stroller is a limited rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on October 12, 2023, as part of the Halloween Event (2023). It could have been purchased in the Asylum Shop for 7,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Spikey Chariot Stroller features a light brown chair with a beige cushion connected to two black wheels with gray spikes. There is a brown handle connected so a player can push the stroller. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Spikey Goggles are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on November 9, 2023. They could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.8% and 0.7% chance of getting them from these gifts, respectively. As they were removed from the game on May 10, 2024, they can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Spikey Goggles feature a pair of goggles with a beige frame and black lens. The frame has two spikes sticking out of it on either side. These pet accessories go over a pet's eyes.

wiki.availability: The Spikey Hair Wig is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 5.5% and 3.3% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on September 29, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Spikey Hair Wig features a bright-yellow wig with tufts sticking from its top; it also has pointy bangs along its front. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Spiky Blue Hair is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 11, 2025, alongside week 2 of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). It was purchasable for 9,001 during the event or from the item rotation in the Cherry Blossom Wagon. It can now only be obtained through trading.

The Spinning Cat Animated Sticker is a legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 3, 2026, as a part of the Pets Plus Refresh Update. It can be obtained through purchasing the Pets Plus subscription and opening the Vol. 2 Pets Plus Sticker Pack, or trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 0.05% chance of getting a Spinning Cat Animated Sticker from the Vol. 2 Pets Plus Sticker Pack. The Spinning Cat Animated Sticker features a cartoon Snow Leopard standing in place, before its feet disappear and its body spins in a circle.

wiki.availability: The Spinning Propeller is a rare toy in Adopt Me!. It can be purchased at the Toy Shop for 1,300, or obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Spinning Propeller features a propeller with a spinning mechanism on top, attached to a gray handle on the bottom. It is color-customizable upon purchase. When a player clicks their screen with the Spinning Propeller equipped, they are propelled upwards. To stop, they can either unequip the item or jump.

wiki.egg: Standard Gibbon Box and Premium Gibbon Box
wiki.availability: The Spinning Teacup Vehicle is a limited ultra-rare four-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on May 16, 2025, alongside the Gibbon Fairground. As the event ended on May 30, 2025, it is now only obtainable through trading or opening any remaining Standard Gibbon Boxes or Premium Gibbon Boxes.
wiki.notes: This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Spinning Top Flying Disc is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 19, 2024. It could have been claimed on day nineteen of the 2024 Advent Calendar, which was released as a part of the Winter Festival (2024). As its day has passed, the Spinning Top Flying Disc can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: As it's a flying disc, when the player throws the Spinning Top Flying Disc to the ground, the player's equipped pet will fetch the disc and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Spinosaurus is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 8, 2023, along with the Danger Egg. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Danger Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 4% chance of hatching a legendary pet from the Danger Egg, but only a 2% chance of hatching a Spinosaurus. The Spinosaurus features a light orange head with two black eyes, white teeth, and brown spots. It has a cream-colored underbelly with a light orange back, brown spots, a brown spine, and an orange tail. It also has two feet and two arms with gray claws. Here are the tricks the Spinosaurus learns in order: The Neon Spinosaurus glows orange on its spines, underbelly, the spots around its eyes and back, and its claws. The Mega Neon Spinosaurus glows in the same areas as the Neon Spinosaurus, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Spiral Glasses are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They are obtainable through purchasing and opening the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. They are otherwise obtainable through opening Admin Abuse Boxes, purchasing them for 1,500 when they are on rotation in the Accessory Shop, or trading.

The Spirit Chew Toy is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 18, 2024, as part of the third week of the Halloween Event (2024). Players could have purchased it for 900 from the lab building or the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon. It can now only be obtained through trading. The Spirit Chew Toy was only purchasable for 2 during week three of the Halloween Event (2024).
wiki.notes: The Spirit Chew Toy features a blue ghost-like shape with two small feet. It also has two white eyes with black outlines and a small white mouth. When interacted with, the Spirit Chew Toy is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it and sit with it in its mouth. To retrieve the item, the player can click their pet. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Sports Bike is an uncommon two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 31, 2022. It can be purchased for 700 in the Vehicle Dealership or obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The bike resembles a modern-day motorcycle and has a windshield, a headlight, and two wheels. As well as a sleek design similar to a Yamaha R6 motorcycle. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Sports Hat is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 26, 2024, alongside the Games Event (2024). Players could obtain the Sports Hat by leveling their Sunshine Games Pass. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Sports Hat features a blue cap with a light blue visor and bottom, separated by a white stripe. In the center of the hat, there is a light blue circular shape with two white stripes. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Sports Shirt is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 26, 2024, alongside the Games Event (2024). Players could obtain the Sports Shirt by leveling their Sunshine Games Pass. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Sports Shirt features a blue shirt with lighter sleeves and hem. At the end of each sleeve, there is a white trim. This pet accessory goes on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Sports Shoes are a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on July 26, 2024, alongside the Games Event (2024). Players could obtain the Sports Shoes by leveling their Sunshine Games Pass. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Sports Shoes feature blue sneakers with a white heel, a white sole, and light blue laces. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's feet.

wiki.availability: The Spray Can is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.8% and 5.5% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Spray Can was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Spray Can features a gray spray can with green wrapper and a gray nozzle. This pet accessory goes on a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Spring Bunny Feet are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on April 14, 2022, along with the Easter Event (2022). They were purchasable for 750, which were hidden around the map for players to find. As the event has ended, they can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Spring Bunny Feet feature curved white shoes with light pink tops. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's feet.

wiki.availability: The Spring Bunny Hood is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 14, 2022, along with the Easter Event (2022). It could be obtained by purchasing it for 1,500, which were hidden around the map for players to find. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Spring Bunny Hood features a white hood topped with bunny ears, held together by a pink bow. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Spring Bunny Leash is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on April 14, 2022, along with the Easter Event (2022). It could be obtained by purchasing it for 900. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Spring Bunny Leash features a white bunny with two long ears; it is connected to a curved white handle at its back. It has a pink string when in use. This item bears a similar appearance to the pet Rabbit and the Bunny. When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, a pink line will connect the Spring Bunny Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The Spring Bunny Nose is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 14, 2022, along with the Easter Event (2022). It could be obtained by purchasing it for 1,000, which were hidden around the map for players to find. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Spring Bunny Nose features a white snout with a pink nose and two whiskers on either side. It has a bucktooth at the bottom. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Spring Glasses are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on March 6, 2021. They could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 300 when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Spring Glasses feature a pair of glasses with black frames, two googly eyes, and dark blue pupils. These pet accessories go on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Springy Heart is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on November 22, 2024, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Springy Heart features a black base, a yellow coil springing outward, and a red heart. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Sprinkler Propeller is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on August 22, 2025 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with the Sprinkler Propeller equipped, they will be propelled upwards. To stop ascending, the player can unequip the item or jump.

wiki.availability: The Sprout Pogo Stick is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 30, 2023, as part of the second week of the 2023 Spring Festival. It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Springfest Shop for 1,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Sprout Pogo Stick features a green sprout planted in a pot. There are two smaller green leaves on top, acting as handlebars, and two larger green leaves on the bottom of the sprout, acting as footrests. The Sprout Pogo Stick serves no use other than being a fun pogostick to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Sprout Snail is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on April 1, 2023, as a part of the 2023 April Fools update. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Fool Eggs or trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 25% chance of hatching a Sprout Snail from a Fool Egg. The Sprout Snail features a light green snail with a leafy green Brussels sprout shell and two black eyes. Here are the tricks the Sprout Snail learns in order: The Neon Sprout Snail glows blue on its shell. The Mega Neon Sprout Snail glows in the same areas as the Neon Sprout Snail, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Spyglass Glasses are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on February 9, 2023. They can be found and purchased in the Rain Gift Shop for 300 when the Rain Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Spyglass Glasses feature two brown spyglasses with gold rings around it. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Squeaky Bone is a common toy in Adopt Me! that is currently purchasable in the Pet Shop for 135. It is otherwise obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: Players receive a free, untradable version of the Squeaky Bone upon joining a server. It is red by default, and its color cannot be changed. It cannot be favorited, and disappears from the player's inventory when they leave the server. A free, white Squeaky Bone with the same conditions was obtainable from a bench in the area containing the Homepass. The Squeaky Bone features a bone that is color-customizable upon purchase. It is based on a real squeaky bone. When a player interacts with the Squeaky Bone, their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to them. It has a squeak sound effect when thrown. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Squeaky Spikey is an uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that is currently available in the Pet Shop for 275. It can also be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Squeaky Spikey features a spikey bone with a color that players can only choose upon purchase. When a player interacts with the Squeaky Spikey, their equipped pet fetch it and bring it back to them. It squeaks when thrown. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Squid is a legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 27, 2022, as part of the Task Board update. It can be obtained through opening RGB Reward Boxes at a 2.25% chance or trading.
wiki.notes: The Squid features a pastel purple body with eight tentacles, two longer tentacles, a dull triangle head, and a pastel blue underbelly. It has two beady black eyes surrounded with pastel pink, light green, and cyan blobs of color. The tip of its head is topped with a yellow color splash and pastel green designs. Here are the tricks the Squid learns in order: The Neon Squid glows multiple colors on its colorful spots, including cyan, light blue, pink, and yellow. The Mega Neon Squid glows in the same areas as the Neon Squid, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Squid Plush is a limited common toy in Adopt Me!. It could have been obtained from the 2018 Gifts rotation for 70 or 199 from the Small or Big Gifts, respectively. As the gifts have been updated to contain new items, it is no longer available and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Squid Plush features a metallic blue squid with lilac purple on the top. It also has six legs and black beady eyes. This plush serves no purpose other than just being a cosmetic item. To interact with this plush, a player clicks or presses the screen to hug it.

wiki.availability: The Squid Rattle is a limited uncommon rattle in Adopt Me! that was released on July 14, 2017. It could be found and bought in the Baby Shop for 425. It was removed from the game on June 24, 2021, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Squid Rattle features a white handle topped with a white, beady-eyed squid with long tentacles. When purchased, the player had the ability to choose a color for the handle. However, this color cannot be changed later on or when the toy is traded. The Squid Rattle leaves behind a rainbow trail as the player moves. The Squid Rattle serves no purpose other than being a fun toy to shake. To interact with it, players can click or tap their screen to shake it.

wiki.availability: The Squid Sticker is a legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Sticker Pack for 250; players have a 4% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. It can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Squid Sticker features a cartoon Squid.

wiki.availability: The Squirrel Car is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on April 1, 2021, as part of the new gifts rotation. It could have been obtained from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts for 70, 199, or 499 respectively. It was removed on November 3, 2022, during the release of the 2nd 2022 Gift Refresh. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Squirrel Car resembles a squirrel. It has two large yellow wheels on the back, and two smaller yellow wheels on the front. On the front, it has two large black eyes, and a set of two small headlights under a large windshield. On the rear there are two glowing red lights and a giant tail. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Squirty Flower is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on August 9, 2024, as part of the Jokes Update. Players can obtain it by opening any remaining Box of Jokes or through trading, as the Box of Jokes left the game on August 16, 2024.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with the Squirty Flower equipped, it sprays out three drops of water.

wiki.availability: The Squished Red Pandorama Sticker is a limited legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on August 1, 2024. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Pets Plus Sticker Packs, which were received when purchasing the Pets Plus subscription for 299, or trading.

The St Bernard is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 25, 2021, during the Winter Holiday (2021). Players could obtain this pet from the 2021 Advent Calendar on Christmas Day (December 25). It can now only be obtained through trading, as its day has passed.
wiki.notes: The St Bernard features a brown and beige body with four beige feet. It has a black nose and eyes on its face, as well as black, beige, and brown areas. It has a small brown neck accessory that is part of the pet and cannot be removed. These are the tricks the St Bernard learns in order: The Neon St Bernard glows a light yellow on its snout, back, neck, feet, and on the tip of its tail. The Mega Neon St Bernard glows in the same areas as the Neon St Bernard, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.egg: Logging in daily or playing for 40 minutes
wiki.availability: The Stable Token is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 21, 2024, along with week two of the Summer State Fair (2024). It could have been obtained by logging in once per day or for every forty minutes of playing the game. A set of six could also be purchased for 80. Stable Tokens were required to start the Speedy Stables minigame.
wiki.notes: After the event, the Stable Token became a tradable throw toy. When interacted with, the Stable Token is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Staff Ingredient is a limited legendary toy in Adopt Me! that was released along with the Monkey Fairground event. There is a 5% chance of acquiring it through opening Premium Monkey Boxes, which cost 195 each. As its event has left the game, the Staff Ingredient is now only obtainable through trading or by unboxing any remaining Premium Monkey Boxes.
wiki.notes: When a player combined three Staff Ingredients and a Monkey during the event, the Monkey was transformed into a Monkey King. This was done by interacting with the Monkey King (NPC). Players also received a Monkey King Crown. The Staff Ingredient features a long red staff with golden yellow on both tips. The Staff Ingredient behaves as a throw toy. When a player clicks their screen with the Staff Ingredient equipped, it is thrown and their equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Standard Capuchin Box is a limited rare gift in Adopt Me! that was released on April 5, 2024, as a part of the Capuchin Fairground event. It cost 300. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
The Standard Chest is a legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests update.
wiki.notes: It can be purchased in the Accessory Shop for 105, purchased from the Star Rewards for 1, obtained through completing the "Buy a Pet Accessory" achievement in the "Explore" section of the Guide, or received as a reward for aging up pets. The Standard Chest is also obtainable through trading. It was previously obtainable by leveling up the Sunshine Games Pass and through the Daily Reward. When the Standard Chest is opened, the player receives a pet accessory; there is a 53.3% chance of opening a common item, a 36.7% chance of opening an uncommon item, a 6.7% chance of opening a rare item, a 2.8% chance of opening an ultra-rare item, a 0.5% chance of opening a legendary item, and a 0.03% chance of obtaining a Chocolate Chip Bat Dragon Backpack. The available items are displayed on the board next to it. The Standard Chest features a treasure chest with a brown base and gray lines throughout its exterior and interior. It also has a circular gray centerpiece which includes a darker gray paw print inside.

wiki.availability: The Standard Gibbon Box is a limited rare gift in Adopt Me! that was released on May 16, 2025, alongside the Gibbon Fairground. It was purchasable for 300. It is now only obtainable through trading, as the event ended on May 30, 2025.
wiki.notes: When a player opens a Standard Gibbon Box, they receive two items. For every 40 Gibbon Boxes of either type a player opened, they were guaranteed a Ringmaster Gibbon, which they could have claimed from the Task Board or Ringmaster Gibbon NPC.

wiki.availability: The Standard Gorilla Box is a limited rare gift in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on March 16, 2023, as a part of the Gorilla Fairground event. Players were able to obtain various ingredients as well as toys through this gift.
wiki.notes: It could have been found inside the circus tent that was located near the Pet Shop, and it cost 600. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading. Every time one is opened, there is a guaranteed Gorilla as well as two other items.

wiki.availability: The Standard Grappling Hook is an ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me!. It can be purchased in the Toy Shop for 2,000, or obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Standard Grappling Hook features a grappling hook with a gray pump-like mechanism on the bottom. The body of the grappling hook is cylindrical and has another small cylinder off the side. On the top is a hook with three hooks. Upon purchase, players are able to choose what color they want the grappling hook to be. However, after the purchase has been made, the color of the grappling hook is final and cannot be changed. To interact with this item, a player can click/press anywhere on their screen to fire a hooked-cable and be pulled towards the target location. Like most other grappling hooks, players cannot use this item on non-solid graphical objects or if they are on a vehicle, doing an obby, flying or riding a pet.

wiki.availability: The Standard Pogo is a common toy in Adopt Me!. Players can purchase the Standard Pogo from the Toy Shop for 150. It is also obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Standard Pogo features an orange pogo stick with black footholds, blue handles and frame. Players have the ability to change the color upon initially buying it. However, after the purchase has been made, the color of the toy is final and cannot be changed. This pogo tends to serve no purpose other than letting a player jump around while equipped.

wiki.availability: The Standard Roller Skates are a common single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that can be purchased from the Toy Shop for 300 or obtained through trading. New players could also obtain them by completing special tasks on the Task Board on the third day of joining the game until the Task Board Revamp Update on November 14, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Standard Roller Skates feature a pair of four-wheeled skates that are color-customizable upon purchase. The Standard Roller Skates received from the Task Board are blue by default; their color cannot be chosen. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Standard Sticker Pack is a common sticker pack in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles update. It can be purchased in the Toy Shop for 250, received as a reward for aging up pets, or obtained through trading. New players could also obtain it by completing special tasks on the Task Board on the fourth day of joining the game until the Task Board Revamp Update on November 14, 2025. It was previously obtainable for free (one per account) and through leveling up the Sunshine Games Pass.
wiki.notes: When the Standard Sticker Pack is opened, the player receives ten stickers. For each sticker, there is a 40% chance of getting a common, a 25% chance of getting an uncommon, a 17% chance of getting a rare, a 14% chance of getting an ultra-rare, a 4% chance of getting a legendary, and a 0.01% of getting a Dragon Breath Animated Sticker. The available stickers are displayed on the board next to it.

wiki.availability: The Standard Unicycle is a common single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that can be purchased from the Toy Shop for 120. It can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Standard Unicycle features a slim frame, a black tire and a black seat. Players can change the color of this vehicle upon purchase. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Standard Wing Chest is a legendary gift in Adopt Me! that was released on September 15, 2022. Players can purchase it for 600 in the Sky Castle, receive it as a reward for aging up pets, or obtain it through trading. When players open the Standard Wing Chest, they receive wing pet accessories that will only appear on their pet when they are flying on it.
wiki.notes: The items that players can obtain from the Standard Wing Chest can be seen on the board displayed nearby: players have a 45% chance of getting a common item, 33% chance of getting an uncommon item, 14.5% chance of getting a rare item, 6% chance of getting an ultra-rare item, and a 1.5% chance of getting a legendary item. The Standard Wing Chest features a red chest with a gray frame and edges. It has a gray-winged lock with a black keyhole. When unboxed, the chest has black insides.

wiki.addedEvent: Halloween Shop during the Halloween Event (2020)
wiki.availability: The Star & Moon Propeller is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was purchasable for 1,250 in the Halloween Shop during the Halloween Event (2020). As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Star & Moon Propeller features a short magenta rod with a small sphere attached to the bottom. On the top lies a shining crescent moon fastened to a tiny golden ring. The two sides of the crescent moon has a thin magenta line that connects two glowing stars. When a player clicks their screen with the Star & Moon Propeller equipped, they will be propelled upwards. To stop, they can either unequip the item or jump.

wiki.availability: The Star Badge is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 650 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Star Badge, features an 8-pointed star badge with a glowing yellow center. This pet accessory is worn on the pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Star Ball is a rare toy in Adopt Me! that can be purchased in the Pet Shop for 450 or obtained through trading. New players could also obtain it by completing special tasks on the Task Board on the fifth day of joining the game until the Task Board Revamp Update on November 14, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Star Ball features a round, purple ball with a white stripe around it and a yellow star on one side. When a player interacts with the Star Ball, an equipped pet will chase after it and bring it back. This toy also makes a squeaky sound when thrown. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Star Balloon is a common toy in Adopt Me! that can be purchased in the Toy Shop for 120 or obtained through trading. New players were able to obtain it by completing special tasks on the Task Board on the second day of joining the game until the Task Board Revamp Update on November 14, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Star Balloon features a star-shaped balloon with a thin white string attached to the bottom of it. The star is color-customizable upon purchase, but this choice is final and cannot be changed after. However, the Star Balloon received from the Task Board is yellow by default; its color cannot be chosen. The Star Balloon allows a player to jump higher when equipped.

wiki.availability: The Star Barrette is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 9, 2023. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 2.2% and 6.7% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on May 10, 2024, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Star Barrette is a hair barrette featuring giant yellow star on the front and the clip behind it. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Star Hoodie is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It was obtainable through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on August 22, 2025, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Star Hoodie features a yellow star with a hollowed inside. This pet accessory is worn around a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Star Sunglasses are a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on June 15, 2023, along with the Summer Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Summer Shop for 450. As its event has now passed, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Star Sunglasses feature a pair of sunglasses with yellow star shaped lenses. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Star Throwing Disc is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 19, 2023, as part of the Winter Festival (2023). It could've been obtained by claiming it from the event's Advent Calendar on day nineteen. It can now only be obtained by trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Star Throwing Disc features a shining yellow star with a dark yellow edge. Similar to other throw toys in the game, when thrown to an equipped pet, the pet would fetch the Star Throwing Disc and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Star Topper Plush is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 5, 2025, alongside the Winter Event (2025). Players could have purchased it for 1,600. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 9, 2026.
wiki.notes: To interact with this toy, a player can click or tap their screen with it equipped to hug it.

wiki.availability: The Starfish is an ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020, as part of the Star Rewards update. It can be obtained through hatching Gemstone Eggs, Basic Eggs, Crystal Eggs, or Admin Abuse Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Starfish was formerly obtainable from the first page of the Star Rewards until September 11, 2026, requiring 550 Stars to unlock. The Starfish is an orange starfish with black eyes and three light orange spots on each arm, growing larger as it extends outwards. It also has pink circular blush below its eyes. Here are the tricks the Starfish learns in order: The Neon Starfish glows baby blue and pink. The small dots that go on the points turn into a baby blue whilst the blush turns bright pink. The Mega Neon Starfish glows in the same areas as the Neon Starfish, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Starfish Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on August 1, 2024. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Pets Plus Sticker Packs, which were received when purchasing the Pets Plus subscription for 299, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Starfish Sticker features a cartoon Starfish.

wiki.availability: The Starhopper is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 23, 2024, alongside the second week of the Celestial Summer Event (2024). Players could have obtained it by leveling their Galactic Pass during week two of the event. As the second week of the event has passed, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Starhopper learns in order: The Neon Starhopper glows orange-yellow on its legs, neck and patterns around its eyes. The Mega Neon Starhopper glows in the same areas as the Neon Starhopper, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Starmite is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 7, 2025, alongside the Moon Egg. It can now only be obtained through hatching any remaining Moon Eggs or Royal Moon Eggs, or through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 6% chance of hatching a Starmite from the Moon Egg, and a 12.5% chance of hatching it from the Royal Moon Egg. The Starmite features a round, mostly white body that comes to three orange points. It also has a fluffy orange underbelly and tail, as well as orange spots around its two black eyes. Here are the tricks the Starmite learns in order: The Neon Starmite glows yellow on the tips of its body, underbelly, tail, and around its eyes. The Mega Neon Starmite glows in the same areas as the Neon Starmite, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Starpower Wand is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was previously available in an old Gifts rotation. It could be opened from Small Gifts, Big Gifts and Massive Gifts which cost 70, 199 and 499 respectively. It is now only obtainable through trading, as its rotation has left.
wiki.notes: The Starpower Wand features a yellow star at the top of a brown stick. The star at the top of the wand emits yellow particles. When a player clicks their screen with the Starpower Wand equipped, it will be shaken back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Stars Egg is a limited uncommon food item in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2019, alongside the Easter Event (2019). It was obtainable during the Easter Event (2019) by collecting the egg currency scattered across the Adoption Island. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Stars Egg features a round, oval-shaped object. The entire shape is colored pink with the exception of several yellow stars.

wiki.availability: The Starter Bike is an uncommon single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. It can be obtained by purchasing the Starter Pack for 9 or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Starter Bike has a design that is based on the Bicycle, but with notable differences. It consists of a red body with one white area, a curved handle, and stabilizers on the rear wheels that have red rims. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The State Fair Sticker Pack is a limited uncommon sticker pack in Adopt Me! that was released on July 5, 2024, as part of the fourth week of the Summer State Fair (2024). It could be purchased for 1,000. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: When the State Fair Sticker Pack is opened, the player receives ten stickers. For each sticker, there is a 40% chance of getting a common, a 25% chance of getting an uncommon, a 17% chance of getting a rare, a 14% chance of getting an ultra-rare, and a 4% chance of getting a legendary.

wiki.availability: The State Fair Sticker Pack is a limited uncommon sticker pack in Adopt Me! that was released on July 5, 2024, as part of the fourth week of the Summer State Fair (2024). It could be purchased for 1,000. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: When the State Fair Sticker Pack is opened, the player receives ten stickers. For each sticker, there is a 40% chance of getting a common, a 25% chance of getting an uncommon, a 17% chance of getting a rare, a 14% chance of getting an ultra-rare, and a 4% chance of getting a legendary.

wiki.availability: The Steampunk Clock Hat is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on November 22, 2024, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Steampunk Clock Hat features a steampunk design with gears and clock elements, primarily in orange and yellow tones. This pet accessory is worn on the pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Steel Drum is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020. It was obtainable from the first page of the Star Rewards, requiring 9 Stars to unlock. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on September 11, 2026 when the Star Rewards were revamped.
wiki.notes: The Steel Drum features a black and gray, circular drum. It comes with two wooden drumsticks with black tips. When a player clicks their screen with the Steel Drum equipped, a drumming animation as well as one of several sounds selected at random will play. This instrument plays the same sounds as the Bone Xylophone.

wiki.availability: The Steel Toe Heel is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It was obtainable through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on August 22, 2025, it can now only be obtained through trading.

The Stegosaurus is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2020, along with the Fossil Egg. As the Fossil Egg is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through trading or by hatching any remaining Fossil Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 30% chance of hatching an uncommon pet from the Fossil Egg, but only a 10% chance of hatching a Stegosaurus. The Stegosaurus features a light brown and pale red dinosaur. There are yellow rounded plates along its head and back, as well as yellow spikes on its tail. It has two black eyes on the side of its head and two smaller black nostrils. Listed below are the tricks the Stegosaurus learns in order: The Neon Stegosaurus glows amber on its spikes, feet, and scales, and scarlet on the top half of each body part. The Mega Neon Stegosaurus glows in the same areas as the Neon Stegosaurus, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Stegosaurus Throw Toy (formerly known as Stegosaurus Chew Toy) is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that could previously be found when excavating for fossils at the Fossil Isle Excavation (2020). As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Stegosaurus Throw Toy features an orange, dinosaur-shaped, rubber toy with no limbs. It has spikes on its head, back, and tail. It is based on the Stegosaurus, but the toy is completely orange rather than multi-colored. The Stegosaurus is a pet that is in the Fossil Egg. To interact with this item, a player can click or press their screen to throw. When thrown, the player's equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Stegosaurus Sticker is an uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Fossil Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Stegosaurus Sticker features a cartoon Stegosaurus.

wiki.availability: The Stegosaurus Throw Toy (formerly known as Stegosaurus Chew Toy) is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that could previously be found when excavating for fossils at the Fossil Isle Excavation (2020). As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.

wiki.notes: The Stegosaurus Throw Toy Sticker features a cartoon Stegosaurus Throw Toy.

wiki.availability: The Steppe Lion is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 15, 2022, as part of week 3 of the Winter Event (2022). It could have been obtained by purchasing it in the Candy Castle for 25,000. Since the event ended on January 5, 2023, the Steppe Lion can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Steppe Lion features a light orange body with a tan underbelly, ear insides, and feet. It has a brown mane, tip of tail, and nose. It has sharp brown markings behind both its black eyes. Its body resembles the Lion. Listed below are the tricks the Steppe Lion learns in order: The Neon Steppe Lion glows pink on its mane, paws, tail, inner ears, and on parts of its face. The Mega Neon Steppe Lion glows in the same areas as the Neon Steppe Lion, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Stethoscope is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.7% and 0.6% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On April 20, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Stethoscope was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Stethoscope, as true to its name, features a gray stethoscope with blue ear parts on its tips. This pet accessory is worn around a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Stick Throw Toy is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that could previously have been obtained through opening the Small and Big Gifts, which cost 70 and 199 respectively. There was a 15% chance of obtaining this toy from a Small Gift, and a 5% chance from a Big Gift. As of the 2021 Gift Refresh update, the Gifts were replaced with another set of items, and the Stick Throw Toy can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Stick Throw Toy is a long, thin brown twig with several branches coming off of it. Players can click or press their screen to throw the Stick Throw Toy. When thrown, an equipped pet will chase after it and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Sticky Hand Earrings are limited rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on June 21, 2024, as part of the Summer State Fair (2024). Players could purchase the Sticky Hand Earrings for 1,600. As the event has ended, they can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Sticky Hand Earrings feature a pair of light blue earrings in the shape of a wavy string with a hand on the end. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's ears, or on the sides of its head.

wiki.availability: The Sticky Stick is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 5.6% and 3.3% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Sticky Stick was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Sticky Stick features a brown stick with two green leaves. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Stingray is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 16, 2021, along with the Ocean Egg. Since it left the game on August 19, 2021, the Stingray is now only obtainable through trading or by hatching any remaining Ocean Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 20% chance of hatching a Stingray from an Ocean Egg. The Stingray has a flat and flexible body with two pectoral fins and a stinger near its rear. It features a grayish-blue body with a white underbelly. It also has two beady eyes on top of its snout. Its tail is dark gray, along with a blackish tip. Here are the tricks the Stingray learns in order: The Neon Stingray glows a pink-lavender color on its underbelly. The Mega Neon Stingray glows in the same areas as the Neon Stingray, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Stingray Sticker is a limited common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on September 20, 2024, alongside the second week of the Ocean Event (2024).
wiki.notes: As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Ocean Sticker Packs or through trading. The Stingray Sticker features a cartoon Stingray.

wiki.availability: The Stitched Up Beanie is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on November 9, 2023. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 2.2% and 6.7% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
