It has two ears with a darker brownish-tan insides, two black eyes, a brown nose on top of its muzzle, and a blue tongue sticking out of its mouth. Its body is a lighter tan and has a circular shape. It has four tan colored feet. Listed below are the tricks the Tan Chow-Chow learns in order: The Neon Tan Chow-Chow glows bright teal around its muzzle, the fur around its chest, the insides of its ears, and the back of its tail. The Mega Neon Tan Chow-Chow glows in the same areas as the Neon Tan Chow-Chow, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Tandem Bicycle is a common two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 3, 2022, along with the Vehicle Dealership revamp. It purchased from the Vehicle Dealership for 300, or obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Tandem Bicycle features a bike with two seats and two pairs of pedals; before each seat, there are sets of handles. At the front of the bicycle, there is a small black paw print. It resembles two combined Bicycles, as the Tandem Bicycle refers to in its name. Like all Vehicle Dealership vehicles, the Tandem Bicycle is color-customizable. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Tangerine Chew Toy is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased from the Lunar New Year Stand for 100 during the Lunar New Year (2021) event. Since its respective event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Tangerine Chew Toy features an orange tangerine with a brown stem and a green leaf sticking out from the top. When interacted with, the player throws the Tangerine Chew Toy, and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. The pet holds it in its mouth until the player picks up the item by interacting with the pet. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Tanuki is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on September 8, 2022. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Japan Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 19% chance of hatching an uncommon pet from the Japan Egg, but only a 9.5% chance of hatching a Tanuki. The Tanuki features a light-brown body with a light-pink underbelly. Its tail has a brown tip, and there is a curved brown spot on its face that covers its eyes. It has four brown feet, two black eyes, a small black nose, and light-brown ears with brown and pink insides. Here are the tricks the Tanuki learns in order: The Neon Tanuki glows yellow around its face, the outside of its ears, and on two lines of its tail. The Mega Neon Tanuki glows in the same areas as the Neon Tanuki, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Tape Measure Leash is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 6, 2024, alongside the Winter Festival (2024). Players could have purchased it for 2,100. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 17, 2025.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with it equipped, an orange line will connect the Tape Measure Leash to their pet. This item can be used to receive a 3x Bucks and XP bonus from the 'walk' ailment if a player's pet specifically requests it.

wiki.availability: The Tarantula is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2025, alongside the second week of the Halloween Event (2025). It could have been obtained through hatching a Basic Egg or Crystal Egg. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Spider Boxes or trading, as it left the game on November 7, 2025.
wiki.notes: There is a 33% chance of obtaining a Tarantula from the Spider Box. It has two beady black eyes and brown sharp fangs, while its body is beige. It has multiple autumn-orange stripes around its legs and dark brown padded feet. On its head till the top of its abdomen are multiple black stripes. It has multiple tufts of fur, most notably on its abdomen. In Arachnophobia mode, its feet become disconnected and it loses its fangs. Here are the tricks the Tarantula learns in order: The Neon Tarantula glows golden yellow on parts of its legs and fangs, the top of its body hair and head, and on its feet. The Mega Neon Tarantula glows in the same areas as the Neon Tarantula, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Target Board is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on June 14, 2024, as part of the Summer State Fair (2024). Players could purchase it for 950. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Target board features a round base with red and white rings. There are three dark blue target pins around the center of the board. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's chest.

wiki.availability: The Tarsier is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 2, 2023, along with the Southeast Asia Egg. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Southeast Asia Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 20% chance of hatching a rare pet from a Southeast Asia Egg, but only a 10% chance of hatching a Tarsier. The Tarsier has a round chocolate-colored body with two chocolate-colored arms and legs. It has two round ears with beige insides, and a tuft of hair on its head. It has a pointed face with a pink nose and two black eyes. Listed below are the tricks the Tarsier learns in order: The Neon Tarsier glows light purple on its arms, tuft, ears, and feet. The Mega Neon Tarsier glows in the same areas as the Neon Tarsier, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Tasmanian Devil is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on January 4, 2024. Players were able to purchase this pet in the Aussie Zone next to the Accessory Shop for 1,450. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Tasmanian Devil features a dark brown body with four dark brown feet, two ears with pink insides, and two beady black eyes. It has beige eyebrows, a beige muzzle with fangs sticking out, and a black nose. Here are the tricks the Tasmanian Devil learns in order: The Neon Tasmanian Devil glows light red on its inner ears, eyebrows, tip of its tail, and the beige parts of its face and neck. The Mega Neon Tasmanian Devil glows in the same areas as the Neon Tasmanian Devil, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Tasmanian Tiger is a limited common pet that was added to Adopt Me! on October 10, 2020. Its release was confirmed in the Fossil Isle Excavation (2020) Event, which started on October 2, 2020. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through trading or hatching any remaining Fossil Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 25% chance of hatching a common pet from the Fossil Egg, but only a 12.5% chance of hatching a Tasmanian Tiger. The Tasmanian Tiger features a brown-orange body with a light beige underbelly and under-chin. It has dark brown stripes extending down its back and two small, brown triangles beside its beady black eyes. This pet has orange triangular ears with brown insides. The face of this pet is pointed, fox-shaped, and similar to that of the Dingo's and Arctic Fox's. Here are the tricks the Tasmanian Tiger learns in order: The Neon Tasmanian Tiger glows bright pink on the stripes on its tail and back, the inside of its ears, and its feet. The Mega Neon Tasmanian Tiger glows in the same areas as the Neon Tasmanian Tiger, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Tasmanian Tiger Sticker is a common sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Fossil Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Tasmanian Tiger Sticker features a cartoon Tasmanian Tiger.

wiki.availability: The Tawny Frogmouth is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 24, 2023. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Urban Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 25% chance of hatching an uncommon pet from the Urban Egg, but only a 12.5% chance of hatching the Tawny Frogmouth. Here are the tricks the Tawny Frogmouth learns in order: The Neon Tawny Frogmouth glows purple on its markings, part of its wings, and feet. The Mega Neon Tawny Frogmouth glows in the same areas as the Neon Tawny Frogmouth, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: Tea is a common food item in Adopt Me! that can be purchased for 2 from the Coffee Shop or received as a pet age-up reward. It can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Tea features a navy blue cup/mug with maroon-colored tea inside. This item can be used to fulfill the 'thirsty' ailment on pets and babies. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. It takes six uses to fully consume.

wiki.availability: The Tea Party Chair is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on August 25, 2022. Players could obtain the Tea Party Set by purchasing it for 1,300 next to the bridge near the Neighborhood. The Tea Party Chair was in the game for one week following its release, it was removed on September 1, 2022. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Tea Party Chair features a light yellow frame, with milky white cushions on the seat and backrest. The Tea Party Chair can be placed on flat surfaces in Adoption Island.

wiki.availability: The Tea Party Set is a limited legendary toy in Adopt Me! that was released on August 25, 2022. Players could obtain the Tea Party Set by purchasing it for 3,000 next to the bridge near the Neighborhood. The Tea Party Set was in the game for one week following its release. The stand was removed on September 1, 2022. As the Tea Party Set is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: Players can pick up the Tea Party Scone, a food item, off of the Tea Party Set. The Tea Party Set features a table with yellow feet, covered by a white tablecloth, and two yellow-framed chairs with white cushions. On top of the table, there is a tower of scones with red and white filling, a white teapot with a yellow handle, spout, and designs, and a white teacup with a yellow lip, base, and handle, sitting on top of a yellow plate. The Tea Party Set can be placed on flat surfaces in Adoption Island.

wiki.availability: The Teacup Stroller is a legendary stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on June 24, 2021, along with the Baby Shop remodel. It can be purchased from the Baby Shop for 1,450 or obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Teacup Stroller features a light pink teacup with a pink handle, dark pink wheels, and a white tea bag with a dark pink paw print on it. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Tealwood Monster is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on June 20, 2026, alongside the Summer Camp Event (2026). Players could obtain it through using a Tealwood Monster Bait at the fishing spot in the Fishing Shop during the event. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on July 20, 2026.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Tealwood Monster learns in order: The Neon Tealwood Monster glows sea green on its head spikes, back spikes, and tail tip. The Mega Neon Tealwood Monster glows in the same areas as the Neon Tealwood Monster, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Teddy Bear is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased at the Toy Shop for 50. It left the game on May 13, 2021, and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Teddy Bear features a brown bear with four legs, a tan belly and snout, and two ears with dark brown inner ears. It has two black eyes, a black nose, and a smile. When a player clicks their screen with the Teddy Bear equipped, they will hug it.

wiki.availability: The Teddy Skele is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on October 14, 2017, as a part of the Halloween Event (2017). During the event, it could have been bought for 3 Candies. As the Halloween Event (2017) ended on November 1, 2017, the Teddy Skele can now only be obtained by trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Teddy Skele is a thin yellow skeleton with stick-like legs, a ribcage, and curved arms. Its head, sported on top of the ribcage, has 2 black eye holes. Similar to all other plushies in Adopt Me!, the Teddy Skele serves no purpose other than being an interactable item. To interact with this plush, the player can click or press the screen to hug it.

wiki.availability: The Tegu is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 15, 2025, alongside the Aztec Egg. It could have been obtained through purchasing and hatching Aztec Eggs for 750, or Basic Eggs for 400. As the Aztec Egg left the game on February 28, 2026, it can now only be obtained through hatching any remaining Aztec Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 35% chance of hatching the Tegu from the Aztec Egg. Here are the tricks the Tegu learns in order: The Neon Tegu glows orange on its head markings, body stripes and spots, tail stripes, the underside of its head and body, and on the spots around its eyes. The Mega Neon Tegu glows in the same areas as the Neon Tegu, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.addedEvent: Gifts rotation in the 2018 Christmas Event
wiki.availability: The Teleportation Potion is a limited uncommon potion in Adopt Me! that was obtainable during the old Gifts rotation in the 2018 Christmas Event. It has a total of 5 uses which gives the player the ability to teleport to either their house or to the Nursery.
wiki.notes: Since the event ended, it is currently unobtainable unless through trading. The Teleportation Potion features a yellow rocket ship shaped capsule with a black circle on its upper half and back line that wraps around its center. The Teleportation Potion also glows in the night and the black line around its center also glows white.

wiki.availability: The Telescope Pogo is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was obtainable in an old Gifts rotation. Since the Gifts were replaced with new items, it is now unobtainable unless through trading.
wiki.notes: The Telescope Pogo resembles a telescope featuring a brown, cone-shaped middle with circles of golden yellow coiled around. At the very top, it contains a bright blue telescope lens, complete with gray tipped brownish-red handles and golden footholds. As it is a pogo stick, it provides transportation by bouncing instead of walking.

wiki.availability: The Temple Friend is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 12, 2025. It could have been obtained through purchasing and hatching Aztec Eggs for 750, or Basic Eggs for 400. As the Aztec Egg left the game on February 28, 2026, it can now only be obtained through hatching any remaining Aztec Eggs and Royal Aztec Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 2% chance of hatching the Temple Friend from the Aztec Egg, and a 3% chance of hatching it from the Royal Aztec Egg. Here are the tricks the Temple Friend learns in order: The Neon Temple Friend glows light blue on much of its clothing and head detailing, claws, and head feathers. The Mega Neon Temple Friend glows in the same areas as the Neon Temple Friend, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Ten Gallon Hat is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 5.5% and 3.3% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on September 29, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Ten Gallon Hat features a beige fedora with a wide brim and a brown sash surrounding its center. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Tennis Ball is an uncommon pet toy in Adopt Me! that is available in the Pet Shop for 200. It can also be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: A free, untradable version of the Tennis Ball was obtainable from a bench sitting in the area containing the Homepass. It couldn't be favorited, and disappeared from the player's inventory when they left the game. The Tennis Ball features a bright-yellow ball with two white curved lines around either side, based on a real tennis ball. When a player interacts with the Tennis Ball, an equipped pet will chase after it and bring it back, similar to most throw toys. It makes a squeaky sound and plays animated effects when thrown. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Tennis Racket Toy is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on July 26, 2024, alongside the Games Event (2024). Players could obtain the Tennis Racket Toy by leveling their Sunshine Games Pass. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Tennis Racket Toy features a tennis racket with white and red strings, a black and blue head, and a white handle. When a player clicks their screen with the Tennis Racket Toy equipped, it is swung down towards the ground.

wiki.availability: The Black Dog is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2025, alongside the second week of the Halloween Event (2025). Players could find it roaming around Adoption Island and purchase it for 43,000, or hatch it from a Basic Egg or Crystal Egg. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on November 7, 2025.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks The Black Dog learns in order: The Neon The Black Dog glows red on its feet and tail. The Mega Neon The Black Dog glows in the same areas as the Neon The Black Dog, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Black Dog Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2025, alongside the second week of the Halloween Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Halloween 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Black Dog Sticker features a cartoon The Black Dog.

wiki.availability: The Theatrical Hat is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on January 30, 2026, it can only be obtained through trading.

wiki.egg: Completing a task given by Patty the NPC
wiki.availability: The Therapy Dog is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on November 10, 2022, as part of the GOSH 2022 update. Players were able to obtain this pet by talking to Patty, who could be found on a stand in front of the Playground; after doing this, the player would receive a task on their Task Board to heal a pet/baby three times. As it left the game on November 17, 2022, the Therapy Dog can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Therapy Dog features a light brown body with long floppy ears, a tuft of hair on its chest, and a fluffy tail. It wears a purple vest with gray strip outlining its edges. The vest covers most of the dog's back and loops through underneath, connecting at the front. It also has a light green collar, with a silver paw-print emblem attached to the right front side. Here are the tricks the Therapy Dog learns in order: The Neon Therapy Dog glows yellow on its tail, ears, feet, and the lining of its vest. The Mega Neon Therapy Dog glows in the same areas as the Neon Therapy Dog, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Thimble Cap is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 20, 2023, as part of the 2023 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.8% and 5.5% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On November 9, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Thimble Cap was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Thimble Cap features a gray thimble. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Thinking Hat is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on January 30, 2026, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Regal Chest was previously obtainable through the Sunshine Games Pass from the Games Event (2024), the graveyard from week two of the Halloween Event (2024), and the Daily Reward. It also could have been obtained from Treasure Chests in the Summer Festival (2025), which required Treasure Keys to unlock. New players could also obtain it by completing special tasks on the Task Board on the seventh day of joining the game until the Task Board Revamp Update on November 14, 2025. When the Regal Chest is opened, the player receives a pet accessory that appears on the board next to the Standard Chest. Players have a 17.8% chance of getting a common item, a 52.2% chance of getting an uncommon item, a 20% chance of getting a rare item, an 8.5% chance of getting an ultra-rare item, a 1.5% chance of getting a legendary item, and a 0.1% chance of getting a Chocolate Chip Bat Dragon Backpack. The Regal Chest features a treasure chest with a brown base and golden lines throughout its exterior and interior. It also has a circular golden centerpiece which includes a dark gray paw print inside.

wiki.availability: The Thinking Hat is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As it was removed from the game on January 30, 2026, it can only be obtained through trading.

The Thor's Grappling Hammer is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on November 22, 2024, as part of the second 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on August 22, 2025 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: By tapping or clicking anywhere on their screen, the player is pulled in the direction that they tap or click on.

wiki.availability: The Thorny Devil is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on January 25, 2024. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Desert Eggs, Royal Desert Eggs, or through trading.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Thorny Devil learns in order: The Neon Thorny Devil glows light green on the dark orange stripe across its face and body, and the spikes on its back. The Mega Neon Thorny Devil glows in the same areas as the Neon Thorny Devil, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Three Blind Mice are limited legendary pets in Adopt Me! that were released on August 29, 2026, alongside the Fairytale Egg. They are obtainable through hatching Fairytale Eggs for 750, Royal Fairytale Eggs for 14, Basic Eggs for 400, Crystal Eggs for 4,000, Admin Abuse Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 1.5% chance of hatching the Three Blind Mice from the Fairytale Egg, and a 5% chance of hatching them from the Royal Fairytale Egg. Here are the tricks the Three Blind Mice learns in order: The Neon Three Blind Mice glow yellow on their inner ears and bellies. The Mega Neon Three Blind Mice glow in the same areas as the Neon Three Blind Mice, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Three Egg Basket is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 14, 2022, along with the Easter Event (2022). It could be obtained by purchasing it for 1,750, which were hidden around the map for players to find. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Three Egg Basket features a light-beige basket with darker grooves along its sides. Inside the basket are three eggs; a red egg with yellow stripes, a blue egg with light blue spots, and a blue egg with yellow stripes. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Throne Stroller is a limited rare stroller in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Baby Shop for 1,250. It was removed from the game on June 24, 2021, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Throne Stroller features a yellow frame with a padded seat and two small steps. It has two large wheels, which are black and yellow. It also has two short yellow-and-black handles for the player to hold on to. The color of the interior could be customized upon purchase; however, it cannot be changed afterwards, even through trading. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Throwback Egg is a limited rare egg in Adopt Me! that was released on September 17, 2026, as a part of the update for The Hunt: Roblox 20 Event. Players could purchase it in front of the Nursery for 400. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on September 28, 2026. The Throwback Egg takes 6 tasks to hatch.
wiki.notes: The Throwback Egg features a half-blue and half-pink egg, the colors being reminiscent of the Blue Egg and Pink Egg.

wiki.availability: The Throwing Knife Target is a limited rare single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on October 6, 2022, as part of the first week of the Halloween Event (2022). It could have been purchased for 15,500. As the event has ended, the Throwing Knife Target can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Throwing Knife Target features a red and white target with a red center that acts as a wheel. It has several knives spaced on various places throughout, each with a black handle and dark gray blade. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Throwing Pumpkin is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released in the Halloween Event (2019). It could be bought from the Candy Trading Shop for 3,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Throwing Pumpkin features a tiny orange pumpkin with a brown stalk on top of it. The Throwing Pumpkin can be used by pressing or clicking the screen to throw. An equipped pet will then fetch it and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Tiffany is a limited legendary two-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was previously obtainable in the Supercars Pack, which cost 1,000. As the Supercars Pack has left the game, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Tiffany is a modern bright pink mid-engine supercar. It appears to be based on the Bugatti Chiron, as both the Tiffany and the Chiron are mid-engine supercars and have a very similar curved design. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.egg: Talking to Tom after finding all three cogs
wiki.availability: The Time Traveler's Clock is a limited common single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 15, 2024, as part of The Hunt: First Edition event. It could have been obtained by collecting three cogs from the three portals, followed by talking to Tom, who would then reward them with the Time Traveler's Clock. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Time Traveler's Clock features a circular clock with a gold frame on the exterior, roman numerals in the interior, a golden cog in the middle, and gray hands to represent the time. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Tiny Convertible is a limited uncommon four-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released in May 2019. Players could purchase it in the Vehicle Dealership for 900. The Tiny Convertible left the game on March 31, 2022, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Tiny Convertible is a small modern convertible resembling the Mini Cooper. It has a large grille at the front, along with two large and round headlights and with two white stripes behind that lead to the windshield. It has two rows of seating, though the back row is noticeably shorter. It also has four simplistic wheels. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Tiny Wings are limited ultra-rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on April 28, 2022. They could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 0.94% and 0.22% chance of getting them from these gifts, respectively. As they were removed from the game on September 29, 2022, they can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Tiny Wings feature two small white wings; each wing has a swirl design in its center, as well as three wing feathers at the side. These pet accessories go on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Tió De Nadal is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was released on April 1, 2023, as a part of the 2023 April Fools update. It could have been purchased from a stand near the Hot Air Balloon next to the Fool Egg for 500. It left the game on April 8, 2023, and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Tió De Nadal features a log with two black eyes and a protruding nose painted red. It is wearing a red hat with black rims, and a red piece of cloth on its back. Here are the tricks the Tió De Nadal learns in order: The Neon Tió De Nadal glows red on the rim of its hat, face, nose, and feet. The Mega Neon Tió De Nadal glows in the same areas as the Neon Tió De Nadal, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Toaster Hat is a limited legendary pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on April 28, 2022. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 0.19% and 0.06% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively. As it was removed from the game on September 29, 2022, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Toaster Hat features a light blue toaster with a yellow paw print in its corner. It also has a small yellow lever and white rims. wiki.availability: The Unicorn Sticker is a legendary sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.

When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Unstable Triangle Car is a limited ultra-rare three-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on November 3, 2022. wiki.availability: The Urban Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on August 24, 2023, replacing the Danger Egg. The Urban Egg takes five tasks to hatch. The Urban Egg features a cream-colored egg with a rounded orange traffic cone on it, acting as a hat. On the traffic cone, there is a white stripe, a graffitied black paw print, the Uplift Games logo, a yellow star, and a pink splotch of paint that appears to be a slanted heart.

wiki.availability: The Water Walking Potion is a limited rare potion in Adopt Me!. It can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Water Walking Potion is stored in a clear bottle with a slight hourglass look in the middle. It has a dark gray cap and players can visibly see the blue liquid inside of it. The Water Walking Potion allows the player to walk on water. When entering water players would normally enter a swimming animation, but when the effect of the Water Walking Potion is active they remain in their normal walking and idle animations while in water. If they jump, they will sink down in the body of water before slowly floating back up. The Water Walking Potion can only be used once before being fully consumed, and its effect does not stack. When used, the Water Walking Potion also emits a blue cloud effect at the player's feet. It is similar to the cloud effect that appears when the Levitation Potion is consumed, except it is a different color.

wiki.availability: The Witch's Caravan is a limited legendary three-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 20, 2020. It was obtainable from the first page of the Star Rewards, requiring 600 Stars to unlock. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on September 11, 2026 when the Star Rewards were revamped.
wiki.notes: The Witch's Caravan appears to be a cart belonging to a merchant or a hawker. Its main body is light brown in color, with some additional parts in darker brown. Both colors are presumably meant to symbolize wood. The caravan notably features two rockets boosters strapped to its side, which are similar to those found in the Rocket Sled. Both of the rockets are connected to the cart with vines. While the shape of these rockets is similar to those of the Rocket Sled, their colors are different, consisting of a transparent piece (inside of which is a glowing orange piece), a black piece, and conclude with a purple piece as the tip. It also has three potion decorations on the top. There are three seats in the Witch's Caravan, including two passenger seats. One passenger seat is a wooden bedside cabinet, and the second one is on the roof along with the potions. The driver's seat is a wooden chair located in front of the cabinet. The Witch's Caravan has four brown wheels, which appear to resemble the wheels of a typical carriage. They somewhat resemble a shrunken version of the wheels found on the Pumpkin Carriage. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.
