wiki.availability: The Wizard Caravan is a limited legendary four-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on March 31, 2022, as part of the 2022 Gift Refresh Update. It could have been obtained by opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, or 499, respectively. As it left the game on May 10, 2024, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Wizard Caravan features a magenta arch decorated with curved yellow edges and details; it has a dark purple base with yellow sides, four gray wheels with yellow axles, magenta seats, and a large green and magenta-striped hat on its top. The hat has a giant magenta ribbon with a yellow tie. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Wizard Hat is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 750 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Wizard Hat is a dark purple hat with lavender stars as a design and a reflective gleam at the tip of the hat. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head. The Wizard Hat has 2 counterparts, the Witch Hat and Bewitched Hat which both bear a similar appearance.

wiki.availability: The Wolf is a limited uncommon pet that was added to Adopt Me! on December 14, 2019, as a part of the 2019 Christmas Event. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by trading or by hatching any remaining Christmas Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 33% chance of hatching an uncommon pet from the Christmas Egg. The Wolf's fur shows certain similarities to the fur of the Australian Kelpie. Due to the Wolf's two-toned color scheme, its underbelly, feet, and bottom part of its head are light gray. The Wolf has two black, beady eyes and a black nose. The inner ears of the Wolf are light gray and surrounded by its smoky gray fur. Here are the tricks the Wolf learns in order: The Neon Wolf glows light-blue on its chest, belly, inner ears, chin, tail, and feet. The Mega Neon Wolf glows in the same areas as the Neon Wolf, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.addedEvent: It was available in the Halloween Shop of the Halloween Event (2022)
wiki.availability: The Wolf Box is a limited legendary gift in Adopt Me!. It was available in the Halloween Shop of the Halloween Event (2022) for 14,000. Upon opening the box, players will either receive a Ghost Wolf at an 87.5% chance, Zombie Wolf at a 10% chance, or Lava Wolf at a 2.5% chance. As the event ended on November 3, 2022, the Wolf Box can now only be obtained by trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Wolf Box features dark gray edges, a dark purple inside, several light gray chains on its sides, and three glowing orange scratch marks along the front.

wiki.availability: The Wolpertinger is a limited common pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 19, 2021, along with the Mythic Egg. As it has now left the game, the Wolpertinger can only be obtained through trading or by opening any remaining Mythic Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 22% chance of hatching a common pet from the Mythic Egg. The Wolpertinger has a brown body with a cream-colored underbelly, two dark brown antlers, a black nose, black beady eyes, light gray fangs, brown wings, and two brown ears with cream-colored insides. Here are the tricks the Wolpertinger learns in order: The Neon Wolpertinger glows white on its chest and neck fur and inside its ears. The Mega Neon Wolpertinger glows in the same areas as the Neon Wolpertinger, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Wood Pigeon is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 23, 2023, along with the Spring Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Springfest Shop for 60,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Wood Pigeon features a gray body with a cream colored underbelly, and two gray wings with white underfeathers. It has a yellow beak with white detailing around it, and a white collar. It also has two cream colored feet and two black eyes. Listed below are the tricks the Wood Pigeon learns in order. The Neon Wood Pigeon glows blue on the white detailing on its neck, wings, and beak, underbelly, and feet. The Mega Neon Wood Pigeon glows in the same areas as the Neon Wood Pigeon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Wood Pigeon Sticker is a limited uncommon sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 25, 2025, alongside week 4 of the Cherry Blossom Festival (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Cherry Blossom 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Wood Pigeon Sticker features a cartoon Wood Pigeon.

wiki.availability: The Wood Scooter is a limited uncommon single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released in 2018. It could have been obtained by opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, or 499, respectively. As the Gifts were updated with new items, the Wood Scooter can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Wood Scooter features a brown scooter that appears to have a wood-like texture for its base. It has a long black rod with black handles; these black handles have a white strip between them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Wood Skateboard is a limited uncommon single-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released in 2018. It could have been obtained by opening Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, or 499, respectively. As the Gifts were updated with new items, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Wood Skateboard features a brown base with a wood-like texture. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Wooden Pan Flute is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts respectively. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: When a player clicks their screen with the Wooden Pan Flute equipped, it will play one of several tunes. The player cannot choose which one is played.

wiki.availability: The Wooden Pogo is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that could be obtained from an old gifts rotation, but is no longer available and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Wooden Pogo is a dark brown color. The handles are a slightly lighter brown color while the footrest is a light tan color. As it is a pogo stick, it provides transportation by bouncing instead of walking.

wiki.availability: The Wooden Spoon Toy is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on May 10, 2024, as part of the 2024 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70 or 199 from Small or Big Gifts. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Wooden Spoon Toy features a dark wooden spoon with a long, thin handle. When interacted with, the player throws the Wooden Spoon Toy, and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. The pet holds it in its mouth until the player picks up the item. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Wooden Sword is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on November 30, 2023, as part of the Winter Festival (2023). It was purchasable in the Winter Village for 850. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Wooden Sword features a dark brown, pointed wooden blade and guard, with a light brown hilt. When a player clicks their screen with the Wooden Sword equipped, it is swung down towards the ground.

wiki.availability: The Woodland Cradle Stroller is a limited ultra-rare stroller in Adopt Me! that was released on March 31, 2022, as part of the 2022 Gift Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70, 199, or 499 from Small, Big, or Massive Gifts, respectively. As it is no longer in the current Gifts rotation, it can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Woodland Cradle Stroller features a purple seat with white edges, two purple wheels with green designs, white strings connecting the seat to the upper frame, and a brown arch that serves as the upper frame. This item can transport one pet or baby at a time and can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Woodland Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on March 17, 2022, replacing the Mythic Egg. It was obtainable by purchasing it from the Gumball Machine in the Nursery for 750. It was replaced by the Japan Egg on September 8, 2022, and is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Woodland Egg is similar to the Pet Egg in appearance, except that it has a lime green gradient and a few sage-colored spots at the top. It twirls inside a nest featuring a few twigs, green leaves, and a few mushrooms. The egg also features additional mushrooms protruding out of the top.

wiki.availability: The Woodpecker is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 17, 2022, along with the Woodland Egg. As it has now left the game, it is only obtainable by trading with other players or by hatching any remaining Woodland Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 34% chance of hatching a rare pet from the Woodland Egg, but only a 17% chance of hatching a Woodpecker. The Woodpecker features a white bird with a pair of black wings. It has red and black markings on its head, as well as two beady black eyes, two black feet, and a yellow beak. Here are the tricks the Woodpecker learns in order: The Neon Woodpecker glows lime green on its feet, head, and inner wings. The Mega Neon Woodpecker glows in the same areas as the Neon Woodpecker, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Wool Beard is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on December 19, 2020. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 250 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Wool Beard features a brown beard and mustache with a wool-like texture. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's face.

wiki.availability: The Woolly Mammoth is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2020, along with the Fossil Egg. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained by trading or hatching any remaining Fossil Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 25% chance of hatching a rare pet from the Fossil Egg, but only an 8.33% chance of hatching a Woolly Mammoth. The Woolly Mammoth features a light reddish-brown body with a darker layer of fur on top. It has a tuft of dark reddish-brown fur on the top of its head and large ears with pink insides. It also has two black eyes and a brown trunk on its face. Two large white tusks can be seen protruding out of its mouth. Listed below are the tricks the Woolly Mammoth learns in order: The Neon Woolly Mammoth glows light red on its inner ears, tusks, feet, and tail. The Mega Neon Woolly Mammoth glows in the same areas as the Neon Woolly Mammoth, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Woolly Mammoth Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 26, 2024, as part of the Fossil Isle Excavation (2024). As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through unboxing any remaining Fossil Sticker Packs or through trading.
wiki.notes: The Woolly Mammoth Sticker features a cartoon Woolly Mammoth.

wiki.availability: The Woolly Rhino is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 29, 2022, alongside week five of the Winter Event (2022). It could have been purchased in the Candy Castle for 80,000. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on January 5, 2023.
wiki.notes: The Woolly Rhino features a fluffy, dark brown body, tail, head, ears, and feet. It has a beige coat around its neck, fur on the tip of its tail, beige ear insides and tip of nose, and two horns (a long one and short one) that protrude down its face. Listed below are the tricks the Woolly Rhino learns in order: The Neon Woolly Rhino glows hot pink on its tail, horns, inner ears, and the fur around its neck. The Mega Neon Woolly Rhino glows in the same areas as the Neon Wooly Rhino, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Worm Farm Grappling Hook is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It can be opened from Small, Big, and Massive Gifts, which cost 70, 199, and 499 respectively. It can otherwise be obtained through opening Admin Abuse Boxes or trading.
wiki.notes: To interact with this item, a player can click anywhere on their screen to fire a brown cable that allows them to be pulled towards their target location. Like other grappling hooks, players cannot use this item on non-solid graphical objects, if they are on a vehicle, doing an obby, flying or riding a pet.

wiki.availability: The Wrapped Doll is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on July 27, 2023. Players could purchase it for 900 at a stand outside of the Nursery. The Wrapped Doll is no longer available and can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: Players can obtain River, Dylan, or Pistachio from the Wrapped Doll. The Wrapped Doll features blue wrapping paper with white polka dots to form the shape of a doll. There is a red ribbon tied around it and a tag hanging off the ribbon.

wiki.availability: The Wrapping Paper Throw Toy is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on November 30, 2023, along with the Winter Festival (2023). It was purchasable for 300. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Wrapping Paper Throw Toy features a roll of red wrapping paper with green Christmas trees scattered along the surface. When interacted with, the Wrapping Paper Throw Toy is thrown and the player's equipped pet will fetch it and bring it back to them. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Wreath Flying Disc (formerly known as Wreath Frisbee) is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 21, 2019, as part of the 2019 Advent Calendar.
wiki.notes: It could have been obtained from day twenty-one from the 2019 Advent Calendar during the Christmas Event (2019). Since this day has passed, the Wreath Flying Disc is now only obtainable through trading. The Wreath Flying Disc features a green wreath with a variety of decorations. The decorations include a red bow on top, red ribbons, red ornaments, two yellow bells on the bottom, and small yellow lights. As it's a flying disc, this toy is meant to be thrown, where the player's equipped pet would fetch the Wreath Flying Disc and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Wreath Flying Disc (formerly known as Wreath Frisbee) is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 21, 2019, as part of the 2019 Advent Calendar.
wiki.notes: It could have been obtained from day twenty-one from the 2019 Advent Calendar during the Christmas Event (2019). Since this day has passed, the Wreath Flying Disc is now only obtainable through trading. The Wreath Flying Disc features a green wreath with a variety of decorations. The decorations include a red bow on top, red ribbons, red ornaments, two yellow bells on the bottom, and small yellow lights. As it's a flying disc, this toy is meant to be thrown, where the player's equipped pet would fetch the Wreath Flying Disc and bring it back to the player. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Wreath Necklace is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on December 14, 2023, as part of the Winter Festival (2023). It was obtainable by claiming it from the event's Advent Calendar on day fourteen. Since its day has passed, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Wreath Necklace features a green wreath with red and yellow ornaments around the surface. This pet accessory goes around a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Wren is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 1, 2025. Players could have purchased it in front of the Nursery for 1,400. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on August 8, 2025. One Wren was given to players for free if they joined the game during the first day after its release, and could be claimed from the mailbox outside of their house.
wiki.notes: Here are the tricks the Wren learns in order: The Neon Wren glows golden yellow on its beak, facial and chest markings, and wing detailing. The Mega Neon Wren glows in the same areas as the Neon Wren, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Wrench Chew Toy is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It could have been purchased for 70 or 199 from Small or Big Gifts. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026 and is no longer part of the Gifts rotation.
wiki.notes: When interacted with, the player throws the Wrench Chew Toy, and the player's equipped pet will fetch it. The pet holds it in its mouth until the player picks up the item. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Writing Brush is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 1.7% and 0.6% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On April 20, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Writing Brush was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Writing Brush features a paintbrush with a maroon handle, yellow brush piece, and a beige brush. There is black paint on the brush. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Wyvern is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 19, 2021, along with the Mythic Egg. As it has left the game, it can now only be obtained through trading or by hatching any remaining Mythic Eggs.
wiki.notes: Players have a 20% chance of hatching an ultra-rare from the Mythic Egg, but only a 10% chance of hatching a Wyvern. The Wyvern features a light green underbelly, broad, dark-green wings, and a long light green tail tipped with a sharp spade. It also has two sharp thorn-looking horns on its head. Listed below are the tricks the Wyvern learns in order: The Neon Wyvern glows white on its underbelly, wings, and spikes. The Mega Neon Wyvern glows in the same areas as the Neon Wyvern, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Xmas Carousel Propeller is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 16, 2023, as part of the Winter Festival (2023). It was obtainable by claiming it from the event's Advent Calendar on day sixteen. Since its day has passed, it is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Xmas Carousel Propeller features eight brown blades with yellow tips, a brown handle, and a yellow grip. To interact with this toy, a player can click or press their screen to be propelled upward; they can press the spacebar or the jump button to stop.

wiki.availability: The Xmas Tree Rattle is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 5, 2023, as part of the Winter Festival (2023). It was obtainable by claiming it from the event's Advent Calendar on day five. Since its day has passed, the Xmas Tree Rattle is now only obtainable through trading.
wiki.notes: The Xmas Tree Rattle features a small pine tree with green leaves and a brown handle. Being a rattle, the Xmas Tree Rattle only shakes when interacted with.

wiki.availability: The Y2K Shades are limited ultra-rare pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on August 22, 2025, as part of the 2025 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. They could have been obtained by purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. As they were removed from the game on January 30, 2026, they can only be obtained through trading.

wiki.egg: Headless Horseman's Grab Bag, The Hauntlet, Sleep or Treat, Admin Abuse
wiki.availability: The Yarn Apple is a limited ultra-rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on October 3, 2025, alongside the Halloween Event (2025). Players were able to obtain it through picking an item from the Headless Horseman's Grab Bag, which could be done for free every 10 minutes. There was an 8% chance of receiving one Yarn Apple, and a 2% chance of receiving three Yarn Apples from the Headless Horseman's Grab Bag. It could also be earned through reaching room 50 of The Hauntlet minigame, as a rare reward from the Sleep or Treat minigame, and upon joining the game for the first time after the event's release. A free Yarn Apple was rewarded to all players who participated in Admin Abuse on November 1, 2025. The Yarn Apple could otherwise be obtained through purchasing a bundle of 5 of 250. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on November 3, 2025.
wiki.notes: During the Halloween Event (2025), players were able to gain 5-10% progress on taming a Kitty Bat when using a Yarn Apple. After the event ended, the Yarn Apple was changed to serve the purpose of a throw toy. When interacted with, the player throws the Yarn Apple, and their equipped pet will fetch it. The pet holds it in its mouth until the player picks up the item. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus. This pet was obtainable from the Yarn Apple.

wiki.availability: The Yarn Ball Earrings are limited uncommon pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on August 11, 2022. They can be found and purchased in the Fall Shop for 150 when the Fall Weather is active, or be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Yarn Ball Earrings feature a pair of orange yarn balls with purple pins stuck in them, attached to gray hooks. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's ears or on the sides of its head.

wiki.availability: The Yarn Ball Toy is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on September 29, 2022, as part of the Accessory Chests Revamp update. It could have been obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Regal Chest for 300 or the Standard Chest for 105; players had a 2.9% and 8.6% chance of getting it from these gifts, respectively.
wiki.notes: On April 20, 2023, the Regal Chest and Standard Chest were updated to contain new items, and the Yarn Ball Toy was removed from the game. This pet accessory can now only be obtained through trading. The Yarn Ball Toy features an orange ball of yarn with a loose end sticking out. It bears a similar appearance to the Yarn Ball Earrings, which feature similar orange yarn balls. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Yarn Beanie was a temporary rare food in Adopt Me! that was released on December 12, 2025, alongside week two of the Winter Event (2025). Players had a 12.5% chance to earn it from event minigames, and could receive one for completing their daily tasks. It was also obtainable through trading, and a bundle of 10 Yarn Beanies was purchasable for 250. It left the game on January 5, 2026, and all remaining copies of this item were later changed into the Yarn Beanie pet accessory on January 16, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Yarn Beanie features a red beanie with a knitted texture topped with a red pom-pom. It bears the same appearance as its pet accessory counterpart. During the Winter Event (2025), players could use a Yarn Beanie to gain 5-10% progress on taming a Snowball Pug. The progress gained depended on how well they timed their throw in the taming minigame: if their throw landed on the highlighted area in the middle, they would gain 10% taming progress. If not, they would get 5% taming progress. This pet was obtainable from the Yarn Beanie.

wiki.availability: The Yellow 5 Panel Cap is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 11, 2020. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 250 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Yellow 5 Panel Cap features a yellow cap with a black brim and a black label. There is a gray paw print on the black label. Several stitches can be seen on the cap. This pet accessory goes on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Yellow Beanie is a limited uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 250 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Yellow Beanie features a yellow beanie with vertical stripes that are a darker shade of yellow. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Yellow Butterfly is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 4, 2022. It could have been obtained through buying a Leaf for 899 within the Butterfly Sanctuary. As the Butterfly Sanctuary has left the game, it can now only be obtained by using any remaining Leaves or through trading. Players have a 60% chance of obtaining a Yellow Butterfly from the Leaf.
wiki.notes: The Yellow Butterfly features light yellow wings with darker decorative lines throughout them. It has a brown body with beady black eyes and two long antennae. Here are the tricks the Yellow Butterfly learns in order: The Neon Yellow Butterfly glows yellow on its antennae, the outer lines, and webbed lines on its wings. The Mega Neon Yellow Butterfly glows in the same areas as the Neon Yellow Butterfly, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Yellow Cap is a limited common pet accessory in Adopt Me! that could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 150 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Yellow Cap features a yellow baseball cap with a small black paw print on the brim. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's head.

wiki.availability: The Yellow Designer Backpack is an uncommon pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2020. It can be purchased in the Accessory Shop for 300. It can otherwise be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Yellow Designer Backpack is a yellow backpack with a black bow on the front of it. There is a black label and a black zipper as well. This pet accessory is worn on a pet's back.

wiki.availability: The Yellow Instant Camera is a limited rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on August 22, 2020. It could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 500 when on rotation. It can now only be obtained through trading, as it left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Yellow Instant Camera is a pastel yellow camera with a black strap that resembles an Instax Mini instant camera. It has a variety of details on the front, including the lens, shutter button, viewfinder, and flash. This pet accessory is worn around a pet's neck.

wiki.availability: The Yellow Pogostick is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on June 6, 2025, alongside the return of the Butterfly Sanctuary. It could have been purchased for 100. It is now only obtainable through trading, as it left the game on June 13, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Yellow Pogostick serves no purpose aside from being a fun pogo stick to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Yellow Sneakers are limited common pet accessories in Adopt Me! that were released on August 18, 2020. They could have been purchased in the Accessory Shop for 150 when on rotation. They can now only be obtained through trading, as they left the game on January 30, 2026.
wiki.notes: The Yellow Sneakers feature yellow sneakers with white soles, white laces, and a white pawprint on the sides of each shoe. These pet accessories are worn on a pet's feet.

wiki.availability: The Yellow Taxi Cab is a limited legendary four-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on February 17, 2022. It could be obtained through purchasing the Taxi Driver Bundle for 300. On April 24, 2026, the Taxi Driver Bundle was added to the Final Stop Shop and discounted to 210 before leaving the game on May 1, 2026. The Yellow Taxi Cab can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Yellow Taxi Cab features a yellow body with black-and-white checkered patterns along the sides of the car. It has a round gray grille, a taxi sign mounted on the roof with a black paw print, four gray wheels with black rims, and circular headlights. The Yellow Taxi Cab allows players to transport others to one of the destinations available for a fee of anything between 0 and 20. There is no way for other players to access the vehicle without requesting a ride. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Yellow-lipped Sea Krait is a limited uncommon pet in Adopt Me! that was released on March 2, 2023. As it is now unavailable, it can only be obtained through hatching any remaining Southeast Asia Eggs or through trading.
wiki.notes: Players have a 25% chance of hatching an uncommon pet from a Southeast Asia Egg, but only a 12.5% chance of hatching a Yellow-lipped Sea Krait. The Yellow-lipped Sea Krait has a long yellow body with a white underside. It has black stripes throughout its body and on its head, and black beady eyes. Here are the tricks the Yellow-lipped Sea Krait learns in order: The Neon Yellow-lipped Sea Krait glows yellowish-orange on its underbelly, stripes, and part of its head. The Mega Neon Yellow-lipped Sea Krait glows in the same areas as the Neon Yellow-lipped Sea Krait, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Yeti is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on December 15, 2020, as part of the Winter Holiday (2020). It could have been obtained by purchasing it in the Snow Castle for 6,000. As the event ended on January 19, 2021, the Yeti is now only obtainable through trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Yeti features a large white body with layers of fur. It has blue arms, feet, and face. It has two big black eyes and a light blue, oval-shaped nose. The Yeti also has two light blue horns on top of its head, which are the same color as its claws and nose. Here are the tricks the Yeti learns in order: The Neon Yeti glows a light yellow-orange color on its horns, claws, and feet. The Mega Neon Yeti glows in the same areas as the Neon Yeti, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Yeti Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on January 3, 2025, alongside the fifth week of the Winter Festival (2024). It can now only be obtained through trading or unboxing any remaining Winter 2024 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000 until January 17, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Yeti Sticker features a cartoon Yeti.

wiki.availability: The Yule Log Chew Toy is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released on December 7, 2023, as part of the second week of the Winter Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it in the Winter Village for 450. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Yule Log Chew Toy features a brown yule log with white in the inside, with a holly on top of it. Being a chew toy, the player will throw the Yule Log Chew Toy when interacted with, where their equipped pet would fetch it and hold it with its mouth until the pet is interacted with. This item can be used to fulfill the 'catch' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Yule Log Dog is a limited legendary pet in Adopt Me! that was added to the game on April 1, 2023, as a part of the 2023 April Fools update. As the event has ended, it is now only obtainable through trading or by hatching remaining Fool Eggs.
wiki.notes: There is a 10% chance of hatching a Yule Log Dog from a Fool Egg. The Yule Log Dog features a cylindrical brown pet with swirls of white near its middle. It has holly leaves and berries on its head, two black eyes, a holly resembling its tongue and a red nose. It has a white back and a small tail. It is based on a Yule Log. Here are the tricks the Yule Log Dog learns in order: The Neon Yule Log Dog glows orange on its ears, the swirl of cream on its front and back, its tongue, and its feet. The Mega Neon Yule Log Dog glows in the same areas as the Neon Yule Log Dog, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Yule Log Dog Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on August 1, 2024. It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Pets Plus Sticker Packs, which were received when purchasing the Pets Plus subscription for 299, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Yule Log Dog Sticker features a cartoon Yule Log Dog.

wiki.availability: The Yule Log Pogo Stick is a limited rare toy in Adopt Me! that was released on November 30, 2023. It was released along with the Winter Festival (2023). It was obtainable by purchasing it for 4,700. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: It serves no other purpose aside from being a fun pogo stick to jump around on.

wiki.availability: The Yule Log Treat is a limited common food item in Adopt Me! that was released on December 2, 2024. It could have been claimed on day two of the 2024 Advent Calendar, which was released as a part of the Winter Festival (2024). As its day has passed, the Yule Log Treat can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Yule Log Treat can be used to fulfill the 'Hunger' ailment for babies and pets, taking three uses to fully consume. The Yule Log Treat features a dark brown rolled cake topped with white frosting.

wiki.availability: The Zamboni is a limited ultra-rare four-seater vehicle in Adopt Me! that was released on January 6, 2022. It could be purchased from a wooden pedestal beside the Hot Air Balloon for 2,500. The Zamboni left the game on January 20, 2022, and can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Zamboni features a light-gray truck with a storage container at the front; this container has large gray paw prints on the sides and a large black grille right at the curved front. It has four wheels with light-gray rims, with the front wheels being smaller and the rear wheels. The back consists of two brown seats and a triangular shaped bottom. This item can be used to fulfill the 'ride' ailment on pets. When specifically requested by a pet for this ailment, it provides a 3x Bucks and XP bonus.

wiki.availability: The Zebra is a rare pet that was released in Adopt Me! on July 21, 2022. Players are able to hatch it from the Pet Egg, Cracked Egg, Royal Egg, Basic Egg, Crystal Egg, or Admin Abuse Egg. It can otherwise be obtained through trading. New players were able to obtain it for 8 Keys, being able to earn one each day by logging in and doing special tasks on the Task Board until the Task Board Revamp Update on November 14, 2025.
wiki.notes: The Zebra has a white body lined with black stripes. It has black hooves, a black snout, and a black tail. The insides of its ears are a purple color. Listed below are the tricks the Zebra learns in order: The Neon Zebra glows cyan on its snout, the end of its tail, its feet, and on all of its stripes. The Mega Neon Zebra glows in the same areas as the Neon Zebra, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Zebra Backpack is a limited ultra-rare pet accessory in Adopt Me! that was released on January 30, 2026, as part of the 2026 Gift and Accessory Refresh Update. It is obtainable through purchasing and opening the Regal Chest for 300, or the Standard Chest for 105. It is otherwise obtainable through opening Admin Abuse Boxes, purchasing it for 4,500 when it is on rotation in the Accessory Shop, or trading.
The Zebra Sticker is a rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on April 19, 2024, as part of the Player Profiles Update.
wiki.notes: It can be obtained through purchasing and unboxing the Standard Sticker Pack for 250; players have a 17% chance of getting it from this sticker pack. The Zebra Sticker can also be obtained through trading with other players. The Zebra Sticker features a black and white cartoon Zebra.

wiki.availability: The Zeopod is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on February 7, 2025, alongside the Moon Egg. It can now only be obtained through hatching any remaining Moon Eggs or Royal Moon Eggs, or through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 12% chance of hatching a Zeopod from the Moon Egg, and a 17% chance of hatching it from the Royal Moon Egg. Here are the tricks the Zeopod learns in order: The Neon Zeopod glows lime green on its head, underbelly, back spikes, and around its eyes. The Mega Neon Zeopod glows in the same areas as the Neon Zeopod, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Zodiac Minion Chick is a limited legendary pet that was added to Adopt Me! on June 16, 2022. It can be obtained through hatching a Zodiac Minion Egg; Gru, an NPC, tasked players to hatch this egg. As the event has ended, it can only be obtained through trading or by hatching any remaining Zodiac Minion Eggs.
wiki.notes: The Zodiac Minion Chick features a yellow chick with a capsule-shaped body. It has two round orange feet, a yellow tuft on its head, and a pointed beak. It wears a single-piece set of goggles with dark blue lenses and a black band; a single black eye can be seen below these goggles. Here are the tricks the Zodiac Minion Chick learns in order: The Neon Zodiac Minion Chick glows yellow on its tufts, beak, wings, and feet. The Mega Neon Zodiac Minion Chick glows in the same areas as the Neon Zodiac Minion Chick, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Zodiac Minion Egg is a limited legendary egg in Adopt Me! that was released on June 16, 2022. The Zodiac Minion Egg was only available for two weeks. It could be obtained by visiting Gru's Lab near the Playground and interacting with Gru, an NPC. Now that the event has ended, the Zodiac Minion Egg can only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The only pet players can hatch from the Zodiac Minion Egg is the Zodiac Minion Chick. The Zodiac Minion Egg features a smooth peach-colored egg. It features the same mesh as the Pet Egg, Pink Egg, and Blue Egg, but is different in color.

wiki.availability: The Zombie Buffalo is a limited ultra-rare pet that was added to Adopt Me! on October 18, 2019, as a part of the first addition of the Halloween Event (2019). It cost 36,000. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading with other players.
wiki.notes: The Zombie Buffalo has a mint green body with a brown overcoat. It has a mint green head and medium-sized white horns. Its front legs are brown, and the back legs are plain white. It also has a tail that looks as if a bone is sticking out. Here are the tricks the Zombie Buffalo learns in order: The Neon Zombie Buffalo glows bright red on its eyes and nose. The Mega Neon Zombie Buffalo glows in the same areas as the Neon Zombie Buffalo, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Zombie Buffalo Plush is a limited uncommon toy in Adopt Me! that was released along with the Halloween Event (2018). Players could have purchased it at the Halloween Shop for 150. As the event has ended, the Zombie Buffalo Plush can now only be obtained through trading.
wiki.notes: The Zombie Buffalo Plush features a mint green body with a brown mane. It has a green head and medium-sized white horns. The front legs are brown and the back legs are white with a whitetail. To interact with the Zombie Buffalo Plush, the player can click on their screen to hug it.

wiki.availability: The Zombie Chick is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 18, 2024, alongside the third week of the Halloween Event (2024). As the event has ended, players can only obtain the Zombie Chick by opening any remaining Halloween Chick Boxes or through trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 70% chance of obtaining the Zombie Chick from the Halloween Chick Box. The Zombie Chick features a Caribbean green body and a pair of wings, jungle green feet and beak, a pair of two black eyes with dull green circles around, an exposed part of the ribcage on its chest, and another exposed part of the skull at the back of its head. Here are the tricks the Zombie Chick learns in order: The Neon Zombie Chick glows green on its wings, feet, around its eyes, and on its exposed skull. The Mega Neon Zombie Chick glows in the same areas as the Neon Zombie Chick, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Zombie Chick Sticker is a limited rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 10, 2025, alongside the second week of the Halloween Event (2025). It is now only obtainable through opening any remaining Halloween 2025 Sticker Packs, which were purchasable for 1,000, or trading.
wiki.notes: The Zombie Chick Sticker features a cartoon Zombie Chick.

wiki.availability: The Zombie Finger Rattle is a limited common toy in Adopt Me! that was released along with the Halloween Event (2022) on October 6, 2022. Players could obtain the Zombie Finger Rattle by purchasing it for 500. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained by trading.
wiki.notes: The Zombie Finger Rattle features a green finger with a white bone on its bottom and a dark green nail. Like other rattles, this toy can be interacted with by clicking to shake it back and forth.

wiki.availability: The Zombie Wolf is a limited ultra-rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on October 20, 2022. There is a 10% chance of obtaining this pet from a Wolf Box, which players were able to buy for 14,000 inside the Halloween Shop of the Halloween Event (2022). As the event has ended, it is now only obtainable through trading or by opening any remaining Wolf Boxes.
wiki.notes: The Zombie Wolf features a light-green body, feet, ears, and upper face with lighter ear insides and snout. Its nose and feet are dark green. It has two black eyes, bits of fur sticking out of the sides of its face, a white bone on its ear, and a visible white ribcage. These are the tricks the Zombie Wolf learns in order: The Neon Zombie Wolf glows light yellow on the inside of its ears, its feet, and the fur under its snout. The Mega Neon Zombie Wolf glows in the same areas as the Neon Zombie Wolf, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Zombie Wolf Sticker is a limited ultra-rare sticker in Adopt Me! that was released on October 25, 2024, alongside the fourth week of the Halloween Event (2024). As the event has ended and the Día De Los Muertos Event (2024) wagon has closed, it can only be obtained through opening any remaining Halloween 2024 Sticker Packs or trading.
wiki.notes: The Zombie Wolf Sticker features a cartoon Zombie Wolf.

wiki.availability: The Granny Wolf is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 29, 2026, alongside the Fairytale Egg. It is obtainable through hatching Fairytale Eggs for 750, Basic Eggs for 400, Crystal Eggs for 4,000, Admin Abuse Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 10% chance of hatching the Granny Wolf from the Fairytale Egg. Here are the tricks the Granny Wolf learns in order: The Neon Granny Wolf glows yellow on its bonnet, underside, and on the bottom of its apron. The Mega Neon Granny Wolf glows in the same areas as the Neon Granny Wolf, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

wiki.availability: The Granny Wolf is a limited rare pet in Adopt Me! that was released on August 29, 2026, alongside the Fairytale Egg. It is obtainable through hatching Fairytale Eggs for 750, Basic Eggs for 400, Crystal Eggs for 4,000, Admin Abuse Eggs, or trading.
wiki.notes: There is a 10% chance of hatching the Granny Wolf from the Fairytale Egg.
